gist: Music, then a warm welcome and thanks to everyone for coming and joining the class.
He says they will pick up last week's unfinished class and see how far it gets this time.
He explains that these classes are not a planned course; the stories go wherever the situation of the day takes them.

hindi: जीवन कायदे से इसी प्रकार चलता है हम कहते हैं चलाना चाहिए पर वो चलता है बहुत कुछ स्वतः होता है
says: Life really runs on its own track: we say we should steer it, but it moves by itself and a great deal happens automatically, without our doing. This is the opening premise for fate and the birth map.
ambiguity: 'चलाना चाहिए' (we should run it) is taken as our wish to control life. How much is automatic and how much is choice is not quantified.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the idea that much of life is set by prarabdha karma is classical. The wording is his own and gives no rule.

hindi: जब हम पैदा होते हैं तो हमारे पैदा होने के पश्चात ऑटोमेटिक ऐसा नक्शा हमारे जीवन का बन जाता है जैसे पैदा होने पर ग्रहों की पोजीशन अंतरिक्ष में होती है
says: When we are born, a map of our life forms automatically, and that map is the positions of the planets in space at the moment of birth. The birth chart is the life map.
ambiguity: He does not say which chart system or which birth moment (first breath or first cry) is meant.
classical_check: Agrees: the natal chart as a map of life drawn from the planets' positions at birth is the foundation of Jyotish.

gist: He notes that many people do not accept this and dismiss astrology as a useless thing.
He says we do not accept what we do not know: many reject God because they do not know Him, and the sentence goes on into the next slice.
The same point for Vastu: many people reject it only because they do not know it.
He says that once a person comes face to face with real knowing, the situation turns and he comes to believe.

hindi: जब तक समय अच्छा चल रहा है यानी आपके पुण्य का घड़ा बढ़िया है तब तक आपके जीवन में सफलता मिलती है
says: As long as your time is running well, meaning your pot of merit (punya) is in good shape, success keeps coming in life. Good periods are the visible result of stored merit.
ambiguity: He does not say how the merit pot is read in a chart. Classically the 5th and 9th houses carry past merit, but he does not name them here.
classical_check: Agrees in idea: purva punya and the link between merit and good periods is classical, usually read from the 5th and 9th houses and their lords.

gist: He says that when a person starts getting beaten by life, he automatically runs towards spirituality, occult science, para-science and astrology.

hindi: अब चूंकि दुख के समय से निकला होता तो शुरू में उसकी पिटाई होती है शुरू में उ गलत डॉक्टर मिलेगा गलत ज्योतिषी गलत वास्तु स्पेशलिस्ट गलत तांत्रिक फत्र सब मिलेगा
says: A person coming out of a bad period gets beaten further at the start: first he will meet the wrong doctor, the wrong astrologer, the wrong Vastu specialist and the wrong tantrik, all of them, before he finds the right help.
ambiguity: 'चूंकि दुख के समय से निकला होता' is garbled and is read as 'since he has come out of a time of sorrow'. 'फत्र' is a caption slip for 'वगैरह' (and so on).
classical_check: Silent: this is an observation about the early phase of seeking help, not a chart rule.

gist: He says that in a new place people suddenly turn stingy: they do not want to give time or money, and following instructions feels hard.
He says many people insist on scanning first whether the doctor is right before they follow anything.
He argues that the mind you use to judge a person from another field knows nothing about that field, so you can never really scan or test a practitioner beforehand.

hindi: आपको फॉलो करना पड़ेगा पिटना पड़ेगा बर्बाद होना पड़ेगा कोटा कटेगा आपके दुखों का कोटा कटने के बाद सब सुधरेगा
says: You will have to follow the practitioner, get beaten and even be ruined, because each person has a quota of sorrow that must be used up. Once the quota of sorrows is cut down, everything improves.
ambiguity: 'सब सुधरेगा' runs across the slice boundary; the first word of the next slice finishes it. 'Ruined' is rhetorical, not a prediction for any person.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the idea that a fixed stock of karma is exhausted through experience is classical (prarabdha). The 'quota of sorrows' wording is his own.

gist: He starts a case: a girl wants a divorce from her husband but will not give him one, because she has no other man lined up.
He relays her worry: she wants her future assured first, with someone beside her tomorrow, whether he brings joy or sorrow.
She asked what to do and, after all the going back and forth, five years had already passed.

hindi: तो मैंने बताया कि भैया 10 साल तुम्हारे और बीतें ऐसे रोपिट के हर साल एक किलो दुख तुम्हें भुगे क्योंकि समय कट रहा है धीरे-धीरे लेकिन टाइम पास हो रहा है
says: In that case he told her that if ten more years pass like this, crying, she will bear one kilo of sorrow every year, because time is only being passed slowly, not used.
ambiguity: He gives no chart or planet for this case; it is life advice drawn from his general view. 'रोपिट' is a caption slip, likely 'रो-पीट' (crying and wailing).
classical_check: Silent: this is counselling for one case, not a Jyotish rule. It is personal advice and should not be read as a prediction.

hindi: तो क्या करें 10 किलो दुख आएगा तलाक लो खत्म करो दोबारा फ्रेश होगी लाइफ स्टार्ट समय बचेगा
says: His advice in that case: ten kilos of sorrow will come if she waits, so take the divorce and finish it, start life fresh again, and the time will be saved.
ambiguity: This is advice given to one person about her marriage. No chart or planet is cited, so it is not a Jyotish rule.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text is behind it; it is his counselling view.

hindi: आप जितना बड़ा दुख भोगते हैं जितनी बड़ी चोट खाते हैं मन पर तन पर धन पर उतनी जल्दी ग्रह कंज्यूम होता है इसलिए फाइट मत करो
says: The bigger the sorrow you go through, the bigger the blow to mind, body and money, and the faster the planet is consumed (used up). So do not fight the trouble but live through it.
ambiguity: He names no planet here, and the next sentence gives the list. 'चोट' (blow) is a general hit, not a diagnosis of anything.
classical_check: Partly agrees: exhausting a malefic dasha or transit by living through it is a common idea, but 'do not fight' is his own advice and classical texts advise remedies.

hindi: जितनी जल्दी शनि राहु केतु यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो इन दैत्य ग्रहों को जल्दी भोग के खत्म कर लोगे उतनी जल्दी जीवन ठीक होगा
says: The sooner you live through and exhaust these demon planets, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, the sooner your life will come right. He groups the six as daitya (demon) planets whose debt is cleared by experiencing it.
cells_derived_method: The sentence names no house or sign. The area of life that is being exhausted follows the house each planet sits in (classical house topics), and the sign tints how it is lived through.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer) would be exhausted through home, mother and inner peace, a long and heavy squeeze that eases with discipline.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo) would be exhausted through career and status, with ambition and sudden swings at work until the turmoil is lived through.
Derived, not said by him: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries) would be exhausted through expenses, sleep and withdrawal, with the themes of loss and detachment lived through.

ambiguity: 'भोग के खत्म कर लोगे' means to experience fully and thereby finish; he does not give a time span. The 12-planet scheme is his, not the classical nine.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn, Rahu and Ketu are the natural malefics, while Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are not part of Parashari Jyotish. The 'daitya planets' grouping is his own.

hindi: बहुत भारी स्थिति के अंदर डॉक्टर सर्जरी करता है काट देता है यानी पूरे शरीर को बचा लिया जाता है
says: In a very serious condition a doctor operates and cuts something away so that the whole body can be saved. He uses surgery as the picture of giving up a part to protect the whole.
ambiguity: It is an analogy for bali and not a medical claim. The part to be cut is not named.
classical_check: Silent: an analogy of his own.

hindi: तो बलि देनी पड़ेगी यानी ये दैत्य ग्रह ऐसे हैं या राक्षस ग्रह ऐसे हैं जो बलि लेते हैं हमारे जीवन में
says: So a sacrifice has to be paid: these demon or rakshasa planets are the kind that take a bali from our life. The cut in the surgery picture is the price they demand.
cells_derived_method: The planets are not named in this sentence; the previous row's list is assumed. What is taken depends on the house the planet sits in and its sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 2nd house (lagna Sagittarius) would take its bali from family wealth and speech through slow, steady restriction.
Derived, not said by him: Pluto (Yama) in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries) would take the bali through sudden change and the loss of secrets, old ties or inheritance.
Derived, not said by him: Uranus in Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra) would take the bali through abrupt breaks in study, romance, children or creative plans.

ambiguity: 'ये' points back to the six planets of the previous sentence, which he does not repeat. 'बलि लेते हैं' is read as extracting a cost, not a literal offering.
classical_check: Differs: in Parashari Jyotish malefics give results of karma and remedies pacify them; the demand-for-sacrifice picture is his own.

gist: He sets up a question about what perfection means: what a perfect thing is, what a perfect life or a fit life would be.

hindi: फिट लाइफ का मतलब होता है आपकी लाइफ में जितना खाना खाया उतना ही मल उस हिसाब से बन गया
says: A fit life means balance between intake and outflow: as much food as you eat, that much waste is made. In life terms, what you take in must be matched by what goes out.
ambiguity: 'मल' (stool) is a crude image of balance between gain and loss, used as an analogy and not a health statement.
classical_check: Silent: a balance idea of his own.

gist: He says Rama, whom we take as God, is not a complete man, while Krishna is the complete man.
He lists what makes Krishna complete: runaway, rascal, lover, fighter, trickster, showman, clever and learned, all at once.

hindi: यानी आपके जीवन में पूर्णता चल रही है परफेक्ट लाइफ मींस आपका उतना ही नेगेटिव हो रहा है जितना पॉजिटिव
says: Completeness in life means a perfect life, and he defines that as having exactly as much negative happen as positive. A life with only good is not perfect; it is out of balance.
ambiguity: He does not say over what period the positive and negative must even out.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no rule that good and bad must balance within a life. It is his own law of balance.

hindi: अगर आपका पॉजिटिव ज्यादा हो रहा है तो आप बड़े नेगेटिव को तैयार रहो
says: If more positive than usual is happening to you, get ready for a big negative. A run of good fortune is a warning that a large setback is coming to restore the balance.
ambiguity: No timing is given for when the negative arrives, and no planet is named here.
classical_check: Differs: classical timing reads good and bad periods from dashas and transits, not from a compensation law.

hindi: अचानक पॉजिटिव हुआ बहुत बड़ा घर आया ग्रह बली लेगा
says: If something very positive happens suddenly, such as a big house coming into your life, the planet will take its bali for it.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the slice boundary: 'अचानक पॉजिटिव' ends one slice and 'हुआ बहुत बड़ा घर आया' starts the next. No specific planet is named in this part.
classical_check: Silent: a compensation claim of his own.

hindi: घर शनि देता है अब आपसे बली लेगा क्लेश आएगा लाइफ के अंदर
says: Saturn is the one who gives a house, and he will now take his bali from you, so strife will enter your life. A gift from Saturn is matched by a price.
ambiguity: 'अब आपसे बली लेगा' presumably means Saturn, the giver, is the taker; he does not repeat the name for the taking part. 'क्लेश' means conflict or strife.
classical_check: Differs: the classical karakas for house and property are Mars (land), Venus (comforts) and the 4th house. Saturn as giver of a house, often late in life, is closer to popular practice.

hindi: आपने बहुत बढ़िया सी एक गाड़ी ले ली अब पंगा देखना कोई ना कोई डंट लगाएगा गाड़ी पे नहीं लगेगा तो आप पे लगेगा तो ग्रह बैलेंसिंग करते हैं अपने जीवन में
says: Once you have bought a very fine car, watch for trouble: someone will put a dent in it, and if it is not the car, the hit will land on you. That is how the planets balance our life.
ambiguity: 'आप पे लगेगा' (it will hit you) is a loose threat, not a diagnosis or a specific accident. No planet is named.
classical_check: Silent: a compensation example of his own, not a classical vehicle rule (4th house and Venus).

hindi: बहुत बड़े सुख की स्थिति हो गई बेटी की शादी बहुत बढ़िया घर के अंदर हो गई कमाल हो गया जी मजा आ गया कोई बीमारी दुख परेशानी आएगी
says: When a big happiness arrives, such as a daughter marrying into a very good home, some illness, sorrow or worry will come after it. He gives a family joy as another case of the planets balancing.
ambiguity: 'कोई बीमारी' is a general warning of trouble, not a named illness or a medical statement about anyone.
classical_check: Silent: a compensation example of his own, not a classical rule.

hindi: ये जो दैत्य ग्रह है ये कहते हैं हमारी बलि कहां है
says: The demon planets speak as if they are asking: where is our bali? He treats them as beings who demand their share of the good that has come to you.
ambiguity: He does not repeat which planets are the demon planets; the six of the earlier list are assumed.
classical_check: Silent: a personification of his own.

hindi: एक इदा नाड़ी चल रही है एक पिंगला नाड़ी चल रही है वो कहती है हमें भी तो कुछ चाहिए तो आपको बलि देनी पड़ती है
says: With one nadi, ida, running and another, pingala, also running, each one says it wants something too, so you have to give a bali. The two breath channels are his picture of two sides each claiming a share.
ambiguity: He does not say which side or planet each nadi stands for. 'वो कहती है' is read as each nadi speaking in turn.
classical_check: Silent: ida and pingala are yogic channels, not Jyotish.

hindi: यह प्रथा होती है वास्तु पुरुष के लिए बलि दी जाती है स्थान देवता के लिए बलि दी जाती है ऐसे ही ग्रह भी बलि लेते हैं
says: It is an old custom that a bali is given for the Vastu Purusha and for the deity of the place, and in the same way the planets take a bali too. He links planetary sacrifice with the Vastu practice.
ambiguity: 'बलि' here is an offering or price; he does not say whether a literal animal sacrifice is meant. The Vastu link is stated only as a parallel.
classical_check: Partly agrees: vastu bali and offerings to the place deity at ground-breaking and house-entry are in Vastu texts. Planets taking a bali in the same way is his own extension.

hindi: अगला हमारा एक देवता जो नाभि के ऊपर है पिछली क्लास के आगे की बात वो हमारा है इंद्र
says: He moves on, continuing the previous class, to the next deity of the body, the one above the navel, who is Indra. In his 12-planet scheme, Indra is the planet Uranus.
ambiguity: He says Indra, not Uranus; Uranus is taken from the scheme set in the task. 'नाभि के ऊपर' ties the deity to a body zone as in the Vastu Purusha picture.
classical_check: Differs: Indra is a Vedic deity and Uranus is not part of classical Jyotish. Placing deities on the body above the navel echoes the Vastu Purusha mandala.

hindi: इंद्र देवता के बारे में सबको पता है बहुत रसिक है बहुत मस्ती मारता है लेकिन वो महेंद्र है यानी कि पूरे ब्रह्मांड का देवता
says: Everyone knows Indra is very pleasure-loving and fond of enjoyment, but he is also Mahendra, the great Indra, meaning the deity of the whole universe, not only of heaven.
ambiguity: Uranus is taken from the scheme in which Indra is Uranus. 'महेंद्र' is used as a title for Indra's cosmic role.
classical_check: Agrees about Indra in Vedic and Puranic lore as pleasure-loving king of the gods. The link to Uranus is not classical.

hindi: अगर हमारे जीवन के अंदर हमारी इंद्रियों का सुख पाना है इंद्रियां हमारी सारी की सारी काम करती तो हम देख सकते हैं कान चलते हैं बोल सकते हैं
says: To enjoy the pleasure of our senses (indriyas), all the senses must be working; only then can we see, hear and speak. He ties Indra to the senses through the wordplay Indra and indriya.
cells_derived_method: Which sense organ is meant can be linked to house topics: the 2nd house for face, speech and taste, the 3rd house for ears and hearing, the 12th house for the eyes and bed pleasures. Where Uranus (Indra) sits shows which pleasure is exposed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Uranus in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) would show the sense of hearing and communication, with sound and speech as the field of pleasure and disturbance.
Derived, not said by him: Uranus in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo) would put taste, voice and the face in front, so food and speech are where the sensory pleasure runs.
Derived, not said by him: Uranus in Cancer in the 12th house (lagna Leo) would point to the eyes, sleep and bed pleasures, with the senses most active at night and in private.

ambiguity: Uranus is inferred from his scheme for Indra. The word-pairing of Indra and indriya is his link and the sentence does not mention a chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Indra as lord of the senses is a Vedic idea, and the house-to-body links used for the examples are classical. Uranus as the planet for the senses is not classical.

hindi: हमारा थूक बनता है मुंह के अंदर भोजन पचने के लाग हालात बनती है स्वाद का पता चलता है हमारे जीवन में कानों में मधु संगीत आता
says: He lists what the working senses give: saliva forms in the mouth and the conditions for digesting food arise, we get to know taste, and sweet music reaches the ears. These are Indra's gifts to our life.
ambiguity: 'पचने के लाग हालात' is garbled and is read as 'conditions for digestion'. The sentence runs across the slice boundary.
classical_check: Silent: a description of sensory life, not a Jyotish rule. The Uranus link is from his scheme.

hindi: ये इंद्रिया है हम इंद्रियों के वशीभूत हैं यानी हमारी इंद्रियां जो हैं वह हमें खा रही है हमने कोई चीज देखी पागल हो गए पैसा उठा लिया तरस रहे हैं
says: These are the senses, and we are ruled by them: our senses are eating us. We see something and go mad over it, we pick up money, we are always craving.
ambiguity: Uranus is inferred from the Indra link of the previous sentences; he does not name a planet here. 'पैसा उठा लिया' is read as 'grabbing at money' out of craving.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical thought also says the senses bind a person, but the planetary link is his own.

hindi: बहुत से लोग आज गरीब क्यों है गरीबी इस कारण से है क्योंकि उनके जीवन के अंदर धन नहीं आ रहा धन क्यों नहीं आता क्योंकि धन को देख के आप कहते उ
says: He asks why so many people are poor today and answers that wealth is not coming into their lives, and wealth does not come because, on seeing it, they only gasp 'oh' in longing. The poverty is explained by a mental habit and not by the chart.
ambiguity: The sentence trails off at 'उ' and carries on with the example. It is a claim about why people are poor, with no planet or house cited.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish reads wealth from the 2nd and 11th houses and their lords, not from a mental habit.

gist: A simple example from college: boys and girls look at each other and think 'if only this one were mine'.

hindi: ये अगर हम कॉस्मिक वाइब्रेशन की बात करें तो हमारे मन में यह हो रहा है आज ये मेरा है ही नहीं तो दादाजी तक मैसेज क्या जा रहा है ये तुम्हारा है नहीं इसलिए तुम्हारा होगा भी नहीं
says: In terms of cosmic vibration, the mind is saying 'this is not mine', so the message that reaches 'dadaji' is that it is not yours, and therefore it will not be yours. Craving is read as an admission that you do not have the thing.
ambiguity: 'दादाजी' is unclear. It may be the ancestors, the cosmos or a higher power; he does not explain it here. The first words 'ये अगर' belong to the example just given.
classical_check: Silent: a law-of-attraction style claim, not Jyotish.

hindi: इसीलिए जब तक आप कंफर्म्ड नहीं है एफर्मेटिव नहीं है यस स्वर्ग का देवता तो मैं ही हूं मैं भाग के जाना होगा जाऊंगा लेकिन पुनः आऊंगा एकत्रित करूंगा अपनी शक्ति
says: Until you are firmly affirmed, able to say 'yes, I am the god of heaven', you will be like Indra who had to flee, saying 'I will go, but I will come back, gather my strength and return'. He holds up that affirmation as the model for getting what you want.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether the words 'yes, I am the god of heaven' are Indra's own or the words he tells the listener to say. Uranus is taken from the scheme in which Indra is Uranus.
classical_check: Silent: an affirmation teaching drawn from the Indra story, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Story: Indra even begged Vishnu and Shiva to save him and give him heaven back, and then became king again.
He says 'that is, you are clever'; the thought is cut off at the end of the slice.

hindi: चुस्त है लेकिन छोड़ते नहीं जो डिप्लोमेसी आपकी लाइफ के अंदर आएगी सारी की सारी इंद्रियों के द्वारा वो 100% डिप्लोमेसी इंद्र के पास है और यह नाभी पर है
says: All the diplomacy (tact, handling of people and situations) that comes into your life through the senses belongs 100% to Indra, and he says this Indra function is located at the navel.
ambiguity: The opening words 'चुस्त है लेकिन छोड़ते नहीं' are the tail of a sentence from the previous batch. 'Indra' = Uranus is only confirmed later (8:01). Body location is given here as navel but later as thighs.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is absent from classical Jyotish; sense-faculties and tact are normally Mercury/Venus/Moon matters there.

hindi: मंगल कौन है हनुमान जी हनुमान जी को कितना कहा गया चतुर है ज्ञानी है कितना विद्वान है
says: Mars is identified with Hanuman, and because Hanuman is described as clever, wise and deeply learned, he credits Mars with shrewd intelligence and scholarship, not just brute energy.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS gives Mars courage, energy, weapons and brothers; knowledge and learning belong to Mercury and Jupiter. Mars-Hanuman is a devotional tradition (Tuesday worship), not a Parashari text rule.

gist: Ramayana episode: Hanuman shrank to enter Surasa's mouth, grew large to come out and flew on; told to show his tactical cleverness.
Hanuman had the sense that Sita wanted Ram to get the glory of the rescue, so he did not take the credit himself.

hindi: उसी पोर्टल को वहीं के एक स्थान को इंद्र शेयर करता है और इंद्र महेंद्र है
says: Indra shares the same navel 'portal' (energy gateway) with Mars, so Mars and Indra occupy one body spot, and he adds that Indra's name here is Mahendra.
ambiguity: 'पोर्टल' is a body or energy gateway at the navel; which exact point is not stated. 'Indra' = Uranus is inferred from the next minutes.
classical_check: Silent: Mars at the navel is a yogic or tantric idea, and Uranus is not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: जयंत के बाद एक महेंद्र नाम का देवता आता है
says: In the Vastu deity sequence, the deity Mahendra (Indra) comes right after Jayant.
classical_check: Agrees: the outer ring of the Vastu mandala has Parjanya, Jayanta, Indra (Mahendra), Surya in order along the east side.

hindi: ई फ के अंदर वास्तु के अंदर यह स्थान हमारा वही है
says: In Vastu this Indra place falls in the zone he labels 'E F' of his house grid, the same spot being discussed.
ambiguity: 'ई फ' is unclear: could be grid labels E and F, a caption error for an east-side zone, or something else. Cannot tell which part of the house it is.
classical_check: Silent on his E/F zone labels. Classical Vastu puts Indra on the east wall.

hindi: अगर वास्तु में इस डायरेक्शन में आपका ई फ डिस्टर्ब आता है इसके एजेक्ट साथ ही फ में सूर्य है
says: If the Indra zone (E-F) of the Vastu is disturbed, note that the Sun's zone sits right next to it; so a fault here sits on the Indra and Sun border.
ambiguity: 'फ में सूर्य' could mean the Sun lies in zone F, or in the next zone along. The caption also leaves unclear whether the clause is part of the condition or a separate remark.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Surya is the deity placed immediately beside Indra on the east wall of the Vastu grid.

hindi: अगर यह डिस्टर्ब आता तो नाभि की नाभि की प्रॉब्लम होती है आपकी नाभि थकी रहेगी आप परेशान रहोगे
says: Vastu-link claim: a disturbed Indra zone gives 'navel problems', meaning the navel centre stays tired and you stay worried and stressed. Recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: 'नाभि की प्रॉब्लम' may be physical or an energy-centre idea; he does not say which.
classical_check: Differs: in classical Vastu the navel of the Vastu Purusha is the centre (Brahmasthan), not the east wall, so this body mapping is his own.

hindi: आपके जीवन में नए नए रास्ते नहीं बनेंगे
says: With the navel and Indra zone out of order, new openings (fresh routes, new opportunities) will not form in life; the person feels stuck.
ambiguity: Continues the previous sentence's condition; unclear whether it applies only to the Vastu fault or to a weak Indra in the chart as well.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब स्वर्ग का देवता बनना है
says: He sets the next goal as becoming 'the god of heaven', the Indra state of abundance and enjoyment, before showing the poor mindset that blocks it.
ambiguity: Could be a rhetorical lead-in to the poverty-mindset riff, not an astrological claim in itself.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Starts a riff on how a poor-minded person sits thinking 'I am poor anyway'.
Comic example: a poor-minded wife thinks she will never get love from her husband.
Comic example: a poor-minded mother thinks children no longer listen to anyone.
Comic example: a poor-minded father calls his son useless and his business dirty.
Clarifies that 'poor' here means poverty of attitude, and all the complainers above are poor in that sense.

hindi: अमीर कौन है जो कहता है नहीं बढ़िया है सब अच्छा है होगा और स्वर्ग की भाति भोगता है
says: His definition of the truly rich (Indra-type) person: one who says 'all is fine, it will work out' and enjoys life like heaven. Richness is the attitude of positive enjoyment, not the bank balance.
ambiguity: Indra is named only in the next sentence, so tying this to Uranus is from context.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts define wealth through the 2nd and 11th houses and Jupiter and Venus, not through attitude.

gist: Says poor Indra is defamed for watching apsara dances; he calls that a human invention and says there is no apsara fight.

hindi: मतलब जो है उसे भोगा
says: The core Indra teaching in one line: whatever you have, use and enjoy it instead of deferring.
ambiguity: 'भोगा' could be an imperative ('enjoy it') or a past form ('enjoyed it'); the sense is clearly advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बहुत रेयर लोग होते हैं जिनके पास जीवन में चीनी है और वह खा सकते हैं धन है और भोग सकते हैं
says: Very few people both possess something and are able to enjoy it: sugar available and able to eat it, money available and able to spend it with pleasure. This capacity to enjoy is what a strong Indra looks like.
ambiguity: 'चीनी' (sugar) is used as a plain example of a sweet pleasure; no health claim intended.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लोग धन लेकर भोगते नहीं कहते रख ले काम आएगा
says: Most people hold money without enjoying it ('keep it, it will be useful later'); he treats this hoarding habit as a missing Indra function. He recommends enjoying, but this is a mindset claim, not investment advice.
ambiguity: He does not say that hoarding is caused by a weak Uranus in the chart; it is shown as a behaviour.
classical_check: Differs in tone: classical texts value saving through Jupiter and the 2nd house; this is a modern enjoyment-first view.

gist: Joke: people buy cheap for themselves (Veer and Mangal bazaar) but expensive gifts for others to impress; calls all of them beggars.

hindi: राजा बनना है तो इंद्र का ध्यान रखो
says: If you want to live like a king, look after Indra: keep the Indra function (Uranus, its body zone and its Vastu zone) in good order.
ambiguity: 'ध्यान रखो' can mean take care of, or keep in mind; it could also be read as meditate on. Context favours take care of.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसी की तैसी में जाए हनुमान जी तो ज्ञान से भरे पुरे हैं पराक्रमी है
says: As a foil to Indra, Hanuman (Mars) is full of knowledge and valour (parakram): the capable, heroic type that does not need to chase enjoyment.
ambiguity: The opening phrase 'ऐसी की तैसी में जाए' is a dismissive filler about the poor mindset just described, not about Hanuman.
classical_check: Partly agrees: valour (parakram) is a standard Mars quality; fullness of knowledge is not.

hindi: इंद्र चालू है
says: Indra (Uranus) is the street-smart operator, 'chalu': quick, manoeuvring, resourceful; the cleverness that works the system to enjoy life.
ambiguity: 'चालू' can mean crafty and shrewd (often mildly negative) or simply smart and active; the tone here seems affectionate.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is outside classical Jyotish; shrewdness is classically Mercury.

hindi: ये इंद्र का स्थान हमारा यूरेनस का है
says: He equates the seat of Indra (in the body and Vastu map) with the modern planet Uranus: in his scheme Indra is Uranus.
ambiguity: 'स्थान' could mean the body place, the Vastu place or the planetary position; context suggests all three.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish has no Uranus; Indra is a Vedic deity, not a graha.

hindi: यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो ये कौन है इंद्रियां ये जांघों पर है
says: The three outer planets, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, are the indriyas (sense and action faculties), and their body location is the thighs.
ambiguity: Earlier he put Indra at the navel (shared with Mars); here the outer-planet trio is on the thighs. Both are recorded as he said them.
classical_check: Differs: Kalapurusha puts the thighs under Sagittarius (9th house); the outer planets are not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: इंद्र ये इंद्र है वरुण है यम है
says: Name mapping for his three outer planets: Uranus is Indra, Neptune is Varuna and Pluto is Yama.
ambiguity: Caption order is garbled ('इंद्र ये इंद्र है'); the mapping is read in the order Uranus, Neptune, Pluto from the sentence before.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Indra, Varuna and Yama are Vedic Lokapala deities (east, west, south); assigning them to modern planets is a modern Indian convention.

hindi: इंद्र जांग हो जांघों पे हमारे साइंस प्रूव करती है ग्रोथ हार्मोंस है इन जांघों पे
says: Indra's body seat is the thighs, and he says science proves growth hormones are associated with the thighs, so Indra stands for growth and bodily renewal. Physiology claim recorded as said.
ambiguity: 'जांग हो' is a caption slip for 'जांघों'. He gives no source for the science claim.
classical_check: Partly differs: Kalapurusha gives thighs to Sagittarius; growth hormone is not a Jyotish idea, and physiologically it is released by the pituitary gland.

hindi: हमारे क्या एक्स्ट्रा आर्टरी है हार्ट अटैक हो जाए तो यहीं से निकालते हैं फालतू दे रखी है बॉडी में
says: To show how important the thighs are, he claims the body keeps a spare artery there which surgeons take for the heart after a heart attack. Medical claim recorded as said, not endorsed.
ambiguity: He says artery; in practice bypass grafts usually come from leg veins or chest-wall arteries, so the detail is loose.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Wonders why nature or God placed a spare there: it is kept so that the heart can be repaired and the person survives.

hindi: यानी इंद्र हमारे जीवन के ग्रोथ हार्मोन देता है
says: Conclusion of the thigh argument: Indra (Uranus) is the giver of growth hormone, so Uranus is the planet of life-growth and renewing vitality.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give vitality to the Sun and growth to Jupiter.

hindi: सब परेशान है बूढ़े हो रहे हैं ग्रोथ हार्मोन डिक्लाइन है
says: Everyone is troubled by ageing; he blames declining growth hormone, so a weak Indra shows as early ageing and loss of vitality. Not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: He speaks of people in general, not of a chart indicator for a weak Uranus.
classical_check: Silent: classical ageing indicators are Saturn and the 8th house.

hindi: आपका टेस्टोस्टरॉन डाउन हो रहा है ग्रोथ हार्मोन डाउन है आपका एसिड ऑइल डाउन है
says: Lists specific markers said to fall with a weak Indra: testosterone, growth hormone and an unclear 'acid oil'. Hormone claims recorded as said, no diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'एसिड ऑइल' is garbled: could be skin oil or sebum, body acid or something else. Cannot tell.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको किसी किस्म के ये प्रॉब्लम हो रही है झुरियां पड़ रही है
says: Wrinkling skin is named as a visible sign of the depleted Indra function, tying Uranus to youthfulness of appearance.
ambiguity: Caption begins mid-thought ('some kind of these problems'); the wrinkle part is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चेहरे पे नूर कमाल का गजब की खूबसूरती
says: The opposite picture: a healthy Indra gives a radiance (noor) on the face and striking natural beauty.
ambiguity: A sentence fragment; the subject Indra is carried over from the earlier lines.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give facial beauty to Venus and the Moon.

hindi: आपके घर के अंदर वैभव पैसा तो बहुत है वैभव कहां है दिखावा होता है ना
says: Vaibhav (real grandeur and richness inside the home) is different from money: many people have plenty of money but no vaibhav, only show-off. Indra gives the real thing.
ambiguity: 'वैभव' is not defined in numbers; it means grandeur and a rich life lived, not a wealth amount.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक सौंदर्य होता है लाजवाब होता है ये चाल चाल होती है राजा वाली ये मस्ती कहां है
says: Royal gait and carefree joy (masti) are marks of a strong Indra; he asks where this regal bearing has gone in people today.
classical_check: Differs: a regal bearing is classically a Sun or Leo and 1st-house mark.

hindi: इंद्र क्या करता है भोगता है विलासिता करता है
says: Indra's function in one line: he enjoys (bhoga) and lives in luxury (vilasita). This is Uranus as the planet of pleasure and comfort.
cells_derived_method: The pleasure function lands on the topic of the house Uranus occupies, coloured by the nature of the sign: house gives the area of life, sign gives the style of enjoyment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 2nd house in Taurus (lagna Aries): enjoyment through food, family table and comforts; steady, sensual, money-linked luxury.
Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Libra (lagna Sagittarius): pleasure comes through friends, networks and gains; refined, aesthetic and social enjoyment.
Derived: Uranus in the 5th in Scorpio (lagna Cancer): intense, secretive or risk-taking pleasure through romance and creativity.
Derived: Uranus in the 12th in Cancer (lagna Leo): enjoyment of private rest, bed comforts and foreign or distant places, with a homesick tinge.

classical_check: Silent: luxury and enjoyment are classically Venus.

hindi: हनुमान क्या करते हैं कोई भोग की आवश्यकता नहीं मैं परिपूर्ण हूं
says: The contrast: Hanuman (Mars) needs no worldly enjoyment and says 'I am complete'; Mars is self-sufficient and driven by duty, the opposite attitude to Indra's bhoga.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous caption line ('करता है हनुमान क्या').
classical_check: Partly differs: classical Mars is passionate and sensual (especially in Taurus or Libra signs), not renunciate; the detachment is the Hanuman image, not a Mars rule.

hindi: इंद्र कहता और आप इन दोनों का फ्लिप देखेंगे इदा और पिंगला
says: Indra says the opposite of Hanuman ('I will enjoy'), and the two are mirror flips of each other like the ida and pingala channels; Mars and Indra work as a polar pair.
ambiguity: What Indra says is cut off by the caption. 'फ्लिप' may mean opposite or mirror image. Ida and Pingala are the left and right yogic nadis (moon and sun channels).
classical_check: Silent: pairing Mars with an outer planet through ida and pingala is his own scheme.

hindi: तो ये जांघे आपकी लाइफ में सब बनाती है
says: The thighs, the seat of Indra, are what builds everything in your life; Indra is the base and foundation that makes outcomes possible.
ambiguity: 'सब बनाती है' is broad; he means life results, wealth and vigour, not a specific event.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Kalapurusha thighs belong to Sagittarius and the 9th house of fortune (bhagya).

hindi: सारे डॉक्टर कहते हैं स्क्वाट्स किए स्क्वाट एक्ससाइज नीचे बैठे ऊपर गए थाइज की एक्सरसाइज करी
says: Practical remedy: do squats and other thigh exercise (sit down, rise up) to keep the Indra zone strong; he cites doctors. Lifestyle advice only, not a medical prescription.
ambiguity: No number of reps, timing or duration is given.
classical_check: Silent: the remedy is physical exercise, not a classical upaya.

hindi: यहां से आपके ग्रोथ हार्मोन रिलीज होते हैं अगर यह आपके रिलीज हो रहे तो आपकी बॉडी ग्रो करती है सेल्यूलर लेवल के ऊपर आपकी लाइफ बेटर होती है
says: He says growth hormone is released from the thighs; when it flows well the body renews at cell level and life gets better. A strong Indra is therefore linked to cell-level renewal and better life quality.
ambiguity: 'ग्रो करती है' means renewal, not height growth. Physiology claim recorded as said.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी आपने जितना भोजन खाया वो कहां हिट करेगा पेट पर अग्नि मंगल जला के राख करेगी
says: Food you eat lands in the stomach where fire (agni), which is Mars, burns it to ash: Mars is the digestive fire.
ambiguity: 'पेट पर' (on the stomach) vs the navel region discussed earlier; he uses both loosely.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars governs bile and heat (pitta); the digestive fire is classically given to the Sun and Mars.

hindi: इंद्र क्या करेगा भोग अगर आपकी लाइफ में कुछ बन रहा है
says: After Mars burns the food down, Indra's job is the enjoyment (bhoga) of what has been built: the Indra function is to use and enjoy the results when something is being created in your life.
ambiguity: The trailing clause 'अगर आपकी लाइफ में कुछ बन रहा है' is loose; it may belong to the next Vastu sentence instead.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे घर के अंदर ए6 ए7 गंधर्व और भृंगराज का देवता का स्थान है
says: Inside the house, his zones A6 and A7 are the seats of the deities Gandharva and Bhringraj.
ambiguity: A6 and A7 are his own grid labels; the layout of his grid is not shown here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Gandharva and Bhringraj are neighbouring deities on the south side of the outer Vastu ring; the A6 and A7 labels are his own.

hindi: यानी आपने जो भी खाया उसका बेस्ट एक्सट्रैक्ट निकालना और जो बेस्ट एक्सट्रैक्ट निकला उसके बाद जो वर्स्ट फेंकने वाली एक्सशन की चीज है वो बाहर फेंक दी गई वो सारी की सारी एक्टिवेट यहां से होती है
says: The A6 and A7 zone (Gandharva, Bhringraj) is where the sorting function activates: taking the best essence of what you eat and throwing out the waste. A Vastu-to-digestion link, not medical.
ambiguity: 'यहां से' refers to the A6 and A7 zone just named; 'एक्सशन' is a caption slip for excretion.
classical_check: Silent: classical Vastu does not link these two devtas to digestion.

hindi: इंद्र का स्थान भी इसी तरफ होता है
says: Indra's place is also on this same side of the house as the Gandharva and Bhringraj zones, so a fault in that region touches both the digestion sorting and the Indra function.
ambiguity: 'इसी तरफ' is loose: Indra is on the east wall while Gandharva and Bhringraj are on the south wall, so he may mean the south-east half.
classical_check: Partly differs: in the 32-pada grid Indra is on the east side and Gandharva and Bhringraj are on the south side, so only the south-east region is common to both.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर नाभी की सेटिंग मींस विल पावर स्ट्रांग हनुमान जी स्ट्रंग है
says: A well-set navel means strong willpower, which means a strong Hanuman, i.e. a strong Mars; navel setting, willpower and Mars strength are one chain.
ambiguity: 'सेटिंग' (alignment, being set right) could be about the body, the Vastu zone or the chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: willpower and drive are classic Mars matters; the navel link is yogic, not Parashari.

hindi: मंगल इंद्र स्ट्रंग है मींस सारा चालू पना निकाल लेंगे भाई बने के तो राजा ही रहेंगे
says: When both Mars and Indra are strong, all your shrewdness (chalu-pana) gets drawn out and put to use, and you stay a king in status and style whatever happens.
cells_derived_method: Strength of Mars depends on sign (exalted Capricorn, own Aries and Scorpio); the house then decides where the combined drive and shrewdness is spent.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th house (lagna Aries): the shrewd drive turns into career authority and public command.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 1st house (lagna Scorpio): a forceful, sharp personality; with Uranus as his co-lord of Scorpio the street-smart streak shows in the self.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 4th house (lagna Capricorn): the drive is spent on home, property and inner security rather than public show.

ambiguity: 'सारा चालू पना निकाल लेंगे' could mean the shrewdness is drawn out (used) or drained away (lost); context favours used.
classical_check: Partly agrees: strong Mars gives drive and status in classical texts, but Uranus is not a classical factor.

hindi: यानी यह तो पक्का बिलीफ है चाहे मैं कुछ भी करूंगा चाहे मैं भगोड़ा बनूंगा पार्टी जरूर करूंगा ऐश जरूर करूंगा
says: The Indra mindset is a firm belief that, whatever happens and even if I turn fugitive, I will party and enjoy; unshakable commitment to pleasure. He describes the attitude, he is not advising anyone to break the law.
ambiguity: 'भगोड़ा बनूंगा' is a hyperbole for going to any extreme.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ना भी एक्टिवेट रहेगी ना भी दो सरतो में एक्टिवेट है
says: The navel centre stays activated, and it is activated only in two conditions, which he lists next.
ambiguity: Caption writes 'ना भी' for 'नाभि' (navel) and 'सरतो' for 'शर्तों' (conditions); read that way.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक तो स्ट्रांग विल पार है के राम का भक्त तु है राम का राम हो कृष्ण हो जिसको जो पसंद हो
says: First condition for an active navel: strong willpower that comes from devotion to a chosen deity, Ram or Krishna or whichever you prefer, the Hanuman route.

says: Second condition for an active navel: a fixed determination that whatever happens, I will enjoy life; the Indra route. The navel is therefore driven either by devotion-based willpower or by an enjoyment-first resolve.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह फिलोसोफी जो देता है वो इंद्र देता है लोग भोगते नहीं है
says: The 'enjoy it now' philosophy is itself a gift of Indra; people in general do not enjoy because they lack that gift.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में कितने सुख के दिन है वही काउंट करते हैं दुख के दिन है वो क्योंकि हम मूर्ख हैं
says: Count the days of happiness in your life; the days of sorrow are there because we are fools. An Indra attitude is to focus on happy days.

hindi: हमारी वासना हमारी इच्छाएं पूर्ति नहीं हुई इंद्र की वासना और इच्छा पूर्ति नहीं होती

hindi: यह थाइज है जो पूरे के पूरे शरीर के वजन को संभाल के चले हमारे टॉरस को

hindi: इसलिए इंद्र ने आपके जीवन के वैभव को संभालना है
says: Because the thighs carry the body, Indra has to carry the weight of your life's grandeur and prosperity; Indra is the bearer and keeper of vaibhav.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आप इसको सेटल करके चलते हैं तो भोग के द्वारा लक्कड़ हजम पत्थर हजम की फिलॉसफी होगी कुछ भी खाते हैं हजम होता है ना

gist: Mimics fussy people sneering at food as rotten, dirty, 'mleccha food', or a bad thing against a good thing.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति ने अपने जीवन में ये नहीं कहा उसको लक्कड़ अजम पत्थर अजम
says: The person who has never sneered at food in that fussy way gets the 'wood-and-stone digestion': a non-fussy attitude to what you eat goes with a strong Indra function.
ambiguity: 'अजम' is a caption slip for 'हजम' (digest).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह नहीं कहा बड़ा गंदा कर्म किया बच्चे ने यह तो बहुत अच्छा बच्चा है नहीं वो बहुत खराब है नहीं कोई भेदभाव नहीं आने दो उसका इंद्र सेट रहता है जांगे ठीक रहती है
says: One who does not label people's acts as good or bad (the good child, the bad child) and lets no discrimination (bhedbhav) in has Indra set and the thighs in good order. A non-judging mind keeps Indra stable.

classical_check: Silent: this is a moral-psychological rule of his own.

hindi: इंद्र आपके जीवन में वैभव देता है
says: Summary claim: Indra (Uranus) is the bestower of vaibhav, grandeur and a rich quality of life; the sort of luxury it brings shows in the area of life where Uranus sits.
cells_derived_method: Vaibhav appears in the life area of the house Uranus occupies, coloured by the sign's nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 4th house in Aquarius (lagna Scorpio): grandeur in home, vehicles and property, modern and unconventional in style.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Libra (lagna Capricorn): grandeur through profession and public image, refined and aesthetic.
Derived: Uranus in the 7th in Gemini (lagna Sagittarius): grandeur through partner, business dealings and clever, communicative social life.

classical_check: Silent: classical texts give grandeur and luxury to Venus and the 4th house.

hindi: ये आठ नंबर राशि का मालिक बनता है मंगल के साथ शेयरिंग करता है और ऐश कराता है आपके जीवन के अंदर
says: Uranus (Indra) becomes lord of sign number 8, Scorpio, sharing that lordship with Mars, and he says it gives comforts and luxury in life.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio becomes a different house in each lagna; in that house the Mars-and-Uranus joint rule adds a force-plus-pleasure flavour. House gives the topic, the dual lordship gives the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 1st house (lagna Scorpio): the self is ruled by both Mars and Uranus, forceful, magnetic and pleasure-seeking.
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries): sudden changes and enjoyment through other people's resources, shared with Mars as lagna lord.
Derived: Uranus in Scorpio in the 11th house (lagna Capricorn): gains and networks come through intense, unconventional routes.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर राशि' is read as sign 8 (Scorpio) by the series convention, though 'house 8' is possible if he used house numbers.
classical_check: Differs: BPHS gives Scorpio to Mars alone; some schools add Ketu as co-lord; Western astrology gives Scorpio to Pluto, not Uranus.

hindi: यूरेनस कौन सा प्लेनेट है फिजिक्स के अंदर ये प्रूव किया जा चुका है कि यूरेनस के ऊपर जब बारिश होती है हमारे यहां बारिश पानी की होती है यूरेनस नाम के प्लेनेट के ऊपर बारिश डायमंड की
says: He supports Uranus as the planet of diamonds and luxury with a physics claim that it rains diamonds on Uranus while Earth gets water rain; symbolically he links Uranus with brilliance, wealth and luxury. The sentence is cut at the end of the batch.

classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish gives diamonds to Venus; and diamond rain on ice giants is a scientific hypothesis from high-pressure experiments, not a proven observation.

gist: Two-word tail that completes the previous batch's sentence ('...rain of diamonds happens').

hindi: अगर आपके जीवन में डायमंड आपको चाहिए तो कहां से मिलेगा थाइज से
says: If you want diamonds (gems, wealth, luxury) in your life, the source is the thighs, meaning the Indra or Uranus function; the thigh zone is where luxury is generated.
ambiguity: 'डायमंड' may be literal gems or a symbol of luxury; 'थाइज से' may mean the body part or the Indra principle seated there.
classical_check: Differs: classically diamonds and jewellery belong to Venus, not to an outer planet.

hindi: आप किसी को डायमंड देने लेने लायक भोगने लायक है यह इंद्र देवता की शक्ति है
says: The ability to give diamonds, to receive them and to enjoy them is the power of the Indra deity; a strong Indra makes you worthy of giving, taking and enjoying luxury.
ambiguity: 'लायक' (fit, worthy) could mean ability or entitlement; both are consistent.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इंद्र की कथाएं हैं कि इंद्र के पास इंद्र जैसा सुख यानी इंद्र के पास क्या नहीं है कुबेर का खजाना है गणपति का आशीर्वाद है बुद्धि है ज्ञान है
says: By Indra's legends he lacks nothing: Kubera's treasury (wealth), Ganapati's blessing (obstacles removed), intelligence and knowledge. His enjoyment rests on full resources, so Indra stands for complete provision.

classical_check: Differs: in Puranic texts Kubera and Ganesha are separate deities, not Indra's possessions; Silent in Jyotish.

hindi: लेकिन वो भोग करता है तो जीवन के अंदर भोगना जरूरी है जो आपके पास है आपका इंद्र सुरक्षित और स्ट्रंग रहेगा
says: Even with every resource Indra still enjoys, so in life you must enjoy what you have; doing so keeps your Indra protected and strong. Enjoyment is the upkeep of the Indra function.
ambiguity: Whether 'indra' means the planet in the chart or the body and Vastu zone is not separated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह आग का देवता है

ambiguity: 'यह' may refer to Indra, or to Mars and Agni at the navel; the caption gives no noun.
classical_check: Differs: Indra is the Vedic lord of rain and thunder; fire belongs to Agni.

hindi: आग के देवता की जल के देवता से को खास पकती बनती नहीं है यह वरुण है समुद्र है
says: The fire deity and the water deity do not get along well; the water one is Varuna, the sea (Neptune). So the fire zone with Indra and Mars and the water zone with Varuna sit as uneasy neighbours.

hindi: इस इंद्र के बाद में आते हैं हमारे बृहस्पति महाराज नौ नंबर राशि धनु
says: In his body and planet sequence the next one after Indra is Jupiter (Brihaspati), who owns sign number 9, Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house (lagna Leo): supports children, education and creative intelligence.

Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 12th house (lagna Capricorn): supports spiritual spending, foreign lands and retreats, but money tends to flow out.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter owns Sagittarius, the 9th sign from Aries.

hindi: हा हा हनुमान जी तो सीधे सपाट
says: Hanuman (Mars) is straight and plain: direct, with no scheming, in contrast with Indra.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical Mars is frank, blunt and direct.

hindi: इंद्र चलाक है ना इंद्र चलाक है साम दम दंड भेद
says: Indra is clever and uses all four statecraft means: sama (persuasion), dama (money or gifts), danda (force or punishment) and bheda (dividing opponents) to get what he wants.

classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; the four upayas come from the Niti and Arthashastra tradition.

hindi: हा तो भोगना है बच्चा देखा आपने कैसे भोगता जीवन चोरी कर लेगा खा लेगा पिट लेगा फिर भोगे
says: A child shows pure Indra: he enjoys life fearlessly; he will steal, eat, get beaten and still go straight back to enjoying. Natural Indra is fearless, resilient pleasure.

says: Adults snatch away the child's enjoyment and kill the habit of enjoying; upbringing suppresses the Indra function early in life.
classical_check: Silent.

classical_check: Silent.

ambiguity: Garbled in places ('दए दए'); the meaning of shooting arrows upward without caring where they go is clear.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Sagittarius is fiery, mutable, optimistic and restless.

hindi: धनु राशि यह नौ नंबर की राशि ऐसे व्यक्तित्व को रिप्रेजेंट करती है जो दौड़ रहा है लगातार चला हुआ है

hindi: हमारे जीवन में गुरु की कृपा कही जाती है हर समय दी जाए

hindi: अब हमारा शुरू होता है य वाटर चक्र अग्नि के नीचे वाटर चक्र है यही हमारा सेक्स चक्र है
says: Now Jupiter's body seat begins: the water centre, sitting just below the fire centre, which is the sex (sacral) centre.

says: Every kind of birth in life, the start of a job, of studies, of a child, of love, and the start of the birth process itself, sits with Jupiter; Jupiter is the karaka of beginnings.

Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 7th house (lagna Gemini): the start of love or partnership is helped by wisdom and a teacher-like partner.

hindi: यानी रूट चक्र के ऊपर हमने मकान बनाना है मकान बनाने का जन्म भी तो चाहिए उसको प्रजनन उसकी जानकारी
says: Analogy: above the root centre we have to build the 'house' (the structure of life), and a house also needs its own birth, generation and knowledge; the creative start for building comes from the water centre above the root.

hindi: यानी हमारे जीवन की जो शुरुआत है धरती पर जीवन के शुरुआत बृहस्पति की कृपा से है

hindi: यानी आपके जीवन में जन्म तो दिया मां ने जो पुनर्जन्म दिया या ज्ञान का जन्म दिया वह गुरु ने दिया

classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; agrees with the common saying that the guru appears when the disciple is ready.

hindi: हम शिष्य बन सकते हैं हम गुरु बना नहीं सकते
says: Only the disciple role is in our hands; we cannot appoint a guru by our own decision. Discipleship is a choice, guruhood is not something we confer.
ambiguity: Repeats the previous idea in a sharper form; recorded because it is a separate sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mocks people who casually 'make' a guru, like making parathas or puris of flour today and grabbing a man to make him guru.

hindi: आपको शिष्य बनना है हम शिष्यवृत्ती दबाते फिरे नहीं हमारी गो नाम ना झुकते
says: You need to become a disciple, but we go around suppressing our disciple-nature (shishyavritti) because our ego does not bow.
ambiguity: 'हमारी गो नाम ना झुकते' is garbled and probably means 'our ego does not bend'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी कि इसका नेगेटिव फ्लिप साइड यह है कि अहंकार भी यही है
says: The negative flip side of this Jupiter centre is ahankar (ego); pride and ego live in the same place as guidance and humility.
ambiguity: 'इसका' could mean the centre or Jupiter; both are read as the same thing.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts link an afflicted or overblown Jupiter with pride and dogma.

hindi: यह चक्र हमारा स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र है स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र को गुरु बृहस्पति लीड करता है
says: This water centre is the svadhisthana chakra, and Guru Brihaspati (Jupiter) leads it; svadhisthana is mapped to Jupiter.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish has no chakra-to-graha map and modern lists vary (Venus, Moon or Jupiter for svadhisthana).

gist: Teases that there is an interesting point about the Jupiter centre which you will see as he draws it.

hindi: धरती यह सूरज है यह छोटे छोटे चिंदी चोर जैसे ग्रह है लुपू लुपू से अब यह बृहस्पति आ गया कितना बड़ा यह है गुरु
says: In a sketch he shows the Sun, Earth and the tiny scrap-like planets, then Jupiter coming in, very large; the guru is the big one, so size equals authority.
ambiguity: A spoken description of a drawing the viewer sees; relative sizes are described, not measured.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically: Jupiter is the largest planet; Silent in Jyotish beyond Jupiter's greatness (Brihaspati).

hindi: अब यहां से सूरज की किरणें आई गई धरती तक पहुंची
says: In the same sketch the Sun's rays travel straight to Earth; this is the baseline route that his next argument compares the Jupiter route against.
ambiguity: Caption has stuttering syllables ('ाए ाए ाए'); the sense is that the rays reach Earth.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मजे की बात समझिए कि धरती से हमने इतनी छोटी सी गेंद से हमने सूर्य परमात्मा की ओर एक आकाश की ओर वो बताया कि भाई भगवान हमारा यह काम कर दे
says: Going the other way, from our tiny ball of Earth we send a request up to the Sun, the Paramatma: 'God, please do this work for us'. He uses it to show how small our direct prayers are.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across a caption line break and the words 'एक आकाश की ओर वो बताया' are loose.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is classically the atma, soul and divine; the idea of prayer going toward it is devotional.

gist: We treat God like a servant: Papa does a favour when asked, but God does not seem to listen to the same request.

hindi: अब यहां से धरती से हमने बहुत छोटा सा एक संदेश भेजा ये धरती अब वो बेचारा चुग्ग चुग्ग चाल से चल के जा रहा है सूरज तक
says: Our tiny message from Earth plods slowly toward the Sun at a pecking pace; a direct request to the Sun or God is small and slow.
ambiguity: 'चुग्ग चुग्ग चाल' is a comic image of slow, pecking steps.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमें करना क्या है धरती के ज्यादा पास जुपिटर है ये साइंटिफिकली प्रूव हैना
says: What should we do? Jupiter is the nearer big body to Earth in his picture, and he calls this scientifically proven, so the request should go through Jupiter.
ambiguity: Nearer than what is not said; read as nearer than the Sun.
classical_check: Differs: astronomically wrong, since Jupiter is about 4 to 6 AU from Earth and the Sun is 1 AU; only valid as a symbol. Jyotish: Jupiter as Devaguru intermediary is classical.

hindi: बड़ी मजे की बात है कि धरती से एक रे फेंक दी गई जुपिटर पे जुपिटर से रिफ्लेक्ट होती है
says: A ray sent from Earth toward Jupiter is reflected by Jupiter; Jupiter acts as a mirror or relay for our requests.
ambiguity: 'रे' is a ray of light or a message; whether it is literal light or a figure is not stated.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; physically a metaphor, not a measured effect.

hindi: कितना बड़ा जुपिटर है यह इतनी बड़ी जगह इतनी बड़ी गेंद से रिफ्लेक्ट करके सूरज पर फेंकता है और दसियों गुना जल्दी स्पीड से पहुंचता है
says: Because Jupiter is huge, it bounces the ray on to the Sun and the message arrives tens of times faster than the direct route; Jupiter is the fast lane to the Sun.
ambiguity: The tens-of-times figure has no source and is not a physical measurement.
classical_check: Differs: physically invalid, since light speed is fixed and a detour adds distance; symbolic only. The guru as fast channel to the divine is a devotional idea.

hindi: यानी सूरज से जो काम कराने है सोलर सिस्टम से कॉस्मस से जो काम कराने है वह किससे कराओ नौकर रख लो इसे
says: For any work you want from the Sun, the solar system or the cosmos, get it done through Jupiter: keep him as your servant or agent, meaning honour the guru principle as your working channel.
ambiguity: 'नौकर रख लो इसे' is figurative: engage Jupiter as an intermediary; no concrete ritual is given.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter as Devaguru and intermediary is classical; the servant framing is his own.

gist: Story opens: Mangeram walks into the forest determined to find God, saying he will catch Him today.
Mangeram searches, gets tired, and is told of Anand Maharaj: take refuge there, and even if you miss God, his hand on your head makes your life.
He reaches the riverside seat of Anand Maharaj, holds his feet, is overcome by his strange aura and falls at his feet.
He tells the Maharaj he was looking for him all along; to hell with God, getting Anand Maharaj's refuge is enough.
Anand Maharaj says be happy and enjoy, gives blessings, says God will set all right; asked for a teaching he says only 'stay in bliss'.
Mangeram feels he has found peace and God, walks on along the river gazing at the scenery, slips and falls into the water.
Swept to the middle of the river he screams for help to God, Ram, Krishna, Jagannath, Premanand and others, but nobody comes.
He suddenly remembers he has just taken a guru and starts crying out 'O Anand, O Anand'.
Just as he is about to go under, Anand Maharaj grabs his hand and pulls him up.
He keeps shouting 'Anand save me' and looks up to see the Maharaj hauling him out by the hand.
Half out of the water he hears the Maharaj calling 'Krishna, Krishna', joins in chanting 'Hare Krishna', loses his grip and falls back into the river.
He dies in the story, reaches the heavens and is greeted by Narada with 'Narayan Narayan'.
He complains to Narada: what sort of Krishna is this; I called out 36 times while drowning and nobody came, Anand came, but he was shouting Krishna.

hindi: बोले अरे बावले तेरी पहुंच आनंदा तक थी आनंदा आ गया आनंदा की पहुंच कृष्ण तक है तुझे अनंदा से मतलब है कृष्ण नहीं सुनता तेरी तुझे नहीं पहुंचा नहीं
says: Narada's moral: your reach extended only as far as Anand (the guru), so Anand came; Anand's reach extends to Krishna, and Krishna does not hear you directly because you cannot reach him. The guru, the Jupiter principle, is the needed go-between to the divine.
ambiguity: The moral comes from a story, and the caption's ending is loose; the guru-as-intermediary reading matches his Jupiter argument just before.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; agrees with the guru-parampara teaching that the guru is the bridge to God.

hindi: आती बात यह बृहस्पति का रोल है
says: Jupiter's role, as the Mangeram story just showed, is to be the go-between that carries your request onward to the higher power.
ambiguity: The first two words 'आती बात' are a garbled lead-in; the sentence is read as the conclusion of the story.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the Devaguru, the divine teacher and intermediary.

hindi: आप आपने जुपिटर तक जो बात पहुंचा दी वह सूर्य तक ज्यादा गति से पहुंचाएगा
says: Whatever message you have already delivered to Jupiter, Jupiter will carry on to the Sun much faster; so approach the guru principle first and let him forward the request.
ambiguity: 'आप आपने' is a stutter. No concrete ritual for delivering the message to Jupiter is given here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies for the Sun are often routed through Jupiter-linked devotion to a guru; the speed claim is his own.

hindi: क्योंकि सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम क्या है जुपिटर इतना ज्यादा शक्तिशाली है उसकी पोजिशनिंग इतनी ज्यादा प्रबल है
says: The key reason is that Jupiter is extremely powerful and its position among the planets is so dominant that it commands whatever passes by it.
ambiguity: 'प्रॉब्लम' is used loosely as 'the main point'; it is not a complaint about Jupiter.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the greatest benefic and the largest planet.

hindi: कि यह इसके साइज के पीछे के यह छोटे ग्रह जो है यहां तक भी सूरज की किरण तभी जाती है जब जुपिटर की इच्छा हो
says: Planets smaller than Jupiter that sit behind its bulk get the Sun's rays only when Jupiter wishes; Jupiter acts as gatekeeper of solar energy to the smaller planets.
ambiguity: 'इसके साइज के पीछे' means in the shadow or behind Jupiter in his sketch; no real orbital arrangement is described.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; not an astronomical fact, only a symbol of Jupiter's authority.

hindi: यानी दैत्य ग्रह भी धरती पर अटैक ना कर सके यह भी इसके बस में है
says: Even the demonic (daitya) planets cannot attack the Earth because that too is within Jupiter's control; Jupiter acts as protector against malefic pressure.
ambiguity: 'दैत्य ग्रह' is not named: could mean Rahu, Ketu and Saturn, the Venus camp (Shukra is the daitya guru), or malefics in general.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat Jupiter's aspect and strength as a strong protection against malefic effects.

hindi: आपका बच्चा पैदा होता है मेंटली रिटा पैदा होता है आप ऑटिस्टिक पैदा होता है किसी प्रकार की इनकंटेंस्टेबल खराबी की स्थिति पैदा कर दी क्योंकि जुपिटर ने प्रोटेक्शन नहीं दी है किसी प्रकार की हेल्प नहीं हो रही है
says: He claims that a child born with a serious mental or developmental condition (his words: mentally retarded, autistic) or another undeniable defect comes from Jupiter not giving protection or help. Recorded only as his claim; not a medical or causal statement and not for use in predicting about any child.
ambiguity: He gives no chart rule (house, sign or aspect) for when Jupiter withholds protection; 'मेंटली रिटा' is an outdated term and 'आप ऑटिस्टिक' is a caption slip.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts tie progeny difficulty to Jupiter and the 5th house, but no classical text gives this specific causal claim, and such conditions have medical causes.

hindi: अन्यथा सूरज के आगे शनि नहीं आ सकता लेकिन ऐसा होता है
says: Normally Saturn cannot come in front of the Sun, yet it does happen; read with the lines before, this is when Jupiter's shielding is missing and Saturn's darkness overpowers the Sun's light.
ambiguity: 'सूरज के आगे शनि आना' may mean blocking the Sun's light or overpowering it in rank; 'अन्यथा' (otherwise) links it to the missing Jupiter protection.
classical_check: Partly differs: Saturn is the Sun's son and natural enemy and is usually weak when combust, so Saturn overpowering the Sun is not a classical rule.

hindi: इसलिए तमस हमेशा रहेगी जीवन में
says: Therefore tamas (darkness, inertia, ignorance) will always remain in life; it can never be removed completely.
ambiguity: The sentence begins in the previous caption line ('होता है'); linking tamas to Saturn is from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn and Rahu are the tamasic karakas, but Jyotish does not say tamas is permanent.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं हम संसार में सुख फैलाए हम ज्ञान फैलाए तुम जितना मर्जी ज्ञान फैला लो उतनी ही पावर से अज्ञानता आएगी
says: To those who say 'let us spread happiness and knowledge in the world': however much knowledge you spread, ignorance will return with equal power; light and darkness stay in balance.
ambiguity: Planets are inferred from the context of Jupiter (knowledge) and Saturn (tamas); he does not name them in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: this is a philosophical balance argument, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: इट हैज टू बी बराबर उसे बराबर होना ही है इसलिए इस चक्कर में मत रहो दुनिया का भला करेंगे किसी को भोजन खिलाएंगे
says: It has to balance out, so do not get caught in the idea that you will fix the world, for instance by feeding people. His view is that world-improving missions cannot tip the balance of tamas. This is his opinion, not a Jyotish rule.
ambiguity: He may mean only the ego of a saviour mission, not charity itself; the next anecdote shows he still values giving.
classical_check: Differs: classical dharma texts and Jupiter's remedies actively recommend feeding and charity (dana).

gist: Anecdote: yesterday a respectable man told him he wanted to donate to his trust.
His retort: nothing here is mine, I am only a middleman on the road, so who is the donor to claim he is giving something in God's name.

hindi: तू जा किसी गुरुद्वारे में पैसे फेंक सबसे बढ़िया तरीका तो वही है
says: On how to give: go and drop your money into a gurdwara; he calls that the best way, because it is giving without a middleman or credit. A charity (dana) suggestion, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'पैसे फेंक' is dismissive in tone; it means drop it quietly and walk away. The gurdwara is an example, and no fixed amount or day is given.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dana is a classical remedy and Jupiter's donations are to teachers and religious places; the gurdwara example is his own.

hindi: नाम क्यों करना है तूने उसे स्लिप भी चाहिए हिसाब किताब भी यह तो अहंकार है कि भगवान हेलो हमने रप चढ़ाए
says: Why do you want your name on the gift, plus a receipt and an account? That is ego: telling God 'hello, look, I offered rupees'. Giving for credit is ahankar, not charity.
ambiguity: 'रप' is a caption slip for rupees.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical dharma texts praise anonymous giving (gupta dana) over giving for fame.

gist: Imagines God ignoring a donor who keeps shouting about his rupees and replying: you fools, you do not really want to give, you only keep eating my head and showing off a favour.

hindi: इसलिए गुरु की कृपा से ही संतान पैदा होती है
says: So children are born only by the guru's (Jupiter's) grace; Jupiter is the giver of progeny, tying the birth theme to Jupiter's blessing.
cells_derived_method: Progeny is read from the 5th house; Jupiter's dignity in the sign there shows how strong the grace is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 5th house (lagna Pisces): strong grace for children and learning, in his view.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th house (lagna Virgo): the grace is weaker, so delays or weaker support in children matters would be read here.

ambiguity: 'संतान' may include a spiritual child (disciple); the physical child is the more natural reading here.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the putra karaka, the natural significator of children.

hindi: उत्तम गुरु गुरु जी वाला गुरु नहीं है
says: He clarifies that the guru who gives such grace is not the human 'Guruji' type; it is the planetary or cosmic guru principle, Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'उत्तम' could belong to the previous sentence (excellent child) or mean the best guru; the caption is loose.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter as the graha guru is distinct from a human guru in Jyotish.

hindi: ये गुरु ग्रह स्वाधिष्ठान कौन सी भावना जो विष्णु की है यह विष्णु का देवता है
says: The guru planet and the svadhisthana centre carry the feeling (bhavna) of Vishnu; the presiding deity of this Jupiter centre is Vishnu.
ambiguity: The caption's 'कौन सी भावना' is a question he answers himself; the first words have a stray 'ये'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: in the Dashavatara-graha scheme Jupiter goes with Vamana, an avatar of Vishnu; puja lists often name Brahma and Indra as Jupiter's deities.

hindi: विष्णु विष्णु हमारे पालनहार हैं यही बृहस्पति माना जाता है
says: Vishnu, our sustainer (palanhar), is taken to be Jupiter; so Jupiter's job is to nurture and keep life going.
ambiguity: 'माना जाता है' presents it as a received tradition, not his own finding.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter as preserver and nourisher fits the Vishnu role; the Jupiter-Vishnu link is common in popular practice.

hindi: यानी बहुत बड़े शीर सागर में शीर सागर मींस मिल्की वे गैलेक्सी के अंदर विष्णु जी बैठे हुए हैं
says: Vishnu sits in the great Ksheer Sagar (ocean of milk), which he equates with the Milky Way galaxy; Jupiter's Vishnu principle is placed in the cosmic whole.
ambiguity: 'शीर सागर' is a caption spelling of 'क्षीर सागर'.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; the Puranic milk ocean is mythic and reading it as the Milky Way is a modern interpretation.

hindi: उनके चरणों में लक्ष्मी लक्ष्मी कहां है लक्ष्मी रही शनि मूलाधार चरणों में लक्ष्मी है
says: Lakshmi sits at Vishnu's feet, and Lakshmi means Saturn, the root (muladhara) centre at the feet; wealth and material support are Saturn, kept beneath Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'रही' is a caption slip; the plain reading is 'Lakshmi is Saturn, the muladhara'.
classical_check: Differs: classically Lakshmi and wealth go to Venus (and Jupiter, the 2nd and 11th houses); Saturn for the root centre appears in modern chakra lists but not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: बृहस्पति जब शनि घर जाता तो हाथ जोड़ता उसको
says: When Jupiter goes into Saturn's house, the host folds his hands to him; in Saturn's signs Jupiter is received with honour.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn and Aquarius fall in a different house for every lagna; the house shows where Jupiter's honoured visit shows up, and the sign dignity (Capricorn is classically a fall for Jupiter) tempers it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 11th house (lagna Pisces): in his view Saturn honours the guest, so gains come through structured long-term networks; classical texts count Jupiter debilitated here.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra): education and children get disciplined support from the Saturn host.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus): fortune and dharma come through hard, patient work; Jupiter is debilitated here in classical texts.

ambiguity: Who folds his hands is not clear in the caption; the next lines suggest Saturn honours Jupiter. 'घर' could mean sign placement or transit.
classical_check: Differs for Capricorn: classical texts make Jupiter debilitated there (deepest at 5 degrees); Saturn and Jupiter are neutral to each other in Parashari.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन हुआ गुरुजी जो कहानी है हमारी सूर्यकांत कहता हां जी गुरु जी आ गए गुरुजी आ गए गुरुजी को ऊंचे आसन पर बिठा उनके पैर धोता है सूर्यकांत
says: In his household allegory Jupiter is 'Guruji' and the Sun (nicknamed Suryakant, the host) welcomes him, seats him on a high seat and washes his feet; the Sun treats Jupiter with the highest reverence.
ambiguity: An allegory, not a technique; the planets are cast as household characters.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun and Jupiter are natural friends in Parashari; the reverence image is his own.

hindi: और उसके पश्चात शनि को आदेश देता है हां भाई शनिचर भोजन का अरेंजमेंट करो
says: In the allegory the Sun then orders Saturn (Shanichar) to arrange the meal, so Saturn works as the Sun's subordinate who handles the arrangements.
ambiguity: An allegory; it is not stated whether the order of command applies to anything in a chart.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn is the Sun's son and a natural enemy, not his subordinate.

hindi: शनिचर आगे कहता है अपने एजेंट राहु केतु को हां भाई करो महाराज के लिए ये आा है गुरुजी के लिए वो लाना है
says: Saturn passes the order down to his own agents Rahu and Ketu, who fetch things for the Maharaj; Rahu and Ketu are Saturn's field agents.
ambiguity: 'ये आा है' is garbled, probably 'ये लाना है'; the sense of fetching is clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is said to behave like Saturn and Ketu like Mars in Jyotish, so Rahu and Ketu as Saturn's proxies has support.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे अन्य प्लेनेट उनकी सेवादारी में लग जाते हैं सेवक
says: Likewise all the other planets get busy as servants in Guruji's service, so the whole planetary court bows to Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'सेवक' ends the line loosely; it labels the planets as servants.
classical_check: Silent: planets do not serve Jupiter in classical texts; Jupiter is the greatest benefic but not a ruler of the other planets.

hindi: यानी कि शनि महाराज की तो औकात ही नहीं सूर्य के आगे आए हाथ जोड़ के रहता है पीठ पीछे चलता है
says: Saturn has no standing before the Sun; he stays with folded hands and walks behind him, so Saturn is subordinate to the Sun in this picture.
ambiguity: This also says why Saturn cannot come in front of the Sun (earlier line); both come from the same picture.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn becomes combust near the Sun and loses strength, but they are natural enemies, not master and servant.

hindi: बृहस्पति जब वहां आता है जहां सूर्य हो तो सूर्य कितना आदर देता है उसे
says: When Jupiter comes to the place where the Sun is (same house or sign), the Sun gives him great respect; the Sun-Jupiter conjunction is a dignified, welcoming pairing.
cells_derived_method: The house shows which area the respected pairing works in, and the sign shows the Sun's dignity, which sets how much honour there is to give.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign Leo with Jupiter in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius): fortune, dharma and a respected teacher are strongly supported.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries with Jupiter in the 1st house (lagna Aries): a commanding, respected personality with Jupiter's blessing.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra with Jupiter in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn): Jupiter's respect helps, but the Sun's confidence in career stays shaky.

ambiguity: 'वहां' means the same sign or house; the caption has a stray 'ब' before 'बृहस्पति'. Whether it is a close conjunction is not said.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Jupiter are natural friends and the Guru-Aditya pairing is generally read as dignified.

hindi: लेकिन जब बृहस्पति के पास शनि के घर भी जाएगा तो कितना बड़ी बड़ी बात होगी वह तो सिर पर बिठाए
says: If Jupiter goes even into Saturn's house, the honour is bigger than the Sun's; Saturn will seat him on his head. Jupiter in Saturn's signs gets the highest welcome.
cells_derived_method: As in the sentence before, the house shows the life area and the sign shows how Jupiter's strength stands; here he claims honour stronger than the Sun's welcome.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 2nd house (lagna Capricorn): family wealth and speech get honoured, steady support.

Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 8th house (lagna Gemini): research, shared resources and inheritance matters are honoured by the host planet, though classical texts count Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn.

ambiguity: The sentence begins with 'लेकिन' at the end of the previous caption line. Whether 'घर' means sign or transit is not said.
classical_check: Differs for Capricorn: classical texts make Jupiter debilitated there; no classical text says Saturn welcomes Jupiter more than the Sun does.

hindi: यानी सारी लक्ष्मी चरणों में रखोगे तो बृहस्पति कमाल करेगा
says: If you keep all your Lakshmi (wealth, material gains) at the feet, that is, below wisdom and service, Jupiter does wonders for you.
ambiguity: 'चरणों में रखना' is figurative: keep wealth under the guru principle, not necessarily give it away.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the Jupiter view that dharma guides wealth.

hindi: यानी जिस व्यक्ति ने लोभ माया मोह मद मत्सर इत्यादि नहीं रखा किसी प्रकार का काम क्रोध वह बृहस्पति की पूर्णता का फल लाता है
says: A person who keeps no greed, maya, attachment, pride, envy, lust or anger brings out the fruit of Jupiter's fullness; these vices cut Jupiter's results.
ambiguity: He lists the vices loosely ('इत्यादि'); the standard six are kama, krodha, lobha, moha, mada and matsarya.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the six inner enemies are the classical set; tying them to the fruit of Jupiter is his own.

hindi: और देव पुरुष साइंटिस्ट बड़े-बड़े ज्ञानी पैदा होते हैं
says: From such fullness of Jupiter divine persons, scientists and great knowers are born; this is the output of a vice-free mind.
ambiguity: Unclear whether such people arise as children of vice-free parents (the next sentence suggests so) or as a result of one's own state.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter signifies wisdom and learned persons.

hindi: जिन माताओं ने यह स्थिति मानसिकता की बनाई है वह ऐसा स्पर्म चूज कर पाती है अपने एक के द्वारा कि बच्चा कमाल का पैदा हो
says: Mothers who build this vice-free mental state can 'choose' the sperm through their own (garbled, probably egg), so that a remarkable child is born. A biological claim recorded as his tradition claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'अपने एक के द्वारा' is garbled; 'egg' is a guess. 'स्पर्म चूज' is not an established biological process.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; echoes the garbha-sanskar idea that the parents' mental state shapes the child, but no medical support is claimed here.

hindi: जिन व्यक्तियों ने अपने जीवन में मानसिकता में एक प्लॉट खरीदा कि ऐसा मकान बनाना है जो सुखद स्थिति दे
says: Setup of a property example: people who, in their mind, buy a plot with the intent of building a home that gives a happy condition. He describes the mental purchase, not a real-estate tip.
ambiguity: 'मानसिकता में प्लॉट खरीदा' may be a real purchase made with that mindset or only an intention; the result is stated in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical Vastu stresses site, shape and direction, not the buyer's mindset.

hindi: मानसिकता में कोई लोभ नहीं है मोह नहीं है माया नहीं है अहंकार नहीं है क्रोध नहीं है वह प्लॉट राजमहल बनता है
says: If the mind holds no greed, attachment, maya, ego or anger, that plot becomes a palace; a clean mindset at the time of buying leads to a grand result. A mindset claim, not advice to buy property.
ambiguity: 'राजमहल' is a figure for a very grand outcome, not a promise of a literal palace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके अंदर मकान गाड़ी खरीदी है वह गाड़ी आपको सुख देती है
says: In the same clean state, the house and the car you buy give you happiness; things acquired with a vice-free mind bring comfort.
ambiguity: 'उसके अंदर' refers to that mental state or that plot; the caption is loose.
classical_check: Silent: vehicle comfort is classically Venus and the 4th house.

hindi: खुद टूट जाएगी आपके एक्सीडेंट में खरोच नहीं आएगी
