says: Such a car will break itself in an accident but you will not get a scratch; the object absorbs the damage so the owner is protected. A tradition claim, not safety advice.
ambiguity: 'खुद' (itself) is the car; no condition for when this protection works is given beyond the clean mindset.
classical_check: Silent: resembles the folk idea of an object taking on a native's affliction.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा बृहस्पति की कृपा से
says: All of this, the palace plot, the happy car and the protection, comes from Jupiter's grace; Jupiter is the source of these results.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of grace, fortune and protection.

hindi: तो यह आपका स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र है यही अहंकार रहता है
says: He closes the loop: this svadhisthana centre that yields all these gifts is also where ego lives, the one flaw to watch.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across a caption line break ('यही अहंकार' then 'रहता है').
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter's weak side is pride and dogma; the chakra mapping is not classical.

hindi: अहंकार बहुत होता है बृहस्पति में सबसे बड़ी समस्या क्या है गुरु घंटाल में अहंकार बहुत होता है
says: Jupiter carries a lot of ego; the biggest problem is that the 'guru-ghantal' (a shrewd, self-made guru type) is full of ego.
ambiguity: 'गुरु घंटाल' is slang for a cunning or pretentious guru, so he may mean the human guru type more than the planet.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts note pride, over-confidence and dogma as the weak side of Jupiter.

hindi: बड़े-बड़े ऐसे साधु संत गुरु हुए हैं जो लात मार के बात करते हैं क्योंकि उन्हें परवाह ही नहीं किसको लात मारते हैं
says: Many great saints and gurus have spoken with a 'kick' (rude, blunt manner) because they do not care whom they kick; Jupiter-type gurus are indifferent to status and flattery.
ambiguity: 'लात मार के बात करना' is figurative for blunt, rude speech and not literal violence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: य एक बड़ा अजीब सा प्रश्न है कि बदतमीज है क्योंकि तुम उसे खरीदना चाहते हो तुम उसे गिफ्ट से खरीदना चाहते हो पैसे से खरीदना चाहते हो लात मार देता है
says: Why is the guru rude? Because you want to buy him with gifts and money, and he kicks that away. The guru's rudeness is a reaction to being treated as purchasable.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गिफ्ट और पैसा कौन है माया कौन है शुक्र
says: Gifts and money are maya, and maya is Venus; Venus is the planet of money, gifts and worldly allure.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the karaka of wealth, gifts, luxury and sensual attraction; maya is often tied to Venus.

hindi: कौन है दैत्यों का गुरु बृहस्पति कौन है देवताओं का गुरु शत्रुता है
says: Venus is the guru of the daityas (asuras) and Jupiter is the guru of the devas, and there is enmity between the two.
ambiguity: The answer 'Venus' for the first question is implied by the previous sentence; the caption does not say it again.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukracharya teaches the asuras and Brihaspati the devas; in Parashari natural friendship Jupiter counts Venus an enemy while Venus is neutral to Jupiter.

hindi: बृहस्पति के आगे शुक्र की चल नहीं सकती
says: In front of Jupiter, Venus cannot prevail; wisdom and integrity outweigh money and allure.
ambiguity: 'चल नहीं सकती' means Venus's pull will not work on Jupiter; it is not a statement about the relative strength of two planets in a chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the greater benefic, but no classical rule says Venus always fails against Jupiter.

hindi: शुक्र जो है शुक्र भृगु जी का पुत्र है
says: Venus (Shukra) is the son of the sage Bhrigu.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukracharya is Bhrigu's son in Puranic accounts.

hindi: भृगु जी कौन है जो भविष्य भविष्य की कथाए लिखते हैं कई जन्मों का रहस्य
says: Bhrigu is the sage who writes accounts of the future and the secrets of many births (the Bhrigu Samhita tradition).
ambiguity: He names no text; 'भविष्य की कथाएं' is read as the Bhrigu Samhita style of birth-chart readings.
classical_check: Agrees: the Bhrigu Samhita is attributed to Bhrigu and records past-life and future accounts, though the book itself is later.

hindi: भगु जीी कौन है बृहस्पति साक्षात तो अजीब अजीब कहानिया है
says: Who is Bhrigu? Brihaspati himself in person (sakshat), and he adds that there are strange stories about this; so he treats Bhrigu and Jupiter as one.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; it may mean Bhrigu's knowledge is reached through Jupiter, not that the two are the same person.
classical_check: Differs: Bhrigu and Brihaspati (son of Angiras) are distinct sages in tradition.

hindi: लेकिन किसी हालत में बृहस्पति खरीदा नहीं जा सकता
says: In no condition can Jupiter be bought; the integrity of the guru principle has no price.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter signifies dharma and integrity; this rhetorical form is his.

hindi: तो जो व्यक्ति आपसे खरीदा नहीं जा सकता उसे गुरु बनाने लायक है वो यानी आप उसे यह कह नहीं सकते कि भैया इतने में बिक जाएगा आपके
says: A person who cannot be bought by you is the one worth taking as guru; you cannot put a price on him ('he will sell for this much'). Unbuyability is his test for a real guru.
ambiguity: The last word 'आपके' belongs to the next sentence and is kept here only because it is contiguous in the caption.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; agrees with the common ideal of an incorruptible guru.

hindi: बृहस्पति जैसे गुण यदि आपके अंदर होंगे तो आप रॉकेट है
says: If you carry Jupiter-like qualities (integrity, wisdom, unbuyability), you are a rocket: you rise fast and high in life.
ambiguity: The first word 'आपके' sits at the end of the previous caption line; 'रॉकेट' is an image for fast growth, not a measured prediction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the classical significator of growth and good fortune.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली के अंदर नौ नंबर का मालिक बृहस्पति है
says: In your chart the owner of number 9 is Jupiter: the 9th sign, Sagittarius, belongs to Jupiter, so it is the guru who runs that slot.
cells_derived_method: If number 9 is read as the sign, Sagittarius falls in a different house for each lagna and Jupiter is lord of that house; if it is the 9th house, Jupiter sits there as its natural karaka.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 1st house (lagna Sagittarius): the guru rules the self, giving a wise, expansive personality.
Derived: if number 9 means the 9th house, Jupiter in the 9th house in Aries (lagna Leo) sits in its natural house for fortune and dharma and acts with Mars-like drive.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' could mean the 9th sign (Sagittarius, by the series numbering) or the 9th house; both belong to Jupiter in tradition, and his next lines talk about houses.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter owns Sagittarius and is the natural karaka of the 9th house.

hindi: यह जहां बैठ जाता है यह औकात अपनी चलाता है किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनता
says: Wherever Jupiter sits he asserts his own authority and listens to nobody; Jupiter dominates the house he occupies.
cells_derived_method: The house Jupiter sits in shows what area gets dominated, and the sign shows how his dominance is styled and how strong it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 10th house in Aries (lagna Cancer): he dominates the career house; advice and teaching bend bosses and rules to his will.
Derived: Jupiter in the 7th house in Leo (lagna Aquarius): he dominates partnerships; the partner is respected but proud and the relationship runs on Jupiter's terms.
Derived: Jupiter in the 3rd house in Taurus (lagna Pisces): he dominates effort and communication with a steady, persuasive speaking style.

ambiguity: 'किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनता' is an idiom for acting entirely on his own authority.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically a house is ruled by its sign lord and Jupiter colours it by presence and by his 5th, 7th and 9th aspects; 'karako bhava nashaya' says Jupiter can also spoil houses he signifies.

hindi: पूरी कुंडली में 12 भावों में जहां बृहस्पति है वहीं कार चलेगा
says: Among the 12 houses of the chart, the house where Jupiter sits is where the 'car will run': things move and get done there, so Jupiter's house is the productive, active house.
cells_derived_method: The topic of the house with Jupiter is the one that runs; the sign sets how well it runs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 2nd house (lagna Scorpio): family, speech and money are the parts of life that run well.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 6th house (lagna Libra): service, daily work and handling of rivals and debts run strongly.
Derived: Jupiter in the 12th house in Taurus (lagna Gemini): spending, comforts and distant places are what run.

ambiguity: 'कार चलेगा' is figurative (affairs move); the next fragment 'दिल का चक' is garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter strengthens the matters of the house he occupies by presence, though 'karako bhava nashaya' warns against his sitting in houses he signifies.

gist: Garbled fragment ('दिल का चक दिल का चक्र है'); may be a remark about a heart centre but the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: अलग-अलग स्थानों पर बैठते हैं अलग-अलग फलित होते हैं
says: Planets give different results when they sit in different places; the house and sign position decides the outcome.
cells_derived_method: The same planet gives a different reading in each of the 144 house and sign cells; the house gives the area of life and the sign gives its strength and style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 1st house (lagna Aries): bold, self-driven and quick to act.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries): restless drive at home, so the domestic area is unsettled.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): strong, disciplined drive that shows in career.

ambiguity: Mars is only a worked example added here; he says it of planets in general.
classical_check: Agrees: results by house and sign (bhava and rashi phala) are the base of classical interpretation.

hindi: कुंडली में ये भाव होते हैं ये फिक्स होते हैं यह अलग-अलग भाव घर के फिक्स कमरों की तरह एक टॉयलेट है एक बात है एक किचन है एक बेडरूम है एक ड्राइंग है ऐसे फिक्स है
says: The houses of the chart are fixed, like the fixed rooms of a home: a toilet, a bath, a kitchen, a bedroom, a drawing room. Each house keeps its own topic, and only the occupants change.
ambiguity: 'एक बात है' is a caption slip for 'एक बाथ है'. The analogy says houses are fixed topics; he does not say here whether the signs on them are also fixed.
classical_check: Agrees: bhava significations (karakatwa) are fixed in classical Jyotish.

hindi: यह पहला है पहला ही रहेगा यह मेरा है
says: The first house stays the first house; it is 'mine', the house of the self, and its topic does not change.
cells_derived_method: The topic stays the self, but the sign on the 1st changes the style of self-expression.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 1st house in Aries (lagna Aries): the self shows as direct, fast and pioneering.
Derived: a planet in the 1st house in Libra (lagna Libra): the self shows as diplomatic, balance-seeking and partnership-minded.

ambiguity: He points at the chart; 'यह मेरा है' is read as the self house.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st house is tanu bhava, the self.

hindi: यह पत्नी का है य उसी का ही रहेगा
says: Another house belongs to the wife and always stays hers; the spouse topic has one fixed house.
cells_derived_method: He does not say the house number (classically the 7th); the sign on that house shades the type of spouse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th house in Libra (lagna Aries): the partner is refined, social and balance-seeking.
Derived: a planet in the 7th house in Scorpio (lagna Taurus): the partner is intense, private and strong-willed.

ambiguity: No house number is spoken; the 7th is assumed from tradition. 'पत्नी' is only the spouse in a male chart reading.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th house (kalatra bhava) is the house of the spouse.

hindi: यह मृत्यु का है उसी का रहेगा
says: One house is the house of death or endings and always stays that; its topic is fixed. He makes no prediction here, only the house label.
cells_derived_method: He does not say the number (classically the 8th); the sign on it shades its topics of endings, transformation, secrets and shared resources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th house in Scorpio (lagna Aries): intense, deep, research-minded handling of transformations and hidden matters.
Derived: a planet in the 8th house in Gemini (lagna Scorpio): the 8th-house topics are handled through curiosity, talk and restless mental effort.

ambiguity: No house number is spoken; the 8th is assumed from tradition.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th house (randhra, ayu bhava) is the house of endings, longevity and transformation.

hindi: यह धन का है वही रहेगा
says: Another house is the house of wealth, and it stays that; money has one fixed house.
cells_derived_method: He does not say the number (classically the 2nd, with the 11th for gains); the sign on it shades how money is earned and held.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 2nd house in Taurus (lagna Aries): money is built steadily and held with a love of comfort.
Derived: a planet in the 2nd house in Cancer (lagna Gemini): money is tied to family, home and food and flows with feeling.

ambiguity: No house number is spoken; the 2nd is assumed from tradition.
classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd house (dhana bhava) is the house of wealth.

hindi: खर्चे है बीमारी है वेस्टेज है
says: Further fixed houses are those of expenses, illness and waste (loss); each of these topics has its own house.
cells_derived_method: He gives no numbers (classically the 12th for expenses and loss, the 6th for disease, debts and enemies); the sign shades how these problems appear.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th house in Pisces (lagna Aries): losses and expenses are diffuse, spiritual or hidden.
Derived: a planet in the 6th house in Capricorn (lagna Leo): debts, daily work and health matters are handled slowly and with discipline.

ambiguity: No numbers are spoken; 'बीमारी' is the topic label of a house, not a diagnosis. 'वेस्टेज' is read as loss or waste.
classical_check: Agrees: the 6th and the 12th are the houses of disease and loss respectively.

hindi: धर्म का स्थान है माता का स्थान है पढ़ाई
says: There are also fixed houses for dharma, for the mother and for studies; he lists them as part of the fixed rooms.
cells_derived_method: He gives no numbers (classically the 9th for dharma, the 4th for mother, the 4th and 5th for studies); the sign shades the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th house in Sagittarius (lagna Aries): dharma, belief and teachers are strong, with an expansive, philosophical style.
Derived: a planet in the 4th house in Scorpio (lagna Leo): the mother bond and early schooling are intense and private.

ambiguity: No numbers are spoken; 'पढ़ाई' trails off and its house is not named.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is dharma, the 4th is mother and early education, the 5th is intelligence and learning.

gist: Promises that he will go through all of this in detail in a separate class and says it is great fun.

hindi: अब जुपिटर महाराज का क्या हाल है व जहां बैठ जाता है ना वो वहां बैठने के पश्चात वहां का मालिक बन जाता है उसके आगे किसी की नहीं चलती
says: Wherever Jupiter sits, after sitting he becomes the master (owner) of that house, and no one else's say prevails there; he overrides the house's own lord.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's dignity in the sign decides how complete his takeover is: strong in his own, exalted or friendly signs, and limited in a sign of fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 4th house in Libra (lagna Cancer): he overrides Venus, the sign lord, in matters of home, mother and comfort.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 8th house (lagna Sagittarius): his takeover is strong over shared resources, research and hidden matters.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): the claimed mastery is weak, as Saturn's sign limits him in career matters.

ambiguity: 'मालिक बन जाता है' may mean practical control of the house results or a figure for strong influence; no condition on his dignity is given by him.
classical_check: Differs: classically the sign lord stays the house lord; Jupiter influences by presence and by his 5th, 7th and 9th aspects and does not replace the lord.

hindi: अब धरती पर सबसे बड़े स्वागत करने वाले राजा महाराजा भी जिसके लिए खड़े हो
says: Even the grandest hosts on earth, kings and maharajas, rise to their feet for the one he is describing (the guru or Jupiter); it points to the rank Jupiter's authority commands. The sentence is cut at the end of the batch.
ambiguity: The sentence ends mid-way ('खड़े हो...') and its subject 'जिसके लिए' is not named; it likely continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the Devaguru and royal preceptor in tradition.

hindi: जाते हैं यानी सूर्य भी खड़ा हो जाता है अपना आसन छोड़ के कि गुरुजी आए गुरुजी आए ज्ञान आया ज्ञान आया
says: Jupiter commands such respect that even the Sun, the king among planets, gets up from his seat when Jupiter arrives, as if announcing that the guru and knowledge have come. He uses this picture to say Jupiter outranks every other planet in dignity.
ambiguity: The slice starts mid-sentence, so the first word is the tail of an earlier thought. It is a metaphor, not a measurable rule.
classical_check: Classical texts make the Sun king and Jupiter the minister and counsellor, so 'the Sun stands up for Jupiter' is a teaching image, not a classical statement.

hindi: और सूर्य की लंका कौन लगाता है राहु
says: The one planet that can wreck the Sun's standing is Rahu (he uses the slang 'who sets the Sun's Lanka on fire'). Rahu is the eclipser that swallows the Sun, so the Sun's authority, father and status themes are damaged whenever Rahu touches it.
cells_derived_method: Where Rahu joins or aspects the Sun, the damage shows in the topics of that house, coloured by the sign: a Sun in its high or home sign resists more, a Sun in its weak sign is hurt more.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th house with Rahu (lagna Cancer): the career and authority position is high but eclipsed by scandal, confusion or a boss who turns hostile.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 1st house with Rahu (lagna Libra): a weak Sun plus Rahu both hit the self, so vitality, confidence and ego identity are shaken from the start of life.
Derived: Sun in own sign Leo in the 9th house with Rahu (lagna Sagittarius): father, guru and dharma topics are clouded, which links to the ancestor theme he raises in the next lines.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the eclipser and a Sun-Rahu conjunction is a standard classical affliction (grahana dosha).

hindi: तो बृहस्पति की लंका भी राहु लगा सकता है उसे डिस्टर्ब सिर्फ राहु कर सकता है
says: Like the Sun, Jupiter too can be ruined by Rahu. He claims Rahu is the one and only planet able to disturb Jupiter, so Jupiter's knowledge, luck and teacher themes are safe from everyone else.
cells_derived_method: The Jupiter-Rahu damage lands on the house topics where the two meet (conjunction or aspect), and the sign decides how much Jupiter can resist: strong signs limit the harm, a fall sign adds to it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 5th house with Rahu (lagna Leo): intelligence and children topics carry Rahu's confusion or an unusual, delayed route to progeny, though the strong sign limits the damage.

Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house with Rahu (lagna Scorpio): luck is large but guru, father or tradition topics get distorted, for example a false teacher or a break from family faith.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 1st house with Rahu (lagna Capricorn): wisdom is shaky and the person's judgement is easily misled.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter-Rahu (guru-chandala yoga) is a known affliction, but the classics also name Saturn, Mars and Ketu as disturbers of Jupiter, so 'only Rahu' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: अब राहु का कंट्रोल किसके पास है राहु का कंट्रोल है पितरों के पास
says: Rahu is kept in check by the ancestors (pitar): how you stand with your forefathers decides whether Rahu behaves or runs wild.
ambiguity: He does not say whether 'control' means a house, a remedy or a cause-and-effect link.
classical_check: Not a classical Parashari statement; the classics tie ancestral curse (pitru dosha) mainly to the Sun, the 9th house and Rahu, so the Rahu-ancestor link is partly familiar.

hindi: हमारे घर के अंदर साउथ वेस्ट में डब्लू व का एरिया है वो पित्रों का स्थान होता है
says: Vastu link: inside the house the south-west zone is the ancestors' place, the zone he connects to Rahu's control over Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'डब्लू व का एरिया' is a caption error, perhaps an English abbreviation or a zone label; only 'south-west is the ancestors' place' is clear. Rahu is added from the surrounding lines, not named here.
classical_check: Matches Vastu tradition (south-west, Nairitya, is the zone of Rahu and the ancestors); the Jyotish classics are silent.

hindi: आप अपने पित्र नहीं छोड़ेंगे तो राहु कभी डिस्टर्ब नहीं करेगा बृहस्पति को
says: Remedy-style promise: if you do not abandon or neglect your ancestors, Rahu will never disturb your Jupiter. Honouring the forefathers is presented as the protection for Jupiter's blessings.
ambiguity: He does not say what 'not leaving the ancestors' involves (rites, remembrance, or keeping the south-west zone in order).
classical_check: Shraddha and tarpana for the ancestors are classical pitru-dosha remedies; the absolute claim 'Rahu never disturbs Jupiter' is his own.

hindi: यानी राहु डिस्टर्ब नहीं करेगा तो केतु नहीं लपेटे अभी बात करेंगे तो बृहस्पति गिरेगा नहीं
says: If Rahu does not disturb Jupiter, then Ketu will not wrap him up either (he says he will take up Ketu shortly), and Jupiter will not fall. So the ancestor remedy is meant to protect against both nodes.
ambiguity: 'केतु नहीं लपेटे अभी बात करेंगे' is garbled; read as 'Ketu will not entangle him, we will talk about Ketu in a moment'.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not make Ketu's behaviour depend on Rahu being quiet.

hindi: और बृहस्पति कौन है पुरुष ग्रह शुक्र कौन है स्त्री ग्रह पुरुष का भी है स्त्री का भी है
says: He classes Jupiter as the male planet and Venus as the female planet, then adds that each belongs to both men and women, apparently meaning every chart carries both principles.
ambiguity: 'पुरुष का भी है स्त्री का भी है' could mean both planets matter in men's and women's charts, or that Venus alone serves both; the caption does not settle it.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is masculine and Venus feminine in the classical gender table, and the karaka roles (Jupiter for a woman's husband, Venus for a man's wife) fit 'for both'.

hindi: सारे पुरुष जो ज्ञानी बने सबका सत्यानाश स्त्री के थ्रू हुआ है वो जमीन पर गिरे क्योंकि वहीं से बदनामी और खराबी आती है यानी राहु ग्रसित कर जाता है एक अकेला काम
says: He claims every man who rose to wisdom or fame was brought down through a woman (the Venus side), because disgrace and ruin arrive from that quarter, and that this is Rahu's single job: seizing Jupiter. In plain terms, Jupiter's standing falls when Venus matters are corrupted by Rahu.
ambiguity: A sweeping, anecdotal claim; it is unclear whether 'woman' means a Venus placement, a relationship or just a lecture illustration.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the classics read scandal from Jupiter-Venus-Rahu and 7th or 12th house afflictions, but this blanket statement about all men is not classical.

hindi: बृहस्पति राहु की बात प आएंगे ये बृहस्पति अगर आपका यहां बैठा है लग्न के अंदर तो इसकी तीन दृष्टियां है
says: He parks the Jupiter-Rahu topic ('we will come back to it') and turns to Jupiter's reach: Jupiter placed in the lagna (1st house) casts three aspects, which he then walks through on the chart.
cells_derived_method: The three aspects always fall on the 5th, 7th and 9th from the seat; for a lagna Jupiter the signs they land on depend on the lagna sign, and the friendship of Jupiter with each target sign lord sets how well each look works.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in lagna Cancer aspects the 5th (Scorpio), 7th (Capricorn) and 9th (Pisces): the 9th gets a look into his home sign, the 5th lands on a Mars water sign, and the 7th falls on Capricorn where he is uncomfortable.

Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in lagna aspects Aries (5th), Gemini (7th) and Leo (9th): the fire signs Aries and Leo get friendly, strong support, while Gemini, a Mercury sign, is the weakest of the three looks.

Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn lagna aspects Taurus (5th), Cancer (7th) and Virgo (9th): weak in himself, but his look on Cancer, the sign where he is strongest, helps the partner house, while Taurus and Virgo are less friendly for the 5th and 9th.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter has the special 5th and 9th aspects plus the 7th that every planet has (BPHS).

hindi: चौथे घर में सामने जाती है एक सबकी जाती है सामने
says: One of the lagna Jupiter's aspects goes straight across to the opposite house, the full 7th-house look that every planet has. The 'fourth house' in the caption does not fit and looks like a slip or a gesture at the board.
cells_derived_method: The 7th-house look lands on the sign opposite Jupiter; that sign's lord and nature set which partner or public-dealing topics he supports.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in lagna Aries looks at the 7th house in Libra: marriage and partnerships get a wise, protective look, but Libra is Venus's sign (a rival of Jupiter), so the partner is supportive yet demanding.
Derived: Jupiter in lagna Cancer looks at the 7th house in Capricorn: the partner is older, serious and duty-bound, and the look softens but does not remove delay in marriage.
Derived: Jupiter in lagna Virgo looks at the 7th house in Pisces, a sign in Jupiter's own sign group: partnership gets his fullest support, a kind and spiritual partner.

ambiguity: 'चौथे घर में' (in the 4th house) does not fit Jupiter's aspects (5, 7, 9); it is probably garbled or a gesture at the board.
classical_check: Agrees on the 7th aspect common to all planets; a 4th aspect is Mars's special aspect, not Jupiter's.

hindi: एक दो तीन 4 5 6 7 8 9 10 11 12 ये हमारा पूर्व जन्म है पूर्व का भाग्य ये हमारा इस जन्म का भाग्य है यह मैं हूं यह मेरा साथी
says: He counts the houses one to twelve round the chart and points at the four places Jupiter touches from the lagna: the 5th is the past-life account (earlier merit), the 9th is fortune of this life, the 1st is 'I' (the self) and the 7th is 'my partner'.
cells_derived_method: Each house topic (past merit, fortune, self, partner) is coloured by the sign on it and the lord of that sign; Jupiter's friendship with the sign lord decides how well his look works there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer puts Scorpio on the 5th: past merit shows through research, depth and hidden knowledge, and Jupiter's look softens Mars's intense water sign.
Derived: lagna Cancer puts Pisces on the 9th: fortune comes through faith, teachers and charity, and Jupiter looks into his home sign, so this is a very protected luck house.
Derived: lagna Cancer puts Capricorn on the 7th: the partner is older, disciplined and duty-bound, and Jupiter's look eases but does not remove restraint.

Derived: lagna Aquarius makes the 'I' detached and group-minded; Jupiter in lagna reaches Gemini (5th), Leo (7th) and Libra (9th), so partner support from Leo is better than luck support from Libra, a sign of his rival Venus.

ambiguity: He does not say the numbers 5, 9, 1, 7 aloud; the mapping is inferred from Jupiter's aspect pattern and his labels (past birth, this birth, 'I', 'my partner').
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is purva punya, the 9th is bhagya, the 1st is the self and the 7th is the spouse.

hindi: चार जगह बृहस्पति की मलकीत है पूरे तौर पे किसी हालत में वहां पर किसी की चलने नहीं देता
says: From the lagna, Jupiter owns four places outright: the lagna itself and the three houses he looks at (5th, 7th, 9th). In his words nobody else's say counts there under any condition.
cells_derived_method: How firm the grip is depends on Jupiter's own sign and on the signs lying on the four houses: in a home or friendly sign his hold is firm, in an enemy or fall sign it is weaker though still present on his claim.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in lagna holds the 1st plus Cancer (5th, a sign where he is very strong), Virgo (7th, Mercury's sign, uneasy) and Scorpio (9th, Mars's sign, friendly).

Derived: Jupiter in Gemini lagna (a Mercury sign, not friendly to him) is not strong in himself but still claims Libra (5th), Sagittarius (7th, his home sign) and Aquarius (9th); the 7th is the best supported of the four.

Derived: Jupiter in Mars's sign Scorpio in lagna (friendly) reaches Pisces (5th) and Cancer (9th), both signs where he is very strong, so luck and children topics are well protected; the 7th in Taurus (Venus) is the weaker spot.

ambiguity: 'Four places' is inferred from the previous pointing: the seat plus three aspect houses.
classical_check: Partly differs: classics say a Jupiter aspect protects the house it falls on, but other influences on that house are still weighed; 'nobody else's say counts' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: अगर और ग्रहों का सम्मेलन है यानी और ग्रह भी इफेक्ट डाल रहे देख रहे हैं तो काम अलग है
says: A caveat: all this holds when Jupiter acts alone. If other planets also sit with or aspect the same places, the outcome is a different matter and has to be read as a combination.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical method weighs conjunctions and aspects on a house together.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति जब गुरु ज्ञान यानी आप आकाश गंगा से ही जल चक्र जो जन्म देता है जीवन देता है
says: Jupiter is the guru and knowledge planet, and he is also tied to the sky-born water cycle (he names the Milky Way) that gives birth and keeps life going. So Jupiter is both the teacher and a source of life itself.
ambiguity: 'आकाश गंगा से ही जल चक्र' is loosely phrased; it may mean rain falling from the sky as the source of life, or the Ganga of the heavens.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is jiva karaka (giver of life) and rules ether; tying him to a water cycle is his own image, since the classics give water to Venus and the Moon.

hindi: मकान बनाना है कुछ बनाना है आपके शरीर की शक्ति लगती है उसमें तभी कहते ना कुछ जी बनाई तो शरीर घट गया वो नेचुरल है आपके शरीर पर चोट आएगी
says: Creating anything, such as building a house, uses up your own body energy, so the body shrinks or takes a knock; he calls this natural. It is loosely tied to Jupiter's role as the creator and life-giver.
ambiguity: 'कुछ जी बनाई तो शरीर घट गया' is garbled, and the link to Jupiter is inferred from the preceding line, not stated.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule links creative effort to bodily loss through Jupiter.

gist: Pointing at the board, he repeats that Jupiter in the lagna looks at the lagna and three other places (the four-places picture already given).

hindi: अगर यहां बैठेगा तो यहां यहां ऐसे दृष्टियां जाएगी भावों की बात अलग होगी
says: If Jupiter sits in some other house, the same three-aspect pattern moves with him and falls on the 5th, 7th and 9th counted from his new seat, so the house topics he reaches are different.
cells_derived_method: The pattern is always 5th, 7th and 9th from the seat; which life topics and which signs get covered depends on Jupiter's house and sign, and the lagna sign fixes the sign names.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 4th house in Libra (lagna Cancer) aspects the 8th (Aquarius), 10th (Aries) and 12th (Gemini): a home-and-comfort Jupiter reaches sudden events, career and losses, with the best support on career through friendly Aries.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th house (lagna Aries) aspects the 1st (Aries), 3rd (Gemini) and 5th (Leo): fortune planet supports self, effort and intelligence.

Derived: Jupiter in the 12th house in Taurus (lagna Gemini) aspects the 4th (Virgo), 6th (Scorpio) and 8th (Capricorn): an expense-and-foreign-lands Jupiter guards home, protects against rivals and debts, and touches hidden matters.

classical_check: Agrees: the aspects are counted 5, 7, 9 from wherever Jupiter sits.

hindi: लेकिन इसके पास पूर्वजन्म की मलकीत है यही पितरों का स्थान भी है ये इस जन्म का है
says: Whatever house topics change, Jupiter keeps the past-life property, and that same place is also the ancestors' seat, while the other spot belongs to this birth. So what you get through Jupiter is a mix of inherited merit and present luck.
cells_derived_method: Whether inherited merit or this-life luck dominates depends on the sign and lord of the 5th and 9th houses and on Jupiter's dignity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius puts Aries on the 5th: past merit shows through initiative, leadership and sport, and Aries is a friendly sign for Jupiter, so the inheritance is active.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius puts Leo on the 9th: fortune and the father line carry authority and fame, and the Sun is Jupiter's friend, so luck comes with status.
Derived: lagna Libra puts Gemini on the 9th: fortune and the father line run through communication, writing and trade; Mercury is not friendly to Jupiter, so luck needs effort.

ambiguity: 'यही पितरों का स्थान' does not say which house: classically the 9th is the father and ancestors' house and the 5th is past-life merit, so he may mean either or fuse them.
classical_check: Agrees on the 5th as purva punya and the 9th as father and dharma; he merges ancestors into the past-life place.

hindi: यानी आप कितने लकी हो अगर इसकी कृपा मिलती है
says: How lucky you are depends on whether you receive Jupiter's grace; he treats Jupiter's favour as the measure of a person's good fortune.
ambiguity: 'इसकी' (its) is a pointer; read as Jupiter from the earlier lines, but it could also mean the ancestors or a guru.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Jupiter is the chief benefic and karaka of fortune.

gist: Anecdote about a saint he calls Ananda Maharaj (with a person named Mange Ram) who is said to carry Krishna 'in his pocket', so that the saint's grace equals God's.

hindi: तो कृष्ण भी नहीं सुनता जिनकी यानी भगवान भी नहीं सुनता जिनकी उनको उनकी कौन सुनेगा या तो पितर सुनेंगे तो पता करो भाई या किसी की कृपा लेना भाग्य बनाओ
says: For a person whom even God does not listen to, nobody else will either; the only hearings left are the ancestors (so find out what is pending with them) or the grace of a realised person. That is how he says you build fortune when luck is missing.
ambiguity: 'पता करो भाई' could mean 'check what duty to the ancestors is unfulfilled' or 'check for a pitru dosha'; he does not say which.
classical_check: Pitru remedies and guru-seva are classical, but the framing here is his own.

hindi: भाग्य कौन देगा कोई आनंदा महाराज देंगे जो बैठ कर के कृष्ण से मिले जुले हैं आपकी तो मौज हो गई तर गए आप
says: Fortune will be handed over by a saint who sits in company with Krishna, someone like Ananda Maharaj; with that grace you are made and you cross over. Guru-grace is offered as the practical source of luck when the chart gives little.
ambiguity: This is spiritual advice naming a person, not a chart factor; the exact name is a caption guess.
classical_check: Silent: guru-grace is a general devotional idea, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति की मजे की बात यहां बैठा अगर तो यहां बैठ के भी वो यहां और यहां देख इसकी दृष्टि अलग किस्म के दृष्टि मीन इंपैक्ट कहां है अगर वो यहां बैठा है तो भी यही तीन
says: The interesting thing about Jupiter: from whatever seat he looks at the opposite house and two more, and his aspects are of a special kind. He says the main impact still falls on the same three things in every placement.
cells_derived_method: Counted from his own seat, the aspects shift; so 'the same three' holds only if the three themes are read from Jupiter's seat, not from the lagna, which changes which house topics are touched.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th house (lagna Cancer) still aspects the 11th (Taurus), 1st (Cancer) and 3rd (Virgo): a weak Jupiter still looks at gains, the self and effort.

Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 10th house (lagna Gemini) aspects the 2nd (Cancer), 4th (Virgo) and 6th (Scorpio): a career-peak Jupiter feeds family wealth, home and service or rival matters, with his strongest look on Cancer.
Derived: Jupiter in the 3rd house in Leo (lagna Gemini) aspects the 7th (Sagittarius), 9th (Aquarius) and 11th (Aries): an effort-and-courage placement lifts partnership, fortune and gains.

ambiguity: 'यही तीन' refers to something on the board and is named only in the next sentence; the number of aspects (three) matches 5th, 7th, 9th.
classical_check: Agrees that the aspects travel with Jupiter's seat; the claim that the same three themes stay prominent is not classical.

hindi: यानी ये सबसे प्रमुख पूर्व जन्म का भाग्य इस जन्म का भाग्य और जो मैं हूं यह सारा का सारा अकेला बृहस्पति जो पकड़ के चलता है
says: The three most important things in a life, past-life fortune, this-life fortune and the self ('I'), are all held by Jupiter alone, which is why he treats Jupiter as the key planet.
cells_derived_method: Which of the three is strongest depends on Jupiter's sign and house: the more dignified he is, the better he holds past merit, luck and self; a weak seat makes the same three come late or through effort.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Pisces in the 5th house (lagna Scorpio): past merit and intelligence are held by Jupiter at full strength, so the past-life account reading is the strongest.

Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus): this-life luck is held by a weak Jupiter, so his claim that Jupiter still holds it means fortune arrives late or through effort.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer): the self is held at full strength, giving a wise, protective personality.

ambiguity: Which three things are meant is inferred from the board talk (past fortune, present fortune, 'I'); he is not counting house numbers.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is natural karaka of the 5th, 9th and life force, but the Sun, not Jupiter, is the usual karaka of the self.

hindi: यह किसी भी राशि का होगा मान लो बृहस्पति शनि की राशि में या नीच का है बृहस्पति नीच का होता है अगर 10 नंबर राशि का हो तो भी ज्ञान देगा
says: Whatever sign Jupiter is in, even Saturn's sign or his fall sign (he says sign number 10, Capricorn), he will still give knowledge. The result will be of a different kind, but the knowing quality is kept.
cells_derived_method: The house where the weak or Saturn-sign Jupiter sits decides which life area receives his knowledge (career, partner, children); the sign adds slowness, discipline and structure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): career is built through knowledge-based work such as teaching, advice or law, but progress is slow and hard-won.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th house (lagna Cancer): wisdom arrives through partners and dealings with a mature spouse, with delay.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra): in Saturn's sign his learning turns systematic and scientific and children come after some delay.

ambiguity: '10 नंबर राशि' is read as sign number 10 = Capricorn, which matches Jupiter's fall; the caption does not say whether 'Saturn's sign' also covers Aquarius.
classical_check: Capricorn as Jupiter's fall agrees with the classics; 'still gives knowledge' is softer than the texts, which weaken a fallen planet unless neecha-bhanga applies.

hindi: फल अलग किस्म का होगा इसका तो भी ज्ञानी ही बनाएगा गजब का जन देगा व्यक्ति को बेटा भी दे देगा नहीं तो बेटा मार देता है जिसका बृहस्पति
says: Even in such a weak sign the result changes in kind, but Jupiter still makes the person learned, gives something remarkable and even a son; otherwise, in the bad case, a spoiled Jupiter takes the son away. The son-loss part is his claim about children, recorded and not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: How the fall sign touches progeny depends on the 5th house and its lord and on where Jupiter sits relative to the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th house (lagna Virgo): the child house is held by the fallen karaka, so children come late and with strain.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus): luck and teaching are delayed, and the children topic is reached only through his aspects on the 1st, 3rd and 5th houses.

ambiguity: 'गजब का जन' is unclear (remarkable people, or remarkable knowledge), and the last clause is cut short, perhaps 'whose Jupiter is spoiled'.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of sons is classical, and a karaka afflicted in the child house is read as harming progeny, but 'kills the son' as a blanket statement is his own.

hindi: यह संतान का स्थान होता है यहां पर इंपैक्ट डालता है 30 साल की उम्र से पहले बेटा पैदा नहीं होता उसके बेटियां होती रहेगी ढेर लगा देगा
says: This (the 5th) is the children's house and Jupiter's look lands there. With that impact a son is not born before the age of 30 and daughters keep coming, in heaps. It is an age-30 and sex-of-child claim, recorded as his statement.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th and its lord colour the delay: Saturn-ruled or earth signs on the 5th already delay children, while a Jupiter-ruled or Sun-ruled 5th gives them readily, so his 'after 30' fits only some cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo puts Capricorn on the 5th, a Saturn sign that itself delays children, so a Jupiter look here fits a late first child, which agrees with his after-30 idea.
Derived: lagna Aries puts Leo on the 5th, the natural child sign, so a Jupiter look gives children readily and an after-30 delay would need another cause such as an affliction.
Derived: lagna Pisces puts Cancer on the 5th, the sign where Jupiter is strongest, so his look is at its best and a late son would not follow from Jupiter alone.

ambiguity: 'यह' points at the 5th house on the board. No trigger is given (which Jupiter position or affliction), so the age-30 claim has no stated condition.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give no rule of 'son only after 30' from a Jupiter aspect on the 5th.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति का य एस्पेक्ट आ गया और यह भले नीच का यानी बर्बाद कर दूंगा तबाह कर दूंगा स्थान को तो भी पुत्र देगा
says: If Jupiter's aspect reaches the children's house, even when Jupiter is in his fall sign and ready to wreck the place, he will still give a son.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter reaches the 5th from the 1st, 9th or 11th house; the sign on the 5th then tells how comfortable the aspect is, and a fallen seat colours the result with strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 1st house (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 5th, Taurus: a son is given despite the weak Jupiter, but Taurus (Venus, a rival) adds friction.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus) aspects the 5th, Virgo (Mercury's sign): the aspect gives a son but with worry and criticism around the child.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 11th house (lagna Pisces) aspects the 5th, Cancer, the sign where he is strongest: a son is likely and the weak seat matters little.

ambiguity: 'ये एस्पेक्ट' points at a board gesture: the target is assumed to be the 5th from the previous lines.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a Jupiter aspect on the 5th is classical support for children, but a fallen Jupiter is normally read as weakening the promise unless neecha-bhanga applies.

hindi: भले उस पुत्र से सुख ना मिले वो फाइट अलग है लेकिन परम ज्ञानी दे सकता है
says: Whether the son brings happiness is a separate battle; the point here is only that Jupiter, the supreme knower, is able to give a son even in a bad condition.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the classics separate having a child from happiness through the child, judged from the 5th house, its lord and the karaka.

hindi: तो यह प्लेनेट एक ऐसा बृहस्पति है यानी कि हमारा सेक्स चक्र हमारा र वाटर चक चक्र हमारा जो वाटर एलिमेंट वो ऐसा है
says: Jupiter rules our sex (sacral) chakra and the water chakra, and through it the water element in the body. He is building up to Jupiter as the planet of body fluids, weight and reproduction.
ambiguity: 'र वाटर चक चक्र' is a stutter, read as 'water chakra'; the sentence is also left unfinished ('वो ऐसा है').
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish gives water to Venus and the Moon and ether to Jupiter; the chakra mapping is a later tantric overlay.

hindi: सारे लोग क्या परेशान होते हैं यार पेट बड़ा निकल गया है यार मोटे हो गए ये सारा स्यापा बृहस्पति का है
says: The things people commonly complain about, a swollen belly and weight gain, are all Jupiter's doing, in his view. This is a body-weight karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is karaka of fat and a stout body in the classical texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति की आकृति क्या है दाढ़ी वाला है बूढ़ा है क्योंकि ज्ञानी है ना बाबा है और उसका पेट निकला हुआ थोड़ा सा
says: He gives Jupiter's physical image: a bearded, aged baba because he is the wise one, with a slightly protruding belly. This is the signature he uses to recognise Jupiter's influence in a person.
classical_check: Close to the classics, which describe Jupiter as large-bodied with tawny hair and a stout build; the beard and baba figure are his image.

hindi: अब मोदी जी को देखो आप उनका बृहस्पति जो है वक्री है उनकी कुंडली में वक्र क्व है मोदी जी के ऊपर उसका इंपैक्ट क्यों नहीं है
says: As a test case he takes the public figure Modi, says Jupiter is retrograde in his chart, and asks why the harm expected from a retrograde Jupiter is not visible in him. The chart claim is his and is not checked here.
ambiguity: 'वक्र क्व' is a garbled 'वक्री'; whether this person's Jupiter is retrograde is his claim and is not verified.
classical_check: Differs from his own later line: the classics treat a retrograde planet as strong (cheshta bala), so a retrograde Jupiter doing well agrees with the texts, while calling retrograde a defect (his liver lines) conflicts with them.

hindi: पुखराज तो पहना नहीं उन्होंने दाढ़ी रखी हुई है थोड़ी सी प्यारी सी मोटी सी तोंद है उनकी प्यारी सी और मोदी जी बाबा की तरह चलते
says: He notes that this person has not worn a yellow sapphire (Jupiter's gem) yet shows Jupiter's marks: a beard, a small belly and a baba-like manner. So Jupiter's signature appears in a person even without any gem.
ambiguity: It is an observation about one named person's looks, not a rule; the gem point is only an aside.
classical_check: Yellow sapphire (pukhraj) is the standard classical gem for Jupiter; that Jupiter's effects show without it is his observation.

hindi: बृहस्पति सिर्फ सपोर्ट कर रहा है छाया हुआ बंदा जहां जाए आग लगा दूंगा कहने का मतलब उसके आगे चलती किसी की नहीं
says: Jupiter here is simply giving support, and the person is overpowering, the 'wherever I go I will set it ablaze' type; before such a person nobody's word carries. His point is that a strong Jupiter makes one dominant.
ambiguity: The sentence is rhetorical and loosely tied to the earlier retrograde question.
classical_check: Loosely agrees: a strong, well-placed Jupiter gives authority and following; the 'nobody else counts' wording is rhetorical.

hindi: तो जितने राहु केतु वगैरह ये तंग करेंगे नो डाउट केतु भी तंग करता है राहु भी करता है तो वो तो स्पेस करना पड़ेगा लाइफ में क्योंकि जितना प्लस होगा उतना माइनस
says: Rahu and Ketu will cause trouble regardless, and you have to face that in life, because the bigger the plus, the bigger the minus. Even a life with a mighty Jupiter carries a node-sized difficulty.
ambiguity: 'स्पेस करना पड़ेगा' in the caption is read as 'फेस करना पड़ेगा' (must face).
classical_check: Silent: the plus-minus balance is a general karmic idea, not a classical formula.

hindi: हमने मोदी जी शब्द इसलिए बोला बहुत से ऐसे लोग हैं सफेद दाढ़ी रख लेने मात्र से ही आपका बृहस्पति का काम सेट हो गया आपको उसके द्वारा नेगेटिव वाइब्रेशंस नहीं आएंगे
says: He explains why he used the example: many people keep a white beard and so, in this idea, their Jupiter business is set and no negative vibration reaches them through Jupiter. A beard is offered as a Jupiter-pleasing habit, though the caption does not make clear whether he endorses it or is teasing the belief.
ambiguity: 'मात्र से ही' may signal a caution ('merely keeping a beard does not fix Jupiter') or an endorsement; the next lines about a defective Jupiter suggest the caution reading is possible.
classical_check: Not classical: a beard is not a listed Jupiter remedy (classical Jupiter remedies are yellow items, gold, guru service and Thursday fasting).

hindi: बृहस्पति के पास क्या है एक तरह का गुरु है हमारा तो बृहस्पति के पास हमारा लीवा है
says: Jupiter, our guru, holds our liver: the liver is under Jupiter's charge. This is a body-part karaka statement, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'लीवा' is read as 'liver' from the lines that follow.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of the liver and fat.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में बृहस्पति में डिफेक्ट है वक्री है सही राशि का नहीं है किसी शत्रु राशि में बैठा है
says: He lists what makes Jupiter defective in a chart: retrograde, not in a suitable sign, or sitting in an enemy's sign. He then attaches liver outcomes to such a Jupiter in the next lines.
cells_derived_method: Which signs count as enemy signs decides the defective cells: for Jupiter the classical enemies are Mercury and Venus (Gemini, Virgo, Taurus, Libra), plus Capricorn as his fall; the house shows which life area carries the defect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 6th house (lagna Capricorn): he sits in an enemy's sign in the house of service, debts and illness, so his protective role is reduced there.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 12th house (lagna Scorpio): Venus's sign, a rival, in the house of loss and foreign lands, so wisdom is spent abroad or in retreat and protection is reduced.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries): the money and speech house in Venus's sign, so wealth and family blessings come with strain and teaching may turn materialist.

ambiguity: 'सही राशि का नहीं है' is vague: it may mean any non-friendly sign, which overlaps with the enemy-sign clause.
classical_check: Partly differs: enemy-sign placement is a classical weakness, but the classics treat a retrograde planet as strong, not defective.

hindi: आप सीधा बोल दो ग्रेड वन फैटी लीवर तो तुझे है ही बंदा बेहोश कहेगा यार कमाल है ग्रेड वन फैटी लीवर इसे कैसे पता
says: He says that to a person with such a defective Jupiter you can bluntly state 'you have grade one fatty liver' and they will be stunned that you knew. This is a medical diagnosis claim, recorded as his statement only and not to be output by the engine.
classical_check: The classics list the liver among Jupiter's significations, but naming a clinical grade of a disease is not classical and is not safe to use.

hindi: अगर वो ज्यादा बिगड़ा तो ग्रेड टू कर देगा लिवर फेलियर
says: If Jupiter's affliction worsens, he says it rises to grade two and then liver failure. This is a medical severity claim, recorded as his statement only and not to be used as a prediction.
ambiguity: The subject of 'बिगड़ा' is taken as Jupiter; it could also mean the liver itself worsening.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give no graded disease scale for Jupiter's affliction.

hindi: मजे की बात है चूंकि मरता नहीं देवता ग्रह और सबसे पावरफुल ग्रह है आपका लीवर फेल भी होने के बाद दोबारा रिकवर हो जाता है
says: Because Jupiter is a god-planet that does not die and is the most powerful planet, your liver can recover again even after it has failed. He reads the liver's recovery as Jupiter's deathless quality. A health claim recorded as his statement.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not link Jupiter's divinity to organ recovery.

hindi: 20 पैसे लीवर बचा हुआ है वो दोबारा से सेट हो जाता है दोबारा जिंदा कर देता है
says: Even if only about a fifth of the liver is left, it resets and brings the organ back to life, in his telling. A health claim recorded as his statement, not medical advice.
ambiguity: '20 पैसे' is probably a caption slip for '20 percent'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text speaks of a remaining percentage of the liver.

hindi: काट के लगा दो दूसरे में कुछ ऑर्गन नहीं है बॉडी के अंदर बंदा भी बचा हुआ वो भी बचा हुआ है लिवर के काट के दूसरे के लगा दो वो भी जी गया तुम भी जी गए
says: Only the liver lets you cut a part out and implant it in another person with both donor and recipient surviving; no other organ in the body allows this. He offers it as another sign of Jupiter's life-giving quality.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the earlier chunk ('काट के') and runs into the next; the transplant remark is medical talk used as an analogy.
classical_check: Silent: it is a biological analogy, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: यह गजब है लिवर के ऑर्गन है जो ग्रो री ग्रो कर सकता है
says: The liver is the organ that can grow itself back. He presents this self-renewal as the body-level picture of Jupiter's repeated revival, which he is about to carry over to knowledge.
classical_check: Silent: self-renewal of the liver is a biological fact used as an analogy, not a classical rule.

hindi: ज्ञान एक अकेली चीज है जो आपके जीवन के अंदर बार-बार आ सकता है कल जो आपको गधा लगा था आज फिर इंटरव्यू लो हो सकता है आज ज्ञानी हो गया हो
says: Knowledge is the one thing that can enter your life again and again: someone who looked like a fool yesterday may turn out wise when you meet him today. So Jupiter's gifts are renewable, like the liver.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it fits Jupiter as the planet of learning and the idea that Jupiter periods can reverse fortunes.

hindi: कहीं ना कहीं एक बेवकूफ मूर्ख कातिल रत्नाकर भी हो सकता है वाल्मीकि बन जाए तो बड़ी विचित्र सी स्थिति है आपके जीवन की आपको ज्ञान कहीं से भी आ सकता है
says: Even a fool or killer like Ratnakar can turn into Valmiki, so knowledge can arrive in your life from anywhere, however low the starting point. He uses this as the example of Jupiter's power to transform a person.
classical_check: Silent: the Ratnakar-Valmiki tale is a Puranic anecdote, not a chart rule.

gist: He says whether Ratnakar really became Valmiki is controversial, so he will not argue it and treats it only as a story.

hindi: इसलिए आपके जुपिटर का इतना बड़ा रोल है और इसी के पास प्रजनन क्षमता है
says: That is why Jupiter's role in your life is so big, and the ability to reproduce also rests with him.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the putra karaka (children), though fertility is also judged through Venus, Mars and the 5th house.

hindi: अगर ऋषि मुनि पैदा होते हैं तो ज्ञान के द्वारा पुत्र प्राप्ति होती है बेटा देता है बृहस्पति
says: When sages are born, the son comes through knowledge: it is Jupiter who gives the son, here tied to wisdom and sage-like children.
ambiguity: The first clause is loose; it may mean 'sages are born of knowledge-based son-getting' or 'if a sage-like child is to be born'.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka that gives sons.

hindi: लेकिन लंबी आयु के बाद कैसे देता है यदि शुक्र पूर्ण
says: He raises how Jupiter gives the son late, after a long age, and makes it depend on Venus being 'full' (strong or supportive). The sentence is cut and the logic is only half visible.
ambiguity: 'लंबी आयु के बाद' may mean after a long delay or after a long life, and 'शुक्र पूर्ण' is cut off; the conditions cannot be fixed from the caption.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong Venus helping Jupiter for progeny is not a standard classical rule, though Venus matters for conception.

hindi: शुक्र दैत्यों का देवता गुरु है बृहस्पति देवताओं का है
says: Venus is the guru of the daityas (demons), and Jupiter is the guru of the devas (gods): the two planets are teachers of opposing camps.
ambiguity: The wording 'दैत्यों का देवता गुरु' is garbled; read as 'guru of the demons'.
classical_check: Agrees: Shukracharya is the guru of the asuras and Brihaspati of the devas.

hindi: अगर देवताओं के गुरु और दैत्यों के गुरु में प्रेम हो क्योंकि शत्रु है प्रेम तो हो नहीं सकता यानी रिस्पेक्ट हो केयर हो तो क्या
says: He sets up a condition: Jupiter and Venus are enemies, so love between them is not possible, but if there were respect and care between the two, what then? The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice, so the consequence is missing.
ambiguity: The answer is not in this slice, and it is unclear how 'respect and care' would show in a chart (aspect, exchange, or conjunction).
classical_check: Partly differs: in the Parashari table Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy, but Venus treats Jupiter as neutral, so 'mutual enemies' is not exact.

hindi: होगा दोनों के द्वारा जो नई कहानी बनेगी नई श्रंखला बनेगी कितनी कमाल होगी
says: He finishes the question left open at the end of the last slice: when Jupiter and Venus, the two enemy gurus, show mutual respect and care, something is created by both together, a new story and a new chain (a fresh lineage), and he calls it wonderful. Jupiter-Venus harmony is read as the creative union that gives progeny.
ambiguity: The opening word 'होगा' continues the previous slice's unfinished 'तो क्या'. 'New chain' is read as a new generation, which the next sentences confirm.
classical_check: Silent as a stated rule; the classics call Jupiter and Venus natural enemies, though a mutual aspect or exchange between them is read as giving learning and wealth.

hindi: इसलिए जब स्त्री सेक्सुअल एक्टिविटी में पूर्ण रूप से संतुष्ट होती है पूर्ण संतुष्ट संतुष्टि मिलती है उसको शारीरिक मानसिक तो पुत्र पैदा होता है बृहस्पति तब कृपा देता है
says: When a woman is fully satisfied in sexual activity, bodily and mentally, a son is born, and Jupiter then bestows his grace. This is a child-sex claim tied to the mother's contentment, recorded as his statement and not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not link a child's sex to the mother's sexual satisfaction; they use sign and planet rules on the 5th house.

hindi: क्योंकि सेक्स चक्र यही है हमारा यही वाटर चक्र है
says: He gives the reason for the last claim: the sex (sacral) chakra, which is also the water chakra, is Jupiter's own centre, so Jupiter's blessing of a son works through it.
ambiguity: 'यही' points back to Jupiter from the earlier lines; it is not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Differs: the chakra and water mapping to Jupiter is a modern overlay; the classics give water to Venus and the Moon.

hindi: यानी बेटा तब पैदा होगा अगर स्त्री परेशान है सताई हुई है तनाव में है कोई क्वेश्चन मार्क है बेटी पैदा होगी
says: A son comes only in that content state; if the woman is troubled, harassed, under tension or in doubt, a daughter will be born. Again a child-sex claim linked to the mother's state of mind, recorded as his statement.
ambiguity: The caption reads as if the son comes when she is troubled, but the closing 'बेटी पैदा होगी' shows that the 'अगर' condition belongs to the daughter. The planets are inferred from the surrounding Jupiter and Venus lines.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule ties a child's sex to the mother's emotional state.

hindi: अच्छा बेटी के अंदर क्या गुण है शुक्र के पास क्या है संजीवनी स्त्री है ना शुक्र संजीवनी मानी संजीवनी आप जानते होंगे
says: Asking what quality a daughter carries, he answers through Venus: Venus holds the sanjivani (life-restoring) power, a woman is the Venus principle, and so the daughter carries sanjivani.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus is the female principle and the karaka of the wife; Shukracharya's sanjivani vidya is Puranic, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Puranic tale: when the daityas (demons) were dying, Shukracharya revived them with the sanjivani vidya, so the demons cannot die.

hindi: इसलिए कहते स्त्री मरती नहीं आसानी से क्योंकि वो शुक्र का साक्षात रूप है और स्त्री के अंदर संजीवनी है
says: So it is said that a woman does not die easily, because she is the direct form of Venus and carries sanjivani within. He turns the Venus-sanjivani idea into a resilience claim about women.
ambiguity: 'Does not die easily' is a general saying about resilience, not a prediction about any one woman.
classical_check: Silent on the resilience idea; Venus as the karaka of women is classical.

hindi: स्त्री दूसरों को भी जीवन देती है हमें मां ने पैदा किया
says: A woman gives life to others too; as his proof he says our own mother gave birth to us. Venus as woman is the life-giver.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Venus and the Moon signify women and motherhood in the classical texts.

gist: Joke that a woman who falls ill recovers quickly while a man who falls ill does not stop until he dies; he says such jokes and stories exist because women carry sanjivani.

hindi: क्योंकि स्त्री में संजीवनी है इसलिए स्त्री का संतुष्ट होना उसका प्रसन्न होना बहुत जरूरी है तब वह आपकी लाइफ में पॉजिटिविटी देगी
says: Because a woman carries sanjivani, her being satisfied and happy is very necessary, and only then will she bring positivity into your life. He frames keeping the woman of the house content as the condition for a good life.
classical_check: Silent: the classics link domestic happiness to Venus and the 7th house, not to a woman's day-to-day contentment as a remedy.

hindi: इसीलिए एक बड़ी सादी बात कही जाती है घर में स्त्री का मुंह बना हुआ है आदमी भी बुझ गया
says: A plain saying: when the woman of the house keeps a sulking face, the man is dimmed too. The home's mood follows the woman's mood.
classical_check: Silent: a household saying, not a chart rule.

hindi: अब वो उसको करना तो आता नहीं उसको सेट कैसे करें तो वो लड़ता है और गृहस्थ खराब हो जाता है
says: The man does not know how to settle her mood, so he quarrels, and the household life goes bad. This is how he says a disturbed Venus side of the home turns into a domestic breakdown.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; classically an afflicted Venus or 7th house is the usual cause of domestic discord.

hindi: शुक्र के द्वारा घर की वाइब्रेशन अपसेट होती है साउथ ईस्ट आपका डिस्टर्ब हो जाता है भोजन इत्यादि तक के लाले पड़ जाते हैं
says: Through Venus the home's vibration gets upset; the south-east zone is disturbed and even meals and basic needs become scarce. A Vastu link tying Venus to the south-east of the house.
ambiguity: He does not say whether 'upset by Venus' means a Venus affliction in the chart or an unhappy woman at home; the lead-in suggests the latter.
classical_check: Matches Vastu tradition: the south-east (Agneya, the kitchen zone) is Venus's; the Jyotish classics are silent.

gist: He restates that it is very necessary for a woman to remain happy and content, a point already made in the last few lines.

hindi: स्त्री को खुद भी ज्ञान चाहिए इसलिए स्त्रियां ज्यादातर गुरुजी बनाती है पुरुष कम वो पुरुष को भी घसीट के वही लाती है
says: A woman herself needs knowledge, which is why women more often take a guru than men do, and they drag their husbands along. In practice, women's pull toward Jupiter is strong.
ambiguity: A general observation about behaviour, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not describe a gender difference in guru-taking.

hindi: तब जान पाती है इस बृहस्पति के कारण से आपके जीवन के अंदर गुरु की उपलब्धि होती है
says: Through that she comes to know, and it is because of Jupiter that a guru is obtained in your life. Jupiter is the planet through which a teacher appears.
ambiguity: 'तब जान पाती है' is a fragment tied to the previous sentence about women.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of gurus and teachers.

hindi: और आपने बृहस्पति के सुधार के द्वारा आप जो भी चीज बनाते हो उसे भोग पाते हो क्योंकि इंद्र का गुरु भी यही है
says: By improving Jupiter you are able to enjoy whatever you create, because Jupiter is also the guru of Indra, the king of the gods who enjoys heaven. He makes Jupiter the planet that decides whether you get to enjoy what you build.
ambiguity: Indra is the god-king here; in his 12-planet scheme Indra is Uranus, so he may also be hinting at Uranus, but he does not say so.
classical_check: Agrees that Brihaspati is the guru of Indra (Puranic); the enjoyment-through-Jupiter claim is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति की ही ज्ञान हनुमान में है इस हनुमान इतने ज्ञानी हैं
says: Hanuman's knowledge is Jupiter's own knowledge; he cites Hanuman as the example of how wise a Jupiter-type person can be.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break ('इतने ज्ञानी' / 'हैं'); the planet link is stated only for Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give Hanuman no planetary lordship; Mars and the Sun are the usual associations.

hindi: इस बृहस्पति लीवर बृहस्पति के पास लीवर है लीवर के पास ही शुक्र को जिंदा रखने की कला है और शुक्र के पास कला है हमें जिंदा रखने की क्योंकि संजीवनी है
says: Jupiter holds the liver, and it is the liver that has the art of keeping Venus alive, while Venus has the art of keeping us alive because of sanjivani. He chains Jupiter to the liver, the liver to Venus, and Venus to our survival.
ambiguity: 'The liver keeps Venus alive' is loosely stated; it probably means a healthy liver sustains Venus's functions of vitality and reproduction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter as the liver karaka is classical; the liver-to-Venus chain is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या है लीवर लीवर में क्या बनता है सारा कोलेस्ट्रॉल लीवर में बनता है
says: Jupiter is the liver, and all cholesterol is made in the liver, so cholesterol falls under Jupiter's rule. A body-function karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees on Jupiter as the liver and fat karaka; the cholesterol link is a modern gloss on that.

hindi: हृदय को सेट करने वाला या मारने वाला सारा काम कोलेस्ट्रॉल के पास है
says: Everything that keeps the heart in order, or kills it, is the work of cholesterol, so heart outcomes trace back to Jupiter's domain of liver and cholesterol. A medical claim recorded as his statement only and not to be used.
ambiguity: Jupiter is not named in this sentence; it is carried over from the previous one.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give the heart to the Sun and the 4th house; the Jupiter-cholesterol-heart chain is his own.

hindi: हम दिल का इलाज करते हैं बृहस्पति का करते नहीं लीवर का इलाज करो
says: People treat the heart but do not treat Jupiter; he says treat the liver instead. Health advice recorded as his statement only.
ambiguity: Whether 'इलाज' means medical treatment or an astrological remedy for Jupiter is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not advise treating one organ for another's complaint.

hindi: जब भी बॉडी में आपको कहीं भी दर्द है यहां दर्द है य दर्द है हा यहां दर्द है वहां दर्द है भूल जाओ लिवर डिटॉक्सिफाई कर लो आपका लिवर डिटॉक्सिफाई हो गया आपकी दर्दें गायब हो जाएंगे
says: Whenever you have pain anywhere in the body, forget the local cause and detoxify the liver; once the liver is detoxed the pains will vanish. A health claim recorded as his statement only, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Jupiter is not named here; the liver link comes from the earlier lines.
classical_check: Silent: a modern health claim attached to Jupiter's liver rulership.

hindi: क्योंकि कुछ भी समझ नहीं आ रहा गुरु पर छोड़ दो तो बृहस्पति कुंडली में जहां जहां बैठा हुआ है वहां वहां का इलाज करो
says: When nothing makes sense, leave it to the guru (Jupiter): treat the body part or life area shown by the place where Jupiter sits in the chart. So the house holding Jupiter points to what needs healing first.
cells_derived_method: The house Jupiter occupies maps to a body area and life topic (1 head, 2 face and throat, 3 arms, 4 chest, 5 upper abdomen, 6 intestines, 7 lower abdomen, 8 excretory and reproductive parts, 9 thighs, 10 knees, 11 calves, 12 feet), and the sign adds its tone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer): look first at the chest region and the home and mother theme, with a Venus-sign flavour of comfort and balance.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 6th house (lagna Capricorn): look first at the intestinal region and the daily-routine and service theme, with a Mercury-sign flavour of nerves and talk.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 10th house (lagna Gemini): look first at the knees and joints and the career-strain theme, with a watery, tiring flavour.

ambiguity: 'इलाज करो' may mean medical treatment of that body part or an astrological remedy for that house; he does not say which. He also does not name the house-to-body mapping, which is supplied here.
classical_check: The house-to-body-part mapping (Kalapurusha) is classical; treating the Jupiter house first is his own rule.

hindi: बृहस्पति पीली चीज होता है यदि आपके पास बृहस्पति की पॉजिटिविटी है तो पीली चीजें बेसन बड़ी सुंदर चीज है
says: Jupiter is the planet of yellow things; to bring Jupiter's positivity, use yellow things, and gram flour (besan) is a lovely one.
ambiguity: 'यदि आपके पास बृहस्पति की पॉजिटिविटी है' could mean 'if you want Jupiter's positivity' (read here) or 'if you already have it'.
classical_check: Agrees: yellow is Jupiter's colour and gram (chana) is one of Jupiter's grains.

hindi: पीला नमकीन होता है तो सूर्य के साथ होता है मीठा होता है तो बृहस्पति मंगल के साथ होता है यह सब टेक्निकल चीजें हैं सिर्फ जानकारी सुनने के लिए काफी
says: A yellow item that is salty goes with the Sun, while a sweet yellow item goes with Jupiter (he adds Mars, which is unclear). He calls these technical details, enough just to be informed.
ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति मंगल के साथ' is garbled: it may mean sweet yellow things belong to Jupiter and Mars together, or Jupiter acting with Mars's help.
classical_check: Partly differs: in the classical taste table Jupiter is sweet (agrees), but salt belongs to the Moon and pungent to the Sun.

hindi: तो ब की पीली करो गाय को मिस्सी रोटी खिला सकते हैं आप
says: As a Jupiter remedy, work with yellow things: you can feed a cow missi roti (a gram-flour flatbread).
ambiguity: 'तो ब की पीली करो' is garbled and is read as 'for Jupiter, make it yellow'.
classical_check: Cow-feeding with gram-flour items is a folk and Lal Kitab-style Jupiter remedy; it is not in the Parashari texts.

hindi: बेसन का सादा दान कर सकते हैं गुरुद्वारे में पीली चीज दे सकते हैं
says: You can donate plain besan, or give a yellow item at a gurudwara, as a Jupiter remedy.
ambiguity: He does not give a weekday or quantity for the donation.
classical_check: Donating Jupiter's grain and yellow items is a standard classical-style remedy; the gurudwara detail is his own.

hindi: यदि बृहस्पति नौवे भाव में नेगेटिव होगा तो नुकसान करेगा
says: If Jupiter is negative (afflicted or badly placed) in the 9th house, it will do damage. He uses this as the case showing why a Jupiter remedy has to be chosen with care.
cells_derived_method: Which signs make a 9th-house Jupiter negative: his fall sign Capricorn or the enemy signs of Mercury and Venus; the lagna sign then fixes what the 9th shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 9th house (lagna Taurus): luck, father and guru topics are weakened, and the damage he warns about is most likely here.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 9th house (lagna Libra): a Mercury sign hostile to him, so faith and teachers turn argumentative and careless Jupiter remedies could backfire.
Derived: Jupiter in Virgo in the 9th house (lagna Capricorn): another Mercury sign, so luck depends on analysis and detail work and relations with elders suffer through criticism.

ambiguity: 'नेगेटिव' is not defined, and it is unclear whether the damage comes from Jupiter himself or from a remedy done wrongly.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted Jupiter in the 9th weakens luck and the father line, but 'does damage' is stronger than the classics, which usually call Jupiter in the 9th good.

hindi: इसलिए ध्यान देना पड़ेगा य सब उपाय समझने पड़ेंगे ऐसा नहीं कि कोई भी उपाय पेल दिया जाए यूनिवर्सल नहीं होता है
says: So care is needed: the remedies must be understood, not simply dumped on anyone, and no remedy is universal. Remedies have to be fitted to the chart.
classical_check: Agrees: classical remedial practice picks a remedy according to the planet's lordship, house and strength in the chart.

hindi: उसके बाद में आपका बृहस्पति प्रसन्न होगा किसी भी जगह विद्या दान करो आप बृहस्पति के लिए किताबें दान कर सकते हो
says: After that your Jupiter will be pleased: donate knowledge anywhere, and for Jupiter you can donate books.
ambiguity: 'उसके बाद में' (after that) points back to the earlier remedies and the caution about choosing them.
classical_check: Agrees: vidya-dana (gift of knowledge) and guru-seva are classical Jupiter remedies.

hindi: जो ज्ञान जैसे पंचतंत्र की कहानियां क्या है फन बुक्स फन क्या है शुक्र और ज्ञान क्या है बृहस्पति सबसे सुंदर
says: Knowledge books such as the Panchatantra tales are fun books; fun is Venus and knowledge is Jupiter, and the best gift joins the two.
ambiguity: 'सबसे सुंदर' is read as 'the combination is the most beautiful'.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is entertainment and pleasure and Jupiter is learning.

hindi: इसलिए बच्चों को कॉमिक्स बहुत पसंद है आप ज्ञान वर्धक कॉमिक्स देंगे बहुत बढ़िया
says: That is why children love comics, and giving them educational comics is an excellent Jupiter remedy because it joins Venus's fun with Jupiter's knowledge.
classical_check: Silent: a modern application of the classical gift-of-knowledge remedy.

hindi: आजकल तो मर्डर वाले गेम्स चलते हैं मर्डर वाली कहानियां चलती हैं वेरी बैड वो नेगेटिव वो हिंसा है तो बृहस्पति पे रोग लग जाता है
says: Today's murder games and murder stories are very bad, negative and violent, and that infects Jupiter with disease. So violent media is a 'don't' for Jupiter's wellbeing.
ambiguity: 'रोग लग जाता है' most likely means Jupiter is afflicted in effect, not a bodily disease.
classical_check: Silent: the classics have no rule about games or media; violence-versus-dharma themes belong to Jupiter's opposites (Mars, Rahu).

hindi: बृहस्पति का स्थान ईशान कोण है हमारा हम वास्तु में भी देखते हैं तो ईशान कोण देख के चलते हैं जब वास्तु पुरुष का हेड है वो नॉर्थ ईस्ट आता है
says: Jupiter's place is the north-east (Ishan) corner; in Vastu too the north-east is checked first because the head of the Vastu Purusha lies there.
classical_check: Agrees: Ishanya (north-east) is Jupiter's direction in Vastu, and the Vastu Purusha's head lies in the north-east.

gist: He stresses once more that Jupiter is a very important planet which must be understood seriously.

hindi: इसकी उच्च राशि चार नंबर है यानी यह मां के घर जब जाता है
says: Jupiter's exaltation sign is number 4 (Cancer), which he describes as Jupiter going to the mother's house, the Moon's sign.
cells_derived_method: The house where the exalted Jupiter sits decides which life area he lifts: strong placements give protection and wisdom, while hard houses like the 8th get hidden support rather than visible luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house (lagna Scorpio): peak luck and guru support, with the mother figure helping fortune.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries): comfort, home, vehicles and the mother are richly supported.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 8th house (lagna Sagittarius): strong but in a hard house, giving hidden support, inheritance and protection from sudden events.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign number 4 = Cancer, which matches Jupiter's exaltation and the Moon's rulership.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: माता जी यह पिता है यह मां है चंद्रकांता इसके घर जाता है तो वह गुरुजी के लिए स्थान खाली कराती है और पूरा का पूरा कार्यक्रम सेट होता है
says: A family picture: Jupiter is the father-figure and the Moon (he calls her Chandrakanta) is the mother; when Jupiter visits her house, Cancer, she vacates the seat for the guru and the whole programme is arranged. This is his story for why Cancer lifts Jupiter.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break ('यह' / 'मां है'); 'Chandrakanta' is a caption spelling for the Moon.
classical_check: Explains an agreed fact (Jupiter exalted in Cancer) with a hosting analogy; the Moon-Jupiter friendship is classical.

hindi: इसलिए अगर बच्चे बच्चों की चिंता करती है ना मम्मी सारे टाइम बच्चे की उस बच्चे की चिंता मां नहीं करती जो ज्ञानी हो जाता है उसको मां भी सिर बिठा है
says: A mother worries about her children all the time, but she does not worry about the child who becomes knowledgeable; she even seats such a child on her head. So a Jupiter-like wisdom in the child ends the mother's (Moon's) worry.
ambiguity: 'सिर बिठा है' is read as 'seats on her head', meaning honours. The sentence begins with a fragment, 'अगर बच्चे'.
classical_check: Silent on the worry claim; the Moon-Jupiter friendship is classical.

hindi: इसलिए आपको यदि मां से टेंशन नहीं चाहिए चंद्रमा क्या है मन मन क्या है मुन्ना लगातार ाए धा चल रहा है मम्मी क्या करती है टेंशन टेंशन टेंशन टेंशन टेंशन
says: If you do not want tension from your mother, understand the Moon: the Moon is the mind, and the mind is like a little boy always running about, so mummy keeps worrying. The Moon, as mind and mother, is the source of that constant tension.
ambiguity: 'ाए धा' is garbled, probably 'इधर उधर' (here and there).
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the karaka of the mind and the mother.

hindi: इस टेंशन का अंध होता है बृहस्पति से
says: The end of this tension comes from Jupiter, so a strong Jupiter calms the Moon's restless worrying.
ambiguity: 'अंध' (blind) is probably a slip for 'अंत' (end).
classical_check: Consistent with the Gajakesari idea of Jupiter steadying the Moon, though not stated classically in these words.

hindi: इसलिए आपके जीवन के अंदर बृहस्पति का करेक्शन बहुत जरूरी है इसका स्टोन है पीला पुखराज आप पीला पुखराज पहनते रिलीफ आता है
says: So correcting Jupiter in your life is very necessary, and its stone is yellow sapphire (pukhraj): wear it and relief comes.
ambiguity: He gives no weight, metal or finger for the stone.
classical_check: Yellow sapphire for Jupiter is the standard planet-gem pairing of the gem texts; gem-wearing as a general remedy is later practice.

hindi: वक्री है बृहस्पति हर हालत में पीला पुखराज चाहिए
says: If Jupiter is retrograde, a yellow sapphire is needed in every case. He treats retrogression of Jupiter as an automatic reason for the gem.
classical_check: Differs: the classics call a retrograde planet strong (cheshta bala), so the gem rule is a modern idea; it also contradicts his own earlier example of a retrograde Jupiter doing well with no gem.

gist: Says that deciding in which combination the stone is needed is a complication, with colour words white, blue and blue-black; the caption is too garbled to extract a rule.
He says all these gem details will be discussed in a later class and that it is necessary to know them.

hindi: इसके बाद आता है ग्रह केतु केतु के पास 12 नंबर राशि है
says: Next comes the planet Ketu, whose sign, in his scheme, is number 12 (Pisces).
cells_derived_method: Where Ketu sits in Pisces the house sets the area where detachment or insight shows, with Jupiter's rulership of Pisces still colouring the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries): detachment, spiritual retreat and foreign or secluded living feel natural.
