Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius): the home and mother theme carries detachment, a person who is inwardly apart even at home.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 8th house (lagna Leo): occult research and sudden insight are favoured, with hidden matters easy to read.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर' is read as sign number 12 = Pisces, which in his scheme is shared by Jupiter and Ketu.
classical_check: Differs: the Parashari tradition gives Ketu no sign of rulership; some later schools assign him Pisces or Scorpio, so this holds only within his 12-planet scheme.

hindi: ये पूछ है बादल है आप सोच के चलो यही बृहस्पति को ढक देता है
says: Ketu is the tail; think of it as a cloud, and it is this cloud that covers Jupiter.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break ('ये पूछ है' / 'बादल है').
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu is the tail of the node pair; the cloud image is his own.

hindi: यानी अगर बादल आ जाए बृहस्पति पर तो बृहस्पति का बाल भी बांका नहीं होगा लेकिन नीच हो जाएगा
says: If the Ketu-cloud comes over Jupiter, Jupiter himself is not harmed in the least, but he behaves like a debilitated planet and his results turn low.
cells_derived_method: Where Jupiter and Ketu meet, the house shows the area that gets covered and the sign shows how much of Jupiter's strength is left to shine through.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th house with Ketu (lagna Aries): Jupiter stays intact but results run low, with faith and guru matters giving less than promised and a detachment from tradition.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st house with Ketu (lagna Cancer): the planet is strong but the person feels detached, so wisdom is not displayed.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 7th house with Ketu (lagna Sagittarius): the partnership house is covered, so marriage and shared learning are deferred or feel hollow.

ambiguity: 'नीच हो जाएगा' is read as 'acts as if debilitated', not as a literal change of sign.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter with Ketu points to a spiritual leaning or confusion; 'becomes neecha' is his own phrase.

hindi: बृहस्पति और चंद्रमा को गजकेसरी योग कहते हैं
says: Jupiter together with the Moon is called Gajakesari yoga.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the yoga depends on the sign both occupy and the house where it forms: friendly or high signs give a protected, respected mind, a rival's sign weakens Jupiter's share.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gajakesari in the 1st house in Cancer (lagna Cancer): Jupiter exalted with the Moon at home, the strongest form, giving fame, wisdom and a protected mind.
Derived: Jupiter and the Moon in Sagittarius in the 10th house (lagna Pisces): Jupiter at home gives the yoga strength in career, as a respected adviser, teacher or lawyer.

Derived: the Moon and Jupiter in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio): the Moon is at her best in Taurus while Jupiter sits in a rival's sign, so partnership and public dealings gain but Jupiter's share is weaker.

ambiguity: He says 'और' (and), which could mean conjunction only; the classical yoga is wider.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical Gajakesari is Jupiter in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th) from the Moon, which includes but is wider than conjunction.

hindi: बृहस्पति और केतु को साथ बैठे चंडाल योग कहते हैं
says: Jupiter and Ketu sitting together he names Chandal yoga.
classical_check: Differs: the classical Guru-Chandala yoga is Jupiter with Rahu, and in the earlier slice he himself made Rahu the one that ruins Jupiter; here the name goes to Ketu.

hindi: यानी वो अपना सारा ज्ञान चंडाल कार्य में लगाएगा मारने में आतंकवाद करने में बुरा काम करने में सत्यानाश चोरी चकारी खराबी यानी जुपिटर बिगड़ गया
says: Such a person will put all his knowledge to wicked use: killing, terrorism, evil deeds, ruin, theft and mischief, which means Jupiter is spoiled. A harsh character claim recorded as his words, not to be applied to any real person.
cells_derived_method: Where the conjunction falls decides the field in which knowledge is misused, and the sign decides the style of the misuse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter with Ketu in Leo in the 3rd house (lagna Gemini): persuasion, media or messaging used to mislead, in a bold and showy style.
Derived: Jupiter with Ketu in Pisces in the 8th house (lagna Leo): occult or hidden knowledge twisted into secrecy and manipulation, with Jupiter at home keeping some restraint.
Derived: Jupiter with Ketu in Libra in the 2nd house (lagna Virgo): speech and money matters where knowledge is used for deceptive gain, in a rival's sign that sharpens the cunning.

classical_check: Overstates the classics: Guru-Chandala (with Rahu) is read as unorthodox or misused wisdom, not as a criminal tendency.

gist: Repeats that it is very important to set your Jupiter right.

hindi: केतु की बड़ी मजेदार बात है केतु गणपति है देवता तो गणपति है ये केतु
says: An amusing point about Ketu: he says Ketu is Ganapati, so Ganesha is the deity of Ketu.
classical_check: Popular remedial tradition links Ketu with Ganesha, while the classical adhidevata list names Chitragupta for Ketu.

hindi: मंगल की दृष्टि होती है पहले घर में चौथे में सातवें में और आठवा पहला मतलब जहां वो बैठा है
says: Mars's aspects cover the 1st (meaning the seat where he sits), the 4th, the 7th and the 8th, counted from where Mars is placed.
cells_derived_method: Counted from Mars's seat, the aspects land on the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from him; the lagna sign then fixes the sign names and the target sign's lord decides how friendly the aspect is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) aspects the 1st (Aries), 4th (Cancer) and 5th (Leo): drive and authority press on the self, home and intelligence houses.
Derived: Mars in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) aspects the 10th (Capricorn), 1st (Aries) and 2nd (Taurus): partnership heat spills onto career, self and family speech.

Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) aspects the 7th (Libra), 10th (Capricorn) and 11th (Aquarius): a weak Mars at home, yet its aspects still push on partner, career and gains.

ambiguity: 'पहला' is the seat itself counted as the first; the classical special aspects of Mars are only the 4th and 8th plus the common 7th.
classical_check: Agrees on the 4th, 7th and 8th aspects of Mars; counting the seat as a 'first' is his own habit.

hindi: बृहस्पति की दृष्टि होती है पहले में पांचवे में सातवें में और नौवें में
says: Jupiter's aspects cover the 1st (his own seat), the 5th, the 7th and the 9th, counted from where Jupiter is placed.
cells_derived_method: Counted from Jupiter's seat, the 5th, 7th and 9th aspects land on houses 4, 6 and 8 away from him; the lagna sign fixes the sign names and the target sign's lord shows how well each look is received.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 2nd house (lagna Gemini) aspects the 6th (Scorpio), 8th (Capricorn) and 10th (Pisces): wealth and speech house protects against rivals and debts, hidden matters and the career.

Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 6th house (lagna Cancer) aspects the 10th (Aries), 12th (Gemini) and 2nd (Leo): an enemy-and-service house Jupiter supports career, expenses and family wealth.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 11th house (lagna Aries) aspects the 3rd (Gemini), 5th (Leo) and 7th (Libra): a gains-house Jupiter supports effort, intelligence and partnership.

ambiguity: As with Mars, the 'first' is the seat itself.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter has the 5th, 7th and 9th aspects.

hindi: शनि की दृष्टि मींस इन्फ्लुएंस ताकत काम करने की पहले में तीसरे में
says: Saturn's aspect, which he explains as influence and the strength to act, covers the 1st (own seat) and the 3rd. The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice, so the remaining Saturn aspects are not given here.
cells_derived_method: Counted from Saturn's seat, the 3rd aspect lands two houses ahead; the lagna sign fixes the sign names, and by the classical pattern the 7th and 10th aspects follow.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th house (lagna Cancer): its 3rd aspect lands on the 6th (Sagittarius), and by the classical pattern also on the 10th (Aries) and 1st (Cancer).
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra): its 3rd aspect lands on the 9th (Gemini), and by the classical pattern also on the 1st (Libra) and 4th (Capricorn).
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): its 3rd aspect lands on the 12th (Pisces), and by the classical pattern also on the 4th (Cancer) and 7th (Libra).

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at 'तीसरे में'; the classical Saturn aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th, so the 7th and 10th probably follow in the next slice.
classical_check: Agrees on the 3rd aspect and the seat; the full classical set is the 3rd, 7th and 10th.

hindi: सातवें में और दसवें में
says: He completes Saturn's aspect list from the last slice: besides the seat and the 3rd, Saturn also looks at the 7th and the 10th, so Saturn's aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th counted from where he sits.
cells_derived_method: Counted from Saturn's seat the aspects land two, six and nine houses ahead (the 3rd, 7th and 10th); the lagna sign fixes the sign names and the lord of each target sign shows how well the look is received.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 2nd house (lagna Sagittarius) aspects the 4th (Pisces), 8th (Cancer) and 11th (Libra): a family-and-speech Saturn presses on home, hidden matters and gains.

Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 9th house (lagna Aquarius) aspects the 11th (Sagittarius), 3rd (Aries) and 6th (Cancer): a luck-house Saturn disciplines gains, effort and the service-and-debt house.

Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra) aspects the 7th (Aries), 11th (Leo) and 2nd (Scorpio): an intelligence-and-children Saturn weighs on partnership, gains and family wealth.

ambiguity: 'सातवें में और दसवें में' continues the Saturn list begun at the end of the previous slice ('पहले में तीसरे में').
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th.

hindi: यानी ये मल्टीपल पावर वाले प्लेनेट हैं बहुत ताकतवर है
says: Mars, Jupiter and Saturn are 'multiple-power' planets because each carries several aspects, and that makes them very strong.
ambiguity: He does not name the three here; they are read as Mars, Jupiter and Saturn from the aspect lists just given.
classical_check: Agrees: these three alone have special aspects beyond the 7th that every planet has.

hindi: और ये तीनों बक्र हो सकते हैं यानी तीनों के तीनों आपकी लाइफ में धमाल मचा सकते हैं ये खूब सारी दृष्टियां है
says: These three can also turn retrograde, and all three together can create havoc in your life; they carry many aspects. Retrogression is read here as adding to their force.
ambiguity: 'बक्र' is a caption slip for 'वक्री' (retrograde).
classical_check: Agrees that Mars, Jupiter and Saturn can be retrograde, as can Mercury and Venus; the classics read retrogression as added strength, which fits 'raise havoc' but sits oddly with his earlier view of retrograde Jupiter as a defect.

hindi: अब केतु महाराज का हल क्या है केतु के पास इनकी सबकी दृष्टि है सभी की दृष्टि है केतु के पास
says: What about Ketu? Ketu holds the aspects of all of them, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn together, so he looks at the 3rd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th and 10th from his seat.
cells_derived_method: With the combined set Ketu reaches nearly the whole chart from any seat; the lagna sign fixes the sign names, and the house where he sits decides which areas feel his cutting influence first.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius) reaches the 6th (Taurus), 7th (Gemini), 8th (Cancer), 10th (Virgo), 11th (Libra), 12th (Scorpio) and 1st (Sagittarius): almost every area feels his cut-off influence.

Derived: Ketu in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer) reaches the 12th (Gemini), 1st (Cancer), 2nd (Leo), 4th (Libra), 5th (Scorpio), 6th (Sagittarius) and 7th (Capricorn): career-side Ketu touches self, family, home, children, service and partnership.

ambiguity: 'इनकी सबकी' is read as the aspects of the three planets just discussed; the exact houses are worked out here by combining those aspect sets.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give Ketu and Rahu only the 7th aspect (some schools add the 5th and 9th); all three planets' aspects is his own view.

hindi: वो कहता है ऐसी की तैसी केतु बादल है धुआ और टिकता नहीं कहीं
says: Ketu's temper is 'to hell with it'; he is a cloud or smoke that settles nowhere, reckless and ungrounded.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Ketu is smoky (dhumra) and the planet of detachment and instability.

hindi: केतु मिस कैरेज का देवता है
says: Ketu is the god of miscarriage, the planet that makes a pregnancy end incomplete. A pregnancy-loss claim recorded as his words.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the classics read pregnancy loss from the 5th house and its lord, with Ketu and Mars as common afflictors, but they do not name Ketu its ruler.

hindi: आपको यूरिनरी डिसऑर्डर है आपके मेंसस स्लो डाउन है कभी जल्दी होते हैं कभी लेट होते हैं
says: He lists, as Ketu's effects, a urinary disorder and slowed, irregular menses that come sometimes early and sometimes late. A medical claim recorded as his statement only and not to be used as a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Ketu is not named here; it comes from the next sentence, which begins 'केतु के दोष से'.
classical_check: Silent: the classics link urinary and menstrual matters to the 7th and 8th houses, Venus and the Moon rather than to Ketu.

hindi: केतु के दोष से आपकी लाइफ के अंदर सेक्सुअल पावर की कमी है आपके सीमन के अंदर प्रॉब्लम है आपके रज में प्रॉब्लम है एग में प्रॉब्लम है
says: A defective Ketu brings a lack of sexual power and problems in semen, menstrual blood and egg, so fertility troubles are put down to Ketu. A medical claim recorded as his statement only.
ambiguity: 'केतु के दोष' is not defined; it is read as an afflicted or badly placed Ketu.
classical_check: Differs: the classics read fertility problems from the 5th house, Jupiter, Venus and Mars, with Ketu as only one afflictor.

hindi: संतान अधूरी हो के मरती है मिसकैरेज होता है
says: The child dies before it is complete and a miscarriage happens; this is the outcome he gives for a Ketu defect on the children side. A pregnancy-loss claim recorded as his words.
ambiguity: The subject is Ketu by carry-over from the previous sentences, not named here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu or Mars afflicting the 5th house is read as pregnancy loss in the classics.

hindi: आपकी जॉब की बात यह लगी लगी लगी छूट गई 00 की सोची थी 5 की लगी यह सब केतु का काम है
says: On jobs: you get one job after another and each slips away, and you expected a big figure but got a small one; all this is Ketu's doing, he says.
ambiguity: The amounts ('00', '5') are garbled in the caption and cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Silent: the classics read job instability from the 10th house, Saturn and Rahu-Ketu, not these specifics.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जो अधूरे काम हो रहे हैं सब केतु के हैं
says: Every unfinished task in your life belongs to Ketu; incompletion is his signature.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu as the planet of cutting off and renunciation fits; 'unfinished work' is a modern gloss.

hindi: कुछ लोग जो इसकी ताकत समझ जाते हैं वो क्या करते काम ही अधूरा करते हैं
says: People who understand Ketu's power deliberately take up work that stays unfinished, using his nature instead of fighting it.
ambiguity: He does not say whether this means leaving tasks half-done as a method or choosing fields where incompletion is normal, such as research, consulting or ongoing projects.
classical_check: Silent: a modern strategy built on Ketu's incompletion theme.

hindi: अगर केतु पावरफुल है और दसवें घर में बैठा है या पावर है या इंपैक्ट है अभी बात करते हैं तो आप अधूरा काम करो उसी में रॉकेट बन जाओगे
says: If Ketu is strong and sits in the 10th house, or has power or impact on it, do unfinished-type work and you will shoot up like a rocket in it.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 10th colours the style of the 'unfinished' success: Saturn's sign favours solo and specialist roles, fire signs favour quick starts and exits, air signs favour short advisory engagements.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries): in Saturn's career sign the rocket path is through one-person ventures, consulting or specialist roles that are never finished.
Derived: Ketu in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer): pioneering starts and quick exits, project-to-project work rather than one long career.
Derived: Ketu in Libra in the 10th house (lagna Capricorn): partnership or advisory work done in short engagements, with deals begun and handed on.

ambiguity: 'अभी बात करते हैं' is filler; 'power or impact' is read as strength or an aspect on the 10th. The sentence runs across the chunk break.
classical_check: Differs: classically Ketu in the 10th is read as detachment from career and obstacles; the advice to do unfinished work and soar is his own.

hindi: केतु सेक्स का देवता है केतु हमारा पेनिस मानी जाती है ब्रेस्ट मानी जाती है
says: Ketu is the god of sex and is taken as the sexual organ and the breast in the body.
ambiguity: 'मानी जाती है' is a caption slip for 'is considered'.
classical_check: Differs: the classics give the genitals to the 8th house and to Mars and Venus; Ketu is not the standard karaka of sex or the breast.

hindi: यानी सेक्स के द्वारा भोग के द्वारा आप विलासिता के द्वारा जो सेक्स का भोग करके एक्ससी महसूस करते हो वो केतु की कृपा है
says: The ecstasy you feel through sex, enjoyment and luxury is Ketu's grace.
ambiguity: 'एक्ससी' is read as 'ecstasy'.
classical_check: Differs: pleasure, luxury and sex are Venus's in the classics.

hindi: आप जीवन में धर्म के लिए दान करते हैं सारा केतु है
says: Whatever you give away in life for dharma, all of it is Ketu; the giving-up impulse belongs to him.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is the karaka of renunciation and moksha, while charity itself is usually assigned to Jupiter.

hindi: चिजी ज्ञान रूपी एक्ससी संभोग बृहस्पति है और शरीर रूपी संभोग वो केतु महाराज की कृपा से है
says: The ecstasy that takes the form of knowledge, a union through wisdom, is Jupiter, while the ecstasy of bodily union comes by Ketu's grace. He splits mind-union (Jupiter) from body-union (Ketu).
ambiguity: 'चिजी' is garbled, perhaps 'जो ज्ञान'; 'संभोग' is used loosely for union or absorption.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not divide union into knowledge-form and body-form between Jupiter and Ketu.

hindi: आपका केतु जो है थोड़ा काम करता है ये मिसकैरेज कराता है ये सातवें महीने का बेबी पाच मार देता है चाहे जान से
says: Your Ketu works in its own way: he causes miscarriage and can end a baby around the seventh month. The end of the sentence is garbled. A pregnancy-loss claim recorded as his words only.
ambiguity: 'पाच मार देता है चाहे जान से' is garbled; only 'ends a seventh-month baby' is readable.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give no month-wise pregnancy-loss rule for Ketu.

hindi: ये नौकरी लगी लगी छोड़ता है
says: Ketu also makes a person take a job and then leave it himself, again and again: the job lands and then he walks away.
ambiguity: The subject 'ये' is Ketu by carry-over; the sentence is very short and loosely worded.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not describe this pattern for Ketu.

hindi: जिसका केतु अपसेट होता है वो बच्चा एक जगह स्कूल में एडमिशन लेता है पढ़ाई से संबंधित और वो छोड़ता है अधूरा कोर्स करता है
says: A child whose Ketu is upset takes admission in a school or course and then drops it, leaving the course incomplete.
ambiguity: 'अपसेट' is not defined; it is read as an afflicted or badly placed Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: the classics read dropped studies from the 4th and 5th houses and their lords.

hindi: एक बेबी का मिसकैरेज या अबॉर्शन होता है यहां से केतु का एस्पेक्ट है संतान भाव पे पांचवी दृष्टि है कहीं से भी है पांचवी है आठवी है नौवी है 10वीं है
says: A miscarriage or abortion of one baby happens when Ketu's aspect falls on the children's house, the 5th, and from wherever he sits the 5th, 8th, 9th and 10th aspects can do it. A pregnancy-loss claim recorded as his words only.
cells_derived_method: Ketu reaches the 5th house by his 5th aspect from the 1st, by his 8th aspect from the 10th, by his 9th aspect from the 9th and by his 10th aspect from the 8th; the sign on the 5th then shows the nature of the child house under his influence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer) reaches the 5th house, Scorpio, by his 5th aspect: the child house gets Ketu's cut-off influence through a Mars sign.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 10th house (lagna Gemini) reaches the 5th house, Libra, by his 8th aspect: career-side Ketu presses on the child house in a Venus sign.
Derived: Ketu in Leo in the 9th house (lagna Sagittarius) reaches the 5th house, Aries, by his 9th aspect: fortune-house Ketu touches the child house in a Mars sign.
Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the 8th house (lagna Libra) reaches the 5th house, Aquarius, by his 10th aspect: an 8th-house Ketu strikes the child house in Saturn's air sign.

ambiguity: He gives no seats, so the seats (1st, 10th, 9th, 8th) are worked out here from the aspect numbers; whether the numbers count the seat as 1 is not clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu or Mars afflicting the 5th is read as pregnancy loss in the classics, but Ketu's 5th, 8th, 9th and 10th aspects are his own.

hindi: एक मिसकैरेज वशन होगा मल्टीपल हो सकते हैं मतलब मिनिमम एक तो देगा ही
says: With this influence there will be at least one miscarriage (or abortion; the caption word is garbled), possibly several: minimum one it will certainly give. A pregnancy-loss claim recorded as his words, not as a prediction to use.
ambiguity: 'वशन' is garbled, probably 'अबॉर्शन'.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give no guaranteed count of pregnancy losses from Ketu.

hindi: एक पढ़ाई में एडमिशन लेकर बच्चा छोड़ेगा ही छोड़ेगा
says: The child will certainly take admission to one course and leave it; he states it as a sure outcome of this Ketu influence.
ambiguity: The trigger (Ketu on the child house) is carried over from the previous lines.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule promises a dropped course.

hindi: हर हालत में एक जॉब का इंटरव्यू छूटेगा उसका यानी कि पहला इंटरव्यू फेल है कोई टेंशन नहीं
says: In every case one job interview will be lost: the first interview is a fail, so do not worry. A near-certain timing claim about the first interview.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break ('एक जॉब का' / 'इंटरव्यू छूटेगा').
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule makes the first interview fail.

hindi: पांचवे घर में केतु का इन्फ्लुएंस है बेटा एक बार आईयूआई करा लो या आईवीएफ करा लो वो खराब हो जाएंगे पैसे दूसरी बार में हो जाएगा
says: When Ketu influences the 5th house, go ahead and try IUI or IVF once, since the first attempt will fail and the money is wasted, while the second attempt will succeed. A fertility-treatment outcome claim recorded as his words, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'वो खराब हो जाएंगे पैसे' is read as 'the money will be wasted'.
classical_check: Silent: IUI and IVF are modern procedures, not covered by the classics.

hindi: शांति पड़ गई केतु को बली दे दो
says: Once peace is established, give Ketu his offering (bali): the first failure can be taken as Ketu's due, after which he is pacified.
ambiguity: 'बली दे दो' is cryptic: it may mean accept the first failure as Ketu's offering, or perform an offering to Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: offerings to Ketu are a general remedy, but this reading is his own.

hindi: केतु के पास हमारी चमड़ी है स्किन है बिना हड्डी के ऑर्गन है कान भी केतु है
says: Ketu rules our skin, the organs that have no bone, and also the ear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: some texts give Ketu skin and nerves, while the ear is usually Saturn's or the 3rd house's.

hindi: कुत्ता भी केतु है मछली भी केतु है केतु पूंछ है गाय की पूंछ वो भी केतु है
says: The dog is Ketu, the fish is Ketu, and Ketu is the tail, including a cow's tail.
classical_check: Agrees: the dog is Ketu's animal in Jyotish, and fish and tails are among his associations.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जो भी आपका सबोर्डिनेट है यानी सेवक का भी सेवक आपने किसी को काम बोला उसने दूसरे को बोला वो केतु है
says: Anyone who is your subordinate's subordinate, the servant of the servant, is Ketu: you tell one person to do a job, he passes it to another, and that second person is Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: the classics give servants to Saturn and the 6th house; the servant-of-a-servant is his own idea.

hindi: अब केतु प्रसन्न रखने के लिए सेकंड लेवल का जो आपका वर्कर है उसको प्रसन्न रखो
says: To keep Ketu pleased, keep your second-level worker, the one below your own staff, happy. A people-based remedy for Ketu.
classical_check: Silent: a folk-style remedy built on his servant-of-servant reading of Ketu.

hindi: और केतु के लिए यहां क्या चाहिए लहसुनिया लहसुनिया इसका स्टोन है लहसुनिया पहना जाता है
says: The stone for Ketu is lahsunia (cat's eye), and that is what is worn for him.
ambiguity: He gives no weight, metal or finger.
classical_check: Agrees: cat's eye (vaidurya) is Ketu's gem in the gem texts.

gist: He raises the practical question that the gems prescribed are so expensive that few can afford to wear them, and that people have no money.
Analogy: only a distressed person goes to a doctor, a healthy person does not.
Anecdote opens: a man with no money, already ruined, lands with an astrologer called Joshi Maharaj.

Dialogue joke: the astrologer says it will cost a lakh, the client says he has no money, and the astrologer replies that is exactly why he came, adding that if he had money he would have brushed him off.
He says he would not even go to see a doctor's face if he were not ill, but once ill he would drop all pending work and run to him.
Conclusion of the analogy: people go to astrologers or doctors only when they are already ruined.
Architect joke: a client happily buys a sofa of one and a half lakh, then a dearer one, and asks for the best table and carpet, spending freely.
Going to an astrologer instead, the client hears a cost of ten thousand and cries that he is ruined and bargains the fee down.
The astrologer, calling the client a rooster he will not let go, admits he is greedy.

hindi: पंडित लोग में क्यों वर्ध हस्तता नहीं है ज्ञान की क्योंकि बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब है उनका उनके पास वाक सिद्धि नहीं है वो लालच कर जाता है
says: Why do pandits lack the blessing hand of knowledge? Because their Jupiter is disturbed, they have no vak-siddhi (the power that makes their word come true), and so they fall into greed. A sweeping claim about priests as a group.
ambiguity: 'वर्ध हस्तता' is garbled, read as 'वरद हस्त' (the blessing hand). 'Pandits' is a whole class, so the claim is general, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Differs: classically an afflicted Jupiter can show as greed or loss of dharma, but 'pandits as a class have a disturbed Jupiter' is his sweeping claim.

gist: The pandit settles for five hundred rupees, saying he will do a five-hundred remedy because the client would otherwise walk away and give nothing.

hindi: इस चक्कर में उससे ज्ञान छूट जाता है यह सब केतु के काम है
says: In this greedy trap the pandit loses his knowledge, and all of it is Ketu's work: Ketu drags the knowledge-holder away from his Jupiter.
ambiguity: Jupiter is not named; it is inferred from 'ज्ञान' and the preceding claim that pandits have a disturbed Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; Ketu covering Jupiter was made a theme earlier in this series.

hindi: अब जो धन आना है आपके पास के जी पत्थर बता दिया किसी ने लाख दो लाख का पैसे तो है नहीं उपाय बता दी पूजा बता दीजी महामृत्युंजय की
says: When someone is told to buy a stone worth a lakh or two and has no money, the astrologer prescribes a puja instead, such as the Mahamrityunjaya. Worship is offered as the substitute for an unaffordable gem.
ambiguity: The opening clause 'अब जो धन आना है आपके पास' is garbled and is not used.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical remedies include mantra, puja and charity in place of gems; the classics do not make gems primary.

hindi: पंडित जी का यह हाल है महामृत्युंजय जाप किया जाता है शिव का संजीवनी का जाप किया जाता है मरे बंदे को खड़ा कर देती है वो सत्य में करती है
says: The Mahamrityunjaya japa is done for Shiva as the sanjivani chant, and he claims it can stand a dead man back on his feet and that it truly does. A claim of reviving the dead, recorded as a devotional tradition claim and not endorsed.
ambiguity: 'पंडित जी का यह हाल है' is a garbled lead-in.
classical_check: The Mahamrityunjaya mantra is a classical remedy for longevity and health; 'raises the dead' is a devotional claim.

hindi: और अगर मरना ही लिखा है तो उसको इतनी शांति से मौत होती है यार डॉक्टर कहते हैं तो तलप के तलप के मरा ही नहीं
says: And if death is in fact destined, the japa makes it come so peacefully that doctors remark the person did not die writhing. A death-related claim recorded as his words only; no dates are given.
ambiguity: 'तलप के तलप के' is read as 'writhing in agony'.
classical_check: Silent: the classics promise longevity through the mantra, not a peaceful death.

hindi: तो मृत संजीवनी कर ली गई महामृत्युंजय जाप कर लिया गया शनि की पूर्ण तक पूर्ण कृपा ले ली यमराज की ले ली बृहस्पति ज्ञान के द्वारा
says: Doing the mrit-sanjivani and the Mahamrityunjaya japa means you have taken Saturn's full grace and Yamraj's grace, and Jupiter's grace through knowledge. So one japa wins the favour of three powers at once.
ambiguity: Yamraj (Yama) is Pluto in his 12-planet scheme, but classically he is the lord of death and Saturn's brother; he does not say which he means here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classically the Mahamrityunjaya is tied to Saturn and the 8th house for longevity; adding Yama and Jupiter is his own.

hindi: तो अल्टीमेटली सवा लाख जाप होना चाहिए
says: In the end, 1.25 lakh chants (sava lakh) should be done for the remedy.
ambiguity: The mantra is not named in this sentence; it is read as the Mahamrityunjaya from the lines before.
classical_check: Agrees: a sava-lakh (125,000) japa is the usual count for the Mahamrityunjaya in practice.

hindi: अगर एक पुरुष चरण यानी गायत्री की सिद्धि करें तो 24 लाख जाप होता है
says: A full purascharana, meaning attaining siddhi of the Gayatri mantra, needs 24 lakh chants.
classical_check: Agrees: a Gayatri purascharana is 24 lakh chants, one lakh for each of the 24 syllables.

hindi: बृहस्पति की सिद्धि मान के चले सबसे बड़ा पुरष चरण है
says: Treat attaining Jupiter's siddhi as the biggest purascharana of all, the greatest practice one can take up.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'Jupiter's siddhi' means a Jupiter-mantra japa or the attainment of knowledge itself.
classical_check: Silent: the classics do not rank Jupiter's siddhi as the greatest purascharana.

gist: He says the japa involves an expense, say a lakh of rupees (the sentence is a lead-in to the next anecdote).
Anecdote: people come to the pandit saying their brother is gravely ill and hospitalised and lakhs have already been spent.
In the anecdote the pandit says the man may survive or not, so just do the Mahamrityunjaya.
The Mahamrityunjaya japa costs seventy to ninety thousand or a lakh, and the family asks whether something cheaper is possible.
He observes that people will pay a doctor a lakh a day without protest but do not want to give through the pandit, feeling it is throwing money in the dustbin in God's name.

hindi: बड़े-बड़े जो साउथ इंडिया में बहुत है अभी भी मंदिरों में बहुत पैसा फेंकते हैं लोग और उनके पास अमीरी आ जाती है खूब फेंकना फेंकना कह रहा हूं मैं नाम नूम नहीं कि पचिया कटवाते फिर रहे हैं
says: In South India people still throw huge sums into temples and wealth then comes to them. He means giving freely and anonymously, not for name or for getting receipts cut. A donation-brings-wealth claim recorded as his words, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'पचिया कटवाते' is read as 'getting receipts cut'.
classical_check: Silent as a Jyotish rule; dana (giving) is a classical remedy in general.

hindi: ऐसा गुप्त दान करना यदि आ जाता है तो पलट के पैसा अंधा वापस आता है
says: If you learn to give such secret donations, money comes back to you in plenty. A wealth-return-from-giving claim recorded as his words, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'अंधा' is read as 'blindly' or 'in abundance'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: secret charity (gupta-dana) is praised as the best in the dharma texts; the money-back promise is his own.

hindi: अंधा हिंदुस्तान के साउथ इंडिया के मंदिर धरती के सबसे अमीर मंदिर माने जाते हैं उनसे अमीर कोई हो नहीं सकता क्यों क्योंकि फेंका है
says: The temples of South India are regarded as the richest on earth, and none can be richer, because people there have 'thrown' (donated) so much. He offers it as proof that giving brings wealth.
ambiguity: The leading 'अंधा' is a garbled fragment, probably 'आज' or a stutter; the temple-wealth claim itself is a general assertion, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: a social claim used as support for the donation remedy.

hindi: अब आपसे फेंका जा सकता है नहीं फेंकते नहीं यह केतु महाराज कहते हैं बेटा जितना फेंके उतना दूंगा
says: Can you give away like that? You do not. Ketu Maharaj says: child, as much as you throw, that much I will give. Ketu is made the returner of what is given up.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dana is the classical remedy for Ketu; the promise of a matching return is his own.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति की कुंडली में केतु यहां बैठ गया मान लो उदाहरण यह खर्चे
says: He begins an example: a person whose chart has Ketu sitting 'here' on the board, say as an example in the expenses area. The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice, so the point is not yet made.
cells_derived_method: If 'expenses' means the 12th house, Ketu there makes spending a channel of detachment or loss, and the sign sets the style of spending.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Aries in the 12th house (lagna Taurus): sudden, impulsive outlays and giving up on causes or conflicts, with little attachment to the money spent.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius in the 12th house (lagna Capricorn): spending drifts toward charity, pilgrimage and spiritual teaching, detached from personal comfort.

ambiguity: The house is not stated ('यहां' points at the board); 'खर्चे' (expenses) suggests the 12th but that is an inference, and the sentence is cut off.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th is the house of expenses; the example itself is incomplete.

hindi: का स्थान है यही मोक्ष का स्थान है बावा घर हैय यह भोग का य आपका पलंग भी होता है
says: The twelfth house is the place of moksha (liberation) and also of bhog (sensual enjoyment); he adds that it is literally your bed, so bedroom life and rest sit in this house together with spiritual release. The word before 'place of' was cut off by the caption.
cells_derived_method: The 12th house themes (moksha, enjoyment, bed) get coloured by the sign on the 12th cusp, that sign's lord, and by the 2 or 3 signs a 12th house spans: water signs make it emotional and spiritual, earth signs material and saving-minded, fire signs impulsive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries has Pisces on the 12th, Jupiter's sign and the natural moksha sign, so the liberation and sleep themes are strongest and bed life is dreamy and emotional.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra has Virgo on the 12th, Mercury's analytical sign, so bed life turns fussy and health-conscious and spending goes to service and detail.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius has Scorpio on the 12th, intense and secretive, so intimacy is passionate and private and losses arrive suddenly.

ambiguity: Caption says 'बावा घर' which is read as 'बारहवां घर' (12th house). Could in principle be another number, but moksha and bed both point to the 12th.
classical_check: Classical texts agree: the 12th (vyaya bhava) covers moksha, expenses, losses and bed pleasures (shayya sukha).

hindi: अगर यहां पर ग्रह आपका डिस्टर्ब है तो बेड पर पहुंचते पति पत्नी लड़ते हैं संभोग की क्रिया के दौरान क्लेश करते हैं
says: If a planet sitting in the 12th house is disturbed (afflicted), husband and wife quarrel the moment they reach the bed and create friction during intimacy. He ties bedroom conflict directly to a damaged 12th house occupant.
cells_derived_method: The style of the bedroom quarrel depends on the sign the afflicted planet sits in: fire signs give anger and impatience, air signs give arguments in words, earth signs give coldness and duty, water signs give moodiness and withdrawal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus has Aries on the 12th, so an afflicted planet there brings heat, anger and short sharp fights in bed.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius has Capricorn on the 12th, so affliction shows as coldness, duty-talk and withdrawal rather than open fights.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer has Gemini on the 12th, so affliction shows as taunts, words and misunderstanding at bedtime.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is taken to be the 12th house because he has just described the 12th as the bed house. 'डिस्टर्ब' (disturbed) is not defined: it could mean debilitated, enemy-sign, combust or aspected by malefics.
classical_check: Consistent with classical shayya sukha reading of the 12th and the 7th/12th link; the exact claim of fights 'on reaching the bed' is his own phrasing.

hindi: अब मान लो य केतु बैठा है केतु की क्वालिटी देखिए यह कहता भाई खर्चे का पैसा अपन देगा बंदा कंगला है अब उसने खर्चे का टारगेट बना लिया
says: Take Ketu sitting in the 12th (expense house): Ketu's quality is that it says 'I will supply the money for your spending'. The native is penniless, yet he sets himself an expense target and the money for that spending shows up.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 12th funds expenses but leaves the native without savings; where the money goes depends on the sign: Jupiter signs push it to religion and donation, Venus signs to comfort and food, Sun signs to status and display.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn has Sagittarius on the 12th, so Ketu's funded spending goes to teachers, pilgrimage, religion and donation.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini has Taurus on the 12th, so spending leaks into food, comfort and luxury while savings stay near zero.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo has Leo on the 12th, so spending goes to display, status and children's pleasures.

ambiguity: The house is not spoken ('यहां'); it is taken as the 12th from the bed and expense context just given. Whether the money really arrives from outside or the native borrows is not stated.
classical_check: Classical texts give Ketu in the 12th as good for moksha and spiritual spending but heavy on expenses; the 'Ketu supplies the money' framing is his own.

gist: Illustration of the expense cycle: target Rs 1 lakh, money comes, then broke again, then Rs 2 lakh, then Rs 2 crore, always broke after spending.
Rhetorical question to the class, asking how much guts (gurda, courage) you have.

hindi: आपकी बॉडी के अंदर मंथ की मेंसेज लड़की के शरीर में लगातार हो रही है बन रही है अपने आप हो रहा है एग आ रहा है जा रहा है सीमन अपने आप आ रहा है जा रहा है
says: He points out that the body produces and sheds things on its own: a girl's monthly menses, the egg and semen are made and released automatically and continuously without anyone's effort. This is the premise for treating such discharge as Ketu's natural, involuntary function.
ambiguity: Ketu is not named in this sentence. The link to Ketu comes from the next sentence ('all of that is Ketu-afflicted'), so this is a premise rather than a stated rule.
classical_check: Classical texts give Ketu moksha, detachment and discharge-type significations loosely; they do not state this body-process argument, so it is silent.

hindi: जिन लड़कों को ये भ्रम रहता है कि मैंने बहुत वीर्य लॉस कर लिया मेरे जीवन में अब आगे क्या होगा कमजोरी है खराबी वो सब केतु से ग्रसित है
says: Boys who carry the delusion (bhram) that they have lost too much semen, that they are weak or spoiled and that their future is ruined are, in his view, all gripped by Ketu. He locates the problem in the anxious belief and ascribes it to Ketu affliction. This is his claim only and is not medical advice.
ambiguity: No house or sign is given, so he does not say where in the chart this Ketu affliction sits. 'ग्रसित' could mean afflicted by placement or by aspect.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish texts do not tie semen-loss anxiety to Ketu.

hindi: कुत्ते की सेवा करो केतु के लिए कृपा मांग के
says: Remedy for Ketu: serve dogs, and do it while asking for Ketu's grace. Dog service is the first remedy he names for a troubled Ketu.
ambiguity: 'सेवा' could mean feeding or general care; he does not say how often.
classical_check: Agrees with the common folk and Lal Kitab style remedy of feeding dogs for Ketu; not from the Parashari core texts.

hindi: चलो आप कैसे मांगते हैं सब बातों की भिखारियों से मांगे जा सकते हैं जितने दरवेश लोग जितने के फकीर लोग हैं जितने सूफी लोग हैं जितने ऐसे लोग हैं जो बहुत सं तत्व की तरह घूमते हैं
says: On how to ask for Ketu's grace: you can ask for blessings from beggars and from all the dervishes, fakirs, Sufis and wandering saint-like people. The renunciate wanderers are treated as channels of Ketu's favour.
ambiguity: Caption 'सब बातों की भिखारियों से' is garbled; read as 'every kind of thing can be asked from beggars'. 'बहुत सं तत्व' read as 'saint-like'.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; matches the folk link of Ketu with fakirs, mendicants and renunciates.

hindi: सब की सेवा करो सेवक का भी जो सेवक हो उसकी सेवा करो आपका केतु इंप्रूव हो जाएगा
says: Serve all of those people, and even serve the servant of the servant; do that and your Ketu will improve. The remedy is humble service stretched down to the lowest helper.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; humility and service as the Ketu remedy is a popular tradition claim.

hindi: ये फालतू का बादल है ना दिमाग के आगे कुछ दिख नहीं रहा लाइफ में कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा
says: An afflicted Ketu is a useless cloud sitting in front of the mind: the person can see nothing ahead and cannot understand anything about life. He calls this mental fog a Ketu symptom.
ambiguity: Caption 'ये फालतू का बादल' could be 'ये फालतू का बादल है' (this useless cloud) or a loose sound-alike; the meaning of a fogged mind is clear from the rest.
classical_check: Classical texts link Ketu with confusion, illusion and detachment, so it broadly agrees.

hindi: यार कहां जाए हां जाए वहां जाए ये करें मैं थोड़ा-थोड़ा यह काम करता हूं थोड़ा-थोड़ा वो सब केतु के कारण है
says: Indecision such as 'where should I go, should I do this or that, I do a little of this work and a little of that' is caused by Ketu. Scattered, half-hearted effort across many things is his sign of Ketu's hand.
classical_check: Silent as worded; consistent with Ketu as a planet of scattering and incompleteness in modern teaching.

hindi: आप में गुर्दा होना चाहिए केतु आपका यहां बैठ गया ये कर्म स्थान है अधूरा काम करो अधूरे काम से ही ठीक होगा
says: If Ketu sits in the karma sthan (career house, the 10th), you need courage (gurda) to do your work deliberately unfinished, because Ketu's problem there is settled only by leaving work incomplete. He turns the usual urge to finish into the remedy.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 10th gives unfinished career work; the sign decides the style of incompleteness: movable signs start and abandon, fixed signs stall at 90 percent, dual signs run many half-done tasks in parallel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo has Gemini on the 10th, so Ketu leaves many parallel half-finished communication, trade or writing tasks.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces has Sagittarius on the 10th, so work in teaching, advice or religion is left unfinished while a spiritual calling pulls the person away.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer has Aries on the 10th, so jobs and projects are started with force and dropped abruptly.

ambiguity: 'यहां' with 'कर्म स्थान' is taken as the 10th house. It could also mean the 6th (karma of service) but the 10th is the usual karma sthan.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Ketu in the 10th as detached from worldly status, often weak in career; the deliberate-incomplete-work remedy is his own tradition claim.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया धर्म स्थान है अधूरी पूजा करो पूरी करनी नहीं
says: If Ketu sits in the dharma sthan, perform worship (puja) incompletely and do not complete it. Leaving the ritual half-done is his remedy for Ketu in the religion house.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 9th shows in religion and dharma matters: the sign shows what kind of worship stays incomplete, such as fire signs leaving rituals mid-way, water signs drifting in devotion, earth signs skipping rules.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius has Leo on the 9th, so Ketu leaves ritual and father-guru matters half-finished and pride in practice is dropped.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer has Pisces on the 9th, so devotion becomes formless and unfinished, which suits the remedy.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn has Virgo on the 9th, so ritual detail is started but never finished because the person keeps fixing procedure.

ambiguity: 'धर्म स्थान' is the 9th by convention, but it could be the 5th (purva punya, mantra) in a dharma-trikona sense. 9th is chosen.
classical_check: Silent on the deliberate unfinished-puja remedy; classical texts only say Ketu in the 9th is for spiritual detachment.

hindi: सर इसमें कोई राशि का लेना देना नहीं है राशि के हिसाब से कितना अधूरा वो बात होगी राशि इसलिए अभी बता नहीं रहा क्योंकि वो बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है
says: These house-wise Ketu rules (unfinished work in the 10th, unfinished puja in the 9th) are given without any sign; the sign decides how much incompleteness there will be, but he postpones the sign-wise detail because it is very complicated. So the house reading is the base rule and sign only scales it.
cells_derived_method: Sign scales the degree: fixed signs make incompleteness stubborn, movable signs make it abrupt, dual signs make it scattered. He has not given sign rules yet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo has Taurus on the 10th, a fixed sign, so unfinished career work lingers for years near completion.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo has Gemini on the 10th, a dual sign, so many tasks are half done at once.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer has Aries on the 10th, a movable sign, so work is started with energy and dropped quickly.

ambiguity: 'सर इसमें कोई राशि का लेना देना नहीं है' could be an audience question ('Sir, is there no sign involved?') answered by him, or his own statement. Both lead to the same deferral.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, where sign, dignity and lord always matter; here he sets the sign aside only temporarily.

hindi: थरू ये थम रूल है लेकिन केतु वहां है कि नहीं डिस्प्लेस भी होता है
says: These readings are only a thumb rule, and one must check whether Ketu is really in that house, because a planet can also be displaced from the house it appears in. He is pointing to the bhava-chalit idea that the planet's effect can move to the neighbouring house.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a house boundary in the rashi chart can shift into the next or previous house in the bhava chart, so the same Ketu may give the 9th reading instead of the 10th. The sign it sits in decides which boundary it is near.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Ketu late in Gemini on the 10th (lagna Virgo) may shift to the 11th in bhava chalit, so unfinished-gain matters replace unfinished-career matters.
Derived, not said by him: Ketu early in Pisces on the 9th (lagna Cancer) may shift to the 8th in bhava chalit, so the unfinished-puja reading becomes an occult or sudden-change reading.

ambiguity: Caption 'थरू ये थम रूल' is garbled; read as 'ये थंब रूल है'. 'डिस्प्लेस' is read as bhava-chalit displacement, though he may mean any shift.
classical_check: Agrees with classical bhava-chalit practice (Sripati and equal-house cusps) that planets shift houses.

hindi: लेकिन केतु का मजे की बात क्या अगर हो भी गया ना तो भी 5 पर 5 पर राशि दृष्टि र व की व है वो चौथी से नहीं तो पांचवी से देख लेगा पाचवी से नहीं देखेगा
says: Apparently he says that even if Ketu is displaced out of the house, its sign-based aspect (rashi drishti) still reaches: if it does not see from the 4th it will see from the 5th. The caption is badly garbled and the last clause contradicts the earlier one, so the exact houses named are uncertain.
cells_derived_method: If Ketu's aspect houses are counted from its own sign, the target houses shift with Ketu's sign and house; he has not given an exact list in this sentence.
ambiguity: Garbled caption: '5 पर 5 पर' and 'र व की व है' are unclear. The numbers 4 and 5 may be house counts or sign counts, and 'पाचवी से नहीं देखेगा' may be an error for another number. Confidence is kept low on purpose.
classical_check: Not standard: classical texts give Rahu and Ketu no agreed aspect, or 5, 7 and 9 in some schools.

hindi: सातवी आठवी नवी से देख लेगा सात आ इकठा कंटन दृष्टि है तो कहीं ना क तो पैक डाल के छोड़ेगा
says: Ketu will also see from the 7th, 8th and 9th; since these are together a continuous run of aspects, it will leave its impact somewhere or other. He is claiming Ketu's aspect field is wide and hard to escape.
cells_derived_method: If Ketu aspects the 7th, 8th and 9th from itself, a Ketu in a given house reaches those three target houses: Ketu in the 1st aspects the 7th, 8th and 9th, Ketu in the 10th aspects the 4th, 5th and 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Ketu in lagna Aries would aspect Libra, Scorpio and Sagittarius, the 7th, 8th and 9th houses.
Derived, not said by him: Ketu in the 10th in Capricorn (lagna Aries) would aspect the 4th, 5th and 6th houses, Cancer, Leo and Virgo.

ambiguity: Caption 'सात आ इकठा कंटन' is garbled ('seven eight nine together, continuous'). Combined with 4 and 5 in the previous sentence, the real list is unclear. Low confidence.
classical_check: Differs from the usual classical aspect scheme: Rahu and Ketu are usually given the 5th, 7th and 9th (or no special aspect), not 7, 8 and 9.

hindi: बादल है ना ये य फलाई करता रहता है टिकता नहीं है
says: Ketu is like a cloud that keeps drifting and never stays in one place. So restlessness and impermanence are Ketu's character.
ambiguity: 'फलाई' is read as 'fly'. 'य' is noise.
classical_check: Silent as worded; fits Ketu as ungrounded and detached.

hindi: बादल धुआ है सिगरेट स्मोकर सब केतु है
says: Smoke, cigarettes and smokers all belong to Ketu. He uses the cloud image to place smoking under Ketu's rulership.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; smoke is usually given to Rahu in common practice, so this differs.

hindi: अगर केतु अच्छा है खूब स्मोकिंग हुक्का मारते हो कुछ नहीं होगा
says: If Ketu is good (well placed and strong), you can smoke cigarettes and hookah heavily and nothing will happen to you. He makes health outcome of smoking depend on Ketu's condition. This is a health claim that is recorded only as his statement and is not advice.
ambiguity: He does not define what makes Ketu 'good' (sign, house or aspect).
classical_check: Silent; medically it is not supported, and the classical texts say nothing on smoking.

hindi: तभी तो डॉक्टर कहते हैं यार समझ नहीं आया जी यह लड़की बचारी सूफी संत है इसको लंग कैंसर हो गया तो कभी सिगरेट सोच भी नहीं केतु डिस्टर्ब है
says: He cites doctors who are puzzled when a Sufi-minded young woman who never even thought of a cigarette gets lung cancer, and he attributes such a case to a disturbed Ketu. This is a disease-cause claim from tradition. It is recorded as his statement only, not a diagnosis and not a validated link.
ambiguity: Whether the case is real or an illustration is not clear. Which affliction of Ketu he means is not stated.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; lungs are given to Mercury and the 4th house, not to Ketu, so this differs.

hindi: हर समय उसके दिमाग में अधूरी बात चलती है यह सब आपके केतु की खराबी के कारण है
says: A damaged Ketu keeps unfinished thoughts running in the mind at all times. He names incomplete, looping mental business as a sign of Ketu's affliction.
classical_check: Silent as worded; broadly consistent with Ketu as a planet of mental confusion.

hindi: जहां केतु बैठा है अधूरा काम देगा आपको
says: Wherever Ketu sits it will give you unfinished work in the matters of that house. This is his general rule behind the house-wise examples.
cells_derived_method: The house Ketu sits in decides which area stays incomplete: 2nd gives unfinished savings and speech, 5th gives unfinished studies and creative work, 7th gives incomplete partnerships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini has Cancer on the 2nd, so savings plans and family talk are left half-done and family feeling is unsettled.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries has Libra on the 7th, so partnerships and marriage plans stay undecided and unformalised.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio has Pisces on the 5th, so creative ideas and studies are started but not finished.

classical_check: Classical texts say Ketu destroys the matters of the house it sits in, which is compatible; 'unfinished' is his own wording.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया अधूरी पढ़ाई
says: Ketu sitting in the education house gives incomplete studies, such as dropped courses or an unfinished degree. The house number is not spoken, only pointed at on the chart.
cells_derived_method: Which signs sit in the education house decides which subjects stay unfinished: Mercury signs leave commerce or language studies incomplete, Jupiter signs leave law or philosophy incomplete.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces has Gemini on the 4th, so basic schooling or a language or commerce course is left half-finished.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo has Sagittarius on the 5th, so higher studies in law, philosophy or religion are started but not completed.

ambiguity: House number is not in the caption. Education belongs to the 4th (basic) and 5th (higher) so both are listed and neither is certain. Treat as 4th or 5th.
classical_check: Classical texts give the 4th and 5th for education, and Ketu there harms those matters, so it agrees in spirit.

hindi: यही नीच और उच्च हो गया डिपेंड करता है अलग-अलग राशियां अभी बात करेंगे हम
says: Whether Ketu turns out low (debilitated) or high (exalted) depends on the sign it is in, and the different signs will be discussed later. He sets the sign-wise Ketu dignity aside for now.
cells_derived_method: He gives no list in this slice, so sign-wise Ketu dignity cannot be derived here without inventing it.
ambiguity: 'यही नीच और उच्च हो गया' is loosely worded; read as 'whether it becomes low or high depends on the sign'.
classical_check: Classical schools disagree on Ketu's exaltation and debilitation signs, so there is no single check; he promises a sign-wise treatment later.

hindi: मजे की बात क्या है केतु अगर आपका नीच है बर्बाद है तबा है लेकिन मंगल अच्छा है मंगल की पूंछ है केतु
says: Even when Ketu is weak, ruined or destroyed, a good Mars rescues the situation because Ketu is the tail of Mars. The sentence is cut before the result, but the sense is that a strong Mars softens a damaged Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Mars is good when in own sign (Aries, Scorpio), exalted (Capricorn) or well placed; house placement of Mars decides which area of life the rescue appears in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives career drive that finishes what a damaged Ketu leaves half-done.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Scorpio in lagna Scorpio gives self-driven willpower that offsets Ketu's confusion.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn) steadies home life and property matters against Ketu's loss.

ambiguity: The result clause is missing: the caption jumps from 'Mars is good' to 'Ketu is Mars's tail'. The rescue meaning is inferred. 'तबा है' is read as 'तबाह है' (destroyed).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts say Ketu acts like Mars in some schools (Mars-like results), but not this exact rescue rule.

hindi: मंगल धूम केतु आप अंतरिक्ष में देखेंगे मिटटी और गिरता आग का गोला होता है पीछे एक पूंछ होती है पूंछ का नाम है केतु
says: Mars is like a comet (dhoom-ketu): in space you see a falling ball of earth and fire with a tail behind it, and the tail is named Ketu. So Ketu is the trailing tail of the Mars fireball, which is the image behind Ketu as Mars's tail.
ambiguity: The Hindi is a metaphor; it does not claim an astronomical fact, only the Mars-Ketu relation.
classical_check: Classical texts name Ketu with dhumra (smoke) and comet-like signs and link it to Mars; agrees in spirit.

hindi: आपका छोटा बच्चा उंगली पकड़ के चल रहा है की पूंछ है वो केतु है उसकी सेवा करो प्यार करो बच्चा है बिटिया है कोई भी है प्रेम करो
says: A small child walking while holding your finger is your tail, and that tail is Ketu; serve and love that child, son or daughter or anyone, as the way to please Ketu. Dependents who cling to you are Ketu's living form.
ambiguity: 'की पूंछ है' is clipped; read as 'is your tail'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a modern teaching image of Ketu as the follower.

hindi: आपका कुत्ता है आपके पीछे पुछ पुछ पुछ चलता रहता है ना वो पूंछ है आपकी पूंछ है इस
says: Your pet dog that keeps trotting behind you is also your tail and so is Ketu. The dog joins the child as an example of a follower that trails you.
ambiguity: 'पुछ पुछ पुछ' is the sound of following, not a word.
classical_check: Folk tradition gives Ketu the dog as its animal, so it agrees.

hindi: समय केतु कौन सी पूंछ है आपके जीवन में जो आपके पीछे पीछे चल रहा है उसका ध्यान रखो केतु इंप्रूव हो जाएगा ऑटोमेटिक
says: Remedy: find which tail is following you in your life right now, whether child, dog or a dependent, and take care of it; Ketu will then improve automatically. The remedy is care for whoever trails you.
ambiguity: 'इस समय' is the start of the sentence, split from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a tradition remedy by analogy.

hindi: लेस निया तो इसका स्टोन है ही
says: Cat's eye (lehsunia) is Ketu's gemstone. He mentions it only as a fact, without saying when to wear it.
ambiguity: Caption 'लेस निया' is read as 'लहसुनिया'. Whether he recommends wearing it is not said.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gem lore gives cat's eye (lehsunia, chrysoberyl) to Ketu.

hindi: इसी केतु के कारण आपको मोक्ष मिलेगा यही आपको ज्ञान जब देगा तो प्राप्ति भी देगा यही मोक्ष देता है
says: Through Ketu you get moksha; when it gives knowledge it also gives attainment, and it is the planet that gives liberation. Ketu is the giver of knowledge and moksha here.
ambiguity: 'प्राप्ति' could mean worldly attainment or spiritual attainment; he does not say.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts name Ketu moksha karaka and karaka of jnana (knowledge).

hindi: यही ऐसा देवता है जो खूब दान कराता खूब देता है यह देने वाला है
says: Ketu is the deity who makes you donate a lot and gives a lot himself; he is a giver. The charity side of Ketu is the opposite of the broke spender shown earlier.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'देता है' means Ketu gives to the native or makes the native give.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; charity with Ketu is a modern teaching.

hindi: आप देख के चलेंगे स्पर्म और एग के द्वारा ही जीवन दिया जाता है यानी इतनी बड़ी शक्ति है
says: Life is given only through sperm and egg, so Ketu, which he ties to these discharges, holds a very great power, the power of creation. He calls it a huge force.
ambiguity: Ketu is not named in this sentence, but the next sentences continue about Ketu's power, so the link is assumed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give procreation to Venus (shukra) and Jupiter, not to Ketu.

hindi: बृहस्पति के संरक्षण में होगा तो लाजवाब बेबी होगा किसी दूसरे के संरक्षण में होगा तो कातिल पैदा हो सकता है कौन पैदा हो भगवान मालिक है
says: If this creative power works under Jupiter's protection the baby will be excellent, but under another planet's protection a killer could be born; who is born only God knows. He makes the child's quality depend on which planet guards the seed.
ambiguity: 'संरक्षण' (protection) could mean aspect, conjunction or lordship; he does not say which. The killer remark is a rhetorical extreme.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that Jupiter is the karaka of children and gives good progeny; the claim about another planet giving a killer is his own.

hindi: लेकिन यह केतु इतना पावरफुल प्लेनेट है कि इसके द्वारा अधूरा काम इसलिए याद रखें कुछ काम जो अधूरे हो रहे हैं ना पूरे नहीं होते केतु के दोष से हैं
says: Ketu is such a powerful planet that, through it, work stays incomplete; so remember that works that keep getting left unfinished and never reach completion are due to Ketu's fault. He turns the observed pattern of unfinished work into a Ketu diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; consistent with the 'unfinished work' line he repeats about Ketu.

hindi: और अगर कुछ काम अधूरे करने से सफलता मिल रही है यानी केतु प्रसन्न है
says: If success is coming from leaving certain works incomplete, that means Ketu is pleased. So the same unfinished-work pattern is a sign of a happy Ketu when it brings success, and of a troubled one when it brings failure.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; this is his own test for Ketu's mood.

hindi: तो सामने देखता है और सारे में प्रकाश फैलाता है अपने के अलावा
says: A pleased Ketu looks straight ahead and spreads light on everything except itself, so it illuminates other things and leaves its own house dark. The sentence is cut at the start, so this is a loose reading.
cells_derived_method: If 'looks ahead' means the opposite (7th) house, then Ketu in a house lights up the house opposite it but not its own house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Ketu in the 6th (lagna Leo) in Capricorn would light up the 12th house in Cancer and leave the 6th itself dark.
Derived, not said by him: Ketu in the 3rd (lagna Leo) in Libra would light up the 9th house in Aries and leave the 3rd dark.

ambiguity: 'सामने देखता है' may mean the 7th aspect or simply facing forward. 'अपने के अलावा' may mean excluding itself or excluding its own house. Low confidence.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give Ketu no special light-giving aspect.

gist: Says drishti (aspects) will be discussed later and that first the basics of the planets must be done.
Complains that students jump straight to 'Sun in 5th will do this, in 6th that' when the Sun is not even there, and that combinations and rules come after placement.
Says the topic is so extensive that it might need separate full classes.
Says Saturn suddenly came to mind because Saturn is next after Ketu, and that Saturn needs a whole class of its own, a long Ramayana.
Says the base chapter has not yet been fully grasped and asks what further detail the student wanted.

hindi: जहां बैठा है वो वन है उसका जहा बैठ व वो उसका वन हो गया ना जैसे बृहस्पति मान लो यहां बैठा है तो ये इसका वन है अब यहां से फव गिन लो ट 3 4 5 6 7
says: For aspects, the house a planet sits in is counted as its own number 1; from there you count the 3rd, 4th, 5th up to the 8th. For example, if Jupiter sits in some house, that house is Jupiter's '1' and the aspect numbers are counted from it.
cells_derived_method: Counting is inclusive: the target of a 7th aspect is the house 6 places ahead of the planet's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet in the 3rd (lagna Aries) in Gemini counts its own house as 1 and its 7th is the 9th house, Sagittarius.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in the 9th (lagna Taurus) in Capricorn counts its own house as 1 and its 7th is the 3rd house, Cancer.
Derived, not said by him: a planet in the 12th (lagna Virgo) in Leo counts its own house as 1 and its 7th is the 6th house, Aquarius.

ambiguity: The start 'बस्ती आपने लि है वन पे होगा' is garbled ('बस्ती' may be 'दृष्टि'). He counts houses here, not signs.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard inclusive counting of graha drishti.

hindi: इलस करेगा हां ये सेवन है जो सूर्य है सूर्य की कहानी लगे सूर्य यहां बैठा हुआ है अगर तो सातवें घर में एक ही बार दृष्टि देगा
says: The Sun casts aspect only once: if the Sun sits in a house, it aspects the seventh house from itself and no other. The Sun has a single, full-strength aspect to the opposite house.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's target is always the house opposite its own, so the house touched depends on where the Sun sits, and the sign aspected is the opposite sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Sun in own sign Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo) aspects the 7th house, Aquarius, so self-assertion lands on partnership.
Derived, not said by him: an exalted Sun in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 4th house, Libra, so authority at work presses on home peace.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo) aspects the 10th house, Taurus, so career is tied to stable, money-related work.

ambiguity: Caption 'इलस करेगा' and 'सूर्य की कहानी लगे' are garbled; the 7th-house-only claim is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun has only the 7th aspect in Parashari tradition.

hindi: बस खत्म चंद्रमा बैठा है यह भी सातवें में ही दृष्टि देगा
says: That is all for the Sun; the Moon too gives aspect only to the seventh house from where it sits. The Moon's aspect is also a single opposite-house aspect.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's target is always the opposite house of where it sits: emotional focus falls on the house and sign opposite.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Moon in own sign Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 1st house, Capricorn, so spouse-related feeling shapes the self.
Derived, not said by him: an exalted Moon in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries) aspects the 8th house, Scorpio, so family and speech feelings tie to in-laws and shared money.
Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Moon in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces) aspects the 3rd house, Taurus, so effort and siblings carry anxiety and worry.

classical_check: Agrees: the Moon has only the 7th aspect in Parashari tradition.

gist: Repeats the Sun and Moon single-aspect point by placing them in the first house and in other houses, each giving one aspect to the opposite place.

hindi: मंगल अगर यहां बैठा है तो मंगल की एक दृष्टि यहां है चार चौथे घर पर एक दृष्टि यहां है सातवी एक दृष्टि यहां है आठवी और यहां पर तो मंगल चार जगह काम कर रहा है यह आग है
says: Mars aspects the 4th house, the 7th house and the 8th house from where it sits; counting the house it sits in, Mars works in four places. He calls Mars fire that acts in four places.
cells_derived_method: Mars's three aspect targets are the 4th, 7th and 8th houses counted from its own house, so each placement hits three different houses and signs; the 'fourth place' is read as the house it sits in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries) aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses, Cancer, Libra and Scorpio, touching home, spouse and longevity matters.
Derived, not said by him: an exalted Mars in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects the 1st, 4th and 5th houses, Aries, Cancer and Leo, so career drive reaches self, home and children.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) aspects the 10th, 1st and 2nd houses, Capricorn, Aries and Taurus, so spouse-related force reaches career, self and family wealth.

ambiguity: He says 'four places' though the standard Mars aspects are three (4, 7, 8). The fourth is read as the house it sits in. It could also be a slip.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars special aspects on the 4th, 7th and 8th houses are standard in Parashari tradition.

gist: Says 'Jupiter is here', then moves on to Saturn and mentions changing the colour on the board; Jupiter's aspect numbers are not captured.

hindi: शनि यहां बैठा है तो शनि की तीसरी एक दो तीन सातवी दसवी 10 अपने से सामने देख र दव घर पर देख र और तीसरे घर पर यह शनि का है
says: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses counted from where it sits: the 3rd (counting 1, 2, 3), the opposite 7th, and the 10th. Those are Saturn's three aspects.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's targets are the 3rd, 7th and 10th from its own house, so the houses and signs touched change with its placement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: an exalted Saturn in Libra in the 1st (lagna Libra) aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses, Sagittarius, Aries and Cancer, so discipline presses on effort, partnership and career.

Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo) aspects the 8th, 12th and 3rd houses, Pisces, Cancer and Libra, so it controls rivals but weighs on hidden matters and losses.

Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo) aspects the 10th, 2nd and 5th houses, Gemini, Libra and Capricorn, so pressure falls on career, family wealth and children.

classical_check: Silent as worded; Lakshmi's fickleness is a proverb, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: लोगों के पास पैसा आता है व अक्सर क्या सोचते हैं भाई साहब पैसा आ गया है मैं यार दान करूंगा नहीं वो कहते हैं भाई साहब अब बुरा टाइम भी आएगा ना तो पांच पेटी तो मैं रख लूंगा
says: When money comes to people they often decide not to donate it, saying bad times will come too, so they set aside five lakh (five 'petis') for that. Fear of a bad future makes them hoard instead of give. This is a behavioural remark, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'पांच पेटी' is read as five lakh rupees; 'पेटी' is slang for a lakh or crore. The Saturn link is only stated at the end of this passage.
classical_check: Silent as worded; hoarding out of fear is a Saturn trait in common teaching.

hindi: डॉक्टरों के लिए पांच पेटी रख लूंगा मैं यार को अगर सर आ गया तंग करेगा उन्होंने पहले निर्धारित कर दिया किसके लिए कौन सी पेटियां बांधनी है वो ये नहीं करते
says: They pre-assign the reserves, five for doctors in case an illness comes to trouble them, and decide beforehand which bundle of cash is for what; they do not do the opposite and give money away. Fear-based earmarking of money is shown as the pattern.
ambiguity: 'को अगर सर आ गया' is garbled; read as 'if an illness (or trouble) comes'.
classical_check: Silent as worded.

hindi: किसी को दे दूं किसी के काम आएंगे नहीं अब तो और रख ले पैसे पता है मेरे मामा के लड़के को भिखारी आ जाएगा साला मांगने पैसे यह सब आपके शनि का काम है
says: The miser thinks 'should I give to someone? it will not help anyone, better keep more', and fears a begging relative will come asking, such as his maternal uncle's son; all of this, he says, is the work of your Saturn. Fear, suspicion and refusal to share are Saturn's doing.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses a chunk boundary; 'भिखारी' is a figure of speech for a relative asking for money.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is associated with miserliness and distrust.

hindi: तीसरा नेत्र मतलब तीसरा नेत्र वो नेत्र है जिसने पुष्पा फिल्म बनी नहीं है लेकिन डायरेक्टर ने यहां बना ली पहले कैसे बनी फिल्म
says: The third eye is the eye by which a director first makes the whole film in his head before it exists in reality; he uses the Pushpa film as the example. So the third eye is inner vision that creates a thing before it appears.
ambiguity: The film example is loosely captioned; read as 'the film was not made yet but the director made it here (in his mind) first'.
classical_check: Silent: not a Parashari concept.

hindi: यानी शनि को कमाल का रूप लक्ष्मी को कमाल का रूप प्रारब्ध के कर्मों को कमाल का रूप कैसे देना तीसरे नेत्र से
says: The question is how to give a wonderful form to Saturn, to Lakshmi and to prarabdha karmas, and the answer is: through the third eye. The third eye is the tool for transforming fate and wealth.
ambiguity: 'कमाल का रूप' means a marvellous form; what exact change is meant is not defined.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: आपका तीसरा नेत्र की कृपा कब होगी जब आंखें बंद है
says: The grace of the third eye comes when the physical eyes are closed. Closing the eyes is the switch that lets the inner eye work.
ambiguity: 'जब आंखें बंद है' is read as physically closing the eyes, with a wider sense of shutting out outer watching.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; consistent with the meditation tradition.

hindi: आपका शनि इलेक्ट्रॉन है शनि मुन्ना है
says: Your Saturn is an electron, a small charged particle; he also calls Saturn 'munna', a child. Saturn is pictured as a tiny negative charge waiting to be set right, with a pet-name tone.
ambiguity: 'इलेक्ट्रॉन' is read as the negatively charged particle, which fits the 'positivity' sentence next; he may only mean something small and movable.
classical_check: Silent: this is a modern analogy, not classical.

hindi: शनि की पॉजिटिविटी कैसे शुरू होंगी जब आपने आंखें बंद कर ली
says: Saturn's positivity starts the moment you close your eyes. Shutting out outer sight is what turns Saturn from negative to positive.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: क्लेश चल रहा है आपने आंखें बंद कर ली आप बात ही नहीं करते पत्नी से बात ही बंद कर दी पति से बात ही बंद कर दी आपका तीसरा नेत्र न हो जाएगा और आप ऑटोमेटिक शनि निकाल देगा
says: If there is quarrel, court-case and strife at home, close your eyes to it: stop talking, wife to husband and husband to wife; then the third eye will switch on and Saturn will sort it out automatically. His remedy is to stop engaging in the conflict. This is relationship advice from him, recorded as his claim.
ambiguity: 'तीसरा नेत्र न हो जाएगा' is read as 'ऑन हो जाएगा'. 'शनि निकाल देगा' is read as Saturn will find a way out.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a modern tradition remedy.

hindi: अंधा व्यक्ति ऑटोमेटिक चलता है अंधों के एक्सीडेंट नहीं सुनने मिलते
says: A blind person walks automatically, and you rarely hear of accidents involving the blind. He uses blindness as the image of Saturn working safely when you do not look.
ambiguity: This is a factual-sounding analogy, not verified; its role is to support 'close your eyes'.
classical_check: Silent: Saturn is classically linked to the blind and the disabled only loosely.

hindi: जब बंदा ध्यान क्रिया में बैठता है त भी तो आख बंद होती है
says: When a person sits in meditation his eyes are closed too, which is the same eyes-closed condition under which the third eye opens. Meditation is shown as the formal way to close the eyes.
ambiguity: The ending 'हां तो' is the beginning of the next point.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Asks twice, as a rhetorical question, why meditation matters, noting that the person sits with eyes closed.

hindi: जैसे ही ध्यान क्रिया में आंखें बंद अगली प्रक्रिया समझने वाली है कि मन भी शांत हुआ है थॉट बंद हु है कि नहीं
says: As soon as the eyes close in meditation, the next thing to check is whether the mind has also become calm and the thoughts have stopped. Closing the eyes is only step one; a quiet mind is step two.
ambiguity: 'थॉट बंद हु है' is read as 'thoughts have stopped'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: तो मुन्ना थॉट बंद नहीं करता
says: The person, addressed as 'munna', does not manage to stop his thoughts just by closing his eyes. This is the problem that makes a further technique necessary.
ambiguity: Short sentence; the subject 'munna' is the student or ordinary person, not a planet.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: तीसरा नेत्र ऑन करने के लिए लोग क्या करते हैं सांस पर ध्यान दो तो नाभी हनुमान जी है
says: To switch on the third eye people focus on the breath, and the navel is Hanuman ji. So the navel centre is identified with Hanuman, who stands for fire and Mars.
ambiguity: Mars is not named in this sentence; it is inferred from the later line that focusing on the breath switches Mars on.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no navel-Hanuman link; Hanuman is traditionally tied to Mars and Saturn remedies in popular practice.

hindi: हनुमान जी के आगे शनि की चलती नहीं
says: Saturn has no power in front of Hanuman ji. Hanuman (fire, Mars) overrules Saturn.
ambiguity: Whether this means Mars overpowers Saturn in a chart or only the deity overpowers him is not said.
classical_check: Agrees with the Hanuman-Saturn folk tradition (Hanuman worship relieves Saturn's troubles); not a Parashari rule.

hindi: शनि क्या है तेल हनुमान जी क्या है आग वो हाथ जोड़ केर खड़ा हो जाता है आसन ग्रहण करो अग्नि आई है भाई देवता जो मर्जी करो तुम मुझे फूको आग लगाओ मैंने हाथ जोड़ दिए
says: Saturn is oil and Hanuman is fire; oil folds its hands before the fire and says 'take a seat, the fire god has come, do whatever you like, burn me, I have folded my hands'. The image shows Saturn surrendering to Mars-fire.
ambiguity: This is a story-like analogy; the astrological content is only that Saturn yields to the fire of Mars or Hanuman.
classical_check: Silent as an element split; Saturn as oil echoes the oil offering tradition.

hindi: तो सांस पर ध्यान देते हैं ना लोग ध्यान तो मंगल ऑन हो जाता है और शनि महाराज शांत हो जाते हैं कहते नहीं नहीं अभी दुख नहीं देना
says: When people watch the breath, Mars is switched on and Saturn becomes quiet, saying 'no, no, not now, I will not give sorrow'. Breath meditation therefore calms Saturn's suffering by waking Mars.
ambiguity: 'अभी दुख नहीं देना' suggests a temporary pause, not a cure.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a modern tradition remedy.

hindi: जितने लोगों को 12 पर कष्ट को 12 ही बना के रखना है उन सबको नाभी पर ध्यान देना है 12 पर जब कष्ट आया है बॉडी नहीं मिलेगी शनि को
says: People who have suffering at the '12' should focus on the navel; when the suffering has come at 12, Saturn will not get a body to act on. Navel focus is offered to those whose trouble sits at the 12th place.
cells_derived_method: If '12' means a trouble placed in the 12th house, the sign on it colours the trouble: Saturn in Capricorn there gives sleep and expense stress, Saturn debilitated in Aries gives anger-driven losses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) gives heavy, dutiful spending and disturbed sleep, which navel meditation is meant to calm.
Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) gives impatient, anger-linked losses and restless nights, the case where navel focus would be advised.

ambiguity: '12 पर कष्ट' could mean trouble in the 12th house, a position at '12' on the body or chart diagram, or twelve o'clock. The sentence is garbled ('कष्ट को 12 ही बना के रखना है'). Low confidence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a navel remedy for the 12th house.

hindi: शनि से मतलब हम प्रारब्ध को लेकर चल रहे हैं सारे ग्रह इवॉल्वड है
says: By Saturn he means we are carrying our prarabdha, the karma now ripening, and all the planets are involved in it. Saturn stands for the destiny we are born carrying.
ambiguity: 'इवॉल्वड' is read as 'involved' (or 'evolved'); either way all planets take part in prarabdha.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is the karma karaka, and prarabdha is read from the whole chart.

hindi: शनि को बदनाम कर रहे हैं क्योंकि वो मूलाधार पर बैठा हुआ है
