says: Saturn is being defamed only because he sits on the root chakra. Saturn is blamed unfairly since he is placed where all the base karma is.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which readily call Saturn a malefic; he defends Saturn here.

hindi: तो इसलिए अपने जीवन में जितना भी कुछ आपने सोचा मेरा मेरा पति मेरी पत्नी मेरा बच्चा यह छोड़ दो बंद कर दो
says: Remedy: drop all the 'mine, mine' thinking, my husband, my wife, my child, and stop it. Giving up possessive attachment is how to deal with Saturn's root karma.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he means give up the attachment or give up the people; context says the possessive thinking.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; consistent with Saturn as the planet of detachment.

hindi: क्लेरिटी नहीं होनी चाहिए शनि लाजवाब काम करता है अगर उस परे छोड़ दो
says: You should not demand clarity; Saturn does outstanding work if you leave the matter to him. Surrendering control, without needing to see how, lets Saturn deliver.
ambiguity: 'उस परे' is read as 'उस पर' (on him).
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: आपके घर के अंदर आप वर्कर से दुखी हो क्यों दुखी हो क्योंकि आप मानसिक तौर पर उसे चेज कर रहे हो यह ऐसे करता है यह ऐसे करता है
says: If you are unhappy with the worker at home it is because you are mentally chasing him, thinking 'he does it like this, he does it like that'. Saturn's domain of servants and workers gives sorrow when you keep supervising them in your head.
ambiguity: He does not name Saturn here but the next sentences ('blind the Saturn') show the link; 'वर्कर' is a household servant.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the karaka of servants and workers; the mental-chasing cause is his own.

hindi: ब्लाइंड हो जाओ ब्लाइंड शनि को ब्लाइंड कर दो अंधा वो सेवक आपके पांव दबाए पता नहीं कब सेवा कर जाएगा क्याक काम कर जाएगा बिन बोले बोला हुआ नहीं करेगा
says: Go blind: make Saturn blind, then that servant will press your feet and serve at some unknown time, doing useful work without being told, not just what he is told. Stop watching your workers and they will serve unprompted.
ambiguity: 'ब्लाइंड कर दो' means to stop watching and controlling; 'अंधा वो सेवक' is read as 'the servant, once you are blind to him'. The caption is noisy.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: श की पूजा करते शनि की पूजा करना बहुत सुंदर है तेल चढ़ाते हैं तो शनि को शक्ति मिलती है
says: Worshipping Saturn is very good, and when you offer oil Saturn gets strength. Oil offering is the standard puja that strengthens Saturn.
ambiguity: 'श की पूजा करते' is a cut fragment and is ignored. Strengthening Saturn contradicts the earlier remedy of calming him; he treats a strong Saturn as a better giver.
classical_check: Agrees: oil offering to Saturn (til or mustard oil) is a standard classical and folk remedy.

hindi: यानी नवम भाव में शनि को प्लेस करते हैं आपका नवम भाव होता है वहां शनि की प्लेसमेंट की जाती है
says: Saturn is placed in the ninth house: the ninth bhava is where Saturn's placement is made. It is unclear whether this means Saturn is given strength in the 9th house of the chart or the Saturn puja item or yantra is placed in the 9th place of the home.
cells_derived_method: If Saturn is treated as strengthened in the 9th, the sign decides how it behaves: own signs give disciplined dharma, debilitation gives strained fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 9th (lagna Gemini) gives disciplined, slow but steady luck and a strict relation with father and guru.
Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) gives a strained, delayed fortune and friction with father or teachers.

ambiguity: Garbled and loose: it follows the oil offering, so it may be a puja-placement or Vastu instruction rather than a chart rule. Low confidence.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Saturn in the 9th as delayed fortune; they do not describe a 'placement' as a remedy.

hindi: श की लेडीज भी शनि की पूजा
says: Women (ladies) too may do Saturn puja. He opens Saturn worship to women as well, though the sentence is clipped.
ambiguity: Clipped caption ('श की'); it could be the start of a sentence continued in 'शनि नपुंसक ग्रह है' rather than a separate claim. Low confidence.
classical_check: Differs from a common folk restriction that women should not touch or offer oil to the Shani idol; he seems to allow it.

hindi: शनि नपुंसक ग्रह है बुद्ध स्त्री नपुंसक है पुरुष नपुंसक शनि है
says: Saturn is a neuter (napunsak) planet: Mercury is the female-neuter and Saturn is the male-neuter. He splits the two neuter planets by their lean.
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' here is Mercury (Budh), not the Buddha.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Saturn are the napumsaka (neuter) planets; the female-neuter and male-neuter split is his own.

hindi: इसलिए बुद्ध के लिए हिजड़ों को हरी चीज दी जाती है
says: Remedy for Mercury: green things are given to hijras (eunuchs, the third gender), because Mercury is a neuter planet. The neuter link gives a donation remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with the popular Mercury remedy of giving green items or bangles to hijras; not found in the Parashari core.

hindi: और दरिद्र व्यक्ति जो नपुंसक मींस किछ करने लायक नहीं है भिखारी है कोढ़ी केतु से बनते हैं आप कोई किसी लायक ही नहीं है शनि के एजेंट है
says: Destitute people who are 'napunsak' in the sense of being unable to do anything, such as beggars and lepers, are produced by Ketu, and these useless-for-anything people are Saturn's agents. He assigns the helpless poor to Ketu and Saturn together.
ambiguity: 'नपुंसक' is used loosely for 'incapable', not as the gender sense; the caption 'मींस किछ' is garbled. The wording about lepers is his and is recorded as spoken.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of the poor and the afflicted, and Ketu of leprosy-type conditions in some texts.

hindi: सारे उनको खूब दो और देने के बाद बखान नहीं
says: Remedy: give plenty to all those helpless poor people (the beggars and incapable ones he just called Saturn's agents), and after giving do not announce or boast about it. Silent, generous giving is the way to satisfy Saturn.
ambiguity: 'उनको' is read as the agents of Saturn from the last sentence of the previous slice. The sentence starts mid-thought.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical Saturn remedy of charity to the poor and servants; the no-boasting rule is his emphasis.

hindi: बखान क्या मतलब अहंकार छन आ गया मुन्ना न हो गया
says: Boasting about your giving means ego has crept in, and with ego you are no longer an innocent 'munna', a child-like person. Ego after charity cancels the benefit.
ambiguity: 'छन आ गया' is read as 'क्षण में आ गया' (comes in an instant). 'मुन्ना न हो गया' is read as 'you are no longer a munna'.
classical_check: Silent as worded; the idea of unboasted charity is a general dharmic teaching.

hindi: नहीं अब शनि को दिखना नहीं चाहिए आपके पास एक शत्रु आया है आपको मारने आया है आप बचोगे कैसे जब उसे आप दिखो ही नहीं
says: Saturn must not see you: like an enemy who has come to kill you, you can only be safe when you are not visible to him at all. Staying out of Saturn's sight is how to be protected.
ambiguity: The last clause 'आप बचोगे कैसे जब उसे आप दिखो ही नहीं' can be a rhetorical question ('how will you be saved if he cannot see you?') but the surrounding logic reads it as 'you are saved when he cannot see you'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classically Saturn's drishti harms what it falls on, and his picture of being seen by Saturn matches that idea, though he puts it in terms of the eyes.

hindi: अब शनि ऑन हो गया आपके अंदर आपका ग्रह नेगेटिव शुरू हो गया शनि मीन सारा प्रारब्ध
says: When you start looking and judging, Saturn is switched on inside you and your planet turns negative; Saturn means the entire prarabdha. He ties the activation of Saturn's bad side to the moment you open your eyes.
ambiguity: 'शनि मीन' is read as 'शनि मीन्स' (Saturn means). 'आपका ग्रह नेगेटिव शुरू हो गया' may mean the Saturn in your chart, or your Saturn state.
classical_check: Silent as worded; Saturn as the karmic, prarabdha planet is standard.

hindi: आप दुखी हो बेबस हो पैसे नहीं है बच्चे नहीं पाल पा रहे काम नहीं है नौकरी नहीं है क्या करें क्योंकि आपने आंखें खोल खोल के देख रखा सब ऐसे हो रहा है वैसे
says: You are sad and helpless, with no money, unable to bring up your children and with no work or job, and the reason is that you have kept your eyes wide open watching everything happen. Constant watching and worrying is named as the cause of poverty and joblessness. This is his claim, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'आंखें खोल के देख रखा' is a figure of speech for overthinking and watching, not a literal eye state. Saturn is not named in this sentence but is the subject of the passage.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, which attribute poverty and job loss to placements and dashas, not to over-watching.

hindi: आंखें बंद कर लो सोचना समझना बंद कर दो शनि को दिखेगा ही नहीं वो मार ही नहीं पाएगा आपको
says: Remedy: close your eyes and stop thinking and analysing; then Saturn will not see you and will not be able to hurt you at all. Letting go of mental control is the protective step.
ambiguity: 'मार ही नहीं पाएगा' is hyperbole for 'cannot harm you'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a modern tradition remedy.

hindi: अब मुन्ना की खासियत है लॉलीपॉप वो फटाफट आपको एक लॉलीपॉप देगा आंखें खोलो गाड़ी आई है गाड़ी सच में आएगी
says: Saturn's special trick is the lollipop: he quickly hands you a sweet gift and says 'open your eyes, the car has come', and the car truly arrives. The gift is bait to make you look and react.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' here is a pet name for Saturn, not the student.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; a story-like teaching.

hindi: अब गाड़ी आते ही आप कहोगे अब वो गाड़ी के नीचे टायर के नीचे दबा के मार देगा अगर आप कहोगे ना गाड़ी आई है
says: If the moment the car arrives you react and say 'the car has come', Saturn will crush you under the tyre. Reacting to or celebrating the gift turns it into the weapon.
ambiguity: 'दबा के मार देगा' is a vivid image of ruin by the gift itself, not a literal death prediction.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: हां तो कोई नहीं वो कहेगा यार एक गाड़ी और देनी पड़ेगी ज वो तब तक जवाई सा खुश ना होंगे जब तक तब तक गाड़ियां देता रहेगा शनि
says: If you do not react, Saturn says 'I will have to give one more car', and he keeps giving cars like a host who cannot please his son-in-law until he has given more. Staying unmoved makes Saturn keep giving.
ambiguity: The caption is noisy ('ज वो तब तक जवाई सा'); the son-in-law comparison is read as a host who keeps giving until the guest is pleased.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि बहुत बड़ा दाता है
says: The reason is that Saturn is a very great giver (daata). He treats Saturn's generosity as the basis for the gift-giving pattern just described.
ambiguity: This contrasts with his earlier statement that Saturn is the planet of sorrow; he reconciles them by saying Saturn gives a lot when you do not look.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically Saturn gives late but lasting results; calling him a big daata is his emphasis.

hindi: क्यों अरे सूर्य का बेटा है इसकी मजे की
says: Why is Saturn so generous and strong? Because he is the son of the Sun. Saturn's power is traced to his parentage.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut mid-way and continues into the next slice.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is Surya putra, the son of the Sun, in classical and mythological texts.

gist: Lead-in question about what is special in Saturn and how strong he is, before the space story.

hindi: जब अंतरिक्ष में धरती को निगलने के लिए सूरज महाराज तैयार है कि धरती हो मंगल हो खाजा में इतना ग्रेविटेशन है सूर्य के अंदर
says: In space the Sun is ready to swallow the Earth and Mars, because the Sun has so much gravitational pull. He opens the cosmic story of how the outer planets hold the inner ones back.
ambiguity: 'खाजा में' is read as 'खा जाए' (so that it would eat). This is a mythic or physical image rather than an astrological rule.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no gravitational model.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति कह रहा है पीछे खींच रहा हूं अब बृहस्पति जब पीछे खींच रहा है तो सूर्य कह रहा है तुझे भी ले जाऊंगा
says: Jupiter says 'I am pulling back', and the Sun answers 'I will take you along too'. Jupiter resists the Sun's pull while the Sun threatens to swallow him as well.
ambiguity: A narrated dialogue between planets; no chart rule is stated, only the sense that Jupiter holds the Sun's pull in check.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no such story.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति की मदद कौन कर रहे हैं सारे के सारे चाकर यह शनि कह रहा है अबे मैंने पकड़ लिया पकड़ लिया बृहस्पति पकड़ लिया भाई पकड़ ले पकड़ ले जा रहा
says: Who helps Jupiter? All the servants, led by Saturn, who shouts 'I have caught him, caught Jupiter, hold on, he is going'. Saturn and the outer planets act as Jupiter's helpers against the Sun.
ambiguity: 'चाकर' (servants) is read as the outer planets (Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) in his scheme; it is not defined here.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no outer-planet story.

hindi: नहीं देवता है ये तो भगवान है तो गुरु है हमारे नहीं नहीं पकड़ लो बृहस्पति को
says: He insists Jupiter is a deity, a god and our guru, so Saturn must hold him back: 'no, no, catch Jupiter'. Jupiter is honoured as the guru whom the other planets protect.
ambiguity: Part of the narrated dialogue; 'नहीं देवता है' is the speaker answering an objection.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is Brihaspati, the guru of the gods.

hindi: खींचने का काम आप देखें बृहस्पति बड़ा है शनि छोटा है सूरज इसको नहीं पकड़ पा रहा यह बृहस्पति को पकड़ पा रहा है
says: Look at the pulling work: Jupiter is the bigger planet and Saturn the smaller, and the Sun cannot get hold of it, yet Saturn manages to hold Jupiter. A smaller planet restrains the larger one.
ambiguity: 'इसको' (this one) is unclear: it could be Saturn (the Sun cannot catch Saturn) or Jupiter. The size claim is physical (Jupiter is larger than Saturn only in a loose sense).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no such size argument.

hindi: अब इसको मदद करने के लिए कौन है इंद्र इसको पीछे और खींचने के लिए ताकि निगल ना जाए सूरज
says: To help Saturn there is Indra (Uranus), who pulls him back further so that the Sun does not swallow him. Uranus is the next helper in the chain.
ambiguity: 'इसको' is read as Saturn (the one just being discussed); 'इंद्र' is Uranus in his twelve-planet scheme.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is outside the classical scheme.

hindi: इसके लिए आपका नेप्चून नेप्चून है वरुण बहुत ज्यादा बड़ा प्लेनेट है बहुत ज्यादा बहुत ही ज्यादा और
says: For this too there is your Neptune, which is Varuna, a very big planet indeed, and it joins in as well. Neptune is the third helper, valued for its great size.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in 'और' and continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is outside the classical scheme.

hindi: एक दुम छल लगा प्लूटो कह रहा है मैं भी आया हूं मैं भी आया हूं मैं भी हेल्प करूंगा वो भी खींच रहा है साथ
says: Pluto (Yama) says 'I have come too, I will also help' and joins in pulling along with the others. Pluto is the last of the helper planets in the chain.
ambiguity: 'एक दुम छल लगा' is garbled and ignored; 'प्लूटो' is Yama in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is outside the classical scheme.

gist: Marvels at how wonderful space is and how God gave humans such a miraculous intelligence and ability.

hindi: यह शनि महाराज इसको खींच रहे पूर्ण रूप से मदद करता है बृहस्पति की
says: Saturn pulls and helps Jupiter fully. He pictures Saturn as Jupiter's complete and devoted supporter.
ambiguity: 'इसको' is read as Jupiter, the one being held back.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Saturn-serves-Jupiter story, though Saturn and Jupiter are classically neutral to each other in friendship tables.

hindi: अगर ये बृहस्पति की पूर्ण रूप से मदद ना करे सोच के चलो गुरु की सेवा में लगा हुआ है नहीं तो मंगल इसके घर आएगा फूक देगा
says: If Saturn did not fully help Jupiter, then Mars would come to Saturn's house and burn him; so think of Saturn as engaged in the guru's service. Saturn's service to Jupiter keeps Mars from attacking him.
ambiguity: 'मंगल इसके घर आएगा' may mean Mars aspecting or entering Saturn's house; not clear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts call Saturn and Mars mutual enemies, which fits the image of Mars burning Saturn.

hindi: इसलिए शनि को अपनी जिंदगी के लिए यानी आपके जीवन के सारे कष्टों को भस्म करने के लिए हनुमान काफी है
says: Remedy: to deal with Saturn, that is to burn all the troubles of your life to ash, Hanuman is enough. Hanuman worship is named as the single sufficient remedy for Saturn's sorrows.
ambiguity: 'काफी है' (enough) could be read as sufficient alone or sufficient first; he does not exclude other remedies.
classical_check: Agrees with the widely held folk remedy of Hanuman worship for Saturn; not a Parashari rule.

hindi: हनुमान क्या है ब्रह्मचारी आपको कुछ नहीं करना जस्ट ऑब्जर्व जस्ट ऑब्जर्व और भोगो
says: Hanuman is a brahmachari (celibate); you do not have to do anything, just observe, just observe, and experience what comes. The method is detached witnessing, not action.
ambiguity: 'भोगो' means experience or undergo; it can mean enjoy or suffer.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; the brahmachari link of Mars is popular teaching.

hindi: अगर आपका कोई व्यक्ति आपसे नाराज है परेशान है उसे पता मत लगने दो क्या आपको पता है कि वह नाराज है
says: Remedy: if someone close to you is angry or upset with you, do not let that person know that you know about it. Acting unaware is presented as the application of 'close your eyes' in daily life.
ambiguity: The sentence is half question and half instruction; the instruction is read as 'do not let them know you know'. This is interpersonal advice, recorded as his claim.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Example of a mother-in-law who is very angry with you: do not let her find out that you know she is angry.

hindi: वही तो जानना तो यही चाहती कि बह को पता लग जाए कि नहीं लग गया मैं नाराज हूं इतनी भोली बनी रहो पता ही नहीं 12 पर कब बीत जाएगा सेट रहो
says: The angry person actually wants you to find out that she is angry; so stay so naive that you seem not to know, and the time will pass without your noticing, and stay settled. Playing innocent starves the anger of its audience.
ambiguity: '12 पर कब बीत जाएगा' is garbled: '12' may mean twelve o'clock, the number twelve in his prarabdha-at-12 phrase, or the 12th house; read as 'it will pass without your noticing'.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: आपकी पत्नी आपसे नाराज है आपको पता है आप उसे पता मत लगने दो कि मुझे पता है और वो इसी में थक जाएगी थोड़ी देर में
says: If your wife is angry with you and you know it, do not let her know that you know, and she will tire herself out in a short while. The same pretend-not-to-know remedy is applied to the wife. This is relationship advice, recorded as his claim.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: कैसे बताऊ मैं नाराज हू आप तो भोले हो आपको तो पता ही आप तो लल्लू हो आराम से बैठे हो जिस चीज से आंखें मूंद लोगे
says: The angry wife thinks 'how can I tell him I am angry when he is so naive and a lallu, sitting comfortably'; and whatever you close your eyes to in this way loses its grip. Shutting your eyes to a thing is how you take Saturn's power out of it.
ambiguity: The last words 'जिस चीज से आंखें मूंद लोगे' are cut and the result clause is carried over to the next sentence ('आप समझिए').
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: आप समझिए हम शनि की बात लंबी क्यों कर रहे हैं यह आपका मूलाधार है शनि आपकी कुंडली में
says: Understand why the Saturn discussion is being stretched: because Saturn is the muladhara, the root foundation, of your kundli. The length is justified by Saturn's foundational role in the chart.
classical_check: Silent as worded; Saturn as the chart's karmic foundation is a modern teaching.

hindi: यह उस प्रकार है जैसे पूरे वास्तु में हम पितृ स्थान ठीक कर लेते हैं और नॉर्थ ईस्ट बृहस्पति ठीक कर लेते हैं पूरे घर के ऊपर जादू हो जाता है कई इंटरनल दोष कवर हो जाते हैं
says: It is like Vastu: when you correct the ancestors' place (pitru sthan) and the North-East, which is Jupiter's zone, magic happens over the whole house and many internal defects get covered. Fixing the key zones fixes the rest, and Saturn is to the chart what these zones are to the house.
ambiguity: He does not say which direction is the pitru sthan, nor whether pitru sthan is linked to Saturn; the comparison with Saturn is by analogy. This is a Vastu-link claim.
classical_check: Agrees that the North-East belongs to Jupiter in Vastu; the pitru-sthan claim and 'covering internal defects' are his own.

hindi: शनि अकेला अगर सेट कर लेते हो तो लाइफ के प्रारब्ध 12 पर रह जाता है
says: If you set Saturn alone right, the prarabdha of your life stays at '12'. Fixing Saturn by itself caps the fated troubles. The meaning of '12' is unclear.
ambiguity: '12 पर रह जाता है' may mean it stays limited at a fixed level, it stays in the 12th house, or the caption mis-hears another word (such as 'zero'). Low confidence on the number.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: यह जन्मपत्री कुंडली जो है इसका उद्गम शनि से ही है यह मूलाधार पर ही है
says: The birth chart itself originates from Saturn, and it sits on the muladhara. The kundli is traced to Saturn as its source.
ambiguity: 'उद्गम' (origin) is figurative; he does not mean the chart is computed from Saturn.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts derive the chart from the Ascendant and the Sun, not from Saturn.

hindi: इस मूलाधार पे प्लूटो भी है इस मूलाधार पर यूरेनस भी है नेप्चून भी है बहुत बड़ी सेना है
says: Pluto, Uranus and Neptune also sit on the same muladhara as Saturn, so the root centre holds a big army of planets. The outer planets share Saturn's seat.
ambiguity: It is a body-seat statement for the outer planets, not a house placement.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no outer planets or chakra seats.

hindi: लेकि सारे काम क्रोध लोभ मोह अहंकार ड़ विकार यही है लेकिन यही बाप है इनका
says: All the vices, lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego and the other disorders, are found here, but Saturn is the father of all of them. He gives Saturn the parentage of every vice.
ambiguity: 'ड़ विकार' is garbled; read as 'and other vikaras (disorders)'. 'यही बाप है' is read as Saturn.
classical_check: Differs from the classical split, in which Mars has anger and Venus lust; he places all with Saturn.

hindi: और यह बाप अपने सुपर बाप की सुनता है बृहस्पति बृहस्पति कौन है ज्ञान
says: Saturn, the father of the vices, listens to his own super-father, Jupiter; and Jupiter is knowledge. Knowledge governs Saturn's negative traits.
ambiguity: 'सुपर बाप' is a joking superlative; the claim is that Jupiter outranks Saturn.
classical_check: Differs from classical friendship tables, which make Saturn and Jupiter neutral; the Jupiter-over-Saturn hierarchy is his own.

hindi: इसलिए किसी ज्ञानी के पास जाकर उससे कृपा लेकर जानो आपका भाग्य
says: Remedy: go to a wise person (a jnani, Jupiter's type), take his grace, and learn about your fortune. Guidance from a knowledgeable person is the way to Saturn's fate.
ambiguity: 'जानो आपका भाग्य' means know or learn your fortune; whether this is a reading or a spiritual teaching is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: seeking a guru for Saturn's problems matches the Jupiter-controls-Saturn idea of classical remedy.

hindi: फिर कहते हैं भाग्य बदल जाता है भाग्य नहीं बदलता वह प्रारब्ध है कभी नहीं बदलेगा वह 12 पर रह जाएगा और आंखें मुदली तो गायब बिल्कुल जीरो
says: People say fortune can change, but he says fortune never changes: it is prarabdha and will stay as it is at '12'; yet if you shut your eyes it vanishes, totally zero. Fate cannot be altered, only made unfelt by not looking at it.
ambiguity: The wording is self-contradictory: the fate never changes, yet disappears on closing the eyes. '12 पर' is unclear and may mean the number twelve, twelve o'clock or the 12th house.
classical_check: Differs from classical Jyotish, which allows remedies to change results; here he says prarabdha is fixed and only the experience of it changes.

hindi: शनि कमाल की बात क्या करता है यह हमारे को प्रोटेक्शन देता है
says: The wonderful thing Saturn does is that he gives us protection. After the warnings, he names protection as Saturn's finest gift.
ambiguity: He does not say what kind of protection or in which house or condition.
classical_check: Partly agrees: strong Saturn gives endurance and security; calling it protection is his emphasis.

gist: Says planets will be taken up one at a time, a little at a time, in the course of the series.

hindi: मान लो जी शनि महाराज यहां बैठे हुए हैं कोई सी भी राशि है अभी राशि पर हम नहीं जा रहे प्लूटो खत्म करने के बाद राशि की बातों पर देखेंगे
says: Suppose Saturn sits in some house in any sign at all; he is not going into signs now and will deal with the sign-wise matters after he finishes Pluto, the last of the twelve planets. So the house-wise Saturn teaching comes first and the sign rules come later in the series.
cells_derived_method: He gives no sign rule here; sign-wise Saturn readings are explicitly postponed to after Pluto.
ambiguity: 'प्लूटो खत्म करने के बाद' fixes the order of the series; it does not say how many classes remain.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, where sign, dignity and house are read together; he is deliberately teaching house first.

hindi: ये शनि हमारा यहां बैठा है अब ये शनि की दृष्टि कहां है यहां है यानी शनि यहां भी है थोड़ा सा शनि यहां भी है थोड़ा सा और शनि यहां भी है थोड़ा सा दसवी तीसरी सातवी दसवीं
says: Where Saturn sits is one place, and his aspects fall on three more, the 3rd, 7th and 10th from him, so Saturn is also present a little in each of those three houses. He treats an aspect as a partial presence of the planet in the aspected house.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's partial presence lands on the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses from his seat, so each placement spreads him over three other houses and signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Libra in lagna Libra is also a little present in the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses, Sagittarius, Aries and Cancer, touching siblings, spouse and career.

Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) is also a little present in the 2nd, 6th and 9th houses, Gemini, Libra and Capricorn, touching family wealth, rivals and fortune.

ambiguity: The list 'दसवी तीसरी सातवी दसवीं' repeats the 10th; the 10th may be a slip or an emphasis. The sentence is read as the standard 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects.
classical_check: Agrees on Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects; the 'a little of Saturn is present there' idea is his own wording.

hindi: तो प्रारब्ध आपका शनि यहां य अटैक मारेगा तो यह हो गया मैं मेरे ऊपर यह हो गया मेरा
says: Your prarabdha through Saturn will attack at his own seat first, and that seat counts as 'me', the self, as if it were the first house. The house where Saturn sits is where the person feels the fate land on himself.
cells_derived_method: The seat house becomes the 'me' of the reading, so its topics colour how the person experiences Saturn's karma.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) makes the person feel himself through partnership, with Saturn's pressure on relationships.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) makes self-worth hang on family, speech and savings.

ambiguity: 'यह हो गया मैं मेरे ऊपर' is garbled; read as 'this counts as me, on me'. The sentence ends with 'मेरा' and continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees partly with the classical reading of a planet's house as the area it afflicts; counting the seat as 1 or 'me' follows his counting method.

hindi: तीसरा घर यह मेरा भाई है बंधु है यह मेरे कम्युनिकेशन है यह हमारा सोशल मीडिया है
says: The third house from Saturn stands for my brother, kin and relatives, my communication and my social media. Saturn's 3rd aspect therefore presses on siblings, communication and social media.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd-house topics from Saturn's seat differ with where he sits: the 3rd from lagna is the natal 3rd, the 3rd from other houses lands on other topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in lagna Libra reaches the natal 3rd, Sagittarius, so siblings and communication carry a serious, advisory, delayed tone.
Derived, not said by him: a debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) reaches the 12th house, Gemini, so sibling and communication matters drift into expense, distance or seclusion.

ambiguity: 'तीसरा घर' is the third counted from Saturn's seat, as the previous sentence implies, not necessarily the natal third. 'बंधु' means kin or friends.
classical_check: Agrees that the 3rd house holds siblings and communication; 'social media' is a modern addition.

hindi: यह मेरी पत्नी है या पति है संतान के लिए भी रिस्पांसिबल
says: The seventh from Saturn is my wife or husband, and Saturn is also responsible for children. His 7th aspect presses on the spouse, and he adds children to Saturn's responsibility.
cells_derived_method: The 7th-from-Saturn target changes with his seat, so the spouse topic shows up in a different natal house each time.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) aspects the 10th house, Cancer, so spouse and partnership weigh on career and public image.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 2nd house, Sagittarius, so spouse matters show up in family wealth and speech, with delay.

ambiguity: 'संतान के लिए भी रिस्पांसिबल' may refer to the 7th from Saturn or to Saturn in general; it is not clear which. Children are normally the 5th house.
classical_check: Agrees that the 7th is spouse; giving Saturn responsibility for children is his own, as classically Jupiter is putra karaka.

hindi: यह मेरा कार्य है
says: The tenth from Saturn is my work. His 10th aspect lands on career and action.
cells_derived_method: The house that carries 'my work' from Saturn depends on his seat: the 10th aspect lands nine houses ahead of him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Cancer in the 3rd (lagna Taurus) aspects the 12th house, Aries, so work is behind the scenes, foreign or long-houred.
Derived, not said by him: an exalted Saturn in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) aspects the 4th house, Cancer, so work is tied to the home base, property or mother.

ambiguity: 'यह' points at the board; the 10th is inferred from the sequence 3rd, 7th, 10th.
classical_check: Agrees that the 10th house is work and karma.

hindi: यह नपुंसक है
says: He says 'this is napunsak (neuter)', apparently about Saturn, right after tying Saturn to children. It repeats the neuter label for Saturn, possibly as the reason Saturn is linked to progeny matters.
ambiguity: The subject of 'यह' is not clear: Saturn as a neuter planet, or the aspected house. Very short and garbled; low confidence.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is a napumsaka (neuter) planet in the classical lists.

hindi: दसवां घर हैय काम का स्थान होता है कार्य आप काम करते हैं कार्य इसकी बात हम क्यों कर रहे हैं क्योंकि काम मनुष्य के लिए सबसे ज्यादा बड़ी और जरूरी चीज है
says: The tenth house is the place of work, the action you do, and he discusses it because work is the biggest and most necessary thing for a human being. He fixes the 10th as the house of work and gives it priority.
cells_derived_method: The kind of work the 10th shows depends on the sign on it and its lord: movable signs give self-started work, earth signs give structured work, dual signs give service work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer has Aries on the 10th, so work tends to be self-started, leadership or action-oriented.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries has Capricorn on the 10th, so work tends to be structured, administrative and long-term.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius has Virgo on the 10th, so work tends to be service, analysis, accounts or health related.

ambiguity: The opening 'दसवां घर हैय' is noisy; the claim is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: the 10th house is karma bhava, the house of work and profession.

hindi: शनि कहीं भी बैठा काम की रिस्पांसिबिलिटी तो थोड़ी सी लेगा ही लेगा
says: Wherever Saturn sits, he will take at least a little responsibility for your work. Saturn is the work karaka everywhere in the chart, not only in the 10th.
ambiguity: He does not say how Saturn reaches the work house from every placement; it may be by karaka nature rather than aspect.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karma karaka for work and profession.

hindi: अगर डायरेक्ट ही बैठ गया है तो ये ब्लाइंड कुंडली है ब्लाइंड होरोस्कोप
says: If Saturn sits directly in the 10th, he calls the chart a 'blind kundli, a blind horoscope'. The meaning is unclear, but it likely marks the native as working blindly in the dark, in line with Saturn as the blind, dark planet.
ambiguity: The caption does not name the house; it follows the 10th-house discussion so the 10th is assumed. 'Blind kundli' is not defined and could mean a chart that cannot be read, or one where karma works unseen. Low confidence.
classical_check: Silent: 'blind horoscope' is not a classical term.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति ने अपने जीवन में 10वां घर है ये शनि यहां बैठा है चाहे यहां पर इसकी दृष्टि है
says: For this person the 10th house is the work house, and Saturn is either sitting in it or aspecting it. A Saturn that sits in or looks at the 10th is the case he is examining.
ambiguity: The caption is noisy; 'यहां' is read as the 10th house.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn in or aspecting the 10th conditions career.

hindi: इसकी दृष्टि यहां से भी होगी शनि की यहां से भी यहां देखेगा यहां से बैठा भी यहां से देख रहा है यहां बैठा होता तो भी यहां देखता तीसरी होती सातवी होती
says: Saturn can reach the 10th house by aspect from other seats too: from where he sits he looks at it, and by the 3rd or the 7th aspect he would look at it as well. He counts the 3rd and 7th aspects as ways Saturn links to the 10th.
cells_derived_method: Saturn reaches the 10th house by 3rd aspect from the 8th, by 7th aspect from the 4th, and by 10th aspect from the 1st.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 8th (lagna Pisces) aspects the 10th house, Sagittarius, by its 3rd aspect, so research and hidden effort feed career.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) aspects the 10th house, Cancer, by its 7th aspect, so home base and mother tie to career.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in lagna Aquarius aspects the 10th house, Scorpio, by its 10th aspect, so a disciplined self drives an intense career.

ambiguity: The caption gives only 'तीसरी' and 'सातवी' (3rd and 7th); the 10th aspect is not named here, so the example from lagna is derived from the earlier Saturn rule. The 'यहां' words point at a board and cannot be resolved.
classical_check: Agrees on Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे अगर शनि की यहां पर कार्यक्रम चल रहा है दसवें घर से लिंक है कैसे भी दृष्टि वाइज
says: If Saturn's programme is running in the chart in this way, it is linked with the 10th house in some way, whether by placement or by aspect. Any aspect link between Saturn and the 10th counts as a link to work.
ambiguity: 'कार्यक्रम चल रहा है' is colloquial for 'the activity is on'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that aspect links count as connections in classical chart reading.

hindi: दूसरी बात आपका शनि बैठा यहां है लेकिन किन चलित में या नवांश में नवांश में भी यस नवांश भी काम करेगा
says: Second point: your Saturn may sit in one house in the rashi chart, but you must also check where it sits in the bhava chalit or in the navamsha; the navamsha too will work. Saturn's work link has to be tested in the chalit and navamsha charts as well.
cells_derived_method: A Saturn near a house boundary or in a different navamsha sign changes which house and sign carries its effect, so the same placement can read differently in each chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn late in Capricorn on the 4th (lagna Libra) may shift to the 5th house in bhava chalit, so the home-and-mother reading becomes a children-and-studies reading.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn early in Gemini on the 10th (lagna Virgo) may shift to the 9th house in bhava chalit, so the career reading becomes a fortune-and-father reading.

ambiguity: 'किन चलित' is read as 'भाव चलित' (bhava chalit); 'यस' is a filler. He does not explain how to read the navamsha result.
classical_check: Agrees: classical practice checks bhava chalit for house shifts and navamsha for strength.

hindi: वो उसकी बात एक्स्ट्रा करेंगे नवांश में भी यदि दसव भाव से एस्पेक्ट है केपी कुंडली में है निर भाग चलित में है तो शनि दसवें का काम करेगा ही हर हालत में
says: He says the Saturn-to-10th-house link must be checked beyond D1 as well: if Saturn is tied to the 10th by aspect in the Navamsha, in the KP chart or in bhava chalit, Saturn will deliver 10th-house (work, karma) results in every case. The opening words are garbled but seem to promise that this point will be extended to the Navamsha.
cells_derived_method: The 10th is work, status and public action and Saturn is its natural karaka. How the link plays out depends on the seat Saturn aspects from (1st, 4th or 8th reach the 10th) and the sign involved: in a movable sign the work result comes through initiative, in a fixed sign through slow grinding, in a dual sign through changing jobs. In D9 or KP the same test is repeated with that chart's own 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in its own sign Capricorn sits in the 10th itself, so the link is by occupation and work comes slowly but with authority and staying power.

Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Libra (exalted) in the 4th casts its 7th aspect on the 10th house Aries, so career is built through property, home ground or public service and is delayed in the early years.

Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in Scorpio in the 8th throws its 3rd aspect on the 10th house Capricorn, so career turns arrive through sudden events, research or shared resources rather than direct effort.
Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn debilitated in the lagna casts its 10th aspect on the 10th house Capricorn, so the career is self-made but pushes and stalls in turn.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled at the start (extra/extend, 'निर भाग चलित' is bhava chalit). It is not clear whether he means only aspect or also occupation of the 10th by Saturn.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of the 10th and the 3rd/7th/10th Saturn aspects are classical; repeating the test in D9, KP and bhava chalit is modern practice not found in BPHS.

hindi: और जब यह काम करता है तो 90 पर लोग लाइफ में देख लेना आप 90 पर आपके जीवन में 90 पर लोगों की लाइफ में 90 पर टाइम्स ये हुआ होगा
says: He claims that when Saturn is working through that 10th link, about 90 percent of people will find, looking back on their own life, that the pattern described next (things not happening as planned) has occurred about 90 percent of the time. The figure is rhetorical; no sample or study is offered.
ambiguity: '90 पर' is the caption for 90 percent. It is unclear whether he means 90 percent of people or 90 percent of occasions in one life.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no frequency figures for any planetary effect.

hindi: साला जो प्लान करते हैं होता ही नहीं जो सोच लिया वो होता ही नहीं जो मुह से बोल दिया
says: Core Saturn principle in his words: under an active Saturn, whatever you plan, whatever you decide in your mind and whatever you announce aloud simply does not materialise. Saturn blocks the declared intention.
cells_derived_method: The area of life where plans fail follows the house Saturn sits in or aspects (derived, not said by him); in Saturn's strong signs the plan is delayed, in a weak sign it is blocked harder.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn strong in Libra in the 7th, so the plans that fail are about partnership and marriage, and they are delayed rather than denied.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn debilitated in the 2nd, so what he announces about savings, family and speech does not come true and money plans stall sharply.

ambiguity: He does not say which house or sign; the sentence is about Saturn in general.
classical_check: Silent as worded; classical texts only say Saturn delays and obstructs the matters of the house it influences.

hindi: गुप्त शनि क्या है बंद कर लो मुंह बंद आंखें बंद गुप्त
says: He defines Saturn as the planet of secrecy (gupt): to work with Saturn, shut your mouth and shut your eyes, meaning do not announce plans and do not hover over results, stay hidden and quiet.
ambiguity: Whether this is a literal behavioural remedy or only a description of Saturn's nature is not made clear.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of secrecy and hidden things is classical (linked to the 8th and 12th); the keep-quiet instruction is his own practical advice, not in BPHS.

gist: A garbled analogy about an electron and a positron and a 'plus' starting to build; the caption does not allow the point to be recovered.

hindi: जो सोचा ही नहीं वो हो रहा है किसी व्यक्ति के लाइफ के अंदर
says: Flip side of Saturn's blocking: the things that happen in such a person's life are exactly the ones he never even thought about. Saturn delivers events unplanned and unexpected, not the ones you chase.
ambiguity: It follows the garbled electron/positron line, so it is unclear whether this is the result of staying silent or just a general Saturn effect.
classical_check: Silent; sudden unexpected events are classically Rahu or Uranus-type themes more than Saturn.

hindi: पांचवें घर से शनि का लिंक हो गया यहां से मान लो शनि की यहां से यहां दृष्टि भी हो सकती है शनि यहां बैठा भी हो सकता है
says: He sets up the case of Saturn linked to the 5th house: the link can be by Saturn's aspect falling on the 5th or by Saturn simply sitting in the 5th. Either counts as a Saturn-5th connection for the effects that follow.
cells_derived_method: Saturn reaches the 5th from the 5th itself (occupation), from the 3rd (3rd aspect) and from the 11th (7th aspect). The sign on the 5th and Saturn's dignity decide the flavour: the 5th is learning, children, romance and past merit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn sits in the 5th in Taurus, Venus's sign, so the block falls on romance and creative learning, with the slowness of an earth sign.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 3rd throws its 3rd aspect on the 5th house Aries, so study and children matters face discipline and delay but not breakage.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 11th looks at the 5th house Cancer by its 7th aspect, so learning is slowed by emotional or family pressure.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture; the actual house Saturn is drawn in cannot be recovered from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects and Saturn's occupation of the 5th are classically harmful to education, romance and children.

hindi: शनि यहां से भी 10वीं दृष्टि दे सकता है 10 नंबर की दृष्टि
says: Saturn can also link to the 5th through his special tenth-number aspect (Saturn's 10th aspect), counted from the seat he points to on the board.
cells_derived_method: Counting 10 houses from the seat inclusive, Saturn's 10th aspect lands on the 5th only from the 8th house. So the seat he indicates must be the 8th (arithmetic, not said). The 8th seat also throws Saturn's 3rd aspect on the 10th and 7th aspect on the 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 8th aspects the 5th house Libra by its 10th aspect, so learning is slow but sturdy.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn debilitated in the 8th aspects the 5th house Capricorn, a sign Saturn rules himself, so education is irregular yet the aspect itself pushes discipline.
Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn in Taurus in the 8th aspects the 5th house Aquarius, where Saturn is the 5th lord for this lagna, so the 5th is blocked and strengthened at the same time.

ambiguity: 'यहां से' points at the chart; it is not stated that the seat is the 8th, it is only what the arithmetic requires.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's 10th aspect is part of the classical special aspects (3rd, 7th, 10th).

hindi: यहां ये पांचवां घर है पढ़ाई का होता है इस व्यक्ति की पढ़ाई में एक रुकावट आएगी आंख मूंद की आएगी
says: The 5th house governs education; if Saturn is linked to it, this person's studies will certainly meet an obstruction. 'Eyes shut' means he is sure of it.
cells_derived_method: The form of the obstruction follows the sign on the 5th and Saturn's dignity: fire signs give loss of interest and impatience, earth signs a slow grind, air signs distraction, water signs emotional breaks. A strong Saturn gives delay, a weak one gives a break.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn exalted in Libra in the 5th, so studies are delayed but the subject is mastered deeply (law, ethics, systems).
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 5th, so the schooling breaks abruptly, courses are dropped and restarted.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in the Moon's sign Cancer in the 5th, so study gaps come from home and emotional matters.

classical_check: Agrees in direction: Saturn in or aspecting the 5th delays education and children in BPHS-style readings.

hindi: यहां बैठा है एक शादी में रुकावट आएगी एक काम में रुकावट आएगी एक भाई या बहन से रिश्ता खराब होएगा
says: If Saturn sits in the seat he is pointing at, three more things go wrong: a marriage is obstructed, a piece of work is obstructed, and the relationship with a brother or sister turns sour.
cells_derived_method: Which house each effect belongs to depends on the seat: marriage is 7th, work is 10th, siblings are 3rd. Saturn in the lagna hits exactly these three by its 7th, 10th and 3rd aspects. Saturn in the 8th hits the 10th (3rd aspect) and the 5th (10th aspect). Saturn in the 5th hits the 7th (3rd aspect), 11th (7th aspect) and 2nd (10th aspect).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in own sign in the lagna aspects the 3rd house Pisces (siblings), 7th house Cancer (marriage) and 10th house Libra (work), a perfect match for his list.

Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in own sign in the 8th aspects the 10th house Aries (work), 2nd house Leo and 5th house Scorpio, so work obstruction is clear while marriage and siblings are not directly aspected.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Scorpio in the 5th aspects the 7th house Capricorn (marriage), 11th house Taurus (elder siblings and gains) and 2nd house Leo.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture. The house is not stated: it could be the 5th (the topic just before), the 8th (the next lines speak of the place of death) or the lagna (whose aspects match marriage, work and siblings exactly). Cannot be settled from the caption.
classical_check: Silent on this exact list; it is consistent with Saturn's classical aspect pattern from some seats.

hindi: मरने मरने में भी रुकावट आएगी मरने भी नहीं देगा यह मृत्यु का स्थान है मरने नहीं देता
says: Saturn will even obstruct dying: he will not let the person die easily, because this is the house of death (the 8th) and Saturn in it prolongs life and drags the end out. It is a general statement, no timing or death date given.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's long-life effect is the same in every sign, but the quality of the life lived changes: strong signs give long life with steady hidden resources, weak signs give long life with repeated crises of the 8th (sudden events, delayed inheritance, obstacles in transformation).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn in own sign in the 8th, so longevity with delayed but real hidden gains.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn debilitated in the 8th, so a long life but through repeated sudden obstacles and reversals.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn exalted in Libra in the 8th, so the steadiest form: long life and stable joint or inherited resources.

ambiguity: 'यह मृत्यु का स्थान है' follows a board gesture; it is taken as the 8th house, but the caption does not say the number.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the karaka of the 8th house and of longevity, and Saturn in the 8th is classically said to give long life with hardship.

hindi: जहां बैठा है क्रूर ग्रह मार देता है सबसे क्रूर ग्रह है
says: General principle: a cruel (malefic) planet destroys the matters of the house where it sits, and Saturn is the most cruel planet of all, so the area he sits in is hit hardest.
cells_derived_method: The damaged area is whichever house Saturn sits in. Classical practice does not apply it blindly: malefics do well in 3, 6, 10, 11 and in the dusthanas they destroy the evils of that house, so the rule bites hardest in 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn debilitated in the 7th, so marriage and partnerships suffer the damage.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn in Scorpio in the 6th, so under the classical view the enemies, debts and disputes of the 6th are what gets destroyed, not the person's own matters.
Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 12th, so expenses, sleep and foreign matters are curtailed, which is often a mild result in a dusthana.

classical_check: Partly agrees: 'papa in a bhava harms its significations' is an old rule, but the texts also say malefics do well in 3, 6, 10, 11, so it is not universal.

hindi: अब यहां बैठा है पांचवा अब यहां पर क्या होगा प्रेम भी यही से होता है एक प्रेम असफल होएगा इसका
says: With Saturn sitting in the 5th house, love life suffers, since romance is also read from the 5th: at least one love affair of this person will fail.
cells_derived_method: The way romance fails follows Saturn's dignity and the 5th-house sign: strong Saturn makes romance serious and delayed, so it fails less often; debilitated or enemy-sign Saturn makes affairs flare and break suddenly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn exalted in the 5th, so romances are serious and late, with a mature partner, and failures are fewer.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn debilitated in the 5th, so impatient flare-ups and abrupt break-ups.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn in Jupiter's sign Pisces in the 5th, so romance with an idealised partner that fails through disillusion.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 5th is a classical indicator of troubled romance and delayed or limited children.

hindi: और शनि इरेगुलेरिटी देता है तीन की संख्या चलाता है यूली दो या तीन दो या तीन
says: Saturn gives irregularity, and his working number is three, usually two or three: whatever Saturn touches repeats two or three times, as gaps, restarts or repeats.
ambiguity: 'यूली' is the caption for 'usually'. Whether 'three' is a numerological claim or just an observed count is not clear.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; Indian numerology ties Saturn to 8 and Jupiter to 3, so this is his own observation.

hindi: दो या तीन अफेयर होंगे
says: For a Saturn-5th person he expects two or three love affairs, not just one.
cells_derived_method: The character of the affairs follows the sign on the 5th: air signs give quick light affairs, water signs deep and secret ones, earth signs slow and practical ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 5th, so several short, talkative affairs.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Scorpio in the 5th, so intense and secretive affairs.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn in own sign in the 5th, so fewer and more serious attachments, closer to two than three.

classical_check: Silent on the number; the classical rule only says Saturn in the 5th troubles romance.

hindi: दो या तीन कोर्स करेगा व्यक्ति पढ़ाई से संबंधित
says: The Saturn-5th person will take up two or three different courses in his education, switching or repeating streams.
cells_derived_method: The type of switching follows the sign on the 5th: fire and dual signs switch more, own-sign Saturn sticks to one technical line with a delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn in own sign in the 5th, so he persists in a technical or systems subject but changes the course once.
Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 5th, so he moves between higher-study fields such as law, philosophy and management.

classical_check: Silent on the count of courses.

hindi: दो या तीन बार फेलियर लेगा दो-तीन साल का गैप ले सकता है
says: He says the person may fail in his studies two or three times and may take a gap of two to three years in education.
cells_derived_method: Failures are more abrupt with a debilitated or fire-sign Saturn, and shorter and more careless in an air or earth sign of Mercury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn debilitated in the 5th, so repeated failures with a long gap before he returns.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 5th, so failures from careless slips in detail, with a short gap.

ambiguity: The numbers two and three are given loosely; he does not say whether they are exact.
classical_check: Silent on counts of failures or years of gap.

hindi: दो-तीन जगह इल्लीगल इलिसिट बाहर बहरीले रिलेशंस रखेगा सेक्सुअल ऑटोमेटिक होना ही है ये इसमें कोई कुछ उखाड़ ले नोबडी कैन स्टॉप इट
says: The Saturn-5th person will keep illegal or illicit outside sexual relationships in two or three places. He says this is automatic and fated, and that nobody can stop it.
cells_derived_method: The nature of the liaisons follows the sign: earth signs sensual and hidden, water signs emotional entanglements, air signs casual ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 5th, so sensual, quietly maintained liaisons.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in the Moon's sign in the 5th, so emotionally tangled outside attachments.

ambiguity: 'बहरीले' is garbled (probably 'bahari', outside). The claim is stated as fate; it is recorded as his claim, not as a verified outcome.
classical_check: Stronger than the texts: classical sources link Saturn with the 5th or 7th to delayed or unconventional relationships but give no fixed prediction.

gist: Restates that this same Saturn gives disturbance in studies, already recorded in G07-11-009.
Rhetorical question to the audience: how can this child's studies ever be good.

hindi: शनि तो पढ़ने देगा नहीं कम पढ़े कमाल हो गया यार कम पढ़े
says: Answering his own question: Saturn will not let the child study much, so the child reads very little, and he finds it remarkable that results still come on so little reading.
cells_derived_method: How little the person studies depends on the sign on the 5th: Saturn's own signs give steady minimal study, a debilitated Saturn gives dropping out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn in own sign in the 5th, so he reads little but what he reads sticks.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn debilitated in the 5th, so the child largely stops studying instead of studying little.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts only say Saturn delays or obstructs education.

hindi: फोटोग्राफिक मेमोरी देता है ये किताब खुली खच बंद
says: Saturn also gives a photographic memory here: the book is opened and shut again with a snap and the matter is already retained, which is how the child gets by with little study.
cells_derived_method: The memory style follows the 5th-house sign: Mercury's signs give quick snapshot recall, Saturn's strong sign gives deep durable memory.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 5th, so quick snapshot memory of details.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn exalted in the 5th, so deep, lasting memory with good judgement of what to keep.

ambiguity: 'खच' is a sound word (a snap of closing the book).
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury and the 5th house rule memory; Saturn is not a memory planet.

gist: Rhetorical question: now what will happen, will he pass or will he fail.
'The whole pre-living concept is with him' - the caption is unclear (maybe a past-life or pre-set pattern idea) and the point cannot be recovered.

hindi: पता नहीं यार क्या होगा पता ही नहीं ओ यार पता ही नहीं शनि गया जेब में
says: The Saturn student's attitude of 'I have no idea what will happen, I truly don't know' is presented as the sign that Saturn has gone into his pocket: once the person stops anxious planning and stops caring about the outcome, Saturn works for him instead of against him.
ambiguity: 'शनि गया जेब में' is an idiom whose meaning is only clear from the next lines (Saturn is controlled or handled); reading is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; this is psychological advice dressed as a Saturn remedy, not found in classical texts.

hindi: शनि उसको पास करा देगा चीटिंग करवा देगा पड़ोसी से
says: Saturn will get such a student through the exam anyway, even arranging that he copies from the neighbour: a pass comes by unplanned or unfair routes, not by preparation. Recorded as his claim, not as advice to cheat.
cells_derived_method: The route of the unplanned pass follows the sign on the 5th: Mercury's sign gives clever shortcuts, water signs give hidden help from others.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 5th, so the pass comes by shortcut tricks and quick improvisation.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Scorpio in the 5th, so the help is secret, from a hidden or unexpected person.

ambiguity: Context is the Saturn-in-5th student; he does not repeat the house in this line.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn is classically a delayer, so a quick pass by luck is his own observation.

gist: Joke: while the teacher checks his paper his wife phones, they have a huge quarrel, he says forget it and passes him, so the student never knows how he passed.

hindi: बहुत से ऐसे लोग आपने देखे होंगे जीवन में पढ़े नहीं लिखे नहीं गाड़ी है बंगला है शनि है हाउ
says: You must have seen many people who never studied, have no education, yet own a car and a bungalow. He credits this to Saturn: a strong Saturn can give material success without education or planning.
cells_derived_method: Material gains from Saturn flow through the 4th (home, vehicles) and the 11th (income) when Saturn sits strong there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn in own sign in the 4th, so a house and vehicles arrive with little formal education.
Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in own sign in the 11th, so large gains and a wide network come through persistence rather than degrees.

ambiguity: 'शनि है हाउ' is garbled, probably 'Saturn is the how (reason)'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the karaka of labour, land and long-term assets; 'success without education' is his observation.

hindi: इसलिए आप देखेंगे मूर्ख होना कितना जरूरी है बी स्टुपिड बी हैप्पी अगर आप मूर्ख है या आप मूर्ख बिहेव करना जानते हैं
says: Practical lesson he draws from Saturn: it pays to be, or to act, simple-minded and not over-clever ('be stupid, be happy'), because over-planning is what Saturn punishes.
ambiguity: It is life advice tied to Saturn, not a stated chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

gist: Remarks about gurus who stage drama and anger while knowing it is a play, like Krishna who 'did nothing': a spiritual aside on non-doership.

hindi: कृष्ण ने सीखा य शनि को जेब में डाला कितनी कमाल की बात है विचित्र बात है
says: He says Krishna learned this trick of acting while knowing it is only play, and by that put Saturn in his pocket. In his scheme, non-doership and detachment are the way to tame Saturn, and he finds this remarkable.
ambiguity: Whether this is a claim about Krishna's chart or a teaching story is not clear.
classical_check: Silent; mythological claim that cannot be tested from a chart.

hindi: ये चौथे घर का शनि मेरे ख्याल से चौथा शनि है राम जी का
says: He picks Saturn in the 4th house as the example and recalls that Lord Rama's chart has this 4th-house Saturn.
ambiguity: He says 'मेरे ख्याल से' (in my opinion), so he is recalling from memory.
classical_check: Agrees: the Valmiki Ramayana tradition places Saturn exalted in Libra, the 4th house from Cancer lagna, in Rama's birth chart.

gist: Asks the audience to confirm that Rama had Saturn in the 4th, gets no answer, and says he knows it was a 4th-house Saturn.

hindi: चौथा घर होता है वैभव सुख देता आनंद वनवास दिया
says: The 4th house stands for splendour, comfort and bliss, but Saturn in the 4th denied this: in Rama's life it showed as exile (vanvas) in place of the comforts of the throne.
cells_derived_method: The 4th is home, mother, vehicles, peace of mind and property. Saturn there dries up comfort in the form the sign allows: a strong sign gives status with austerity, a weak sign gives open loss of home peace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn exalted in the 4th as in Rama's chart, so rulership and fame come together with exile and denial of home comfort.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn debilitated in the 4th, so home peace breaks, property disputes and separation from the mother's side.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn in own sign in the 4th, so comfort comes late and the home is austere but stable.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 4th classically denies domestic happiness; exalted Saturn in a kendra also forms Sasa yoga (kingship), so the texts show both sides.

gist: Repeats that whatever is thought, planned or wished does not happen on earth under Saturn (already recorded in G07-11-003), now said as 'whenever you go anywhere'.

hindi: ऐसे-ऐसे लोग हैं जो रोते रहते हैं सारी जिंदगी ये बेटा कब सफल होगा बेटा क वो भजन किए जा रहे हैं कभी नहीं होगा इस जन्म में आपने शनि एक्टिवेट कर रखा है
says: Illustration of a Saturn-blocked wish: parents who weep all their life asking when their son will succeed and keep singing bhajans. He says it will never happen in this birth because Saturn has been activated; devotion does not undo the Saturn block.
ambiguity: 'बेटा क' is cut off. He does not say whether the son's matters are read from the 5th house; it is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts allow remedies and prayer to soften Saturn, so this fatalistic claim is stronger than the tradition.

hindi: उच्च का शनि था राम जी का चौथे में
says: He stresses that Rama's Saturn in the 4th was exalted (uchcha): even an exalted Saturn in the 4th brings the block and the exile, so dignity does not remove the effect.
cells_derived_method: Exaltation sign for Saturn is Libra, so exalted Saturn in the 4th occurs only with Cancer lagna. The same exalted Saturn in other houses gives different results because the house topic changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn exalted in the lagna, so the block and discipline fall on the person's own plans and body-image, with a strong, serious personality.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn exalted in the 10th, so career is slow to start but rises to a firm, long-lasting position.

ambiguity: He does not name the sign; Libra follows from 'exalted Saturn' by the standard table.
classical_check: Agrees with the Valmiki Ramayana tradition: Saturn exalted in Libra, 4th from Cancer lagna.

gist: Repeats that if you go ahead with a fixed plan and chase it, Saturn will not let that work happen (already in G07-11-003).

hindi: इसलिए आपको क्या करना है ब्लाइंड रहना है
says: Prescription for living with an active Saturn: remain 'blind', meaning do not look at, chase or push for the outcome of what you do.
ambiguity: 'Blind' is figurative: it means not fixating, not literal blindness.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural remedy of his own.

hindi: जैसे ही अहंकार किया मींस पता लग गया बृहस्पति है अहंकार आते ही वो शनि को रौन देगा और शनि खत्म जॉब छूट गई पैसा खत्म
says: Warning: the moment ego arises, which he reads as Jupiter's presence, it overrides or provokes Saturn and the gains Saturn had given collapse: job lost, money finished. A Saturn-favoured person must keep pride away.
ambiguity: 'रौन देगा' is garbled (maybe 'trample'); 'पता लग गया बृहस्पति है' may mean Jupiter is active or that Jupiter stands for the ego. The reading is inferred.
classical_check: Differs: ego is classically the Sun's matter, and Jupiter is neutral to Saturn in the natural-relations table, so this Jupiter-versus-Saturn clash is his own.

hindi: लॉटरी गें सारे शनि के पास है
says: Lottery and similar chance gains (the next word 'गें' is garbled, maybe games or gains) are all in Saturn's keeping. Recorded as a karaka claim only; it is not advice to gamble or invest.
ambiguity: 'गें' is unclear.
classical_check: Differs: classically sudden or speculative gains are ruled by Rahu and the 5th and 8th houses; Saturn gives slow gains.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति को तुक्के से जॉब लगती है बिना तैयारी के जाए बिना पढ़े लिखे जाए
says: Such a Saturn-type person lands a job by sheer luck (tukka), even when he goes for the interview or exam without preparation and without study.
cells_derived_method: A job by luck is expected when Saturn links the houses of service and work (6th, 10th). The sign sets how smooth the luck is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in own sign in the 6th, so a service job comes through an unplanned, persistent route.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in own sign in the 10th, so the post arrives easily, without much preparation, and lasts.

ambiguity: He does not tie this to a specific house; the 6th and 10th links are derived.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not promise jobs without effort.

hindi: शादी होगी यहां सातवां है चॉइस तो होती नहीं
says: With Saturn tied to the 7th house, the marriage does take place, but choice does not: the match will not be one the person selected.
cells_derived_method: Saturn on the 7th gives a duty-type or arranged marriage whose tone follows the sign: strong sign gives a steady mature partner, weak sign gives an imposed and strained partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn exalted in the 7th, so the marriage is steady but with a mature or arranged partner rather than a chosen one.
Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn debilitated in the 7th, so a partner imposed by circumstances and a strained marriage.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in own sign in the 7th, so a delayed, duty-bound marriage to a serious partner.

ambiguity: 'यहां सातवां है' does not say whether Saturn sits in or aspects the 7th; both are treated alike in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Saturn on the 7th delays marriage and gives an older or reserved partner; 'no choice at all' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: चॉइस की लड़की नहीं मिलेगी पूरे जन्म लड़का नहीं मिलेगा चॉइस का पूरे जन्म मरते मर जाओ
says: He pushes it to the extreme: the person, boy or girl, will not get a partner of his or her choice in the whole life, 'die trying'. Saturn's grip on the 7th denies the ideal partner altogether.
cells_derived_method: The kind of partner who replaces the dream partner follows the sign on the 7th: water signs give an emotionally needy or older partner, fire and dual signs give a partner from a different background or place.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in the Moon's sign in the 7th, so the partner is emotionally needy or older and the family overrides the person's choice.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 7th, so the partner comes from a different culture, religion or distant place and is not the one wanted.

ambiguity: The last word 'जाओ' is in the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Stronger than the texts, which only speak of delay and difficulty in marriage.

gist: Joke: 'free-fund astrology is running here', meaning he is giving this for free.

Anecdote with an invented figure (3,600 or 36,000 girls) who refuse to marry unless the boy is of their choice; he mimics them in a thin voice and answers 'sister, where do I bring one of your choice'.

hindi: शनि की दृष्टि है या बैठा यहां तुझे चॉइस का मिलेगा ही नहीं
says: He treats Saturn aspecting the 7th and Saturn sitting in the 7th as equivalent: either way the person will simply not get a spouse of choice.
cells_derived_method: Saturn reaches the 7th from the 7th itself, from the 1st (7th aspect), from the 5th (3rd aspect) and from the 10th (10th aspect). The seat decides which side of life carries the pressure: lagna adds personal seriousness, 5th adds romance getting overridden, 10th adds career pressure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in own sign in the lagna aspects the 7th house Cancer by its 7th aspect, so the person's own seriousness narrows the choice and marriage is sober and late.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn exalted in the 5th aspects the 7th house Sagittarius by its 3rd aspect, so a love choice is overridden and the spouse comes from a different background.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn debilitated in the 10th aspects the 7th house Capricorn by its 10th aspect, so career pressure crowds out the search and circumstances pick the partner.

classical_check: Differs in strength: classically an aspect of Saturn is milder than occupation, but he applies the same result to both.

gist: The mimicked girl swears she will not marry without a boy of choice, will grow old and die rather than accept one.

hindi: फिर शनि क्या करता है सेक्स लाइफ पर इंपैक्ट डालता है
says: Saturn, tied to the 7th, also hits the marital sex life, which is a part of how he spoils a marriage. Only the area is named, no medical statement is made.
cells_derived_method: The tone of the strain follows the sign on the 7th: water and secretive signs give guarded or cold intimacy, air signs give distance and mismatched timing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in Scorpio in the 7th, so intimacy is intense but guarded, with coldness or secrecy in the bond.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 7th, so intimacy is cut down by distance, talk instead of touch, and mismatched timing.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the 7th or the 8th is meant for sex life; he is on the 7th in this passage.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Saturn on the 7th is classically cold in marital pleasure; the 7th is read for sex and marriage.

hindi: तो ऐसे लड़के से शादी कराता है जो पहले से शादी शुदा हो
says: Saturn on the 7th can marry the woman to a man who is already married, so the spouse arrives with a previous commitment.
cells_derived_method: How the earlier commitment shows follows the 7th-house sign: Jupiter's sign gives an older, family-bound spouse, Sun's sign a spouse of status with an existing household.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 7th, so an older spouse with earlier family ties.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in the Sun's sign in the 7th, so a spouse of status who already has a settled household or a past marriage, with ego friction.

ambiguity: He speaks of a woman marrying a boy who is already married; the same logic for a man is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of an older or previously married spouse under Saturn on the 7th, not this exact claim.

hindi: तो इलीगल रिलेशन सारे शनि के पास है
says: All illegal or unsanctioned relationships fall under Saturn's authority, which is why a Saturn-hit 7th leads to such matches. Recorded as a significator claim.
classical_check: Stronger than the texts: classical karakas for illicit relations are Venus, Rahu and the 7th and 12th houses, with Saturn playing a supporting part.

gist: Joke: learn to 'set' Saturn and your illegal relations will run without ever being caught, but he will not teach it and it would cost a separate fee.

hindi: शनका क्या चंद्रमा और शनि का कोई रिश्ता नहीं है
says: Turning to the Moon and Saturn: he says the two have no relationship with each other, no common ground, because their natures do not mix.
ambiguity: 'शनका क्या' is a garbled lead-in (what about Saturn).
classical_check: Partly differs: in BPHS the Moon is neutral to Saturn but Saturn treats the Moon as an enemy, so there is a relation, a one-sided hostile one.

hindi: चंद्रमा जल है शनि तेल है
says: His element picture: the Moon is water and Saturn is oil, and oil and water do not mix, which is why he says there is no relation between them.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon as watery is common, but Saturn's classical element is air (Mars fire, Mercury earth, Jupiter ether, Venus water, Saturn air), though Saturn does rule oils such as sesame oil.

hindi: मंगल आग है सूर्य उसकी अग्नि है बुध उसके ऊपर की हवा है यह सारे के सारे तत्व है
says: Continuing the oil picture: Mars is fire, the Sun is the flame of it, and Mercury is the air above it; he says all of these are the elements (tattva), set against Moon as water and Saturn as oil.
ambiguity: 'उसकी अग्नि' could mean the Sun is Mars's fire or the flame of the oil lamp; the lamp image is inferred.
classical_check: Partly differs: Mars and Sun as fire agree with the texts, but BPHS gives Mercury as earth, not air.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा जो है वह विचारों को लेकर आता है और खड़ चेंज करता है
says: The Moon brings thoughts, meaning the mind, and changes them fast; the garbled word before 'change' is probably 'quickly'.
ambiguity: 'खड़ चेंज' is garbled (likely 'fatafat', quickly).
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the karaka of the mind (manas) and is the fastest and most changeable planet.

hindi: हर ढाई दिन में चंद्रमा का विचार बदलता है राशि बदलती है
says: The Moon's thinking changes about every two and a half days because its sign changes; the sign change is the marker of the mood change. In fact the Moon takes about 2.25 days per sign.
classical_check: Agrees closely: the Moon spends about 2.25 days in a sign; he rounds to 2.5.

hindi: हर ढाई साल में शनि की बदलती है
says: Saturn's sign changes about every two and a half years, so his influence shifts very slowly, in contrast with the Moon. In fact Saturn stays about 2.4 to 2.5 years per sign.
ambiguity: The word 'राशि' is missing in the caption and is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's sidereal period is about 29.5 years, so about 2.46 years per sign.

hindi: जैसे अमावस्या होती है अधेरा होता है उस टाम शनि का प्रकोप ज्यादा होता है
says: Saturn's affliction is stronger at new moon (amavasya), when it is dark, because he is a planet of darkness.
ambiguity: It is not stated whether he means the day of amavasya in general or a person born at a new moon.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is strong at night in Shadbala (natonnata bala), but a link to amavasya itself is not a classical rule.

gist: Restates that when it is the dark new moon, Saturn takes power (same point as G07-11-059).

hindi: इसीलिए शाम के समय जितने लोग नाइट लाइफ में लाजवाब जिंदगी करते हैं उनके शनि अच्छे होते हैं
says: People who flourish in night life from the evening onward are the ones with good Saturns; he reasons from Saturn's power in darkness.
ambiguity: 'अच्छे' could mean well-placed or just active; no dignity test is given.
classical_check: Indirectly agrees: Saturn is a night-strong planet and rules nocturnal work; the night-life inference is his own.

gist: Sets up the contrast: grandfather, swamis and mothers who tell people to get up at 4 in the morning (he says he says it with ears held, meaning respectfully).

hindi: अरे कहां से उठे शनि देव है उसका वह सारी रात में ही कमाए वह सारी रात में ही सफल होगा उसकी नाइट लाइफ ही चलेगी
says: A person whose planet is Saturn cannot make himself rise early: he earns and succeeds only through the night, and it is his night life that runs.
ambiguity: 'शनि देव है उसका' says Saturn is his, without giving a chart test such as lagna lord or dasha.
classical_check: Silent as worded; consistent with Saturn's classical night strength and rule over night-shift and labour work.

hindi: तभी उठेगा जब तक वो दारू नहीं पिएगा उसकी लाइफ में सफलता नहीं होगी
says: He claims such a Saturn person will get going only after drinking liquor, and has no success until he does. Recorded as his claim; it is not a recommendation to drink.
ambiguity: The wording mixes two readings: he will rise only when he has drunk, and there is no success until he drinks.
classical_check: Silent on this claim; later texts connect Saturn and Rahu with intoxicants but not with success depending on them.

hindi: जिनके शनि एक्टिवेटेड है यहां से जिसका शनि यहां पड़ा हुआ है अगर पड़ा है और इंपैक्ट दे रहा है अपने बेड बॉक्स में दारू की बोतल रखो पत्नी से सेक्सुअल लाइफ अच्छी हो जाएगी
says: Remedy: for a person whose Saturn is active and impacting the marriage area (he points at the chart, apparently the 7th), keep a bottle of liquor in the bed box (under-bed storage); he says the sexual life with the wife will then become good. A placement, not advice to drink.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture and the house is not named; the 7th is inferred from the wife and sex-life context.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy. Classical Saturn remedies are about oil, service and fasting, not liquor.

hindi: अदर वाइज सवाल ही पैदा नहीं होता पति बाहर भागेगा या पत्नी बाहर भागेगी अब
says: Without that remedy there is no chance of a good marital life: the husband or the wife will stray and run outside the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Who strays follows the sign on the 7th and its nature: earth signs give a sensual, practical drift, mutable signs give a drift through talk and mismatch.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 7th, so the straying is sensual and quietly kept.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 7th, so the drift comes from criticism, distance and mismatch of habits.

ambiguity: The trailing 'अब' starts the next sentence in the following chunk.
classical_check: Stronger than the texts, which only speak of strain in marriage.

gist: Repeats the question 'so what to do' and the answer 'liquor is needed' for the Saturn-hit marriage, already recorded as a remedy in the previous slice.
Voices a common complaint of girls: 'my husband drinks'.

hindi: व बहन वो शराब पी के ही तेरे साथ फिजिकल रिलेशन करेगा बच्चे पैदा नहीं होंगे नहीं तो
says: Replying to the complaining wife: with this Saturn-hit marriage the husband will have physical relations with you only after drinking, and otherwise children will not be born. He treats the drinking as unavoidable for intimacy and conception. Recorded as his claim only, not as advice and not as a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: He gives no sign variation. Derived: the habit takes its tone from the 7th-house sign, a fixed routine in Saturn's own sign and a secretive pattern in a water sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in own sign in the 7th, so the spouse's drinking is a settled routine and intimacy depends on that routine rather than on mood.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in Scorpio in the 7th, so the habit is private and intense and intimacy is guarded.

ambiguity: Saturn and the 7th are carried over from the previous slice; this line does not name them. The sentence breaks off at 'नहीं तो'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not connect Saturn in the 7th with this specific claim.

gist: A garbled fragment after 'otherwise' ('श हैमा नहीं'); the sense cannot be recovered.

hindi: शनि डाउन कभी नहीं होता चंद्रमा शनि को कभी खत्म नहीं कर सकता पानी तेल को कभी नहीं कर सकता किसी हालत में भी
