says: Saturn never 'goes down' (is never cancelled or weakened): the Moon can never finish Saturn, just as water can never finish oil, under any condition. So a Moon influence does not cancel Saturn's effect.
ambiguity: 'डाउन' could mean debilitated (neecha) or just 'put down'; the oil and water image supports the second meaning.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts let the Moon's conjunction or aspect modify Saturn (Moon-Saturn combinations) and Saturn can be debilitated in Aries, so 'never' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: यह तो समझ लो शनि बहुत पावरफुल है
says: A plain assertion that Saturn is very powerful, the point he wants understood before the next explanation of karma.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is called the great giver of karmic results (karmaphala data).

gist: Lead-in: 'but understand all the prarabdha karma, this is a lovely point', introducing the box image.

hindi: शनि एक बक्सा है यहां पर बैठा है हिप बोन में
says: Saturn is pictured as a box (chest) that sits in the body at the hip bone, the base of the body.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is a body gesture; the hip bone is what he names. The link to the muladhara comes in a later line.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the karaka of bones and the lower limbs; the hip-bone seat and the box image are his own.

hindi: इस बक्से में पूर्व जन्म के डीएनए की सारी मेमरी है सारे कर्म है
says: The Saturn box holds the whole memory of the past-life DNA and all the karmas, that is the stored prarabdha that plays out in this life.
ambiguity: 'DNA' is used as a figure for inherited past-life impressions.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is the karaka of karma and prarabdha; the DNA wording is modern.

hindi: चंदा मामा यहां से ऊपर से लाता है सोच और खच से धरती पर नीचे हमारी धरती जो है मूलाधार वहां जाकर टक्कर मारता है
says: The Moon (Chanda Mama) picks up a thought from above and drops it, with a snap, down to the 'earth' below, which is our muladhara (root) region, where it strikes the Saturn box.
ambiguity: 'खच' is a sound word for a snap.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon as the mind is classical; the muladhara as 'earth' is yogic, and the thought-to-karma mechanism is his own model.

hindi: कौन सा विचार आया शनि उससे झंकृत हो रहा वो वाला वो वाला पौधा लग जाता है और व कर्मन हो गया
says: Whichever thought arrives, Saturn resonates with it, and the matching stored seed is planted as a sapling, which becomes karma (action and consequence).
ambiguity: 'कर्मन' is garbled and is read as karma.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe this mechanism.

hindi: और फिर वो चीजें होनी शुरू हो जाती है पर वो कितने टाइम होती है ढाई साल शनि की ढैया ढैया
says: After the seed sprouts, the events begin to happen, and he asks for how long: about two and a half years, which he calls Saturn's dhaiya.
ambiguity: He uses 'dhaiya' for any 2.5-year Saturn spell.
classical_check: Differs in terminology: dhaiya normally means Saturn in the 4th or 8th from the Moon; the 2.5-year length per sign is right.

gist: Wordplay: dhaiya and 'daiya re daiya' (oh my god) sound like a mixed word, so you will cry 'daiya re daiya'.
Opens the topic: think about Saturn's dhaiya, and what is its story (the first words are garbled).

hindi: शनि की ढैया का मतलब है कि आपका शनि ढाई साल यहां चलेगा ढाई साल यहां चलेगा और ढाई साल यहां
says: He explains Saturn's 'dhaiya' as Saturn running two and a half years in one place, then two and a half in the next, then two and a half in a third, that is three consecutive signs and about seven and a half years in all.
ambiguity: He uses 'dhaiya' for what is usually called Sade Sati (three signs); the words 'यहां' are board gestures.
classical_check: Differs in naming: three consecutive 2.5-year stays around the Moon sign are Sade Sati in the texts, while Dhaiya is a single 2.5-year stay in the 4th or 8th from the Moon.

hindi: यह ढाई नहीं होता लगभग 29 साल के आसपास पूरी धरती का च अंतरिक्ष में चक्कर मार लेता है 29 से 30 साल में सूर्य का
says: Correcting himself: the stay is not exactly two and a half years, because Saturn takes about 29 to 30 years to go once around the whole sky and around the Sun.
ambiguity: The words 'धरती का च' are garbled (probably the whole circle of the zodiac).
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn's sidereal period is about 29.5 years.

hindi: तो 30 साल मोटे तौर पर ढाई साल बोलते हैं एक राशि 12 ढाई 30
says: Treating the cycle as roughly thirty years, a sign is called two and a half years because twelve signs times two and a half make thirty. The real figure is slightly less, about 2.46 years per sign.
classical_check: Agrees as an approximation: 29.5 years divided by 12 is about 2.46 years.

hindi: तो ये तीन में जब शनि है यानी ये वाली राशि आपकी जन्म राशि आपकी ये वाली है राशि
says: The trouble window is the set of three signs centred on your birth sign: when Saturn is in any of these three, the period is on, with the birth sign as the middle one.
cells_derived_method: Counted from the birth sign, the window is the sign before, the birth sign and the sign after. Which houses of the lagna chart it presses on depends on where the birth sign sits in the chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Libra in the 10th, lagna Capricorn, so the window is Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, which are the 9th, 10th and 11th houses; pressure falls on luck, career and gains in turn.
Derived: natal Moon in Scorpio in the 4th, lagna Leo, so the window is Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, the 3rd, 4th and 5th houses: effort, then home, then children and studies.
Derived: natal Moon in Gemini in the 1st, lagna Gemini, so the window is Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, the 12th, 1st and 2nd houses: losses and sleep, then the self, then money and family.

ambiguity: He says 'birth sign' without saying it is the Moon's sign; classical practice uses the Moon sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Sade Sati is Saturn in the 12th, 1st and 2nd signs from the natal Moon.

hindi: अब आपकी राशि में यहां एक नंबर लिखा है दो लिखा है तीन लिखा है चार लिखा है जो भी आपका लिखा है वो आपकी राशि है जन्म की
says: How to find your birth sign: in the chart the box has a sign number written in it, 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on, and whichever number is written for you is your birth sign. Numbers run Aries 1 to Pisces 12.
ambiguity: He says 'birth sign' (janma rashi, normally the Moon's sign), but the number written in the chart's first box is the lagna sign; the caption does not say which box he points at.
classical_check: Differs if he means the lagna: janma rashi is the sign of the Moon, not the lagna number.

hindi: अब उस राशि से एक पिछला और उस राशि से एक अगला शनि आ गया
says: Saturn counts as 'arrived' when he is in the birth sign, in the sign just before it, or in the sign just after it: the three-sign window, which is the 12th, 1st and 2nd from the birth sign.
classical_check: Agrees: this is the Sade Sati window.

hindi: शनि आया है मींस दुख
says: When Saturn arrives in the window around the birth sign, it means sorrow (dukh).
cells_derived_method: The area the sorrow comes through depends on which houses of the lagna chart the window covers, which is set by where the birth sign sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Pisces in the 6th, lagna Libra, so the window covers Aquarius, Pisces, Aries (5th, 6th, 7th) and the sorrow arrives through children and studies, then debts and disputes, then marriage.
Derived: natal Moon in Leo in the 12th, lagna Virgo, so the window covers Cancer, Leo, Virgo (11th, 12th, 1st) and the sorrow comes through gains, then expenses and losses, then the self.

classical_check: Agrees: Sade Sati is classically a period of hardship.

hindi: राहु आया मींस बेबसी
says: When Rahu comes over the birth-sign window, it means helplessness (bebasi): the person feels unable to act.
cells_derived_method: The area of helplessness follows the house the birth sign occupies in the lagna chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Aquarius in the 8th, lagna Cancer, so Rahu over this sign brings helplessness around sudden events, shared money and hidden matters.
Derived: natal Moon in Libra in the 3rd, lagna Leo, so Rahu over this sign brings helplessness in effort, communication and dealings with siblings.

ambiguity: It is not stated whether it is only the birth sign or the three-sign window for Rahu.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu's transit over the Moon is classically confusing and unsettling; 'helplessness' is his word.

hindi: केतु आया मींस समझ ही नहीं आ रहा
says: When Ketu comes over the birth sign, it means nothing makes sense: the person cannot understand what is happening.
cells_derived_method: The confusion falls on the house the birth sign occupies in the lagna chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Pisces in the 12th, lagna Aries, so Ketu over this sign brings confusion about expenses, sleep, foreign matters and the spiritual path.
Derived: natal Moon in Aries in the 9th, lagna Leo, so Ketu over this sign brings confusion about belief, the guru, the father and luck.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is the planet of detachment and confusion; the window logic is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति आया मींस आराम से बैठो ज्ञान से काम होंगे
says: When Jupiter comes over the birth sign, sit back at ease: work will get done through knowledge and wisdom, not through struggle.
cells_derived_method: The area where work gets done through knowledge follows the house the birth sign occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo, so with Jupiter over it, study, children and creative work go ahead through counsel and learning.
Derived: natal Moon in Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini, so with Jupiter over it, money and family matters move through guidance and sound advice.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's transit over the Moon is classically favourable.

hindi: बुद्ध आया मींस वाणी से काम होंगे बोल बोल के होंगे बुद्धि से होगा अपने आप चपलता चंचलता से सीख जाओगे आप
says: When Mercury ('Buddh') comes over the birth sign, work gets done through speech: by talking things through, through intellect, and you will pick things up by nimbleness and restlessness.
cells_derived_method: The area helped by speech follows the house the birth sign occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Gemini in the 3rd, lagna Aries, so with Mercury over it, effort, writing and negotiation succeed by talking.
Derived: natal Moon in Virgo in the 11th, lagna Scorpio, so with Mercury over it, gains and networks come through speech and quick skill-learning.

ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is the caption for Budh, Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Mercury is the karaka of speech and intellect.

hindi: मन चंद्रमा आया मीन आशीर्वाद से काम
says: When the Moon (the mind) comes over the birth sign, work gets done through blessings: the goodwill of elders and others carries the matter.
cells_derived_method: The area carried by blessings follows the house the birth sign occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in own sign Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries, so the mother's and elders' blessings carry matters of home and property.
Derived: natal Moon in Aries in the 10th, lagna Cancer, so the goodwill of seniors and the public carries career matters.

ambiguity: The sentence ends in the next caption chunk ('होंगे'). The Moon crosses a sign in about 2.25 days, so this is a very short effect.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon's transit over the birth sign is classically mildly favourable; the 'blessings' reading is his.

hindi: मंगल आया मींस पराक्रम मेहनत जोर लगा के हिम्मत मारूंगा मैं काम होक रहेंगे कैसे नहीं होंगे
says: When Mars comes over the birth sign it means valour (parakram): hard work, putting your full force in, and the mood 'I will push it through, how can the work not get done'.
cells_derived_method: The area pushed through by effort follows the house the birth sign occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: natal Moon in Aries in the 3rd, lagna Aquarius, so with Mars over it, courage, short journeys and projects with siblings or team are driven through by effort.
Derived: natal Moon in Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo, so with Mars over it, effort wins over competition, debts and daily work.

ambiguity: 'होक' is garbled and is read as 'हो के'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Mars is the karaka of courage and effort.

gist: Summary line: all these are the different programmes of the different planets, recapping the planet-by-planet list just given.

hindi: शनि की ढैया के दौरान आपको आंखें मूंदना सीखना है जितना संघर्ष करोगे उतनी दिक्कत होगी
says: During Saturn's dhaiya the lesson is to learn to shut your eyes, meaning stop resisting and stop watching, because the more you struggle, the more trouble you will get.
ambiguity: 'Shut your eyes' is figurative for non-resistance, not literal.
classical_check: Silent: classical advice for Sade Sati is patience, service and mantra, not non-struggle.

hindi: जहां शनि बैठा होता व्यक्ति उसके साथ नहीं रहता
says: Wherever Saturn sits in the chart, the person does not stay with it: he gets separated from the matters of that house.
cells_derived_method: The separation takes the form the house gives it: distance from siblings in the 3rd, living away from home or abroad in the 12th, and so on through the houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 3rd, so he lives apart from brothers and sisters and keeps contact only from a distance.
Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 12th, so he stays away from his own bed and home and lives elsewhere or abroad.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn in a house harms its significations by separation, but classical texts exempt the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th.

hindi: जिसका शनि कुंडली के यहां बैठा ये पिता का स्थान होता है यह माता का यहां बैठा है व्यक्ति मां से दूर रहेगा यह पिता से दूर रहेगा
says: Saturn sitting in the mother's house (taken as the 4th) keeps the person away from his mother, and Saturn in the father's house keeps him away from his father.
cells_derived_method: How the distance shows depends on the sign: a strong Saturn gives a dutiful but far-off bond, a weak one gives a break.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn in own sign in the 4th, so he lives away from his mother but keeps a dutiful bond.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn exalted in the 4th, so a long separation from the mother and the home, as in Rama's exile.
Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in own sign in the 9th, so the father is far away or reserved and his support comes late.

ambiguity: He points without numbering. The mother's place is the 4th in most texts. The father's place is the 9th in BPHS but some schools use the 10th, and the caption names the father twice, so the house he means is not certain.
classical_check: Agrees on the 4th for the mother; the father's house differs between the 9th (BPHS) and the 10th (some schools).

hindi: यहां बैठा है पढ़ाई से दूर रहेगा
says: Saturn sitting in the house of studies (the 5th) keeps the person away from education.
cells_derived_method: The reason for staying away follows the sign: a fire sign gives pride or boredom, Saturn's own sign gives a technical, non-academic path.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in the Sun's sign in the 5th, so he avoids formal study out of pride or restlessness.
Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn in own sign in the 5th, so he stays away from conventional schooling but follows a technical or systems-based path.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture; the 5th is inferred from 'पढ़ाई'.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 5th is classically bad for education.

hindi: यह शत्रु अपने आप ही बनाएगा अपने आप ही मर जाएंगे
says: Saturn in the house of enemies (the 6th): the person makes his enemies on his own, and they die away or fade out by themselves.
cells_derived_method: The rivals' nature follows the sign: Saturn's own sign gives rivals worn down by time, an air sign gives rivalry through words and paperwork.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in own sign in the 6th, so rivals and disputes are dissolved by time without his fighting.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 6th, so enemies arise through talk and paperwork and wear themselves out.

ambiguity: 'मर जाएंगे' may be literal or figurative (they fade away).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn in the 6th is classically good for defeating enemies; 'making enemies on his own' is his addition.

hindi: पत्नी से दूर रहेगा
says: Saturn in the house of the wife (the 7th) keeps the person away from the spouse: the couple live apart or are emotionally distant.
cells_derived_method: The kind of distance follows the sign: a strong sign gives a dutiful, far-off marriage, a Moon sign gives emotional distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn exalted in the 7th, so the marriage lasts but with distance and duty rather than warmth.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in the Moon's sign in the 7th, so emotional distance and a spouse who is cool or older.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture; the 7th is inferred from 'पत्नी'.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 7th classically delays marriage and cools it.

hindi: मृत्यु से दूर मृत्यु आएगी बारबार साला मरेगा ही नहीं
says: Saturn in the house of death (the 8th) keeps the person far from death: death-like scares come again and again but he does not die. This is a general claim, with no date or medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The kind of scare follows the sign: a fixed water sign gives crises of transformation, a dual water sign gives hidden or spiritual crises.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in Scorpio in the 8th, so repeated brushes with crisis and transformation, each survived.
Derived: lagna Leo, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 8th, so crises of a hidden or spiritual kind and a long life.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 8th is classically said to give long life.

hindi: यह काम काम से दूर रहेगा ऑफिस में बैठता ही नहीं पता नहीं कहां से कमा रहा है
says: Saturn in the house of work (the 10th): the person stays away from conventional work, does not sit in an office, and nobody knows where his income comes from.
cells_derived_method: The unconventional income follows the sign: an air sign gives a network or technical income, a fire sign gives a risky, one-off earning.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Saturn in own sign in the 10th, so work through networks, systems or consulting with no fixed office.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn debilitated in the 10th, so income is irregular and comes in lumps from unusual sources.

ambiguity: 'यह काम' is a board gesture for the 10th.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn in the 10th is good for career; here it is read as detachment from conventional work.

hindi: सारे प्रॉपर्टी डीलर कमीशन एजेंट शनी है
says: Property dealers and commission agents are all Saturn types: Saturn is the karaka of that middleman, property trade.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is a karaka of land and property with Mars, but commission and brokerage work is more Mercury's.

gist: Mimicked dialogue of the Saturn dealer: asked what he is doing he says 'very busy', yet he sits idle in his office for 25 days a month doing nothing.

hindi: एक डील करता है महीने की वो चार पांच पेटी कमा ली हो गया काम खत्म पैसे नहीं है फूक दो आ गए पता नहीं कहां से आ पता नहीं
says: The Saturn dealer does one deal a month and earns four or five 'peti' (dealer slang for a lakh rupees each), calls the work done, spends it freely, and more arrives from he knows not where. This lumpy, unplanned income is his picture of Saturn money. It is not advice.
ambiguity: 'पेटी' as one lakh is slang; the amount is approximate.
classical_check: Silent; this is an observation of Saturn-type income, not a classical rule.

hindi: तीसरा नेत्र का बौन होता है पता नहीं जब परमात्मा पर छोड़ दो पता नहीं
says: The 'I don't know' state, when you leave everything to the Supreme, is what he calls the boon (or base) of the third eye.
ambiguity: 'बौन' could be 'boon' (वरदान) or 'bone/base'; boon is inferred from the surrender context.
classical_check: Silent: the third eye is yogic, not part of classical Jyotish.

gist: Rhetorical question: so where is the key to switching on the third eye.

hindi: तीसरे नेत्र में सूर्य समझ लो सूर्य देता है प्रकाश
says: Take the Sun to be the third eye: the Sun gives the light.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun as light and soul is classical; the third-eye link is yogic.

hindi: शनि हाथ जोड़ के खड़ा होता है पिताजी आ गए यह कब होता है जब तीसरा नेत्र ऑन हो
says: When the third eye (the Sun) is switched on, Saturn stands with folded hands saying 'father has come': the Sun's light makes Saturn submit, which is the state in which Saturn's grip eases.
ambiguity: It is not stated what, in a chart, 'third eye on' means.
classical_check: Partly differs: Saturn is mythologically the Sun's son, but the two are natural enemies in the astrological relations table; the submission claim is his.

hindi: यानी जीवन के सारे कष्ट सारे प्रारब्ध सारा भाग्य बदलने की जो ड्रामेबाजी की बात है वो सारी की सारी आपके शनि के कृपा इलेक्ट्रॉन लेने इलेक्ट्रॉन का पॉजिटन बनने से होगा
says: All the talk about changing the sufferings, prarabdha and fortune of life happens only through Saturn's grace: an electron taking up an electron and turning into a positron, that is a negative charge turned positive. This probably explains the garbled electron and positron line in the earlier slice.
ambiguity: 'इलेक्ट्रॉन लेने' is garbled; the physics image is only an analogy.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn's grace softening prarabdha is a traditional idea; the particle analogy is his own.

gist: Lead-in: so where is Saturn sitting, introducing the house-by-house list that follows.

hindi: यहां बैठा है बड़े भाई से दूर रहेगा
says: Saturn sitting in the house of the elder brother (the 11th) keeps the person away from his elder brother.
cells_derived_method: The distance follows the sign: an earth sign gives a steady but far-off relation, a Jupiter sign gives distance from mentors and older friends too.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 11th, so the elder brother is distant but gains stay steady.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 11th, so distance from the elder brother, and from mentors and older friends.

ambiguity: 'बड़े भाई' points to the 11th by the classical rule; he does not give the number.
classical_check: Agrees: the 11th house is the elder brother in classical texts.

hindi: यहां बैठा है धन से दूर
says: Saturn sitting in the house of wealth (the 2nd) keeps the person away from money: savings do not accumulate.
cells_derived_method: How money stays away follows the sign: Saturn's own sign gives slow, strict saving, a water sign gives money drained by family needs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn in own sign in the 2nd, so savings come slowly and with strict discipline.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn in the Moon's sign in the 2nd, so money is drained by family needs and emotional spending.

ambiguity: The 2nd is inferred from 'धन'; he does not say the number.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 2nd is classically hard on wealth and speech.

hindi: अब यहां शनि बैठा है किसी का या यहां दृष्टि है यह धन का हिसाब किताब है प्रेम का है नौकर का है चाकर का है
says: For Saturn sitting in, or aspecting, this house, he says the matter is one of accounts: the accounts of money, of love, and of servants and staff. Saturn is the planet of ledgers.
cells_derived_method: How the ledger-keeping shows follows the sign: Saturn's own sign makes the accounts strict, an exalted Saturn makes them balanced.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn in own sign in the 2nd, so money is handled with a strict ledger and tight control of staff.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn exalted in the 2nd, so the accounts are balanced and fair, in money and in relationships.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture. The 2nd is inferred from 'धन', but servants are the 6th house, so the house is not certain.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the karaka of servants and labour, and the 2nd is money; accounts and 'love ledgers' are his addition.

hindi: हिसाब मत लगाओ अगर आपने शनि का हिसाब लगा लिया पैसों का इतने पैसे पड़े गायब
says: Warning: do not calculate or tally Saturn's money. If you do the accounting, the money that was lying there disappears. This is a tradition claim, not financial advice.
ambiguity: 'इतने पैसे पड़े गायब' is clipped (so much money was lying, gone).
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

hindi: कई लोग देख ले अपने जीवन में सोच के कि यार पैसे टिकते ही नहीं इसका मतलब गिनते हो गिनना नहीं है
says: Many people notice that money does not stay with them; he says that means they keep counting it, and the instruction is not to count.
ambiguity: He does not name Saturn in this sentence; it carries over from the previous line.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural claim of his own.

gist: Sets up an example: suppose Saturn sits here in someone's chart, in a child, and understand what his features will be.

hindi: यह कर्म स्थान है काम कैसे करेगा यह सारी जिंदगी सारी रात उठेगा सारा दिन सोएगा
says: With Saturn in the 10th, the house of karma and work, he asks how the person will work and answers: with an inverted rhythm, awake all night and asleep all day, for the whole life.
cells_derived_method: The kind of night work follows the 10th-house sign: air and earth signs give structured night roles, a water sign gives secretive or investigative night work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn exalted in the 10th, so night-shift roles with authority such as security, logistics or operations.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 10th, so night-time communication work such as broadcasting, support desks or writing.

ambiguity: 'यह कर्म स्थान है' is a board gesture; the 10th is taken from the phrase 'karma sthana'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is strong at night in Shadbala (natonnata bala); a lifelong night schedule is his reading.

gist: Describes what people will tell such a child: take education, this is sin and that is merit, get up in the brahma muhurta, with his comment that this type of fuss is conventional advice.

hindi: उसकी लाइफ लाजवाब जाएगी रॉकेट बनेगा वो अगर रात भर जागेगा दिन भर सोएगा
says: Such a Saturn-10th person's life will go wonderfully and he will shoot up like a rocket, provided he stays awake all night and sleeps all day, that is follows his Saturn rhythm instead of the conventional early-rising advice.
cells_derived_method: How high the rise goes depends on Saturn's dignity in the 10th: strong signs give a firm authoritative rise, a weak sign gives a rise with repeated setbacks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn in own sign in the 10th, so the night rhythm becomes a strong, authoritative career with lasting position.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in Scorpio in the 10th, so night work in a secretive or investigative field brings the rise.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not link career success to a night schedule.

hindi: उसका एक स्वभाव क्या होगा वो आधे पलंग पर सामान फैला के रखेगा भाई ढूंढेगा कौन अव्यवस्था शनि का गुण है व यही रखेगा
says: A habit of the Saturn native: he keeps his belongings spread over half the bed ('who will find anything?') because disorder is a Saturn quality.
ambiguity: It is said in the context of the Saturn-in-10th child, but 'अव्यवस्था शनि का गुण है' is a planet-wide statement.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts call Saturn unclean and slovenly (malina) while also stressing discipline.

gist: Mimicked reply, partly garbled: the things are plainly visible in front of him and nothing of his ever gets lost, because he never puts anything away in the wardrobe.
Dialogue: a son walking round in a towel says he is going to bathe, and when asked when, says even that needs a muhurta from the pandit and he may not go today at all.

hindi: गु वाला हो नहीं गुस्सा तो बसमत ही देगा शनि का गुस्से से कोई लेनदेन नहीं
says: Saturn has no dealings with anger, so a Saturn-type child will not be the hot-tempered kind. The opening words are garbled.
ambiguity: 'गु वाला' and 'बसमत' are garbled; the sense is read from the last clause.
classical_check: Partly differs: anger is Mars's karaka, but Saturn gives cold, suppressed resentment, so 'no dealing at all' is an overstatement.

hindi: अगर इस शनि की दृष्टि सूर्य पर होगी कुंडली में सूर्य तो महाराज मान लो य बैठे हैं अब शनि की य दृष्टि है य बाप को खा जाएगा
says: If Saturn's aspect falls on the Sun in the chart, Saturn will 'eat the father': the Sun is the karaka of the father and Saturn's aspect harms him. It is stated as a general rule with no timing.
cells_derived_method: The father is hurt in the way the Sun's house and sign allow: Saturn reaches the Sun from the 3rd, 7th or 10th houses counted from Saturn, and the Sun's sign decides whether the father is strong or weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, the Sun exalted in the 10th and Saturn in the 4th looking at it by its 7th aspect, as in Rama's chart, so the father is a figure of great authority yet is lost at a hard turning point in the son's life.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, the Sun in own sign in the 9th aspected by Saturn, so the father is dignified but cold and distant, and his support is delayed.
Derived: lagna Leo, the Sun in Saturn's sign Aquarius in the 7th aspected by Saturn from the lagna by its 7th aspect, so relations with the father are strained and status comes through partnerships.

ambiguity: 'खा जाएगा' is an idiom: it may mean harm, separation or the father's early death; he does not say which, and the chart seats are board gestures.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: the Sun is the karaka of the father and Saturn's aspect or conjunction is a classical affliction of the father; 'eat' is stronger than the texts.

hindi: राम जी की बाप को खा जाता है
says: He cites Rama's chart as the proof case of this rule: there Saturn's aspect on the Sun 'ate the father'.
cells_derived_method: In the chart recalled earlier for Rama (lagna Cancer), Saturn is in the 4th in Libra and the Sun is in the 10th in Aries, so Saturn's 7th aspect lands on the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in the 4th casts its 7th aspect on the 10th house Aries, where the Sun is placed in its exaltation sign, which is the pattern of Rama's chart.
Derived: the Sun receives the aspect in the 10th in Aries; it is exalted here, so the father is a figure of authority yet is lost early.

ambiguity: The caption is clipped ('Rama ji's eats the father'). The reference to King Dasharatha's death after Rama's exile is the traditional story, not stated here.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition: Dasharatha died after Rama went into exile, and Saturn in the 4th aspecting the Sun in the 10th is the usual explanation.

gist: An instruction to a helper to put Rama's chart in later, and that this will be taken up right after.

hindi: अब य बाप को खा जाएगा मार भी दे पीटे भी तो कोई भरोसा नहीं मार भी सकता है
says: He elaborates the same Saturn-on-Sun claim: the child may harm the father physically, thrash him or even kill him, and there is no guarantee against it. This is his harshest reading, recorded as his claim only.
ambiguity: 'मार' can mean beat or kill; both are mentioned.
classical_check: Stronger than the texts, which speak of the father's hardship or separation, not violence by the child.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति और बुध का दोष होगा तो मारेगा बाप को पकड़
says: If Jupiter and Mercury are also afflicted, the child will catch hold of the father and beat him (or kill him): the added affliction of the judgement planets turns the harm into direct violence.
ambiguity: 'पकड़' is cut off. Why Jupiter and Mercury are the added factors is not explained; wisdom and intellect is only a guess.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no such rule.

gist: Says people will call such a child a great sinner, but it is not his fault; that moral defence leads into the astrological reason that follows.

hindi: उसके ग्र ऐसे उसके ग्रह ऐसे क्यों है उसके बाप की कुंडली में पंचम स्थान डिस्टर्ब है पितरों की कृपा नहीं है इसलिए अपना बच्चा ही उसको मारेगा अपना ही बच्चा कटेगा उसको
says: Why the child's planets are like that: in the father's own chart the 5th house (children) is disturbed and the ancestors' grace is missing, so the father's own child turns on him.
cells_derived_method: The kind of trouble from the child follows the sign on the 5th of the father's chart: a fire sign gives a hot-headed child, Saturn's earth sign gives cold distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the father's chart, lagna Virgo, the 5th house is Capricorn; if it is disturbed, the child brings hardship and coldness, tied to missing ancestral grace.
Derived: in the father's chart, lagna Sagittarius, the 5th house is Aries; if it is disturbed, the child is hot-headed and confrontational towards the father.

ambiguity: 'ग्र' is a stutter for 'ग्रह'. He reads the father's chart, not the child's.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: the 5th is the house of children and of ancestral merit (pitru dosha); the violent outcome is stronger than the texts.

hindi: पांचवे भाव में शनि की राशि पड़ी है शनि बैठा है महाराज दृष्टि है
says: The Saturn-on-the-5th link can come in three ways: Saturn's sign (Capricorn or Aquarius) falls on the 5th house, Saturn sits in the 5th, or Saturn aspects the 5th. He treats all three as the same link.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's sign on the 5th occurs for Virgo lagna (Capricorn) and Libra lagna (Aquarius). In both Saturn rules the 5th, which ties him to children and studies wherever he sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, the 5th house is Capricorn, Saturn's own sign, so Saturn is lord of the 5th and tied to children and studies even when he sits elsewhere.
Derived: lagna Libra, the 5th house is Aquarius, Saturn's own sign, and as lord of the 4th and 5th Saturn makes children's matters carry his slowness and discipline.

ambiguity: 'शनि की राशि पड़ी है' could be the sign on the 5th or the sign Saturn is in; the first is taken.
classical_check: Agrees: lordship, occupation and aspect all link a planet to a house in classical practice.

hindi: तो शनि महाराज की कृपा से यह बाप एक करोड़ रुपए लगाएगा अपनी बेटी की शादी में एक करोड़ लगाएंगे अपनी लल्ली की बेटी की शादी में
says: With Saturn linked to the 5th, the father will plan to put a crore of rupees into his daughter's wedding, said sarcastically as 'by Saturn Maharaj's grace'. It sets up the next line, where the money does not go as planned.
ambiguity: 'कृपा' is sarcastic. The figure of a crore is illustrative.
classical_check: Silent; this is an illustration, not a classical rule.

hindi: बेटी बेटी ब्याह करके भाग जाएगी और वो एक करोड़ रह जाएगा जेब में पड़ा हुआ रोते रहो
says: But the daughter will marry and run off, and the crore will stay lying in the father's pocket, so he can keep crying. This is his example of Saturn on the 5th turning the children's matters against the parents' plans.
ambiguity: 'भाग जाएगी' could be elopement or simply going off on her own terms.
classical_check: Silent; it is an illustration of the 5th-house block on children's matters.

gist: Repeats that Saturn will not let things happen by your wish: the work will not happen as you want (same point as the earlier plans-do-not-happen principle).
Says that wherever and in whatever form Saturn shows up, they will take a whole class on it later.

hindi: अभी मोटे तौर पे है कि जहां जो बैठ गया वहां काम नहीं होगा
says: As a rough working rule for now: wherever Saturn has sat, the work of that house does not get done, and the matters of that house do not come off.
cells_derived_method: The blocked work is the one the house governs: in the 9th, luck and dharma; in the 12th, settlement abroad and expenses; in each other house its own subject.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 9th, so luck, dharma and father matters do not come off and pilgrimages and fortune are blocked.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in own sign in the 12th, so the work of the 12th (foreign settlement, expenses, sleep) is not completed as planned, though own sign gives a steadier result.

ambiguity: 'जो बैठ गया' is read as 'whichever planet (Saturn) sat'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: it is the 'papa in a house harms it' rule; the texts exempt 3, 6, 10 and 11.

gist: A clipped fragment ('of someone's husband place') cut off at the end of the slice; it continues in the next slice.

hindi: साथ बैठ गया आप रोते रहो बैठ के पति से झगड़ा ही होगा आपको
says: Continuing the cut-off clause of the previous slice: once Saturn has sat together with the husband's house, the woman will keep sitting and crying, and quarrels with the husband are certain.
cells_derived_method: The quarrels take their theme from the 7th-house sign: fire signs make them about ego and status, earth signs about money and comfort, Saturn's own sign about duty and workload.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in the Sun's sign in the 7th, so the quarrels are about ego and status, with cold stand-offs.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn in own sign in the 7th, so the quarrels are about duty and workload, yet the marriage holds.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 7th, so the quarrels are about money, comforts and affection.

ambiguity: 'साथ बैठ गया' continues the cut-off 'किसी के पति स्थान के' of the last slice, so 'with the husband's place' is inferred. He addresses a woman ('आप रोते रहो').
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Saturn in or with the 7th is classically a source of marital friction and delay.

hindi: सेक्स के लिए बाहर भेजेगा प्रेम के लिए पति के साथ अगर पति से सेक्स दे रहा है तो प्रेम बाहर करना पड़ेगा
says: Saturn splits sex from love: either she is sent outside for sex while love stays with the husband, or, if the husband satisfies her physically, love has to be sought outside. One of the two always lies outside the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Which of the two goes outside follows the 7th-house sign: air signs push companionship outside, Jupiter's signs push an idealised emotional bond outside.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Saturn in Mercury's sign in the 7th, so companionship and conversation (the love side) are found outside while the physical bond stays with the spouse.
Derived: lagna Virgo, Saturn in Jupiter's sign in the 7th, so an idealised emotional bond is sought elsewhere while the marriage stays dutiful.

ambiguity: The first half is clipped: 'भेजेगा' has Saturn as its subject, and who is sent where is read from the second half.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe this split.

gist: Notes that people will then say it is illegal, wrong and dirty work.

hindi: यही रास्ता है वह मजबूर है यही करने कर ही नहीं सकता कुछ और अन्यथा क्या करेगा धक्के खाएगा
says: His defence of such a person: this is the only path left, she is compelled and can do nothing else; otherwise what would she do, she would only suffer knocks. Saturn leaves no other way.
ambiguity: 'यही करने कर ही नहीं सकता' is stuttered; the sense is that she cannot do anything else.
classical_check: Silent; this is a moral defence, not a classical rule.

hindi: उसकी लाइफ में ऑटोमेटिक अली स्थिति बनेगी
says: Circumstances of this kind arise automatically in such a person's life, by themselves and without her design; he treats them as fated by the Saturn placement.
ambiguity: 'अली' is the caption for 'ऐसी'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि पुरुष पुस ग्रह
says: Saturn is a male planet. The word after 'पुरुष' is garbled and may be 'napumsak' (neuter), which would match the later line calling such men impotent.
ambiguity: 'पुस' is cut off: it may mean 'male and neuter' or just a stutter.
classical_check: Differs if he means male: BPHS lists Saturn with Mercury as a neuter (napumsaka) planet; Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male.

hindi: सारे पुरुष जो सीटियां बजाते हैं ऐसे खड़े होक लड़कियों को देखते रहते हैं छेड़ा खानी करते हैं सब ये वही है
says: All the men who whistle, stand around watching girls and tease them are Saturn types: street-corner teasing is a Saturn behaviour.
ambiguity: 'ये वही है' is read as 'this is that same (Saturn)'.
classical_check: Silent on this specific behaviour.

gist: Mimicked street-corner dialogue: seeing a heroine's dance, a man says 'look at her waist', then 'she is my sister', and that is the whole of his doing.

hindi: उनका करना धरना कुछ नहीं है उनकी बस की कुछ नहीं है क्योंकि पुरुष नपुंसक है
says: Such teasers do nothing beyond teasing, it is beyond their capacity, because he says the male is 'napumsak' (impotent or neuter). Recorded as his claim only, not as a medical statement.
ambiguity: 'नपुंसक' can mean sexually impotent (colloquial) or the neuter-planet label; the first reading is the likelier here.
classical_check: Agrees only with the neuter label of Saturn; the claim about teasing men is his own.

hindi: वो सब शनि को डीएक्टिवेट करे बैठे हैं कभी लाइफ में अमीर नहीं बन सकते भोग और विलासिता शरीर की ले ही नहीं सकते
says: Such men have deactivated their own Saturn, so they never become rich and cannot even enjoy bodily pleasures and luxury.
ambiguity: 'Deactivate Saturn' is not defined; it seems to mean spending Saturn's energy on idle teasing. The last word 'सकते' is at the start of the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि के पास शुगर है आपके शनि में दोष है आपको शुगर होगी
says: He assigns sugar (diabetes) to Saturn and says that if your Saturn is afflicted you will get sugar. Recorded as his claim only, not a diagnosis; Stage 3 must not turn it into a medical prediction.
ambiguity: He does not say what counts as 'dosh' in Saturn, whether debilitation, affliction or house.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn is a karaka of chronic ailments, but diabetes is usually read from Jupiter and Venus (sweetness, kapha) and the 6th house; assigning it to Saturn alone is his claim.

hindi: ठीक करनी है नीलम पहनो
says: Remedy: to fix it, wear a blue sapphire (neelam), Saturn's gem.
classical_check: Agrees that neelam is Saturn's gem; classical practice also warns to test a sapphire before wearing it.

hindi: कैसा नीलम पहनो य लफड़ा है जो शायद ये ब्रजेश गौतम सिखा ना पाए क्योंकि वय खोपड़ी में है इसकी वायरिंग कहां से दिखाऊं कितना नीला हो कौन से कलर की मिक्सिंग हो
says: Which sapphire to wear is the hard part: he says the right shade of blue and the colour mixing are judged by a faculty in his head, like wiring he cannot show, so it may be something he cannot teach, though a sapphire must be worn.
ambiguity: He refers to himself in the third person ('ये ब्रजेश गौतम').
classical_check: Silent on shade-level guidance beyond the classical quality checks of colour and clarity.

hindi: लेकिन नीलम पहनना पड़ेगा वक्री हो गया आपका शनि नीच जगह में बैठा है उच्च जगह में बैठा है वक्री है
says: A sapphire must be worn when your Saturn is retrograde, or sits in a debilitated place, or sits in an exalted place: in all these states he prescribes the sapphire.
cells_derived_method: The sign conditions are Saturn debilitated in Aries and exalted in Libra, plus retrograde in any sign. The house decides which life area the gem is meant to repair.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, Saturn exalted in the 10th, so by his rule the sapphire is still worn, to support career results from a strong Saturn.
Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn debilitated in the 7th, so the sapphire is advised to repair marriage matters, though classical practice would be cautious.
Derived: lagna Pisces, Saturn in own sign in the 11th and retrograde, so the sapphire is advised for gains and friendships.

ambiguity: 'नीच जगह' and 'उच्च जगह' (low place and high place) are read as debilitation and exaltation signs; the caption does not say sign or house.
classical_check: Differs: classical practice does not prescribe a gem blindly; a gem for a debilitated planet can backfire, and an exalted or retrograde Saturn is not by itself a reason, because lordship and strength are checked first.

hindi: नीलम डाल लो पूरी जि जिंदी सेट हो जाएगी पूरा जन्म सेट होगा
says: Put on the sapphire and, he promises, the whole life, the whole birth, will be set right.
ambiguity: 'पूरी जि जिंदी' is a stutter for 'पूरी जिंदगी'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not promise a whole life set right by one gem, so this is an overstatement.

hindi: राम जी ने नीलम पहना होता तो जिंदगी कहीं की कहीं होती
says: If Rama had worn a blue sapphire his life would have gone very differently; he uses this to show the power of the Saturn gem.
ambiguity: A counterfactual; the chart link (Rama's Saturn exalted in the 4th) is from earlier slices, not in this line.
classical_check: Silent; a counterfactual, and classical practice would not usually prescribe a sapphire for an exalted Saturn.

gist: Disclaimer: but who are we to speak about Rama, it was a divine play and this had to happen.

hindi: पर यही कारण है जो कृष्ण जी ने इतने रत्न पहने हुए हैं बाकी भगवानों ने पहने नहीं कमाल हो गया
says: This, he says, is the reason Krishna is shown wearing so many gems while the other gods are not: gems are how Krishna handled the planets; he finds it remarkable.
ambiguity: It is an iconographic claim; the link from gems to planets is implied, not explained.
classical_check: Silent; mythological reasoning.

gist: Says Krishna had an art of astrology and, as the playful one (lilādhārī), laid out life wonderfully; the caption here is partly garbled.
Rama did not give us the Gita, Krishna did; the Gita is life's pathway, a way of seeing how to live.

hindi: बृहस्पति कितना जेब में होगा कृष्ण जी के सूर्य जैसा प्रकाश कितना तेज होगा
says: He rhetorically imagines how fully Krishna must have held Jupiter in his pocket and how intense a Sun-like radiance he had, that is Jupiter (wisdom) and the Sun (light) under complete control.
ambiguity: It is praise by rhetorical question and sets up the next line about Saturn; no chart is given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि कितना जेब में होगा करना धना कुछ नहीं मैं ना अस्त्र उठाऊंगा ना मैं शस्त्र उठाऊंगा मैं कुछ करूंगा ही नहीं शनि करेगा सारा काम स्वतः
says: How fully must Krishna have had Saturn in his pocket: he does nothing, takes up neither missile nor weapon, and Saturn does all the work by himself. When Saturn is under control the work happens on its own.
ambiguity: 'करना धना' is the caption for 'करना धरना' (doing). The words are Krishna's vow in the Mahabharata, put in his mouth.
classical_check: Silent; a devotional reading, not a classical rule.

gist: Mahabharata story: Barbarika, watching the war from above, says he saw nothing work except the Sudarshan Chakra.
Says the Sudarshan Chakra is the Sahasrara, spinning at a '1024 GB' speed, with 1024 petals in our crown centre: a yogic claim, not planetary.

hindi: कौन काम कर रहा है कॉस्मस आपके जीवन में कॉस्मस काम कब करेगा जब वरुण की कृपा होगी
says: Who is really working in your life? The cosmos, and the cosmos works only when Varuna (Neptune) is gracious.
ambiguity: Varuna is his name for Neptune in the 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no Neptune; this belongs to his own 12-planet scheme.

hindi: वरुण की कृपा कब होगी वरुण की कृपा जब प्लूटो की कृपा होगी तो वरुण कृपा करेगा
says: Varuna's (Neptune's) grace comes only when Pluto (Yama) is gracious; Pluto is the gate that comes before Neptune.
ambiguity: Pluto is called Yama in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent: the outer planets are outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: वरुण की होगी तो इंद्र करेगा जब शनि करेगा तब कृपा मिलेगी
says: When Varuna's grace is there, Indra (Uranus) acts, and when Saturn acts the grace finally reaches you: a descending chain from Pluto through Neptune and Uranus to Saturn, with Saturn the last gate before the person.
ambiguity: The exact hand-off between steps is garbled; the order is read from the preceding sentences.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no such chain.

gist: Satire on Nirmal Baba style remedies: 'grace is stuck here' so eat golgappa with green water or wash clothes with Tide, a belief made by that baba.

hindi: इसलिए आपकी कृपा कहां अटकी हुई है आपको सिर्फ कृपा लेने पर ध्यान देना
says: So, where is your grace stuck? He says to put your attention only on receiving grace, not on doing or fixing.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous caption chunk ('इसलिए').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और कृपा कब होगी जब अपना दिमाग नहीं लगाया इन्होने आपको कृपा बह बह के आएगी
says: Grace comes when you do not apply your own mind to it: then, he says, grace will come flowing to you in streams.
ambiguity: 'इन्होने' is garbled; the sense is 'when you did not use your own brain'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Satire on the human attitude: we will use our own brain and do it ourselves, why does the One above not do it, keep him as a servant.
Krishna cheerfully offers to serve, asking only that you be Arjuna and not Duryodhana, or he will have you killed.
Says we do not want to become Arjuna, who lay at Krishna's feet from the start, because that quality is not in us.
People often pick a guru who himself has no sense but has the power and skill of an Arjuna, and that guru ends up useful to them.
Callers phone him about their work and ask for a horoscope reading; he says the earning will come through another route, from a third person who is that caller's guru.
Continues the caller story: A has faith in B, C asks him how A's work will happen; he says it will happen through B, not through him, because B's reach goes up to Krishna.
Rhetorical lead-in: so keep Krishna as a servant, but when will Krishna come to serve.

hindi: कृष्ण स्पेस एलिमेंट है
says: In his cosmology Krishna is the space (akasha) element.
ambiguity: Krishna is not a planet; he does not link the space element to a planet in this line.
classical_check: Partly agrees: in BPHS the ether (akasha) element belongs to Jupiter; Krishna as space is his devotional reading.

hindi: जब काम क्रोध लोभ मोह अहंकार बकवास भैस गुस्सा बंद करोगे
says: Krishna (the space element) will come to serve you when you stop lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego, nonsense and sulky buffalo-like temper.
ambiguity: 'भैस गुस्सा' is read as buffalo-like anger.
classical_check: Silent as astrology; the five vices (kama, krodha, lobha, moha, ahamkara) are standard in Indian ethics.

hindi: जब सड़ना बंद करोगे जब कुड़ना बंद करोगे लड़ना तो नेप्चून कृपा देगा
says: Neptune gives his grace when you stop rotting inside with envy, stop fuming and stop fighting.
ambiguity: The words 'कब बंद करोगे' just before it ask the question; 'लड़ना' is attached to the stopped actions.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: अगर आप में ईर्षा है और बात बात पर आप कोसते फिरते हो तो आपको वरुण की कृपा नहीं मिलेगी धक्के खाओ
says: If you carry envy and curse at every small thing, you will not get Varuna's (Neptune's) grace and will take knocks instead.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और वो धक्के दिलाने का जिम्मा किसके पास है शनि महाराज अपन देगा धक्के अंधेरे में धक्का देगा
says: The job of delivering those knocks belongs to Saturn Maharaj: he pushes you around, and he pushes you in the dark when you cannot see.
ambiguity: 'अपन' is colloquial for 'he' or 'we'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is the giver of hardship and karmic lessons.

hindi: टांग तोड़ देगा सारी हड्डियां शनि तोड़ता है आपको हड्डी कहीं कैसी भी प्रॉब्लम आ गई शनि गड़बड़ है
says: Saturn breaks legs and bones: any bone problem anywhere in the body means Saturn is disturbed. Recorded as a significator claim only, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical karaka of bones and joints.

hindi: शनि गड़बड़ है तो पता नहीं कौन से ग्रह की वजह से कुंडली में यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो कौन सा क्या कर रहा है कोई पता नहीं भैया
says: When Saturn is disturbed, nobody can tell which of the outer planets, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto, in the chart is behind it or what each one is doing.
ambiguity: He means the cause cannot be pinned down; it is an admission, not a rule.
classical_check: Silent: the outer planets are not classical.

hindi: तो शनि इज ब्लाइंड शनि एक अंधा होरोस्कोप है अंधी कुंडली बनाता है
says: Saturn is blind: he is a blind horoscope and makes a blind chart, so what Saturn rules cannot be foreseen or planned, only gone through.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses into the next caption chunk ('अंधा' then 'होरोस्कोप').
classical_check: Differs in image: classical texts call Saturn lame (pangu) and slow, not blind.

hindi: अंधे ग्रह के कारण से आप जीवन में जहां जहां अंधे चलोगे वह काम लाजवाब होगा आपके जीवन में
says: Because of the blind planet, wherever in life you proceed blind, that is without planning or looking at the outcome, that work will turn out wonderfully.
ambiguity: 'अंधे चलोगे' is read as acting without fixing on the result.
classical_check: Silent: a behavioural principle of his own.

hindi: ऐसा अक्सर कई बार लोग कहते हैं मैंने जी प्रॉपर्टी खरीदी अगर कुंडली कह रही है ना चौथे घर से शनि का लिंक है
says: This often happens: a client says 'I bought a property' while the chart shows Saturn linked to the 4th house (property and home); this is the case he is about to dissect, and the readings follow in the next lines.
ambiguity: It only sets up the case; the 4th-house readings are under G07-13-050.
classical_check: Silent on this setup.

gist: His own reply in such a case: he says 'shut up, stop the nonsense', and the client first thinks him very rude, though he says it is a deliberate style.

hindi: अहंकार तोड़ो शनि अहंकार से मार देता है कि अहंकार तोड़ो
says: Break the ego: Saturn strikes through the ego, which is why he answers the client so bluntly, to break his pride before Saturn does.
ambiguity: 'मार देता है' is read as strikes or hits.
classical_check: Silent: ego is classically the Sun's matter; the Saturn-ego link is his own.

hindi: कि बिल्कुल बकवास कर रहे हो प्रॉपर्टी गोद में आके गिरी है
says: His blunt answer: you are talking nonsense, the property did not come by your effort, it fell into your lap. With Saturn on the 4th, property arrives unplanned instead of being acquired by design.
cells_derived_method: The form of the unplanned property follows the 4th-house sign: Saturn's own sign gives land or a house through inheritance or a long-standing route, a Venus sign gives a comfortable home that arrives unexpectedly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Saturn in own sign in the 4th, so a house or land arrives through inheritance or an old family route, not through a plan.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Saturn in Venus's sign in the 4th, so a comfortable home comes unexpectedly, through a settlement or help from others.

classical_check: Differs from his own earlier line that Saturn in the 4th denied Rama home comfort, and from the classical view that Saturn in the 4th troubles property and the mother. It is consistent if read as: planned property fails, unplanned property comes.

hindi: फिर व कहता हा यह बात तो अपने सेही की मैंने खरीदी पता नहीं कहां से आ गई पैसे कहां से आए पता नहीं कहां से आए
says: The client then admits it is true: he did buy it, but does not know how it came to him or where the money came from. With Saturn on the 4th, the money for the property comes from an unknown source.
ambiguity: 'अपने सेही की' is garbled; the sense is that the client agrees the point is right.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: The client then concedes (accepts the 'iron') and praises him; the follow-up half sentence about the need to make him accept is garbled.
Explains that there is no need to make the client accept, because he would not follow the advice anyway and himself does not know what to follow.

hindi: बृहस्पति और बुध यदि वक्री दोनों में से कोई एक हो जाए व्यक्ति दूसरे को फॉलो नहीं करता फॉलो ही नहीं करता व चाहता ही नहीं फॉलो करना
says: If either Jupiter or Mercury is retrograde, the person does not follow the other: he does not follow guidance and does not even want to.
cells_derived_method: The area in which advice is ignored follows the house of the retrograde planet: Jupiter retrograde in the 9th ignores the guru and father, Mercury retrograde in the 10th ignores professional advice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter retrograde in own sign in the 9th, so he disregards the guidance of teachers, guru and father and goes by his own belief.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Mercury retrograde in own sign in the 10th, so he ignores professional advice and follows his own analysis.

ambiguity: He says 'one of the two retrograde' and the person does not follow 'the other'; the direction of who does not follow whom is read loosely.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no Jupiter-Mercury retrograde rule.

hindi: यहां पर नीच राशि में कोई भी ग्रह बैठा हो ज्योतिषी को सीधा उसे यह बोलना है मेरे पास किस लिए आया तुम बिलीव तो इन चीजों में करते नहीं
says: If any planet sits in a debilitated sign at the house he points to, the astrologer should tell the client straight: why did you come to me, you do not believe in these things anyway. A debilitated planet there means the person does not believe.
cells_derived_method: The house he points at is not named; if it is the house of faith (9th) or of merit (5th), a debilitated planet there weakens belief in teachers, ritual and astrology.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus, Jupiter debilitated in the 9th, so faith in teachers and ritual is weak and belief is hard to win.
Derived: lagna Gemini, the Sun debilitated in the 5th, so confidence in tradition and inner conviction is low.
Derived: lagna Pisces, the Moon debilitated in the 9th, so faith is unsteady and swayed by moods.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a board gesture; the house is probably the 9th (faith) or the 5th (merit), but he does not say.
classical_check: Silent as worded; classically faith is read from the 9th, the 5th and Jupiter, and debilitation there weakens it, which fits his idea.

gist: Repeats that the client is stunned because he truly does not believe, and that with a debilitated planet here he will not believe (same point as the line before).

hindi: तो अल्टीमेटली क्या करने का है पहले वही चीज तोड़ डालो
says: So what finally has to be done: first break that very thing, the block or disbelief that the debilitated planet stands for, before anything else.
ambiguity: 'वही चीज' (that very thing) is not named; read as the disbelief or block just discussed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आपके जीवन में कृपा लेनी है ग्रहों का आशीर्वाद लेना है आपको इस प्रकार से समझना कि मैं अपनी कुंडली सुधार सकूं
says: To receive grace and the planets' blessings in your life, you should approach it with the understanding that you can improve your own chart: the attitude that the chart is improvable.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts allow remedies to soften a chart; this is his framing of that.

hindi: सबसे पहले शनि महाराज की कृपा लेकर चलो
says: First of all, proceed after taking Saturn Maharaj's grace: Saturn's favour is the first step of any improvement.
ambiguity: How to take Saturn's grace is not said in this line.
classical_check: Silent as worded; consistent with the classical idea of appeasing Saturn first in a difficult period.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि का सबसे डेंजर जोन क्या है इसका भाई है प्लूटो
says: Saturn's most dangerous zone is his brother Pluto (Yama): that is where Saturn's matters turn dangerous, which is why Saturn's grace is to be taken first.
ambiguity: Pluto is Yama in his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Agrees on the family tie: Shani and Yama are brothers (sons of Surya) in mythology; Pluto as Yama is his own mapping.

gist: Describes, with gestures, a child sitting cross-legged with feet set, saying one part falls on the chest and another comes down; the posture needs the picture to follow.

hindi: जो यह हिस्सा आ रहा है यह नीचे आ रहा है और जो पैर के पंजे हैं वो मूल आधार पर तो अल्टीमेटली प्लूटो जो पाव पर है यमराज और यह हिप बोन यह दोनों एक ही है
says: Reading the seated child's posture, the soles of the feet land on the root (muladhara), so Pluto, who sits at the feet and is Yamaraj, and the hip bone he calls Saturn's seat are one and the same zone.
ambiguity: The posture is described by gestures; the mapping is read from the last clause.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body map (Kalapurusha) puts the feet in Pisces, the 12th house, not at the hip bone, and Pluto is not classical.

hindi: तो मौत होती है उससे
says: Death comes through this Pluto and hip-bone zone, that is Pluto (Yama) is the agent of death. No timing or person is given.
ambiguity: 'उससे' points back to the Pluto and hip-bone zone.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Yama is the god of death and the 8th house and Saturn are linked to endings; the Pluto-hip mapping is his own.

gist: Begins to name the most powerful planet of our life, but the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice and continues in the next one.
Says a full talk on Pluto would run very long and the parathas would go cold, so he will keep it short.

hindi: प्लूटो मृत्यु देता है आपको मरना है शनि के रास्ते से होते हुए सीधा वो यमराज के पास भेज देता है
says: Pluto is the planet that brings death, meaning final endings. The road to it runs through Saturn, and after that Pluto sends the person straight to Yamraj, the lord of death.
ambiguity: 'मरना है शनि के रास्ते से' could mean Saturn is the gate or stage (decay, delay, old age) before Pluto's final step, or that Saturn carries the person to Pluto; he does not say which. A few lines later he widens 'death' to job, money and love, so it may not be literal.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto: Jyotish before the outer planets gives death to Saturn (ayushkaraka) and the 8th house, with Yama as Saturn's brother in myth.

hindi: और सिर्फ सत्यवान की पत्नी ही बचा सकती है उसे
says: Only the wife of Satyavan, that is Savitri, can rescue a person from Pluto and Yamraj. He uses the myth to say that protection from Pluto comes through the woman, the wife-type feminine force.
ambiguity: Whether 'wife' means a literal wife or a wider feminine principle is only settled in the next lines (a woman's blessing, a bhabhi).
classical_check: Silent: the Savitri and Satyavan story is a Mahabharata tale, not a Parashari or Jaimini rule, although a strong 7th house and 7th lord is classically read as the spouse's protective strength.

gist: Savitri myth told in a joking tone: Satyavan had no strength of his own, so his wife snatched him back from Yamraj.
Repeats that everyone knows this nature and asks listeners to think how powerful a thing it is to escape Yamraj.

hindi: यह प्लूटो है इससे बचाएगा कौन यमराज से कौन बचा सकता है यमराज से आपको सिर्फ सिर्फ सिर्फ नेप्चून बचा सकता है क्योंकि नेप्चून को क्रॉस किए बिना आ नहीं सकता ऊपर
says: Only Neptune can save a person from Pluto, because Pluto cannot come up to the person without first crossing Neptune. Neptune is therefore the shield that sits between Pluto and the native.
ambiguity: 'आ नहीं सकता ऊपर' (cannot come up) points to an ordering of the outer planets or body positions in his scheme, with Neptune lying between Pluto and the person; the ordering is not spelled out here.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no outer planets, so there is no protective Neptune.

hindi: तो नेप्चून कौन है नेप्चून के पास ईर्षा यहां ईर्षा रहती है घुटनों पर क्रोध रहता है
says: Neptune is tied to jealousy (the caption's ईर्षा, meaning ईर्ष्या), which he places at a body spot he points to, while anger is said to live at the knees. He is mapping emotions to body places in his planet scheme.
ambiguity: The 'here' is a gesture on his body. The planet that owns the knee spot is not named (Saturn if knees are Capricorn, or Mars for anger). The garbled caption could also mean Neptune is the cure for jealousy rather than its owner.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical kalapurusha puts the knees with Capricorn and Saturn and anger with Mars; jealousy has no outer-planet owner.

hindi: आपकी ईर्षा आपको बचा सकते ईर्ष छोड़ दो
says: Remedy: give up jealousy. The caption is broken, but the point seems to be that dropping envy opens the way for Neptune's protection from Pluto, while holding on to it blocks that protection.
ambiguity: Read literally 'आपकी ईर्षा आपको बचा सकते' says your jealousy can save you, which clashes with 'leave jealousy' in the same breath; most likely a negation was dropped by the caption ('नहीं बचा सकती').
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives giving up jealousy as a remedy against an outer planet.

hindi: और क्या करो नेप्चून का स्थान कहां है वण का स्थान क हदय पर हृदय के स्थान पर क्या है शुक्र शुक्र कौन है स्त्री स्त्री का
says: Neptune (Varuna) has its seat at the heart, and at the heart's place sits Venus, who stands for the woman. In his body map the heart region links Neptune, Venus and the feminine.
ambiguity: 'वण का स्थान क हदय' is garbled but reads as Varuna's place is the heart. The last words 'स्त्री का' are cut and completed in the next chunk ('आशीर्वाद लो').
classical_check: Differs: classical kalapurusha gives the heart to Leo and the Sun (5th house), while Venus rules the face, eyes and reproductive area.

hindi: आशीर्वाद लो आप स्त्री का आशीर्वाद लोगे आपके जीवन में मृत्यु से बचे बचोगे
says: Remedy: take a woman's blessing. If you do, you will be saved from the 'deaths' in your life, meaning Pluto's endings.
ambiguity: 'बचे बचोगे' is a stammer for 'bachoge' (you will be saved). Which planet the 'woman' stands for is inferred from the heart link (Venus, Neptune), not named here.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for the 8th house and Saturn use mantra and charity; a woman's blessing as protection from an outer planet is his own scheme.

hindi: मृत्यु कौन सी है नौकरी की मृत्यु पैसे की मृत्यु मकान की मृत्यु शरीर की मृत्यु शरीर के किसी ऑर्गन की मृत्यु प्रेम की मृत्यु
says: He widens Pluto's 'death' beyond the body: it can be the death of a job, of money, of a house, of the body, of some body organ, or of love. Any final ending is Pluto's territory. Bodily death is only one item in the category list; no timing or case is given and none is recorded here.
cells_derived_method: Which area 'dies' follows the house Pluto sits in: the 10th for job, the 2nd and 11th for money, the 4th for house and home, the 1st for the body, the 5th and 7th for love; the sign colours how the ending comes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) points the ending at the job or standing: a position that ends abruptly or has to be rebuilt.
Derived: Pluto in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) points the ending at house and home: a property deal that dies or a home that must be given up.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer) points the ending at love and romance: a relationship that dies hard.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 2nd (lagna Capricorn) points the ending at money: savings or family income that dries up.

ambiguity: 'शरीर की मृत्यु' (death of the body) sits in the same list as job and love, so it is probably a figurative scope list rather than a literal prediction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classically the 8th house governs sudden endings and loss, the 2nd and 11th money, the 4th the house, the 10th the job, the 5th and 7th love; Pluto itself is not classical.

hindi: किसका आशीर्वाद चाहिए स्त्री कौन सी स्त्री सावित्री सावित्री सत्यवान की पत्नी यानी कि भाभी आपके जीवन में किसी ना किसी तरह से भाभी के थ्रू आशीर्वाद मिलेगा
says: The blessing needed is from a woman of Savitri's type, Satyavan's wife, whom he equates with a bhabhi (brother's wife). In everyone's life, in one way or another, the blessing will come through a bhabhi.
ambiguity: A wife of Satyavan is called a 'bhabhi' only from another family member's viewpoint. It is unclear if he means the native's own brother's wife or any bhabhi-like woman; no house is named.
classical_check: Silent on a rule; classically an elder brother's wife is read from the 5th house (7th from the 11th) and a younger brother's wife from the 9th (7th from the 3rd).

hindi: और अन्य तौर पर नेप्चून भी एक गुरु
says: He adds that in another sense Neptune is also a guru, a teacher-like guide that can protect the native. The thought is cut short as he turns to a joke.
ambiguity: 'गुरु' may mean a teacher in general or Jupiter (Guru); the sentence is unfinished so the exact claim is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not classical and the guru karaka is Jupiter.

gist: Joking story: a woman working at one spot has her eyes everywhere and sees with a thousand eyes, so nothing escapes her.

hindi: क्योंकि पेरिफेरल विजन बहुत स्ट्रांग होती है उसकी इसलिए वो फोटोग्राफिक मेमोरी बहुत स्ट्रांग है इसलिए स्त्री पुरानी से पुरानी बातें पकड़ के चलती है
says: He claims a woman's peripheral vision is very strong, so her photographic memory is strong, so she holds on to even the oldest matters. He goes on to file these as the feminine traits that belong to Neptune.
ambiguity: Neptune is named only in the next chunk ('ये नेप्चून है'), so tying these traits to Neptune is read from there. The vision-to-memory chain is his own physiological argument, not an astrological rule.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give memory to the Moon and Mercury and have no vision-and-memory logic.

gist: Claims that biologically the memory part of the brain (hippocampus, which he calls a gland) is double the size in women than in men.
Joke that a man cannot even lie properly: the wife catches his half-baked lie through his password and asks who he is chatting with, while he himself does not know.

hindi: क्योंकि ये स्त्री और पुरुष के गुण अवगुण है ये नेप्चून है
says: He sums up that these traits of women and men, virtues and flaws alike (sharp perception, long memory, getting caught in lies), belong to Neptune.
ambiguity: 'गुण अवगुण' of both sexes is a wide label; he gives no list beyond the jokes just before.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is outside classical Jyotish.

gist: Repeats that to be saved from death you need a woman's grace, and asks the listener to read this as a blessing.

hindi: तो कुंडली में जितने स्त्री ग्रह हैं उन सबकी प्रसन्नता हेतु जहां जहां जैसे बैठा वैसे वैसे दान करो
says: Remedy: for every feminine planet in the chart, donate to please it, and let the gift follow where and how that planet is seated, so the donation is customised by its house and sign.
cells_derived_method: The planet decides the gift (Venus: women, white and luxury items; Moon: milk, rice, mother figures), its house decides whom or what the gift serves (7th spouse, 6th helpers, 4th mother and home, 12th hidden charity), and the sign dignity decides how much effort is needed (a weak sign asks for a larger, steadier gift).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Libra, its own sign, in the 7th (lagna Aries): the gift goes through the spouse's house, such as gifts for the wife or women of the family, white sweets or cloth; a modest regular gift is enough.

Derived: Venus in Virgo, its debilitation sign, in the 6th (lagna Aries): the gift is steered to women who serve or are unwell, such as helpers, nurses or maids, and the weak sign suggests a larger, more regular gift.
Derived: Moon in Taurus, where it is exalted, in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): the gift is linked to the mother and home, for example milk, rice or a gift to the mother, and a strong Moon needs little.
Derived: Moon in Cancer, its own sign, in the 12th (lagna Leo): the gift is quiet charity, such as feeding the needy or giving to a hospital or ashram, in line with the 12th house of giving away.

ambiguity: He does not list which planets count as 'स्त्री ग्रह'. Venus and Moon are classical; in his scheme Neptune may count as well; Mercury and Rahu are not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical remedies tie the donation to the planet and its placement, with Venus and the Moon as the feminine planets.

hindi: यह आपका विद्यालय का स्थान होता है यह पत्नी का स्थान है
says: Pointing at places in his chart he names two life areas: one place is the school or education seat, and another place is the wife's seat. These are house topics, not planet claims.
cells_derived_method: He names no house number because he points at the chart. Classically schooling is the 4th (higher study the 5th) and the wife is the 7th; a planet in those houses colours the topic, and the sign on the house shows the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 4th (lagna Aries) makes the school place a Moon-ruled one: nurturing schooling, near home, with the mother involved.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (lagna Cancer) makes the wife's place a Saturn-ruled one: a serious, duty-minded partner and a slow-building marriage.
Derived: Libra on the 5th (lagna Gemini) turns the learning seat toward law, arts and balance, with study done in company.

ambiguity: 'यह' (this) is a gesture, so which houses he means is inferred (4th for school, 7th for wife), not stated.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th and 5th for learning and the 7th for the wife are standard.

hindi: बहुत बढ़िया कॉमिनेशन है शरीर राहु इकट्ठा होना
says: He calls a certain planet-with-Rahu pairing a very fine combination. The first planet's name is garbled in the caption as 'शरीर', and the context of feminine planets and the wife's seat suggests Venus, with Saturn as the other possible guess.
cells_derived_method: The house shows where the pairing acts. If it is Venus with Rahu, desire, glamour and foreign colour are amplified in that house's topic; if it is Saturn with Rahu, discipline meets obsession there. Readings below are derived and rest on a guess about the garbled planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived (if the garbled planet is Venus): Venus with Rahu in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) gives a glamorous, foreign or unconventional flavour to the spouse and to partnerships.
Derived (if Venus): Venus with Rahu in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius) amplifies comforts, vehicles and luxury at home, with a risk of restlessness inside the house.
Derived (if Saturn): Saturn with Rahu in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) is a driven, industrial career pairing with high ambition and power over work.

ambiguity: 'शरीर' is not a planet; it is probably शुक्र (Venus) or शनि (Saturn) misheard. He also may be pointing at a chart on screen, so the house is unknown.
classical_check: Differs or mixed: classically Venus with Rahu gives worldly gain and indulgence with relationship risk, and Saturn with Rahu is a hard pairing; neither is called plainly 'very good'.

hindi: खूब दारू पियो कुछ नहीं होगा फैक्ट हैय दारू की गिफ्ट करो दारू का साज सामान लो सब कुछ वही लो
says: Remedy tied to the Rahu pairing just named: he says drink liquor freely, claiming nothing will happen, gift liquor, and take liquor accessories, since in his scheme liquor is Rahu's item. This records his claim only and is not endorsed as health advice.
ambiguity: Could be a donation (daan) instruction for Rahu, or a literal permission to drink, or a joke. 'कुछ नहीं होगा' (nothing will happen) is a claim about this chart, not a general health statement.
classical_check: Partly agrees: some remedial lore links Rahu with intoxicants and offerings of them, but orthodox texts forbid liquor for most people; the permissive drinking claim is his own.

gist: Aside that people do not usually talk about Pluto, leading into what happens wherever Pluto sits in the chart.

hindi: प्लूटो बैठा है प्लूटो प्लूटो यहां बैठा है खुद को मारोगे यहां बैठा है मां को मारेगा पढ़ाई को मारेगा यहां काम को मारेगा पत्नी को मारेगा बच्चे को मार देगा अगर अच्छा बैठा
says: Reading Pluto by the life area it sits in, pointing at his chart: in the self place it ruins the native, in the mother place the mother's side, in the study place the studies, in the work place the work, in the wife place the wife's side, and in the child place the children's side. 'Kill' is his strong word for destroying that area; the thought continues with the good-placement case.
cells_derived_method: Each house is a life area (1st self, 4th mother and basic study, 5th children and study, 7th wife, 10th work). Pluto's harm falls on the area of the house it occupies, and the sign sets the manner (fixed signs slow and grinding, movable signs abrupt, dual signs split or doubled).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Gemini in the 1st (lagna Gemini) turns the harm on the native's own identity and confidence, a self-undermining and nervous streak.
Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo) hits the mother's side and peace at home, with intensity, secrecy or sudden upheaval around property.
Derived: Pluto in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) hits career and public standing, with a post that is taken away or must be rebuilt from nothing.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo) hits the wife's side and partnerships, with detachment and sudden breaks in the bond.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) is a gesture, so house numbers are inferred from the topics (self 1, mother 4, study 4 or 5, work 10, wife 7, child 5). 'मारेगा' literally means kill; like the earlier death list it most likely means ruin of that area, and no death is predicted.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto, but the logic matches classical bhava-nasha, where a malefic in a house harms that house's matters; the house-to-topic mapping used is standard.

hindi: है तो शनि जैसा दाता है यमराज क्या दे रहा है जीवन दान दे रहा है जीवन दे रहा है
says: The other side of the previous claim: when Pluto is well placed it acts as a giver like Saturn, and Yamraj then gives the gift of life. A good Pluto revives or sustains the area it sits in.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Pluto restores the area of its house instead of ruining it, and the sign tells the style of the revival (fixed signs lasting, movable signs fresh starts).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus) gives a career that renews itself, with a job or position that returns or is handed over without struggle.
Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio) revives children, creativity and study matters, with results arriving almost on their own.
Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Capricorn in the 1st (lagna Capricorn) gives the native resilience and repeated fresh starts after setbacks.

ambiguity: 'अच्छा बैठा' (well seated) is not defined: no sign, dignity or aspect test is given.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; compares it to Saturn, who classically gives lasting results after delay when well placed.

hindi: अगर प्लूटो आपका अच्छा बैठा है आपने यहां पढ़ाई में यह पढ़ाई का स्थान है विद्या क्या कमाल होगा आपने सिर्फ एडमिशन लेना है आप पास हो जाओगे
says: If Pluto is well placed in the education seat (vidya), the result is wonderful: you only have to take admission and you will pass. The study house gets the life-giving side of Pluto.
cells_derived_method: The house meant is the study seat, classically the 4th for schooling, the 5th for intelligence and the 9th for higher study; the sign shows the type of subject and the ease of the path.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius): schooling and basic degrees come smoothly and steadily, admission is easy and passing follows.
Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini): exams go well in law, arts or negotiation-linked subjects, as if success arrived by itself.
Derived: a well-placed Pluto in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): higher or foreign study opens without much effort.
