ambiguity: 'यह पढ़ाई का स्थान है' is a pointing gesture, so the house number is inferred. 'अच्छा बैठा' is again undefined.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; the study houses (4th, 5th, 9th) are standard.

gist: Anecdotes of students who say they do not know how their engineering got done, or how the girl or boy for marriage just appeared by itself.

hindi: शनि का भी यही कार्य चलता है क्यार प्रकट ही हुए पता ही नहीं यार क्या हुआ समझ नहीं आया यार समझ नहीं आया
says: Saturn works the same way as a good Pluto: results simply appear and the person cannot tell how or when they happened, leaving them baffled.
ambiguity: 'क्यार प्रकट ही हुए' is garbled; it reads as 'यार, प्रकट ही हुए' (things simply appeared).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn's results come quietly and slowly without show, but classical texts do not call them effortless.

gist: Car-crash style joke: nobody understands death, it comes at speed round a turn and hits us, and we do not even know when we died.

hindi: ऐसे ही पास कब हुए पता ही नहीं शादी कब हुई पता ही नहीं अमीर कब बने पता ही नहीं
says: He applies the unnoticed-arrival idea to good outcomes: exams passed, marriage and becoming rich all come without the person knowing when, just as death arrives unnoticed. These three are his examples of what a good Pluto or Saturn delivers silently.
cells_derived_method: The outcome follows the house of the planet: studies 4th or 5th, marriage 7th, wealth 2nd or 11th; the sign shows how smooth the arrival is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a silent-result Pluto in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is the marriage case: the match comes together without the native knowing how.
Derived: a silent-result Pluto in Sagittarius in the 11th (lagna Aquarius) is the wealth case: gains and income grow without a visible turning point.

ambiguity: He names no planet in this sentence; Pluto and Saturn are carried over from the lines before.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie unnoticed arrival of results to a planet.

hindi: ये कब होगा प्लूटो प्लूटो कौन है मौत का देवता
says: He answers 'when does this happen?' by naming Pluto, and then defines Pluto as the god of death.
ambiguity: 'ये कब होगा प्लूटो' could mean 'when Pluto is good' or simply 'this is Pluto's doing'; he gives no timing.
classical_check: Silent: classically the god of death is Yama, tied to Saturn and the 8th house, not to a planet Pluto.

hindi: कौन है मौत के लोग जितने लोग आपके जीवन के अंदर आपके शत्रु बने बैठे हैं आप जिनसे शत्रु बने बैठे हो जिनकी वजह से आप घबराते हो
says: Pluto's 'death people' are all those who have turned into your enemies, the people because of whom you feel panic and dread. In a native's life, enemies are Pluto's agents.
cells_derived_method: Enemies are classically the 6th (open foes) and the 12th (hidden foes); the house Pluto sits in decides whether the 'death people' are open opponents, hidden enemies or enemies of that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini) makes the 'death people' open opponents, such as rivals, litigants and competitors, fierce and relentless.
Derived: Pluto in Libra in the 12th (lagna Scorpio) makes them hidden enemies, people who undermine you from behind or from far away while looking friendly.

ambiguity: 'मौत के लोग' (people of death) is his phrase for Pluto's agents; it is unclear whether he means actual enemies or anyone who threatens your peace.
classical_check: Agrees that enemies sit in the 6th and 12th; Pluto as the planet is not classical.

hindi: घबराना डरना नहीं डरना शनि के पास है घबराना वो सब प्लूटो है
says: He separates two emotions: fear or dread (डरना) belongs to Saturn, while panic and nervous anxiety (घबराना) belong to Pluto.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn as the planet of fear and anxiety is classical; Pluto is not.

hindi: उन सबसे घबराना बंद कर दो
says: Remedy: stop panicking about all those enemies. Dropping Pluto-style anxiety is the first step in his plan.
classical_check: Silent: a behavioural instruction, not a classical remedy.

hindi: और बीच में किसे ले आओ वरुण को कौन है कृपा प्रेम परमात्मा
says: Bring Varuna (Neptune) into the middle, between you and the enemies. Neptune stands for grace, love and God.
ambiguity: 'बीच में' (in the middle) most likely means between you and Pluto's enemies, matching the earlier claim that Pluto must cross Neptune.
classical_check: Silent: Varuna is a Vedic deity, but not a graha in classical Jyotish.

hindi: किसी भी रूप में जैसे ही आप उसको ले आए स्त्री रूप में वरुण रूप में प्रेम रूप में परमात्मा रूप में ऑटोमेटिक आपके सारे शत्रु मर जाएंगे
says: Remedy: invite Neptune's grace in any one of four forms, as a woman, as Varuna, as love or as God, and all your enemies will die out automatically.
ambiguity: 'शत्रु मर जाएंगे' most likely means the enemies' hostility ends rather than literal deaths.
classical_check: Silent: no classical remedy of this kind.

hindi: शत्रु कौन है कोर्ट कचहरी शत्रु कौन है आपके भाई रास्ते में किसी ने पैसे उगा लिए कोई लड़ने बैठ गया
says: He lists who the 'enemies' are: court cases, your brothers, someone who cheated you out of money on the way, and someone who sat down to fight with you.
cells_derived_method: The kind of enemy follows the house Pluto sits in: the 6th for court and litigation, the 3rd and 11th for brothers, the 2nd and 11th for money cheated away; the sign shows the style of the enemy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Sagittarius in the 6th (lagna Cancer) is the court-case reading: legal disputes and long litigation with moral or religious overtones.
Derived: Pluto in Libra in the 3rd (lagna Leo) is the brothers-as-enemies reading: a rivalry or fallout with siblings that stays polite on the surface.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries) is the money-cheating reading: gains lost to a friend, a network or a group that cheats you.

ambiguity: He names no planet in the sentence; Pluto is carried over from the previous lines on enemies. Brothers are listed as enemies, which he does not explain.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th house for litigation and enemies and the 3rd for siblings are standard; brothers as natural enemies is his own framing.

hindi: आपको हर हालत में कृपा लेनी है इसलिए अक्सर कहा जाता है घर की स्त्री का आशीर्वाद लेते चलो
says: Under every circumstance you must secure grace, and for that reason the common saying advises you to keep taking the blessing of the woman of the house. He presents the folk advice as the practical form of Neptune's protection.
classical_check: Silent: respect for the mother or wife is common advice but not a graha remedy in classical texts.

hindi: अगर घर की स्त्री बहुत कलह करती है क्लेश करती है झंझट करती है उसमें मैस्क निटी बहुत ज्यादा है वो खुद को सुधारे नहीं तो वो खुद को नष्ट कर देगी
says: If the woman of the house quarrels, creates strife and trouble a lot, he reads it as too much masculinity in her; unless she corrects herself, she will ruin herself.
ambiguity: Masculinity is not tied to any planet; it could be read as strong Mars, Sun or Rahu in her chart, but he does not say. 'मैस्क निटी' is the English word masculinity in Devanagari.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe quarrels as a masculine excess of the wife.

hindi: ऐसी स्त्रियां भी है जो खुद को ही नष्ट कर रही है उनका जीवन नष्ट है उनको कोई प्रेम नहीं करता उनके जीवन में कोई पुरुष नहीं है ना भाई है ना पिता है ना पति है ना पुत्र है
says: Describes women who are destroying themselves: their life is ruined, nobody loves them, and no male relation stands by them, not a brother, father, husband or son. He presents it as the end state of the quarrelsome pattern just described.
ambiguity: This is an outcome described from conduct; no chart indicator is given in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; classically lack of male support would be read from afflicted 3rd or 11th (brothers), 9th (father), 7th (husband) and 5th (son).

hindi: प्लूटो नाराज है पुरुष शब्द का सुख नहीं देगा ना भाई से मिला ना पिता से ना पति से ना पुत्र से
says: When Pluto is angry it denies the happiness of the male relations altogether, with nothing coming from brother, father, husband or son. He ties the loveless, male-less state above to an angry Pluto.
cells_derived_method: Each male relation has a house (brother 3rd or 11th, father 9th, husband 7th, son 5th); an angry (afflicted) Pluto on or in that house withholds that relation's support, and the sign shows the manner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an angry Pluto in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) withholds the husband's support: a husband who is absent, harsh or lost in quarrels.
Derived: an angry Pluto in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn) withholds the son's support: a son who is distant or whose bond is cold.
Derived: an angry Pluto in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) withholds the father's support: a father who is absent, proud or unavailable.
Derived: an angry Pluto in Cancer in the 11th (lagna Virgo) withholds the elder brother's support: a sibling bond that feels cold or draining.

ambiguity: 'नाराज' (angry) is not defined as a placement; it likely means an afflicted or ill-placed Pluto. 'पुरुष शब्द का सुख' means the happiness of the male relation.
classical_check: Agrees with the house logic for male relations; Pluto itself is not classical.

hindi: आपके जीवन में करना क्या है फिर घबराना बंद करना है कुड़ना बंद करना है सड़ना बंद करना है आप घबराते रहते हो सारे टाइम खुद को कोसना
says: Remedy summary: what you must do is stop panicking, stop fretting, stop rotting inside, and stop cursing yourself all the time, since constant worry is the Pluto trap.
classical_check: Silent: a behavioural instruction, not a classical remedy.

hindi: मिनिमम बेर घटे हुए लेवल पर जाकर के आप मौत का साक्षात करते हो
says: The caption is broken, but he seems to say that when you go down to a minimal, stripped-down level you come face to face with death, that is, you meet Pluto's matter directly.
ambiguity: 'मिनिमम बेर' may be 'minimum bare' (bare minimum) and 'घटे हुए लेवल' a reduced level; 'साक्षात' may be साक्षात्कार (an interview or meeting) or साक्षात (in person).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बर्फ जैसा ठंडा है प्लूटो 400 डिग्री कहते हैं टेंपरेचर है माइनस में यानी बर्फ का पहाड़ है पूरा बर्फी बर्फ है
says: Pluto is as cold as ice; he quotes a temperature of about minus 400 degrees and calls it a whole mountain of ice. Coldness is the chief nature he gives Pluto.
ambiguity: The figure is the caption's. Pluto's surface is about minus 230 degrees Celsius (about minus 380 Fahrenheit), so 400 is likely Fahrenheit rounded; astrologically only the 'cold' nature matters.
classical_check: Silent: no classical Pluto; cold and dry is classically Saturn's quality.

hindi: इतना कोल्ड यानी आप इतने कोल्ड हो चुके हो इतने सड़ चुके इतने कुड़की हो नेचर के अंदर के त भाव
says: He turns Pluto's coldness into a personal warning: you have become that cold, that rotten and resentful in nature. The inner feelings (the last word is broken in the caption) that match Pluto's ice are bitterness and decay in your temperament.
ambiguity: 'कुड़की' is probably 'कुढ़ा हुआ' (resentful) and 'त भाव' is cut, possibly 'दुर्भाव' (ill feelings); the exact last phrase is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सावित्री ने जाकर के खूब गप्पे मारी खूब बातचीत करी अमरा से आपको मौत से बात करनी है
says: Savitri went to Yamraj and chatted and talked with him at length; likewise you should talk to death. Conversation with Pluto's matter, rather than fear, is the method.
ambiguity: The caption's 'अमरा' is read as Yamraj. 'मौत से बात करनी है' is figurative: it means facing and talking over the matter that is dying, not literal speech with death.
classical_check: Silent: the myth is used as a model, no classical remedy of this form.

hindi: आपका जब भी घर की डीलिंग मर रही है बैठो आराम से मुन्ना के नीचे है ठीक है शनि के ठीक नीचे उससे बात करो यार मकान तुझे खरीदना था क्या करें
says: Remedy for a failing property deal: sit down calmly and talk to Pluto, who is placed exactly below Saturn, starting with words like 'I was to buy you, what do I do now?'.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना के नीचे' is garbled, possibly 'घुटने के नीचे' (below the knee) in his body map. 'Talk to him' may mean addressing Pluto, the lost deal itself, or the opposing party.
classical_check: Silent: a conversational remedy with no classical basis; classically property is the 4th house.

hindi: सारा सम्मोहन प्लूटो के पास है सोहन का देवता नेप्चून और प्लूटो
says: All hypnosis and enchantment (सम्मोहन) belongs to Pluto, and the deities of it are Neptune and Pluto together. This explains why talking to them can change the situation.
ambiguity: 'सोहन का देवता' is the caption's version of 'सम्मोहन का देवता' (god of hypnosis); the link to the talking remedy is inferred.
classical_check: Silent: classically hypnotic influence is not given to outer planets.

hindi: यार इतनी हमने मकान लिया था क्या हुआ नौकरी यार छूट गई क्यों छूट गई तो तेरे को छूटना नहीं चाहिए था मुझे चाहिए थी तेरी जरूरत थी कपशप मारो देखो आपको कॉल
says: A sample of the conversation method: speak to the lost house or job like a friend, saying 'we took the house, what happened, the job slipped away, why did it go, you should not have left, I needed you', and chat it out. The line is cut off at the end of the batch.
ambiguity: The last words 'देखो आपको कॉल' are cut off by the batch boundary, so the sentence is unfinished.
classical_check: Silent: a talk-it-out remedy with no classical basis.

hindi: पता ही नहीं कैसे कॉल आ गई अपने आप पता नहीं हम विदेश कैसे चले गए अपने आप यह सारे के सारे शनि महाराज और प्लूटो के कॉमिनेशन से होते हैं
says: Events that seem to arrive on their own, such as an unexpected call or going abroad without knowing how, all come from the Saturn and Pluto combination.
cells_derived_method: Foreign travel reads from the 12th and 9th houses, calls and news from the 3rd; the house holding Saturn with Pluto decides which kind of unnoticed event arrives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn with Pluto in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer) points to a move abroad that happens without planning.
Derived: Saturn with Pluto in Libra in the 3rd (lagna Leo) points to an unexpected call or message that changes direction.

ambiguity: 'Combination' may mean conjunction, aspect or just both being strong; not specified.
classical_check: Silent: Pluto is not classical; foreign travel from the 12th is standard.

gist: Says do not ask too many details, they are reading the chart in broad strokes with whatever data is available.
Introduces Lord Rama's chart and explains why it is chosen: Rama was born with great maryada and an exemplary personality that people cannot imagine anyone could follow.

hindi: य पहला घर है दूसरा तीसरा चौथा पांच छ सात आ 9 10 11 12 ये एेंट लिखा है वन नंबर एेंट का मतलब होता है एक नंबर एेंट मतलब भाव
says: He shows how to read the chart: the boxes are the houses numbered 1 to 12, and the number written is the house (bhava), not the sign.
ambiguity: 'एेंट' is a caption garble of the English word for house or ascendant label; the sign number comes separately next.
classical_check: Agrees: house numbers counted from the lagna are standard.

hindi: अब यहां पर बृहस्पति भी और चंद्रमा भी चार नंबर की राशि है बृहस्पति का क्या खेल है गुरु है वो गुरु चार नंबर का
says: In Rama's chart Jupiter and the Moon sit together in sign number 4, Cancer, in the first house. Jupiter is the guru placed in sign 4.
ambiguity: He says sign number 4 and the lagna is also Cancer, so house 1 is read from the chart shown.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter exalted in Cancer.

hindi: यह चंद्रमा मां है यह माता अपने घर के चार नंबर होता है चंद्रमा का
says: The Moon is the mother, and sign number 4 is the Moon's own home.
ambiguity: Could also be read as the 4th house being the mother's house; both coincide in this chart.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is mother karaka, Cancer its own sign, 4th house the mother.

gist: Names the other planets in the chart in passing: Moon, Sun, Mercury, Rahu, Venus and Varuna.

hindi: तो चार नंबर में चंद्रमा अपना घर अपने घर है ये माता का या देवी मां जो मां है चंद्रकांता
says: The Moon is in its own home in sign 4, and this stands for the mother or the goddess-mother, also called Chandrakanta.
ambiguity: 'चंद्रकांता' as a name is a poetic touch, not a technical term.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon in Cancer is own sign.

hindi: यानी चंद्र ग्रह के अपने घर में गुरु आया है सबसे ऊंचे पद पर बिठा है यानी जो गुरु पूरे सोलर सिस्टम को चला रहा है हमारे शरीर के अंदर हमारे जिंदगी को चला रहा है जो गाइड करता है
says: Jupiter has come into the Moon's home and sits at its highest post. Jupiter runs the solar system and our body and life as the guide, so here it gives the best results.
cells_derived_method: The best fruit shows in the house Jupiter holds with Cancer; in the 1st it lifts the whole personality, in the 5th children and learning.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces) gives wise, protected children and intelligence.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) gives strong luck and a guru-like father figure.

ambiguity: 'सबसे ऊंचे पद' means exaltation.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter exalted in Cancer.

hindi: चार नंबर मीन उच्च का उच्च मींस अपने घर में भी इतना मौज नहीं करता है जितना यह चंद्रमा के घर जाकर करता है
says: Jupiter in sign 4 is exalted, and it enjoys itself more there in the Moon's home than in its own homes.
classical_check: Agrees: exaltation is held stronger than own sign.

hindi: और चंद्रमा इसके साथ पावर पकड़ के बृहस्पति चंद्र यह गजकेसरी योग होता है गजकेसरी योग सैकड़ों लोगों की कुंडली में होता है उससे कुछ नहीं होता
says: The Moon gains power with Jupiter, forming the Gajakesari yoga. He warns that this yoga is present in hundreds of charts and by itself does nothing.
classical_check: Agrees that Gajakesari is common and needs strength; texts promote it more than he does.

hindi: तो इनका गजकेसरी योग है कि यह महान प्रतापी कमाल लग्न मैं यह मैं है यह मेरी मां है ये बाप है या पत्नी है ऐसे ऐसे चलता है
says: Rama's Gajakesari is great because it falls in the lagna, the 'I' house; he then reads the houses as relations: the lagna is me, then mother, father, wife in order.
ambiguity: The reason that makes it powerful is only hinted; the lagna position is the stated difference.
classical_check: Agrees: Gajakesari is strongest in kendras and the lagna.

hindi: अब ये कहते हैं मैं राजा बनूंगा तो ये राजा बनेंगे राजा ही हैं और राजा ही बने
says: With Jupiter and Moon in the lagna, whatever he says, such as 'I will be king', comes true; Rama was a king and did become king.
ambiguity: Rama's own ruling was disrupted by exile, which he discusses next.
classical_check: Agrees: Gajakesari in the lagna gives rank.

gist: Asks where the trouble comes in along the way, leading into the next point.

hindi: पर है दूसरा घर इनका सूर्य का चार पांच नंबर राशि
says: The caption suggests that the Sun's own home, sign 5 (Leo), falls in the second house of this chart; the line is garbled.
ambiguity: 'चार पांच नंबर' is unclear; with Cancer lagna the 2nd house is Leo, which fits.
classical_check: Agrees that Leo is the Sun's sign and 2nd from Cancer.

hindi: अब सूर्य कहां बैठा है सूर्य बैठा है कर्म स्थान में ये दसवां घर है दसवां घर एक नंबर राशि मींस मंगल की सेनापति के घर है ये भी हो चुका है बेस्टेस्ट अपने घर से भी ज्यादा पावरफुल
says: The Sun sits in the karma sthana, the 10th house, in sign 1, Aries, the home of Mars the commander. This is its best (exalted) placement, more powerful than its own sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun exalted in Aries and strong in the 10th.

hindi: मंगल चार 10 नंबर का है यह भी हो चुका है
says: Mars is in sign 10, Capricorn, which is also exalted, so this planet is done at its best too.
ambiguity: 'चार 10' is garbled; sign 10 is clear. The 7th house is implied by the chart but not said.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars exalted in Capricorn.

hindi: शनि की ऐसी पेल के शनि शुक्र वरुण के घर में यह भी हो चुका है
says: Saturn is also exalted, sitting in the home of Venus and Varuna, which is Libra.
ambiguity: Garbled opening phrase; Libra as 'Venus and Varuna's home' fits his scheme of two lords.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn exalted in Libra; Neptune lordship is his.

hindi: अब यह दुष्ट ग्रह कहता है मैं नास पीटू
says: The malefic planet, here Saturn, says it will wreck things: even among exalted planets Saturn threatens ruin.
ambiguity: The planet is not named in the sentence; Saturn is inferred from the next section.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is a natural malefic.

hindi: सबसे ऊंची क्वालिटी का मंगल कहता है मैं अच्छाई दूंगा पत्नी में गर्म हिसाब किताब सबसे उच्च क्वालिटी
says: Mars of the highest quality promises good results; in the wife's area it gives heat and sharp dealings, of top quality.
ambiguity: 'पत्नी में' places Mars in the wife's house, the 7th; 'गर्म हिसाब किताब' is a loose phrase.
classical_check: Partly differs: Mars in the 7th is classically Mangal dosha, though exalted Mars forms Ruchaka yoga.

hindi: सूर्य कहता है मैं राज पाठ और फेम कराऊंगा सबसे उच क्वालिटी
says: The exalted Sun in the 10th gives rule, authority and fame of the highest quality.
classical_check: Agrees: strong Sun in the 10th gives status.

hindi: चंद्रमा और बृहस्पति कहते हैं मैं राजा बनाऊंगा इतना ऊंचा इतना महान इतनी कमाल की बात सबसे उच्च क्वालिटी
says: The Moon and Jupiter in the lagna promise kingship at the highest level.
classical_check: Agrees: Gajakesari with exalted Jupiter in a kendra gives rank.

hindi: यह शुक्र है य यह भी उच का है केतु अपने घर का है बड़ी अजीब कॉमिनेशन है ऐसा आदमी ने तो भगवान ही बनना है
says: Venus is also exalted and Ketu is in its own home; this is a strange combination, and such a person has to become godlike.
ambiguity: Sign is not said; Pisces is inferred from Venus exalted, and Ketu's own home in his scheme is Pisces.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus exalted in Pisces; Ketu's own sign is not classical.

hindi: यह कहता है मैं भाग्यशाली बनाऊंगा इतना तगड़ा भाग्यशाली कुछ भी क्यों ना हो जाए इस इंसान का नसीब अल्टीमेटली इसे बचाता रहेगा चाहे कुछ भी हो
says: This planet promises great luck so strong that whatever happens, the person's fortune will keep saving him in the end.
ambiguity: The speaking planet is not named; the 9th house luck link and Venus come from the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees: strong 9th house and exalted lord of luck protect.

hindi: फिर राहु अपने घर का है केतु भी अपने घर का है कौन से ग्रह को पकड़े हम कहां जाए कुछ नहीं छूटा
says: Rahu and Ketu are also in their own homes; every planet is in strength, so nothing is left out.
ambiguity: Signs not said; own home for Rahu is Virgo in his scheme, which is the 3rd here.
classical_check: Silent: Rahu and Ketu own signs are not classical.

hindi: बुध भी अकेला अकेला बुध बहुत अच्छा होता है बुद्धि अकेली बहुत अच्छी यह शुक्र के घर का है शुक्र दो नंबर यह मित्र है इसका परम मित्र परम मित्र है
says: Mercury sits alone, which is very good for intelligence, in Venus's home, sign 2, Taurus, where its supreme friend rules.
ambiguity: 'Alone' is not defined; it means no other planet shares the house.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is friendly with Venus.

gist: Asks where the damage and the problem come from in such a perfect chart.

hindi: हर ग्रह यहां तो उच्च का है सामने नीच का है यह उच्च का है यहां नीचे यह उच्च यहां नीचे जो जहां सबसे अच्छा फल दे रहा है व वहां सबसे घटिया फल दे रहा है
says: Each planet exalted in one house is debilitated in the house opposite; where it gives the best result, it also gives the worst result in the house facing it.
cells_derived_method: For a planet in its exaltation sign in house H, its debilitation sign falls in the 7th from H, so it harms the topic of that opposite house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) throws a weak, debilitated face on the 4th house of home and mother.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) turns its debilitated side on the 10th house of career.

ambiguity: He may mean aspect from the opposite house or the debilitation sign opposite; not fully explained.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not state this opposition rule.

hindi: यह भाग्य का घर है और पिता का घर है और भाग्य घर के ठीक सामने होता है भाई बहनों का घर भाई है
says: The 9th is the house of luck and the father, and directly opposite it sits the 3rd house of brothers and sisters.
classical_check: Agrees: 9th luck and father, 3rd siblings.

hindi: य शुक्र उ चका है इसका नीच फलिया है भाई भाई से अलग करा दिया
says: Venus is exalted in the 9th and its low result lands on the 3rd house, which separated brother from brother in Rama's life.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'उ चका' and 'फलिया'.
classical_check: Silent: his opposition-house logic.

hindi: यह शुक्र है उच्च का सर्वश्रेष्ठ राजा के यही पैदा होना है लेकिन शुक्र ग्रह क्या होता है शुक्र जहां होता है मारक होता है
says: Exalted Venus gives birth in a royal family, but Venus is a maraka: wherever it sits it ends or kills what that house stands for.
cells_derived_method: Venus ends the matters of the house it sits in; the sign adds how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) harms the father's side while giving a high birth.
Derived: Venus in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) would be read as harming spouse matters.

ambiguity: Maraka here is his usage, not the classical 2nd/7th lord meaning.
classical_check: Differs: classically maraka refers to 2nd and 7th lords.

hindi: अब शुक्र क्या कर रहा है बाप को मार दिया
says: He says Venus here ended the father, tying Dasharatha's death to Venus in the 9th. His claim only; no timing recorded.
ambiguity: Death language is tradition and story based.
classical_check: Silent: classically father is read from 9th or 10th and its lord.

hindi: अब कहेंगे उच्च का शुक्र और मार दिया यस नीच का शनि सड़ा सड़ा के दूर कर देता है उच्च का शुक्र मार देता है
says: Even exalted Venus kills; debilitated Saturn rots a thing slowly and drives it away, but exalted Venus ends it outright.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर ये नीच का शुक्र होता तो मरने जिंदा पैदा होने से पैदा होने के बाद में ही बाप मर जाता हो सकता है गर्भ में ही बाप मर जाता ये मार सकता है ऑटोमेटिक
says: If Venus had been debilitated, the father might have died soon after birth or even in the womb. Death-timing claim recorded as his, not endorsed.
ambiguity: Virgo is Venus's debilitation sign; the house is the 9th by implication.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां सूर्य कह रहा है लाजवाब करूंगा यहां शनि कह रहा बर्बाद करूंगा यहां सूर्य कहता है यहां लाजवाब करूंगा ये कहता है बर्बाद करूंगा बाप बेटे की आपस में नहीं बनेगी
says: The Sun in the 10th promises excellence while Saturn in the 4th, directly opposite, promises ruin, so father and son will not get along.
cells_derived_method: A bright planet facing a malefic across the 4th and 10th axis splits the home and career axis, hurting the father bond.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) facing Saturn in Aquarius in the 4th would give the same father-son friction.

ambiguity: Father-son friction is read from the Sun and Saturn pair, not stated by house.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun-Saturn opposition strains the father relation.

hindi: वो तो मर्यादा पुरुषोत्तम है क्यों क्योंकि चंद्रमा बहुत निर्मल है इसलिए बहुत ही शांत स्वभाव के हैं चंद्रमा अच्छा है महा शांत स्वभाव के हैं राम जी कहते हैं कोई नहीं यार
says: Rama still behaved with perfect dignity because his Moon is very pure, which makes him extremely calm in nature, so he just says it is okay despite the friction.
ambiguity: 'निर्मल' (pure) is not defined as a technical measure.
classical_check: Agrees: a strong, unafflicted Moon gives a calm mind.

gist: Tells how the father finally asked Rama to accept exile but Rama refused to listen to anyone and stood firm.

hindi: तीसरा राहु है पराक्रम जो खोपड़ी में घुस गया ना एक बार घुस गया धरती पर कोई नहीं बदल सकता खुद भी नहीं बदलूंगा चाहे कुछ भी क्यों ना हो जाए
says: Rahu in the 3rd, the house of courage, makes a resolve stick in the head; once fixed, nobody can change it, not even the person himself.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 3rd locks will and courage; sign colours the stubbornness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) gives a headstrong, daring resolve.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 3rd (lagna Leo) gives a fixed idea about fairness or deals.

ambiguity: Sign not said; Virgo is implied by Cancer lagna.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu in the 3rd gives courage and obstinacy.

hindi: लफड़ा सारी कुंडली का एक ही आता है यह शनि जो है यह सूर्य के सीधा टक्कर में यह दूर है य लिखा नहीं यह रेट्रोग्रेड है वक्री है
says: The one problem in the whole chart is Saturn, which faces the Sun head-on and is retrograde, although the chart does not mark it.
ambiguity: Retrograde is not marked on the chart he shows.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn opposes the Sun.

hindi: यह एस्पेक्ट की कोई बात नहीं करता जो वक्री शब्द की बात हमने करी है वक्री मींस वक्र उल्टा चल रहा है
says: Nobody talks about aspects of retrograde planets; vakri means moving crooked or backward.
classical_check: Agrees on the meaning of vakri.

hindi: है ये उच्च का लेकिन वक्री हो गया उल्टा पीछे की ओर अच्छा है ये पीछे की ओर अच्छा है
says: Saturn is exalted but retrograde, so it works backward and pulls results in reverse.
ambiguity: The phrase 'अच्छा है' is rhetorical filler.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically retrograde adds strength.

hindi: ऐसा आदमी घर के लिए कुछ चौथा घर का शनि है ना घर से दूर जहां हो वहां से दूर
says: Retrograde Saturn in the 4th house keeps the person away from home and away from wherever he is.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 4th takes one from home.

hindi: यह राजपाट है फेम है दूर नाम से दूर दूर वक्री हर समय राम जी के जीवन में कष्ट ही रहा
says: The retrograde Saturn keeps rule and fame far away and Rama's life was always full of hardship.
ambiguity: Fame and distance are contradictory in the next lines.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह सुख का भाव है चौथा घर यह मां का भाव है मां से दूर रहे सुख से दूर रहे फेम मिली नेम मिला साथ ही बदनामी भी मिली उतना नेगेटिविटी मिली वनवास मिला यह वक्री ग्रह का खेल है
says: The 4th is the house of happiness and the mother; Rama stayed away from mother and joy, got fame with infamy and exile, which he calls the retrograde planet's play.
classical_check: Agrees: 4th is happiness and mother.

hindi: यहां कोई भी वक्री है चौथे घर में अपनी अपनी ताकत के अनुसार कबाड़ा करेगा
says: Any retrograde planet in the 4th house will spoil that house in proportion to its strength.
cells_derived_method: Damage lands on home, mother and peace; the sign decides which planet is strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Saturn in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) strains home and mother heavily.
Derived: retrograde Mars in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries) damages home peace.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर बुध वक्री है वह महीना डेढ़ महीने का खेल करले तो एक राशि में आता है सूर्य के साथ-साथ रहता है व क्या उखाड़ लेगा 10 दिन पाच दिन के लिए वक्री हो के महीना वक्री होके शुक्र भी
says: Retrograde Mercury and Venus do little harm because they stay near the Sun and are retrograde only days or a month, so their effect is small.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि वक्री होता है चार महीने हो गया फिर छ महीने सीधा हो गया फिर दो महीने हो गया ढाई साल तो एक राशि में रहना है इसने न चाएगा
says: Saturn is retrograde about four months, then direct six months, with 2.5 years in a sign, so its retrograde effect lasts much longer and matters more.
ambiguity: The numbers are approximate.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn spends about 2.5 years per sign.

hindi: शुक्र की दृष्टि क्या एक ही जगह बुध की क्या है एक ही जगह शनि की कहां है चार जगह पूरी कुंडली की बैंड बजा के रखेगा
says: Venus and Mercury aspect only one place, but Saturn aspects several places, so it can shake the whole chart.
ambiguity: He says four places; classically Saturn has three aspects.
classical_check: Differs on count: Saturn aspects 3rd, 7th and 10th.

hindi: अब यहां से वक्री शनि ने यहां दृष्टि दे दी तीसरी शत्रु बनवा दिए कर्म करा दिया फालतू का वनवास भेज दिया और ये लगन पर चंद्रमा को दूषित कर दिया
says: From the 4th, retrograde Saturn aspects the 6th (enemies), the 10th (action, pointless exile) and the lagna, spoiling the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects 3rd, 7th and 10th from its house, here the 6th, 10th and 1st.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer) hits 6th Sagittarius, 10th Aries and 1st Cancer.

ambiguity: 'तीसरी' is the third aspect.
classical_check: Agrees on Saturn's aspects.

hindi: बृहस्पति तो दबा नहीं इससे लेकिन इसकी दृष्टि है चंद्रमा दबा दिया मन दबा हुआ है मन में जो आ गया दबाव दूसरे के कहना मानते गए जो कहते गए हुकम फॉलो करते गए
says: Jupiter was not suppressed but the Moon was, so the mind was pressed and he obeyed others' orders.
classical_check: Agrees: afflicted Moon gives a pressured mind.

gist: Rama listened to whoever spoke, such as the washerman, and followed every command.

hindi: और अल्टीमेटली क्या हुआ कोई वजूद नहीं बन पाया लेकिन कमाल की प्रतिभा थी कमाल के ग्रह थे भगवान ही कहलाना था इसलिए उच्च के
says: In the end he built no personal existence, yet the excellent talent and exalted planets meant he had to be called God.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the end of the batch.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ग्रह कितने हैं कुंडली में कुंडली कितनी पावरफुल है आप अपने जीवन में कुछ नहीं है सिवाय ग्रहों के जो जो ग्रहों ने किस्मत ने बना दिया वही है
says: He says the chart is very powerful: in your life nothing exists except the planets, and whatever fate and the planets have made is what you have.
ambiguity: A strongly deterministic claim; he does not mention free will or karma balance.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give planets a strong role but leave room for effort and remedy.

hindi: जितनी जल्दी एक्सेप्ट करेंगे कृपा मिलनी शुरू हो जाएगी नेगेटिव बंद हो जाएगा
says: Remedy by attitude: the sooner you accept what the planets have given, the sooner grace begins and the negativity stops.
classical_check: Silent: acceptance as a remedy is his own.

hindi: यह लड़ना बेकार यार वो बंदा क्यों कर रहा है बढ़िया काम यार वो कम पढ़ा लिखा है उसके ना राहु मंगल केतु बढ़िया है उसके ग्रह अच्छे
says: Fighting is useless: when a less educated person does well, it is because his Rahu, Mars and Ketu are good, his own planets are favourable.
ambiguity: Which houses make Rahu, Mars and Ketu good is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: success follows the chart, not education alone.

hindi: मेरा बेटा मुझे सुख क्यों नहीं देता मेरी पत्नी से अरे भाई उसके अपने ग्रह तुम्हारे अपने ग्रह
says: Complaints that a son or wife gives no happiness miss the point: the other person has his own planets and you have yours, so their behaviour comes from their charts.
classical_check: Agrees that each person's chart rules his own conduct.

gist: Jokes about a dark, ugly-looking man who somehow got a fairy-like wife.

hindi: उसकी कुंडली में योग ऐसा है कि उसको पत्नी सुंदर मिले प्यारी मिले सेवा भाव वाली मिले
says: Such a man's chart carries a yoga that gives him a beautiful, loving and service-minded wife, which is the real reason behind the joke.
cells_derived_method: The wife's quality is read from the 7th house, its sign, lord and Venus; a strong Venus lord in a good sign gives the beauty he mentions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 7th (lagna Scorpio) puts Venus in charge of the spouse, giving a beautiful, affectionate partner.
Derived: Cancer on the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives a caring, home-loving, service-minded wife.

ambiguity: The yoga is not named and the 7th house is implied by 'wife'.
classical_check: Agrees: spouse quality is read from the 7th and Venus.

gist: Garbled caption about twins' charts being a different class; the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: इसलिए आपका एक वक्री ग्रह पूरी कुंडली का नाश किए बैठा है
says: A single retrograde planet can sit and ruin the whole chart.
classical_check: Differs: classically retrograde adds strength.

gist: Asks what the remedy is and says they now have to look at Saturn's own sign.

hindi: शनि की अपनी राशि का शनि की अपनी राशि 10 नंबर यहां यह प्लूटो की है
says: Saturn's own sign is number 10, Capricorn; the other sign shown here, Aquarius, is Pluto's in his scheme.
ambiguity: He points at the chart; Aquarius is inferred from his later 'number 11'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn owns Capricorn and Aquarius; Pluto's lordship is his.

hindi: यह भी इसी की है लेकिन प्लूटो की है 10 नंबर राशि है शनि की वक्री है
says: This sign too belongs to Saturn but is Pluto's as well; sign 10 is Saturn's, and Saturn is retrograde.
ambiguity: Garbled; the two signs are mixed in the caption.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto.

hindi: इस आदमी का नीलम पहनाओ ना तो यह तीन खाने खराब है चौथा यह एक दो तीन
says: Weighing a blue sapphire for this man, he counts the boxes it would touch, three of which are bad houses.
ambiguity: Garbled; which three boxes is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees that a gem activates its planet's houses.

hindi: अगर यहां 10 नंबर होता तो नीलम नहीं पहना सकते क्योंकि फिर यह वाले भाव को पकड़ लेगा
says: If Saturn's sign 10 fell in a bad house, the sapphire could not be worn, because it would grab and activate that house.
cells_derived_method: The house where Capricorn falls decides whether the sapphire is safe: avoid it in the 6th, 8th and 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 6th (lagna Leo) means a sapphire would excite enemies and disease houses.
Derived: Capricorn on the 8th (lagna Gemini) means a sapphire would excite the house of crisis.

classical_check: Agrees: gems of 6th, 8th or 12th lords are avoided.

hindi: यह आपका शत्रु का है रोगों का है यह आपकी मृत्यु का है पेन पेन का है ये यह आपका डॉक्टर के खर्चे फलाने ढम काने वेस्टेज कितनी होगी हॉस्पिटल के खर्चे क्या होंगे
says: Pointing at houses, he says one is of enemies and diseases, another of death and pain, with doctor and hospital expenses. These are house topics, not diagnoses.
ambiguity: Houses are pointed at, not numbered; the next line names the 6th and 8th.
classical_check: Agrees: 6th enemies and disease, 8th death and pain.

hindi: छठे घर आठवें घर और दसवें घर में जिस ग्रह की राशि है उसका स्टोन नहीं पहना सकते
says: The stone of a planet whose sign falls in the 6th, 8th or 10th house cannot be worn.
cells_derived_method: Find which sign sits on 6, 8 or 10 and ban that sign lord's stone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 6th (lagna Cancer) bans Jupiter's yellow sapphire.
Derived: Aquarius on the 8th (lagna Cancer) bans Saturn's blue sapphire.
Derived: Scorpio on the 8th (lagna Aries) bans Mars's red coral.

ambiguity: Listing the 10th here is odd, as it is a good house; the 12th may be meant, since later he rejects the stone that would aspect the 12th.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically the 6th, 8th and 12th are the avoided houses.

gist: Says gem selection is an intricate science with a lot of detail.

hindi: जैसे बृहस्पति की राशि है नौ नंबर इसे पुखराज इस व्यक्ति को ये राम जी है उनको पुखराज नहीं पहना सकते बहुत लफड़ा हालांकि इन्ह जरूरत भी नहीं है
says: Jupiter's sign 9, Sagittarius, falls in a bad house here, so Rama cannot wear a yellow sapphire; it would make trouble, and he does not need it anyway.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius on the 6th for Cancer lagna; other lagnas change the verdict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (lagna Aries) makes the yellow sapphire safe.

ambiguity: The house is not said; the 6th follows from Cancer lagna.
classical_check: Agrees: gem of a 6th lord is avoided.

hindi: यह बुध की राशि तीन नंबर ये भी नहीं पहना सकते पन्ना पन्ना पहनाए तो ये 30 12वें घर को एस्पेक्ट कर देगा
says: Mercury's sign 3, Gemini, also bars its stone: an emerald would activate the 12th house.
ambiguity: 'ये 30' is garbled; likely 'ये तो'.
classical_check: Agrees: 12th lord gems are avoided.

hindi: ये 11 नंबर है प्लूटो प्लूटो के लिए कोई टेंशन नहीं है हमारे को वो भी शनि के हिसाब से ट्रीटमेंट से चलता है
says: Sign 11, Aquarius, is Pluto's, and Pluto causes no gem problem since it is treated as Saturn.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto.

hindi: लेकिन नीलम पहन सकते हैं क्योंकि 10 नंबर है
says: The blue sapphire can be worn, because sign 10 sits in a safe house, the 7th, for this chart.
ambiguity: The 7th house is inferred from Cancer lagna.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn lords the 7th and 8th for Cancer, so classical advice is cautious.

hindi: अगर यह शनि यहां बैठा है तो इसने घर से कष्ट दे दिया मालिक कहां का है सातवें घर का पत्नी से भी अलगाव दे दिया
says: Saturn sitting in the 4th gave trouble from home, and as lord of the 7th it gave separation from the wife.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 4th hurts home; 7th lordship afflicts the spouse.

hindi: पत्नी से अलगाव ही रहा पूरी जिंदगी शादी हुई अलग हो गए बच्चे हुए बच्चों से अलग हो गए राजपाट मिला राजपाट से अलग हो गए यह क्या हो रहा है ये यह सिर्फ शनि का वक्री होना है अकेला
says: Rama had wife, children and kingdom and lost each; he says all of this is the effect of retrograde Saturn alone.
ambiguity: Reads a life story back onto one planet.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे ही हम केस स्टडी देखें बुध की मंगल राहु सबका यही हाल है
says: The same holds for retrograde Mercury and Mars and Rahu: they behave the same way in case studies.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view.

hindi: राहु तो होता ही वक्री हमेशा वक्री रहता है राहु और केतु लवेज
says: Rahu is always retrograde, and so is Ketu.
ambiguity: 'लवेज' is 'always'.
classical_check: Agrees: the mean nodes move retrograde.

gist: Teases an interesting point about Mangal dosha to come later.

hindi: अभी यह वक्री प्लेनेट ने राजपाट में चैन नहीं दिया खुद की जिंदगी में चैन नहीं दिया यहां चैन नहीं दिया और यहां नहीं
says: The retrograde planet gave Rama no peace in rule, in personal life, or in the other areas he points to.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a pointing gesture.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अच्छा बीच बीच में मिला क्यों क्योंकि अंतरिक्ष में जब ग्रह वक्री हो जाता होगा तो उन दिनों में बहुत बढ़िया हो जाता है फिर जब व हो जाता है दोबारा प्रॉब्लम होती
says: Relief came in patches because when the planet is retrograde in the sky, it matches the birth state and goes well; when it turns direct, problems return.
ambiguity: The caption is broken at 'जब व हो जाता'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि जन्म का ग्रह पीछे को हटता हुआ ग्रह है वह वाइब्रेशन को पीछे की ओर खींच रहा है शनि की पैदाइश के टाइम पर शनि वक्री है
says: A natal retrograde planet pulls vibrations backward, and Saturn was retrograde at the time of birth.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर हम इसको लॉजिकली भी ना समझे तो य जान ले कि यार कुंडली में लिखा है शनि वक्री है पैदाइश के टाइम जो वक्री है उसका स्टोन चाहिए
says: Even without understanding the logic, the rule is simple: the planet that was retrograde at birth needs its own stone.
classical_check: Differs: classical gem advice is based on lordship and friendship, not retrogression.

hindi: अब मान लो इन केस यहां 10 नंबर होता यहां 10 होता यहां 10 तो हमें कॉमिनेशन का नीलम चाहिए उसका कलर डिफरेंट होगा
says: If Saturn's sign fell in the bad houses, a special combination sapphire of a different colour would be needed instead of the plain one.
cells_derived_method: Same as the ban rule: the 6th, 8th and 12th get a combined stone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 8th (lagna Gemini) calls for a blended sapphire.

ambiguity: What the 'combination' blends is not said.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि नीलम तो चाहिए और नीलम ही नुकसान करेगा और नीलम नहीं पहनेंगे तो कभी लाइफ में सफलता नहीं तो यह बचाव चलता रहेगा ऑटोमेटिक
says: The sapphire is needed yet may itself harm; without it there is never success, so protection must continue automatically.
ambiguity: The sentence is loose.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says people carry much infamy in Rama's name.

hindi: दूसरा पॉइंट है पता नहीं इस जगह पर यह बैठे भी हैं कि खिसके तो नहीं हुए
says: Second point: one must check whether the planets truly sit in these houses or have shifted into another house in the chalit chart.
classical_check: Agrees: bhava chalit can shift a planet to the next house.

hindi: अब शनि का 101 पर इन्फ्लुएंस यहां होगा या हमारे पास य हर्शल नेप्चून प्लूटो नहीं है यहां इन्फ्लुएंस होगा
says: He asks where Saturn's influence falls, and notes the outer planets are not in the chart but may still influence it.
ambiguity: '101' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent on the outer planets.

hindi: आठ नंबर के अंदर प्लूटो की दृष्टि होगी तो नेगेटिव है वरुण का होगा कार्यक्रम तो नेगेटिविटी आती है बच्चों से भी दूर कर देता है
says: Pluto's aspect on the 8th is negative; with Neptune's influence negativity comes too and separates from children.
ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर' could be house 8 or sign 8.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये और शनि हो सकता है चलित में या कहीं खिसक के यहां आया हो तो बच्चों से भी दूर करता है मल्टीपल इंपैक्ट्स
says: Saturn may have shifted in the chalit chart into the house of children, which also separates one from children: multiple impacts.
ambiguity: The 5th house is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 5th hurts children.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर किसी भी व्यक्ति की लाइफ के अंदर एक वक्री ग्रह पूरी कुंडली का सत्यानाश करने के लिए बते रा है
says: In any person's life, one retrograde planet is enough to ruin the whole chart.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts.

gist: Raises the question of why great sages like Vashistha did not change Rama's fate.

hindi: उस समय की कॉन्शसनेस यही थी आज की कॉन्शसनेस डिफरेंट है नहीं तो एक छोटा सा एक नीलम पहना दो काम खत्म
says: The consciousness of that era was different; otherwise one small sapphire would have ended the matter.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says kings did not wear stones and who are we to judge why Rama did not.

hindi: पर आज के समय में संभव है इसलिए नीलम पहन पहन लिया
says: Today it is possible, so wear the blue sapphire.
classical_check: Silent.

classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the fire planet.

gist: Lead-in: asks what we should do to get knowledge, and recaps that the first house was just shown.

hindi: ये भाव फिक्स होते हैं ये ऐसे ही रहेंगे हमेशा सदैव
says: He states that the twelve house positions are fixed and permanent: house 5 is always the house of study and so on, whoever the native is. Only the signs falling in each house change from chart to chart.
classical_check: Agrees: bhavas are fixed numbered positions counted from the lagna; only the signs and planets in them vary.

hindi: यह आपका पांचवा भाव है ये पढ़ाई और ये है ज्ञान अब ज्ञान मिलेगा यहां से
says: He names the fifth house as the house of study (padhai) and knowledge (gyan), and says knowledge will come to the native from here.
cells_derived_method: The house topic (study and knowledge) is fixed; the sign in the 5th and that sign's lord colour what kind of learning comes easily. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini (Mercury) in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. Study leans to language, maths, commerce and communication; knowledge comes by reading and talking.
Derived: Sagittarius (Jupiter) in the 5th, lagna Leo. Higher education, law, philosophy and teaching; a classically comfortable placement for learning.
Derived: Scorpio (Mars, or Uranus in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Research, investigation, technical or occult study; learning comes through intensity rather than ease.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of vidya (education), buddhi (intellect) and purva-punya.

gist: Repeats that this place is study and knowledge: 'what was it, your study, study, knowledge, knowledge'.

hindi: आपने आंखें दो खोली दिख रहा है जो दिख रहा है वही दिख रहा है और वही सत्य है तीसरा नेत्र बताता है अरे ये आईडिया वो बात ऐसा सोच यहां से रास्ता निकाल सॉल्यूशन मिल गई
says: He contrasts the two physical eyes, which show only what is visible and make you take it as the truth, with the third eye, which gives ideas, a different line of thought and a solution. By pointing 'from here' he ties the third eye to the fifth house.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th would set the style of insight (quick, analytic, imaginative). Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries (Mars) in the 5th, lagna Sagittarius. Ideas arrive suddenly and are acted on at once; insight is quick but impatient.
Derived: Virgo (Mercury, or Rahu in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Taurus. Solutions come by analysis and sorting detail rather than by flashes.
Derived: Pisces (Jupiter, or Ketu in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. Intuition, dreams and imagination give the guidance.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name the house; 'from here' is read as the 5th by the flow of the passage. 'इंटू' just before it looks like a garbled 'intuition'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give the 5th to buddhi, mantra and intuition, but the 'third eye' image is modern and not classical.

gist: Acts out a man sitting with eyes closed saying 'what do I do, what do I do' again and again, stuck for an answer.

hindi: तीसरे नेत्र से आवाज आती है ज्ञान ऑन हुआ है कहीं से कोई पोर्टल ऑन हुआ है
says: He says that when the third eye speaks, it feels like knowledge has switched on, as if some portal has opened from somewhere. This is his picture of how inner guidance arrives.
ambiguity: This sentence names no house or planet; the 5th-house link comes in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent: the 'portal switching on' image has no classical basis; only the general 5th-house link to intuition exists.

hindi: उसे ऑन करने का क्या रास्ता है यह है पांचवां घर
says: He answers that the way to switch that knowledge portal on is the fifth house; the 5th house is the control point for learning and inner guidance.
cells_derived_method: The 5th is the switch for everyone, but the sign in it decides which kind of knowledge opens. Derived from sign nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus (Venus) in the 5th, lagna Capricorn. The portal opens through arts, music, finance or practical craft knowledge.
Derived: Cancer (Moon) in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Learning is tied to memory and emotional safety; it opens when the mind is calm.
Derived: Libra (Venus, or Neptune in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Gemini. Knowledge opens through discussion, design, law or balance-seeking subjects.

classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 5th is the house of intellect and learning.

hindi: यह है पांचवां घर यहीं से आपकी संतान होती है
says: He says the fifth house is where children come from: the native's children (santan) are read from it.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th gives the nature of the children and the ease of having them. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer (Moon) in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Children are emotionally close and nurturing; the bond with them is strong.
Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Children come late or are few, and they are serious and dutiful.
Derived: Leo (Sun) in the 5th, lagna Aries. A proud, strong-willed child; fewer but dominant children.

ambiguity: The house is not restated in this sentence; it follows from the 5th just named in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th (putra bhava) is the main house of children.

gist: Lists again that knowledge and study are read from this same house.

hindi: यहां से पितृ
says: He adds that the ancestors (pitru) are read from the fifth house, so pitru-related matters such as pitru dosha are checked here.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th would show what kind of ancestral influence is carried. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Ancestral karma shows as delay, duty and old burdens passed down.
Derived: Scorpio (Mars, or Uranus in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Hidden or sudden ancestral issues, disputes over inheritance or family secrets.
Derived: Sagittarius (Jupiter) in the 5th, lagna Leo. Ancestral blessings and a religious lineage are the theme.

ambiguity: Very short caption fragment; it is clear he means pitru (ancestors) but not exactly which part of the pitru topic.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts read pitru dosha mainly from the 9th and the Sun, with the 5th for purva-punya and lineage. His use of the 5th is a school choice.

hindi: यहीं से आपका प्रेम आपका लव अफेयर होगा तो यहां से होगा
says: He says love and love affairs are read from the fifth house: whether the native has a romance, and its nature, comes from here.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th sets the style of romance. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra (Venus, or Neptune in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Gemini. Romance is courteous, partnership-minded and drawn to refined people.
Derived: Scorpio (Mars, or Uranus in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Intense, secretive and possessive love affairs.
Derived: Gemini (Mercury) in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. Playful, talkative flirting; romance starts through conversation and may not stay single.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of romance and affairs of the heart, with the 7th for marriage.

hindi: पढ़ाई होगी हायर स्टडी यहां से होगी संतान होगी तो यहां से होगी
says: He says specifically that higher studies, not just school, and the birth of children are both decided by the fifth house.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th points to the field of higher study. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo (Mercury) in the 5th, lagna Taurus. Higher study in medicine, accounts, analysis or technical fields.
Derived: Aquarius (Saturn, or Pluto in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Libra. Long, disciplined study in science, engineering or research.
Derived: Pisces (Jupiter, or Ketu in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. Higher study in arts, spiritual subjects or healing.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th covers advanced learning and children.

hindi: अगर यहां ग्रह नेगेटिव है तो आपके बच्चे नहीं होंगे
says: He claims that if a negative planet sits in the fifth house, the native will not have children. He gives it as a flat rule without saying which planets count as negative.
cells_derived_method: Which sign the negative planet sits in would change how hard the effect is, by dignity: a planet in a friendly or strong sign hurts less than one in a weak sign. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a malefic such as Saturn in Libra in the 5th, lagna Gemini. Saturn is exalted there, so the damage to children would be softer, probably delay rather than denial.
Derived: a malefic such as Mars in Cancer in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Mars is debilitated in this sign, so the harm to children and the mind is the heavier case.
Derived: a malefic such as Ketu in Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo. Ketu in Jupiter's sign is milder; Jupiter's protection can soften denial.

ambiguity: 'Negative' (नेगेटिव) is not defined: it could mean natural malefics, an enemy-sign planet or a debilitated planet. No planet is named. It also says 'will not have', not 'delayed'.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say malefics in the 5th can reduce or delay children but weigh the 5th lord, Jupiter and aspects; they do not give absolute denial from one planet.

hindi: पितृ दोष है तो रिपोर्ट ठीक है बच्चे नहीं हो रहे आपके पास अ पितृ दोष है संतान का दोष है
says: He says that when medical reports come back normal yet the couple cannot have children, the cause is pitru dosha, a defect of the child-house. He is giving a medical-looking case a chart reason; this is his claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: He does not say how pitru dosha is identified in the chart (which planet or sign), so the cell cannot be narrowed. The caption has a filler 'अ'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts do link delayed children to pitru dosha or Sun/Saturn afflictions of the 5th and 9th, but this exact 'normal reports' rule is not classical.

hindi: अगर संतान का ग्रह और पितृ दोष है साथ में कुंडलियों के अंदर राशि और ग्रहों के कॉमिनेशन से होता है तो आपकी संतान होगी और वही आप को मारेगी हो सकता है वही दुखी करे वही खून के आंसर लाए
says: He says that if the child-planet is afflicted together with pitru dosha, through some sign and planet combination in the chart, a child will be born but that same child may torment the parent and bring tears of blood. 'Will kill you' is a figure of speech for severe grief; it is not a prediction of death and is not to be used as one.
cells_derived_method: The torment would depend on which sign and planet combination afflicts the 5th; he does not specify one. Derived from sign nature only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Mars or Ketu affliction in Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. A willful, conflict-prone child fits the picture.
Derived: a Saturn-type affliction in Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. A cold or distant child, with grief from emotional separation.

ambiguity: The caption is rough ('कॉमिनेशन' = combination; 'संतान का ग्रह' probably means Jupiter or the 5th lord). 'मारेगी' is figurative here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts describe sorrow from children when the 5th and its lord are afflicted with Rahu, Saturn or the Sun, but the 'torments you' wording is his own.

hindi: यहीं से प्रजनन है स्त्री की बॉडी के अंदर ओवेरियन प्रॉब्लम्स जितनी हैं वो वन ऑफ द एरियाज ये है
says: He says reproduction (prajanan) is read from the fifth house, and that all ovarian problems in a woman's body are one of the areas shown by it. This is his health claim, recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th points to which kind of reproductive-organ weakness the house leans to. Derived from sign nature and body-part rule, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio rules the reproductive region in the body-part scheme; a Scorpio 5th (lagna Cancer) would put reproductive-organ matters in focus.
Derived: Cancer is the sign of the womb and fluids; a Cancer 5th (lagna Pisces) would put hormonal and womb-related matters in focus.

classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give the 5th to progeny and the womb area to the 5th/8th and Mars/Moon, but 'ovarian problems' as a 5th-house area is a modern restatement.

gist: Says there is a second area elsewhere ('the other one happens over there, one from here'); the caption is too broken to tell which house or topic he means.

hindi: अगर यहां पर मंगल का दोष है केतु का दोष है तो ओवरी में सिस्ट होती है लड़की को
says: He claims that if Mars or Ketu afflicts the fifth house, a girl will get cysts in the ovaries. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: How strong the Mars or Ketu fault is depends on the sign, since dignity changes malefic strength. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Mars is exalted there, so the fault would be disciplined and reduced compared with a weak Mars.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Mars is debilitated in this sign and in a water sign linked to fluids, the heavier version of his claim.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. Pisces is Ketu's sign in his scheme, so the Ketu fault would be the strong, own-sign type.

ambiguity: 'Dosha' of Mars or Ketu is not defined (conjunction, aspect or placement). It also says 'the girl', unclear if the chart is the girl's own or a parent's.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no cyst rule; Mars and Ketu in the 5th are general child and mind afflictions.

hindi: यहीं से लड़के का स्पर्म काउंट देखा जाता है
says: He says a man's sperm count is judged from the fifth house. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th and its lord point to the strength or weakness; Venus is the classical karaka of semen, so a Venus-ruled 5th is the sensitive case. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus (Venus) in the 5th, lagna Capricorn. Venus rules both the sign and semen, so the strength of Venus decides the reading.
Derived: Aquarius (Saturn, or Pluto in his scheme) in the 5th, lagna Libra. A Saturn-ruled 5th is read as slow or reduced output unless Saturn is strong.

classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat the 5th and Venus (shukra) as showing male fertility, but a count measurement from the chart is a modern claim.

hindi: यहीं से सेक्सुअल कंपट देखी जाती है
says: He says sexual compatibility between two people is read from the fifth house. The word 'कंपट' is a broken caption for 'compatibility'.
cells_derived_method: Compatibility would be judged by comparing the sign and planets in each person's 5th. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in one partner's 5th, lagna Gemini, would pair well with another harmonious (Taurus or Libra) 5th.
Derived: Aries in a partner's 5th, lagna Sagittarius, a fiery and quick 5th that clashes with a very slow or Saturn-ruled 5th.

ambiguity: 'कंपट' is garbled; compatibility is the most likely word, but it could be 'competence' or 'compulsion'.
classical_check: Silent: classical matching (ashtakoota, graha maitri) does not read sexual compatibility from the 5th; the 7th and 8th are used.

hindi: यहीं से सेक्स का रिलेशनशिप अगर दो लोगों में यह कुंडली का एरिया ठीक है मैचिंग अच्छी है तो उनका सेक्सुअल लाइफ अच्छी होगी
says: He says the sexual relationship between two people is read from this area of the chart, and if the area is healthy in both charts and the match is good, their sexual life will be good.
cells_derived_method: Good matching would mean the two 5th houses have compatible signs and no affliction. Derived from sign element, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in one partner's 5th, lagna Aries, matches well with another fire or air 5th, such as Aries or Gemini, and poorly with a cold Capricorn 5th.
Derived: Pisces in one partner's 5th, lagna Scorpio, matches well with water or earth 5th houses such as Cancer or Taurus.

ambiguity: 'यह कुंडली का एरिया' does not name the house; it is taken as the 5th from the flow. It is unclear which chart elements count as 'matching'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical matching rule uses the 5th for sexual life.

hindi: यह शादी की है शादी की लाइफ खराब होगी किसी-किसी की शादी की लाइफ बहुत अच्छी होगी सेक्स लाइफ डेड होगी
says: He observes that results vary widely between marriages: for some the married life turns bad, for some it is very good, and for some the sex life is dead.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'यह' still points to the 5th or to marriage in general (the 7th); the sentence gives no rule for who gets which outcome.
classical_check: Silent: it is an observation, not a classical rule.

hindi: उसमें एक्टिविटी कैसी होगी यह 12वें घर से होगा
says: He says the actual quality of the activity in the sexual relationship is judged from the twelfth house, while the fifth house gives the compatibility.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 12th would colour the style and intensity of bedroom activity. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus (Venus) in the 12th, lagna Gemini. Sensual, comfort-seeking and slow-paced activity.
Derived: Scorpio (Mars, or Uranus in his scheme) in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius. Intense, secretive and high-energy activity.
Derived: Virgo (Mercury, or Rahu in his scheme) in the 12th, lagna Libra. Reserved and anxious about performance; more mental than physical.

classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of bed pleasures (shayana sukha).

hindi: संतान प्राप्ति के लिए कैसे होगा अगर आपका 12वां घर है ये यह सेक्स का एरिया है यही
says: Asking how a child is obtained, he points to the twelfth house as the sex area, so conceiving depends on the state of the 12th as well as the 5th.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 12th tells whether this sex area is healthy or weak. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces (Jupiter, or Ketu in his scheme) in the 12th, lagna Aries. Jupiter-ruled 12th protects the house, so conception is helped by it.
Derived: Leo (Sun) in the 12th, lagna Virgo. A Sun-ruled 12th is dry and heated, a weaker support for conception in his logic.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and carries over to the next line; it is clear only that the 12th is named as the sex area.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 12th is the house of bed pleasure, but classical texts do not make it a gate for children.

hindi: भोग का है संभोग का है यही कीर्ति का है यही धन का है यही वेस्टेज का है यही डॉक्टर के खर्चे हैं
says: He lists what the twelfth house stands for: enjoyment (bhoga), sexual union, fame, money, wastage and doctors' expenses.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 12th decides which kind of outflow is most visible. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini (Mercury) in the 12th, lagna Cancer. Spending goes to travel, phones, courses and short trips.
Derived: Virgo (Mercury, or Rahu in his scheme) in the 12th, lagna Libra. Expenses tilt to health, doctors and service work.
Derived: Sagittarius (Jupiter) in the 12th, lagna Capricorn. Spending goes to religion, teachers, long journeys and charity.

ambiguity: 'कीर्ति' (fame) and 'धन' (money) are his additions; the 12th is normally loss, so 'money' may mean money going out.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical 12th is vyaya (expense), bed pleasure, hospital and loss; 'fame' and 'wealth' as gain are not classical.

gist: Says he will give each house in detail later; this is only a rough overview, and for now the talk is about knowledge.

hindi: यह आपका अगर दूषित है तो नेचुरल सेक्स के थ्रू संतान नहीं होगी आईवीएफ कराना पड़ेगा सरोगसी करानी पड़ेगी ऐसे ऐसे आपका कार्यक्रम चलता है
says: He says that if this house is afflicted, the native will not conceive by natural intercourse and will have to use IVF or surrogacy. This is his medical-sounding claim, recorded as said.
cells_derived_method: A weak sign or a malefic in these houses would raise the risk, while a Jupiter or Venus influence would lower it. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius in the 5th, lagna Libra, with Saturn or Rahu in it: the delay-and-assist case in his logic.
Derived: Scorpio in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius, afflicted by Mars or Ketu: the sex-area fault that would push towards assisted conception.

ambiguity: 'यह आपका' does not say which house: the 5th (children) and the 12th (natural sex) were both just discussed.
classical_check: Silent: assisted conception is a modern idea; classical texts only give delay or denial of children.

hindi: ज्ञान चाहिए तो यहां क्या है पढ़ाई तो एक तो विद्यालय है
says: Returning to knowledge, he says that for knowledge you look at study, and study links to the school (vidyalaya), so the school is the place connected with the fifth house.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 5th is education; the 'school as the house's place' step is his own link for the remedy.

hindi: यहां विद्यालय तो आपने किसी भी विद्यालय में दान करना है
says: Remedy: the native should donate to any school; giving to a school is how the fifth house is nourished.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts prescribe vidya-daan and feeding students, but not as a fixed 5th-house remedy by sign.

hindi: यहां जो राशि पड़ी यह पांच नंबर तो भाव है चार नंबर राशि पड़ी तो चंद्रमा है एक नंबर पड़ी तो मंगल है आठ नंबर भी मंगल मानो इंद्र मानो
says: He fixes the donation by the sign lying in the fifth house: if sign 4 (Cancer) is there the planet is the Moon, sign 1 (Aries) is Mars, and sign 8 (Scorpio) is also Mars, or Indra (Uranus) if you accept that.
cells_derived_method: Same lookup for every sign in the 5th: find the lord of that sign in his 12-planet scheme and that planet's item is what is donated. Derived for the signs he has not yet named, using classical lordship.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 5th, lagna Aries. The sign's lord is the Sun, so the Sun's item is donated to the school.
Derived: Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. The sign's lord is Saturn, so the Saturn item is donated.
Derived: Pisces in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. The lord is Jupiter, or Ketu in his scheme, so the Jupiter item is donated unless he says otherwise.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर तो भाव है' fixes the house as 5, and the other numbers are sign numbers (Aries 1 to Pisces 12). 'Mars or Indra' for sign 8 is left open.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars and the Moon rule these signs classically; Uranus (Indra) as Scorpio's lord is not classical.

hindi: दो नंबर पढ़िए तो शुक्र हो गया सात नंबर भी शुक्र है तीन नंबर और छह नंबर बुध है
says: He continues the lookup: sign 2 (Taurus) and sign 7 (Libra) in the fifth house make the planet Venus, and sign 3 (Gemini) and sign 6 (Virgo) make it Mercury.
cells_derived_method: He applies this only to the 5th. By the same logic any other house could take the lord of its sign and a matching institution, but he does not say so. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 10th, lagna Sagittarius. If the lookup were extended, the lord Mercury's item would be given to a place linked to the 10th, such as the workplace.
Derived: Taurus in the 7th, lagna Scorpio. If extended, Venus's item would be given in a spouse-linked cause.

ambiguity: Libra is given only as Venus here, though his scheme allows Neptune too; Virgo is given only as Mercury though his scheme allows Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees: classical sign lordship is Taurus and Libra for Venus, Gemini and Virgo for Mercury.

hindi: बृहस्पति हो गया 9 12 10 11 हो गया शनि
says: He finishes the lookup: signs 9 (Sagittarius) and 12 (Pisces) in the fifth house make the planet Jupiter, and signs 10 (Capricorn) and 11 (Aquarius) make it Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Same method for other houses is not stated by him. If used, the lord of the sign in that house gives the planet. Derived only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 9th, lagna Cancer. If extended, Jupiter's item would be given to a teacher or temple linked to the 9th.
Derived: Capricorn in the 4th, lagna Libra. If extended, Saturn's item would be given in a home or mother-linked cause.

ambiguity: The caption runs the numbers together ('9 12 10 11'); the pairing 9 and 12 for Jupiter and 10 and 11 for Saturn is the only sensible reading. His scheme allows Ketu or Pluto for 12 and 11 but he does not use them here.
classical_check: Agrees: Sagittarius and Pisces are Jupiter's, Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's.

hindi: शनि की हो गई काली दाल बृहस्पति की हो गई पीले वाली दाल ऐसे ऐसे चलना है शुक्र की हो गई सफेद जाल सफेद चने
says: He assigns the pulses for the donation: Saturn's is black dal, Jupiter's is yellow dal, and Venus's is white dal or white chickpeas.
cells_derived_method: In the 5th-house remedy the sign selects the planet and the planet selects the item. Saturn signs (10, 11) give black dal, Jupiter signs (9, 12) yellow dal, Venus signs (2, 7) white dal. Derived from his earlier lookup.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo, gives black dal as the school donation.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo, gives yellow dal.
Derived: Taurus in the 5th, lagna Capricorn, gives white dal or white chickpeas.

ambiguity: The caption writes 'जाल' for 'दाल'. Which yellow dal (chana or toor) is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in part: black for Saturn, yellow for Jupiter and white for Venus match common graha-dravya lists.

hindi: बुध का हो गया हरी वाली दाल मूंग साबत हो गया ऐसे ही मंगल के लिए लाल वाली हो गई
says: He assigns two more pulses: Mercury's is green dal, specifically whole moong, and Mars's is red dal.
cells_derived_method: Mercury signs (3, 6) give whole green moong and Mars signs (1, 8) give red dal when that sign sits in the 5th. Derived from his earlier lookup.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 5th, lagna Aquarius, gives whole green moong.
Derived: Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer, gives red dal (Mars).

classical_check: Agrees in part: green moong for Mercury and red masoor for Mars are common graha-dravya.

hindi: ये दालों में बता रहे हैं चंद्रमा के लिए चावल हो ग सूर्य के लिए गेहूं
says: He notes that these are the pulses, and adds the non-pulse items: rice for the Moon and wheat for the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Cancer in the 5th gives rice and Leo in the 5th gives wheat. Derived from his earlier lookup.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 5th, lagna Pisces, gives rice (Moon).
Derived: Leo in the 5th, lagna Aries, gives wheat (Sun).

ambiguity: 'हो ग' is a cut-off word; it is read as 'हो गया'.
classical_check: Agrees: rice for the Moon and wheat for the Sun are standard graha-dravya.

hindi: आपने वो ले जाकर किसी विद्यालय अंध विद्यालय में दान कर देने है जैसी राशि है वो दान कर दो
says: Remedy: take that grain to a school, for example a school for the blind, and donate the item that belongs to the sign in your fifth house.
cells_derived_method: The item to carry depends on the sign in the 5th and its lord. Derived from his lookup.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 5th, lagna Taurus, means carry whole green moong to the school.
Derived: Aries in the 5th, lagna Sagittarius, means carry red dal to the school.

classical_check: Silent: charity to the blind and to schools is general daan, not a classical 5th-house rule.

hindi: आपका ये खाना अपने आप पंप अप हो गया ऑटोमेटिक पंप हो गया और यह पंप हो जाने से क्या होगा
says: He says that once the donation is made, this house (khana, meaning a house of the chart) is pumped up automatically, so the donation strengthens the fifth house by itself.
ambiguity: 'खाना' is the Hindi chart word for a house box; 'pump up' is his image for strengthening, with no stated mechanism.
classical_check: Silent: it is a remedy-mechanism claim; classical texts do not explain why daan acts on a house.

hindi: पेपर से ठीक पहले बच्चों के हम यही उपाय कराते हैं
says: Timing of the remedy: for students he has this same donation done just before their exam paper.
ambiguity: 'Just before' is not given in days or hours.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no exam-eve remedy.

hindi: मान लो पांच नंबर राशि है राशि ही पांच नंबर है तो सूर्य और मंगल की है तो बच्चा को चॉकलेट दिलवा देते हैं
says: Worked example: if the sign number in the fifth house is 5 (Leo), which he ties to the Sun and Mars, he has the child hand out chocolates.
cells_derived_method: Mars signs Aries and Scorpio in the 5th would give the same Mars-type sweet by his logic. Derived from his lookup.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 5th, lagna Sagittarius. A Mars sign, so the child gives out chewable sweets.
Derived: Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Also Mars, so the same chewable-toffee remedy.

ambiguity: Leo is the Sun's sign only, so 'Sun and Mars' is odd: he may be pairing Sun and Mars as the fire planets, or means the sign is Mars-ruled. 'पांच नंबर राशि' here is sign number 5, not house 5.
classical_check: Differs: Leo is ruled by the Sun alone classically; Mars has no role in it.

hindi: बच्चों को चॉकलेट बांट के आओ बेटा खूब सारी टॉफी चबाने वाली चूसने वाली टॉफी नहीं वो शुक्र की हो गई चबाने वाली मंगल की
says: Remedy detail: have the child distribute many toffees, but the chewable kind, which belongs to Mars, and not the sucking kind, which belongs to Venus.
cells_derived_method: Mars-sign fifth houses (Aries, Scorpio) use chewy sweets; Venus-sign fifth houses (Taurus, Libra) would use sucking sweets by his logic. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 5th, lagna Capricorn. A Venus sign, so sucking candy would be the matching item.
Derived: Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. A Mars sign, so chewable toffee.

classical_check: Silent: sweet types by planet are his own.

hindi: तो बेटा टॉफिया देकर आओ उसके पेपर पास हो जाते हैं पता नहीं कैसे हो जाते हैं
says: Outcome claim: the child who gives out toffees passes the paper, and he admits he does not know how it works.
ambiguity: No success rate is given and he does not claim a mechanism.
classical_check: Silent: there is no classical basis for this outcome.

gist: An audience member says 'yes sir' and asks what happens if Neptune or Pluto is there; the caption is cut off.

hindi: नेपच्यून प्लूटो की राशि भी तो चाहिए फिर उसका चलित भी तो चाहिए फिर उसका भाव भी तो चाहिए फिर उसका केपी भी तो चाहिए
says: He answers that for Neptune and Pluto you also need their sign, then their bhava-chalit position, then their house and then their KP position. A full reading of these outer planets needs all four views.
ambiguity: 'उसकी राशि' could mean the sign they sit in, or which signs they rule; both readings fit.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune and Pluto are outside the classical system.

gist: Says this is not halwa but a big khichdi (a big mix), so that you at least know the know-how.
Reminds the class that in class they only talk about astrology; the sentence carries over into the next line.
Says a pure astrology class is very crude, and people who want to learn to be astrologers have to be called separately.
Says what he is doing is not astrology but a programme to switch on the light of the Divine, the light of the supreme knowledge.
Says these matters are deep; if understood, the brain will pick up something, and like tenth-class studies they will come in useful later.
Says the brain gets sharpened and washed by churning it again and again, like turning a wheel.
Says our biggest problem is giving up; to attain God you must keep at it, and only a mad person gets God, not an ordinary one.
Says whatever you chase obsessively you get, and that is why people complain that God is not found; the wording is loose.
Story begins: a king got fixated on finding God, and was told a sadhu knows where God is.
The sadhu is said to have the longing to meet God and will show the king the way; the sentence runs into the next line.
The king orders his men to find the sadhu; they say he wanders from jungle to jungle with no known address.
The king has mansions built in many jungle areas and posts soldiers everywhere to watch for the sadhu passing.
One day from a mansion the king sees the sadhu passing below and orders him called up.
The sadhu refuses rudely: he listens to nobody, he is bound only to Ram and Krishna.
The king calls again; told to come down the stairs from the fourth floor, the sadhu would run off first, so a rope is thrown instead.
They loop a rope around the sadhu and start hauling him up; the king shouts to pull, marks will appear, and says let them.
Someone tells the king he is pulling too, his hands will blister and elbows scrape; the king says let it happen.
Story continues: the king's men let the marks happen and haul the sadhu up the rope to the king.
The king bows at the sadhu's feet: says he is tormented by the search, wants to know about God and how God is attained.
The sadhu replies that attaining God is no hard task if you really want it; the king says he always wants it, and the sadhu asks why then he was called.
The king says the sadhu keeps running away and only through him can he learn; the sadhu asks if this is a way to call someone.
The king explains he built many mansions and searched long, and that sending men down the stairs would have made the sadhu leap away and die, so he had him pulled up by rope.
The sadhu's verdict: if you want God with this kind of mad craving, you will get Him too.
