Moral: with the same madness and daring, whatever you want, business, job, study, work or love, you get; that is why mad people succeed.
Says such people churn their brains so hard that they dig the thing out; this education and big research work need brain-churning.
Says roughly 'man does not speak the word'; the key word is lost in the caption and the sentence runs into the next line.
Says the questioning words 'how will we do it, from where, what will we do' (all starting with the 'ka' sound) have to end for a person on such a mission.
Joke: nobody can leave home without telling his wife, who will ask on the phone where, why, with whom, how, how many people, ka, ka, ka.

hindi: आपको इस शब्द से निकलना है मूलाधार से नहीं निकले कुछ पता नहीं
says: He says you must get out of the habit of the 'ka' question-words (how, why, what); if a person has not come out of the Muladhara (root chakra), nothing is known to him. He ties endless doubting questions to the root chakra.
ambiguity: He names the Muladhara but no planet or house here; the caption 'कुछ पता नहीं' could also be read as 'nobody knows what happens'.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no chakra link; chakra-to-planet pairings (Saturn for root) are a later yoga-tantra overlay.

hindi: करो शनि जेब में शनि ही आपको रॉकेट बना देगा
says: He says to 'put Saturn in your pocket', meaning to take hold of Saturn, and that Saturn alone will turn you into a rocket. A well-handled Saturn, with its discipline and hard work, launches the native upward.
ambiguity: 'Saturn in the pocket' is not explained: it could mean keeping Saturn's items on you, mastering Saturn's discipline, or having Saturn strong. Reading is a guess.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn gives slow, hard-earned rise through discipline; 'rocket' speed is his image.

hindi: यह कृपा तब जाकर के मिलेगी जब ब्लाइंड रहोगे किसी भी विद्यालय में यह दान करने मात्र से ग्रह की चीजें आपकी कृपा का खाना खुलता है
says: Remedy: this grace comes by donating the planet's items in any school; the mere act of giving opens the 'grace house' of the chart. The phrase 'when you stay blind' is lost in the caption.
cells_derived_method: Which item to donate depends on the lord of the sign in the 5th, as in his earlier lookup. Derived from that table, not repeated here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 5th, lagna Gemini. The lord is Venus, so white dal or white chickpeas go to the school.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo. The lord is Jupiter, so yellow dal goes to the school.
Derived: Aquarius in the 5th, lagna Libra. The lord is Saturn, so black dal goes to the school.

ambiguity: 'ब्लाइंड रहोगे' is garbled (maybe a blind school, as before). The 'grace house' is not numbered; it is taken as the 5th because the donation is the school remedy for the 5th just given.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie a sign-lord item to a school for the 5th house.

gist: Says there are many more remedies, but covering them now would make the session too long.
Announces that next week the class will take up the houses and signs together: which signs get placed in the houses.

hindi: जैसे कि यह तो घर फिक्स हो गए बेडरूम फिक्स हो गया टॉयलेट फिक्स हो गया किचन फिक्स हो गई सब फिक्स हो गए
says: By analogy with a home, he says the houses of the chart are like fixed rooms: the bedroom, the toilet and the kitchen are fixed in place, just as the twelve houses are fixed in their topics.
ambiguity: He does not say which house is the bedroom, toilet or kitchen.
classical_check: Agrees: each bhava has a fixed set of topics; the room analogy is his own.

hindi: अब वहां पर किस रंग की चादर लगाई है बेडरूम में किस तरफ आपने सिर रखा है यह आपके ग्रह और राशि का कॉमिनेशन बताता है
says: Continuing the room analogy, he says the finer details inside a fixed room, such as the colour of the bed sheet and which direction you keep your head, are shown by the combination of planet and sign sitting in that house. This is his house-versus-planet-and-sign logic in a vastu form.
cells_derived_method: For a given room-house, the sign and its lord pick the colour and the direction. Derived using the planet colour and vastu direction-lord tables, not stated by him. Taking the 12th as the bed house, as he did earlier for bed pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries (Mars) in the 12th, lagna Taurus. Red-toned sheet and a head to the south, the direction of Mars.
Derived: Libra (Venus) in the 12th, lagna Scorpio. White or cream sheet and a head to the south-east, the direction of Venus.
Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 12th, lagna Aquarius. Dark blue or black sheet and a head to the west, the direction of Saturn.

ambiguity: He gives no rule for the colour or direction by sign here; examples use the standard planet colour and vastu direction lords. Which house is the bedroom is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no sheet-colour rule; vastu direction-lords exist in vastu texts but not as a house-sign rule.

hindi: भाव तो फिक्स है इस भाव से आपकी गाड़ी ही देखी जाएगी हमेशा
says: He gives an example of a fixed house: from this house your vehicle (gaadi) will always be read, whoever the native is.
cells_derived_method: The sign in this house gives the type of vehicle. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini (Mercury) in the 4th, lagna Pisces. Light vehicles that are changed often.
Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 4th, lagna Libra. Heavy, slow or second-hand vehicles.
Derived: Aries (Mars) in the 4th, lagna Capricorn. Fast, sporty vehicles and a taste for speed.

ambiguity: He does not say the house number; vehicle is the 4th house classically and is taken as that.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is the house of vehicles (vahana).

hindi: अगर इस भाव में आपका नेगेटिव ग्रह बैठा है विद ब बैड राशि तो एक्सीडेंट देगा
says: He says that if a negative planet sits in the vehicle house together with a bad sign, it will give an accident.
cells_derived_method: Which signs are 'bad' for the planet is not stated; by standard dignity, enemy and debilitation signs are the bad ones. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. Mars is debilitated there, the worst vehicle-accident combination in his logic.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 4th, lagna Capricorn. Saturn is debilitated there, so accidents tied to slowness, fatigue or old vehicles.

ambiguity: 'Bad sign' (बैड राशि) is not defined, and the vehicle house number is not spoken (taken as the 4th).
classical_check: Partly agrees: a malefic in the 4th or its lord afflicted is read as vehicle trouble; he gives no dignity rule.

hindi: खून निकालेगा मंगल है हड्डी तोड़ेगा शनि है इस प्रकार चलता है यह चीजें अलग जाननी है
says: He splits the accident by planet: if the planet is Mars it draws blood (cuts, bleeding), if it is Saturn it breaks bones. He says these details are to be learned separately.
cells_derived_method: Dignity changes how severe the injury is. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 4th, lagna Leo. Mars is in its own sign, so bleeding injuries are possible but the damage is controlled.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. Saturn is exalted, so the fracture risk is softened or turns into delay and fatigue.

ambiguity: The sentence does not repeat the house; it is the vehicle house from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Mars is the karaka of blood and cuts, Saturn of bones and fractures.

hindi: जहां जहां जिस ग्रह की दृष्टि है उस उस हिस्से पर शरीर पर चोट मारेगा
says: He says that wherever a harmful planet casts its aspect, it will strike the body part that belongs to the aspected place, so the injury lands on that part of the body.
cells_derived_method: The body part is read from the aspected house and the aspected sign together: the house gives the Kala-Purusha body part and the sign adds its own body part. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a malefic aspecting Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. The 4th is chest and heart; Libra is kidneys and lower back, so chest and lower back are targeted.
Derived: a malefic aspecting Aquarius in the 10th, lagna Taurus. The 10th is knees; Aquarius is calves and ankles, so knees and lower leg.
Derived: a malefic aspecting Gemini in the 3rd, lagna Aries. The 3rd and Gemini both point to arms and shoulders, so the strongest match for arm injury.

ambiguity: He does not say whether the body part follows the house or the sign; the examples use both.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give each bhava and rashi a body part (Kala Purusha) and read injury from afflicted ones.

hindi: अगर किसी का यह भाग्य का स्थान पूजा पाठ का स्थान यही दूषित है यानी इसमें नीच का ग्रह बैठा है नेगेटिव प्लेनेट है तो वह व्यक्ति जिंदगी में पूजा पाठ करके बर्बाद हो जाएगा
says: He says that if the house of fortune and worship is afflicted, meaning a debilitated or negative planet sits in it, the person will be ruined in life by doing puja and rituals.
cells_derived_method: Any planet that is debilitated in the 9th triggers it. Debilitation signs by planet: Sun Libra, Moon Scorpio, Mars Cancer, and so on. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 9th, lagna Aquarius. The Sun is debilitated; ritual leads to ego losses and quarrels with priests or fathers.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 9th, lagna Pisces. The Moon is debilitated; heavy emotion in worship, with cheating or exploitation by gurus.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 9th, lagna Scorpio. Mars is debilitated; ritual turns into conflict, injury or money loss.

ambiguity: He says 'bhagya sthan', worship place, with no house number; this is the 9th classically and is taken so. 'Ruined' is strong and unqualified.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not say puja ruins the person; a weak 9th is read as luck and dharma problems.

hindi: अब यह उसी प्रकार है सुबह जल्दी उठना चाहिए सारे जल्दी उठने वालों में जरूरी नहीं है उन्हें कभी कैंसर नहीं होगा हार्ट अटैक नहीं होगा वो भी मर जाते हैं
says: By analogy, he says good habits like waking early do not guarantee protection: not every early riser avoids cancer or heart attack, and they die too. Likewise, a good ritual does not shield you if the chart is bad.
ambiguity: He mentions illnesses as an analogy only; no diagnosis for any chart is given.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the doctrine of prarabdha says chart-promised events cannot be averted by habit alone.

hindi: सुबह-सुबह जल्दी उठ के जाते हैं हमेशा पूरी जिंदगी हार्ट अटैक हो पड़े अब क्या पाप है उनका क्योंकि आखिर में होगा वही जो ग्रह चाहते हैं अगर यहां लिखा है
says: He adds the example of people who go for early walks all their life and still get a heart attack: what sin did they commit? In the end only what the planets want happens, if it is written in the chart.
ambiguity: 'अगर यहां लिखा है' leads into the next line, where he reads Jupiter and Moon from the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the planets' promises (karma-phala) decide outcomes.

hindi: जुपिटर आपका ठीक है आपका लिवर कभी फेल नहीं होगा
says: He says that if the chart shows your Jupiter is in good shape, your liver will never fail. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: 'Fine' for Jupiter means strong by sign and house. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. Jupiter is exalted, so the liver is safe by his rule.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo. Jupiter is debilitated in the disease house, so liver trouble is the weak case.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 11th, lagna Aquarius. Own sign, strong, so the liver is protected.

ambiguity: 'Fine' is not defined and the absolute 'never' is his wording.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter is the classical karaka of the liver and fat metabolism, but absolute guarantees are not classical.

hindi: आपका चंद्रमा पावरफुल है आपका कभी भी किसी भी हालत में किडनी में गड़बड़ नहीं आएगी मंगल साथ ठीक होना चाहिए
says: He says a powerful Moon means your kidneys will never go wrong under any condition, provided Mars is also fine alongside it. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A powerful Moon means exalted or own sign, a weak one debilitated; the house adds the body part (7th is the kidney zone). Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 2nd, lagna Aries. The Moon is exalted, the strong case: kidneys safe by his rule.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. Own sign, strong and fluid-balanced.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 7th, lagna Taurus. The Moon is debilitated in the kidney zone, the weak case.

ambiguity: Why Mars is needed is not explained (it may mean Mars must not be afflicted).
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon governs body fluids and, with Venus and Libra, the kidney area; Mars as a co-condition is his addition.

hindi: अगर आपका चंद्रमा नीच का है और यहां कहीं एक्सपेक्टेड है आपका अपेंडिक्स का ऑपरेशन करा देगा
says: He says that if the Moon is debilitated and is also hit or aspected somewhere in the chart, it will lead to an appendix operation. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The house where the debilitated Moon sits decides the likely trigger: the 6th is intestines, the 8th surgery, the 12th hospital. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 6th, lagna Gemini. Debilitated in the intestine and disease house, the strongest fit for an appendix problem.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 8th, lagna Aries. Debilitated in the surgery house, so an operation is the form it takes.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius. Debilitated in the hospital house, so hospital stay and expense are the form.

ambiguity: 'एक्सपेक्टेड' is a garbled word (affected, aspected or exalted); it is read as 'afflicted'. Scorpio is the Moon's debilitation sign.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts connect a weak Moon with the 6th, 8th and 12th to abdominal disease, but name no appendix rule.

hindi: मंगल या नीच का कहीं है सीजेरियन ऑपरेशन करा देता है लड़की का
says: He says that Mars, or a debilitated planet, placed somewhere in the chart, causes a caesarean operation for a woman. This is a health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The house and sign of Mars change how it acts: in the 5th (children) or 8th (surgery) it points to childbirth by operation. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Mars is debilitated in the child house, so childbirth by surgery.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 8th, lagna Virgo. Own sign in the surgery house, so an operation, a controlled one.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Mars is exalted, so the caesarean risk is less despite Mars.

ambiguity: The house is not named: 'कहीं' (somewhere). It follows the 5th and ovary talk, so the 5th or the 8th is likely.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule for caesarean births.

hindi: आप कुछ भी उखाड़ लो वो होना ही है इसीलिए कहते हैं होनी बलवान है आप कुछ भी उखाड़ लो नहीं रोक सकते
says: He states that whatever you try, what is destined must happen, and that is why it is said 'honi balwan hai' (what must happen is stronger than you); nothing can stop it.
ambiguity: It sits oddly with his remedies: he also teaches donations and gems, which suggests protection and softening, not stopping.
classical_check: Partly agrees: prarabdha karma is fixed in classical thought, though texts allow remedies to soften its force.

hindi: इसलिए कई लोगों को पूजा पाठ करना नुकसान देता है
says: He says that for this reason, doing puja and rituals gives harm to many people.
cells_derived_method: none; the link to an afflicted house of worship is the sentence given a little earlier.
ambiguity: Which charts it applies to is not said here; the earlier sentence points to a debilitated or negative planet in the house of fortune.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts prescribe puja as a remedy; a harm rule is his own.

gist: Says he will take this up in the Saturn class.

hindi: जितने लोग आध्यात्मिक है सब शनि ने बनाया टोटल 100%
says: He says that every spiritual person was made so by Saturn, with total, 100 percent certainty.
ambiguity: '100%' is rhetorical; it is not a measured rate.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is the karaka of renunciation and vairagya, but classical texts also credit Ketu and Jupiter for spirituality.

hindi: जो स्पिरिचुअलिटी की बात करता है शनि से कुटा हुआ है पिट पिट के स्पिरिचुअल बातें करता है मनुष्य इसलिए शनि पीटता बहुत है
says: He explains how: whoever talks spirituality has been beaten up by Saturn, and a person turns to spiritual talk after being beaten again and again. That is why Saturn beats people a lot.
ambiguity: The mechanism is suffering leading to spirituality; no house or sign is named.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Saturn gives hardship that leads to detachment.

hindi: इसलिए शनि ही केतु और राहु के लिए मार्ग खोलता है
says: He says Saturn is the one who opens the path for Ketu and Rahu, so the shadow planets' work comes after Saturn's.
ambiguity: Whether this means an order in dasha, in life stages or in the way a chart is read is not said.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no such sequence between Saturn and the nodes.

hindi: ये जो मैं बकबक कर रहा हूं य राहु का काम है करना धरना कुछ नहीं बस य मुंडी लानी देखना सोचना समझना करना नहीं
says: He says the chatter he is doing now is Rahu's work: talking, seeing, thinking and understanding without actually doing anything. Rahu stands for talk and thought that stay short of action.
ambiguity: 'मुंडी लानी' looks like 'मुंडी हिलानी' (nodding the head); the caption is rough.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is linked to talk, speculation and illusion, though not specifically to inaction.

hindi: इसलिए राहु के द्वारा आपको मौज चलती है
says: He says that is why enjoyment and fun (mauj) run through Rahu: you take your pleasure in talking and thinking.
ambiguity: 'मौज' (pleasure) is used loosely and could mean idle enjoyment or just continuing without effort.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is a karaka of worldly desire and indulgence.

hindi: ज्ञान बांट रहे हैं तो केतु सेट ऑन हो जाता है
says: He says that when you are giving out knowledge to others, Ketu gets switched on. Teaching and sharing knowledge activates Ketu.
ambiguity: 'सेट ऑन' is his phrase for activating or strengthening Ketu.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is a karaka of moksha and occult learning; its link to sharing knowledge is not classical.

hindi: जायज बाटेंगे बृहस्पति सुधर गया अपने ग्रह
says: He says that if you share the knowledge in a proper, legitimate way, Jupiter improves. Right sharing acts as a remedy for Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'जायज' (legitimate) is not defined; the sentence also runs on to 'improve your own planets' on the next line.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: teaching and giving vidya-daan is a classical remedy for Jupiter.

gist: Says to improve your own planets, because life has moved on; the sentence is cut short.
Says that if you only chase money, money, what is the use of it.
Joke that even actor Akshay Kumar did not get his 'cut' by chasing only money; the caption is garbled.
Audience asks to take questions; he agrees that since they insist, he will do it.
Audience says the Manglik topic was left pending; the host says it is kept pending for now.
Someone asks what to do about being Manglik; he says not to worry and not to leak this in the market.
Says Manglik is a very beautiful topic to be taken up properly later.

hindi: वैसे मंगलिक आपके रिश्ते अब आए हुए भी चले जाएंगे
says: He says a Manglik person's marriage proposals may go away even after they have come; the matches that arrive can still fall through.
cells_derived_method: Manglik status comes from Mars in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th; he names none here. Derived using the standard Manglik houses, with dignity changing the strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 7th, lagna Libra. Manglik in the marriage house in his own sign; proposals come but break at the last step through temper.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 4th, lagna Libra. Manglik, but Mars is exalted, which classical texts often treat as cancelling the fault.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 12th, lagna Leo. Manglik with Mars debilitated, the heavier case for losses within the partnership.

ambiguity: He gives no house list or criteria for Manglik; 'will go' is not tied to a time.
classical_check: Differs: classical Manglik texts offer many cancellations (own sign, exalted sign, Jupiter aspect) and do not say proposals always fail.

hindi: अब तो मंगली की गृहस्थ खराब रहता है कुछ भी कर लो बहुत उपाय चाहिए
says: He claims that a Manglik's married household life stays bad whatever you do, and that many remedies are needed to change it.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the fault depends on the house (7th and 8th are heavier) and the sign of Mars. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 8th, lagna Aries. Own sign in the 8th: a hard, long-lasting strain on married life.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. Mars is debilitated in the family house, so harsh speech and family friction.

ambiguity: 'कुछ भी कर लो' is absolute, yet he then says remedies are needed, which weakens it.
classical_check: Differs: classical Manglik dosha is mitigated by matching two Manglik charts and by remedies; he gives it as nearly unavoidable.

hindi: बस वही जो मैंने शुरू में कहा यू नो गुरु कृपा चाहिए
says: He says that, as he said at the start, the real answer is the guru's grace: the Manglik problem needs the blessing of a guru and cannot be fixed by remedy alone.
ambiguity: 'वही' refers back to his opening remarks of the lecture, which are not in this slice.
classical_check: Silent: guru-kripa is a general doctrine, not a Manglik rule in the classics.

gist: First audience question: will wearing a gemstone fix the Vastu dosha of the home; the question continues into the next line.

hindi: वास्तुदोष बिल्कुल ठीक नहीं होता
says: Answering the question, he says a gemstone does not fix the home's vastu dosha at all.
ambiguity: The first part of the answer sits at the end of the previous line (the question); the 'gemstone' subject is carried from it.
classical_check: Agrees: gemstones are a graha remedy, and vastu texts prescribe structural changes.

hindi: लेकिन जेम स्टोन पहनने के बाद पता नहीं कैसे हालात अपने आप बदल जाते हैं और वास्तु दोष हटाने वाला व्यक्ति मिल जाता है ऑटोमेटिक होता है
says: He says that even so, after wearing the gemstone, circumstances change by themselves in some unknown way and a person who can remove the vastu dosha turns up automatically.
ambiguity: No mechanism is given: he says 'I don't know how'. No gem is named.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not claim a stone brings the person who fixes vastu.

hindi: किसी लड़की की शादी में समस्या है जेम स्टोन डाल दो पता नहीं क्या होगा अपने आप ही सेट हो जाएगा
says: He says that if a girl has a problem in her marriage, you should put a gemstone on her and it will set itself right on its own, though he does not know how.
ambiguity: No stone, planet or chart condition is stated; it is a blanket claim.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gemstones for the marriage karaka (Venus or the 7th lord) are classical, but not as a blanket cure.

hindi: लड़के की जॉब नहीं लग रही जेम स्टोन डाल दो जो जायज है पता नहीं क्या होगा कैसे जॉब लग जाएगी
says: He says that if a young man is not getting a job, you should put on the appropriate gemstone, and he does not know how, but the job will come.
ambiguity: 'जो जायज है' (whichever is suitable) leaves the stone unspecified, so it depends on the chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gemstones for the 10th lord or Sun and Saturn are classical, but outcome claims are not.

hindi: इसमें कैसे काम नहीं करता जादू काम करता है जिंदगी अपने आप चलती है
says: He says these remedies do not work by an explainable mechanism; magic works, and life runs on its own. He is saying no logic is needed for a remedy to act.
ambiguity: The opening 'इसमें कैसे काम नहीं करता' is garbled and may be 'it does not work by how'; the 'magic' sense is the clearer part.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give a karma-based account, not 'magic'.

hindi: आपका एक्सीडेंट नहीं होगा जेम स्टोन पहन के 101 पर लिखा अगर लिखा है तो जरूर होगा आपको कुछ नहीं होगा जेम स्टोन मतलब प्रोटेक्शन
says: He says a gemstone means protection: it will not stop what is written, since if an accident is written it will surely happen, but it shields you in the way a safety measure would. He makes it sound as if you will come to no harm with the stone.
ambiguity: The '101' part is garbled (maybe a speed, 101, or a number plate); he says both 'no accident will happen' and 'if it is written it will happen', which conflict.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gems are meant to strengthen a planet, protective by tradition, but not to override prarabdha.

hindi: बदाम का मतलब क्या है कोविड नहीं आएगा कोविड आएगा उसको आना है तो आपकी इम्युनिटी बढ़ेगी स्टोन का मतलब है प्रोटेक्शन
says: Analogy with almonds: eating almonds will not stop Covid, which will come if it has to, but it raises your immunity; a stone likewise means protection and not prevention.
ambiguity: Almonds and Covid are only the analogy; he gives no health advice.
classical_check: Silent: the analogy is his own; classical texts present gems as strengtheners of a planet.

hindi: ये चश्मे ने क्या एक्स्ट्रा कर दिया कुछ भी नहीं ये प्रोटेक्शन है नंबर नहीं गिरने देगा आगे हेडेक नहीं होने देगा परेशानी नहीं होने देगा साफ दिखेगा
says: Analogy with spectacles: glasses add nothing extra, but they protect by stopping the power from getting worse, preventing headaches and giving clear vision. A gemstone works as protection in the same way.
ambiguity: The point is that the stone supports, it does not cure.
classical_check: Silent: the spectacles image is his own.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा काम यह चश्मा करेगा और कोई लेना देना नहीं आपके कपड़े क्या करते हैं आपको प्रोटेक्शन देते हैं हमारी
says: He ends the glasses point by saying the glasses do all this work and nothing else, then adds clothes as a third analogy: your clothes protect you, as a stone does. The sentence is cut off.
ambiguity: The last word 'हमारी' is cut off and the sentence has no end.
classical_check: Silent: the clothes analogy is his own.

hindi: प्रोटेक्शन के उपाय होते हैं सिर्फ प्रोटेक्शन रस्ता ब रास्ते अपने आप बनते हैं
says: He states that remedies are only protection and nothing more; the actual ways and openings in life then form by themselves, without the remedy creating them.
ambiguity: 'रस्ता ब' is a cut-off word, read as 'रास्ते'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies are meant to soften or protect against karma, not to create results.

hindi: आपने जायज स्टोन पहन लिया बुरे टाइम में आप नीचे नहीं गिरोगे
says: He says that if you wear the proper gemstone, then in a bad period you will not fall down; the stone limits how far you drop when the bad time arrives.
ambiguity: 'जायज' (proper) means the stone suited to the chart; no stone is named. The words just before it ('नेगेटिव बन') are garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gems are traditionally worn to strengthen a planet during its period, but 'will not fall' is stronger than the texts say.

hindi: आपका बुरा समय आ गया आपने गिरना शुरू किया ग्रह कहता है कि ग्राफ के अंदर जीवन के ग्राफ में आपको नीचे की ओर गिरना है ये आपका लाइफ है
says: Using a graph, he says that when your bad time arrives you start falling because the planets are telling you that your life graph must go downward at this stage; this is simply how a life runs.
ambiguity: He gives no rule for how a bad period is identified in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: good and bad dasha periods lift and lower fortune.

hindi: अभी अच्छे टाइम में आप ऐसे क्लाइम किए पूरा टाइम आया गिरे अब कायदे से इसके नीचे आपको यहां गिरना चाहिए था बुरे टाइम में
says: On the graph he says that in the good time you climb up, then when the bad time comes you are due to fall to a low point; that low point is where the chart takes you by the proper course.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a drawn line, so the exact low level is only shown, not said.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the rise and fall follows the sequence of dashas.

hindi: बुरे टाइम में गिरने के बाद जब अच्छा टाइम आएगा तो फिर दोबारा यहां उठना था अब उठने के बाद यहां से उठना था
says: He continues the graph: after the fall in the bad time, when the good time comes again you were due to rise again from that low point, and from there the climb continues.
ambiguity: Again he is drawing on a board; the exact heights are not given.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: a good dasha follows a bad one and recovers fortune.

hindi: आपने स्टोन डाल लिया यहीं आप यहां से नीचे नहीं गिरोगे और यहीं से उठ जाओगे
says: Remedy effect on the graph: if you put on the stone, you do not fall to the low point; you stop at a higher level and start rising again from there.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe remedies as raising the floor of a fall.

hindi: अगर आप यहीं से होते तो यहां से इतना उठते उसी में और रॉकेट बनते
says: He compares the stone-protected rise with the unprotected path: had you been at the bottom you would have risen that much in the same time and become a rocket. The caption does not make clear whether he sees this as better or worse than the protected rise.
ambiguity: Two readings fit: the stone gives a higher but smaller rise, or without it the rebound would have been a sharper rocket. The surrounding section lines are garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस दौरान गुरु क मिला यह गुरु की कृपा से मिला है अगर ये मिला है तो गुरु की कृपा से मिला है अदर वाइज
says: He says that if you got this protection or help during that period, it came through the guru's grace; otherwise you would not have got it.
ambiguity: 'गुरु' may mean a human teacher or the planet Jupiter; he settles it as Jupiter in the next line. 'क मिला' is cut off.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of grace, guru and protection.

hindi: नहीं मिला यह मिले गए गुरु बृहस्पति ही कृपा दे रहा है
says: He names the giver of the grace: it is the guru Jupiter himself who is giving the grace and protection.
ambiguity: The first words 'नहीं मिला' end the previous sentence ('otherwise it would not have been got').
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the planet of grace.

hindi: और वकृत्व का लफड़ा सबसे बड़ा है बृहस्पति वक्री आदि लाइफ तो वैसे कबाड़ा हो गई बहुत लफड़ा है
says: He says retrograde motion (vakritva) is the biggest trouble in this subject: with a retrograde Jupiter and similar cases, life goes to ruin and there is a lot of mess.
cells_derived_method: How bad a retrograde Jupiter is would depend on its dignity and house. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo. Jupiter is debilitated and retrograde in the trouble house, the heaviest case.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. Jupiter is exalted, so grace is kept but is uneven or late.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th, lagna Aries. Own sign, so the faith and guidance stay, with inner doubt.

ambiguity: 'वकृत्व' is garbled for 'वक्रत्व' (retrogression). 'आदि' (and so on) suggests other retrograde planets are bad too.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat a retrograde benefic as strong in its effects (cheshta bala), not as simply bad.

hindi: मोदी जी का बृहस्पति वक्री है चौथे घर में चौथा घर जो हमने राम जी का शनि जहां बिठाया था भोग नहीं मोदी जी की लाइफ में देखो
says: As a named example he says that Narendra Modi has a retrograde Jupiter in the 4th house, the same house where he earlier seated Ram's Saturn, and that there is no enjoyment (bhoga) in Modi's life. This is his claim about a public figure's chart; it has not been checked here.
cells_derived_method: The sign of the retrograde Jupiter in the 4th changes the strength of the denial of comfort. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. Exalted in a kendra, so comfort is denied less and the mind keeps its peace.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Capricorn in the 4th, lagna Libra. Debilitated in the home house, so home comfort and peace are weak.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. In a Venus sign, so comfort comes in form but is not enjoyed.

ambiguity: He gives no sign or birth data for the example. 'Ram ji's Saturn' refers to an earlier class (Saturn exalted in Libra in the 4th of a Cancer lagna).
classical_check: Differs in part: Jupiter in the 4th usually gives home and comfort, and retrogression does not remove it; the no-enjoyment rule is his own.

hindi: अगर उस व्यक्ति को भोग चाहिए तो तड़पता रहेगा क्योंकि बृहस्पति भोग देगा ही नहीं
says: He says that if such a person does crave enjoyment (bhoga), he will keep pining, because a retrograde Jupiter in this place simply will not give enjoyment.
cells_derived_method: A craving for comfort with a denying Jupiter shows more in worldly signs than in spiritual ones. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Taurus in the 4th, lagna Aquarius. Strong wish for comfort and property with a Venus sign, so the denial hurts most.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Pisces in the 4th, lagna Sagittarius. Own sign with a spiritual bent, so the lack of comfort is felt less.

ambiguity: The house is carried from the previous sentence (the 4th).
classical_check: Differs: no classical text says a retrograde Jupiter in the 4th denies enjoyment altogether.

hindi: लेकिन वो व्यक्ति साधु है उसे भोग चाहिए नहीं इसलिए राजा बना रखा है
says: He adds the other side: because the man is of a sage's nature and does not want enjoyment, Jupiter has made him a king instead; the one who does not need enjoyment gets rulership.
ambiguity: A 'sadhu nature' is not tied to any chart factor, so it cannot be tested from the chart alone.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text links a denying Jupiter with kingship for a renunciate.

hindi: यह है हमारी कॉन्शसनेस बकरी गुरु है इसलिए मोदी जी भी क किसकी मनते सुनते हैं पक्के बंद मुट्ठी वाले आदमी है
says: He says a retrograde Jupiter ('बकरी' is the caption's garble of 'वक्री') is our own conscience, so such a person listens to nobody: he is firm and closed-fisted, does what he has decided, and he gives Modi's push on Article 370 as the example.
cells_derived_method: The stubborn streak would show in different ways depending on the sign. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Aries in the 1st, lagna Aries. Self-willed, impulsive and quick to follow his own inner voice.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Scorpio in the 7th, lagna Taurus. Stubborn in partnerships, secretive and slow to accept advice.

ambiguity: 'बकरी गुरु' is read as 'वक्री गुरु'; if wrong, the claim is about something else. The political example is only illustration, not a ruling on it.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a retrograde Jupiter this self-willed meaning.

gist: Audience asks the next question: if Jupiter is combust, how do you get work from the guru.
Says combustion is also a mess and that he has not touched this topic yet.

hindi: अगर अस्त है तो इसका मतलब सूर्य के साथ साथ बैठा
says: He defines a combust (asta) planet as one sitting together with the Sun.
ambiguity: He says 'together' only; no degree limit is given here.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: combustion needs a planet close to the Sun, within degree limits set by the planet.

hindi: ग्रह अस्त होता है अस्त का मतलब है सूरज की इतनी ज्यादा रोशनी है कि वो ग्रह दिख नहीं रहा तो अस्त कहते हैं
says: He explains the word: a planet is called asta when the Sun's light is so strong that the planet cannot be seen.
classical_check: Agrees: combustion is the loss of visibility in the Sun's glare.

hindi: अस्त सोया हुआ अस्त मींस जान नहीं है
says: He adds that asta means asleep, a planet with no life or energy in it.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: a combust planet is treated as weakened and unable to deliver its results.

hindi: बुध अक्सर अस्त होता है क्योंकि सूर्य के साथ ही रहता है चंद्रमा भी होता है मंगल भी होता है सब अस्त हो जाते हैं सूर्य के प्रकाश के आगे
says: He says Mercury is often combust because it always stays close to the Sun, and the Moon and Mars can be too; all planets go combust before the Sun's light.
ambiguity: Venus is also often combust but is not named here.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury and Venus are the usual combust planets as they stay close to the Sun; the Moon is combust near the new moon.

hindi: वो जो अस्त है उसको भी स्टोन से ही ठीक किया जा सकता है या थोड़े बहुत दान से
says: Remedy: a combust planet can be put right with a gemstone, or with a little donation.
ambiguity: No stone or item is named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies for a combust planet include its gem and charity, though some texts say a combust planet's gem is the stone to wear.

hindi: लेकिन वक्री इज डेंजरस अस्त स्लो
says: He contrasts the two: a retrograde planet is dangerous, while a combust planet is slow, meaning milder in its trouble.
ambiguity: 'Slow' may mean slow in results or a slower damage.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat both as modifications of strength, and retrograde is often seen as strong.

hindi: बुध अस्त है तो मैथ्स में नंबर नहीं आएंगे फिजिक्स डाउन रहेगा
says: He gives a school example: if Mercury is combust, the student will not score in maths and physics will stay down.
cells_derived_method: A combust Mercury is in the same sign as the Sun, and the house decides how much it hurts studies. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust Mercury with the Sun in Gemini in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. The study house is hit, so maths marks are the likely casualty.
Derived: combust Mercury with the Sun in Virgo in the 4th, lagna Gemini. Mercury is exalted and own-sign, but combust, so school learning is weak despite talent.
Derived: combust Mercury with the Sun in Gemini in the 2nd, lagna Taurus. Early learning and speech are hurt, which shows in calculation.

ambiguity: Physics 'down' is vague, and no house for study is named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a weak or combust Mercury is linked with poor mathematics and logic.

hindi: शुक्र अस्त है तो बायोलॉजी की बैंड बजी रहेगी
says: He says that if Venus is combust, biology will be badly hit.
cells_derived_method: A combust Venus is in the same sign as the Sun; the house shows where the loss lands. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust Venus with the Sun in Taurus in the 5th, lagna Capricorn. Own sign but combust in the study house, so life-science subjects are weak.
Derived: combust Venus with the Sun in Pisces in the 4th, lagna Sagittarius. Venus is exalted but combust, so early education is uneven.
Derived: combust Venus with the Sun in Libra in the 6th, lagna Taurus. The Sun is debilitated and Venus combust, so exams and sustained practice are a struggle.

ambiguity: Why Venus is tied to biology is not explained (life, living bodies).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie Venus to biology as a subject.

hindi: लेकिन शुक्र वक्री है बायोलॉजी छूट जाएगा
says: Contrasting with combustion, he says that if Venus is retrograde the student will drop biology altogether.
cells_derived_method: Dignity and house change how complete the dropping is. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Venus in Libra in the 5th, lagna Gemini. Own sign, so the subject is dropped but another arts-type subject takes its place.
Derived: retrograde Venus in Virgo in the 4th, lagna Gemini. Debilitated and retrograde, the most complete case of leaving a subject.
Derived: retrograde Venus in Taurus in the 9th, lagna Virgo. Own sign, so the field is left in higher studies, not in school.

ambiguity: 'छूट जाएगा' could be dropped by choice or lost through failure.
classical_check: Silent: retrograde Venus has no biology rule in classical texts.

hindi: अच्छा मतलब उसका पोटेंसी हल्की रहेगी लेकिन वो का काम नीच और रेट्रोग्रेड की तरह ही करेगा वो छोड़ देगा
says: He says a combust planet has a lighter potency, yet its work will go the same way as a debilitated or retrograde planet: it will leave the subject. The caption is broken and the sense is only partly clear.
ambiguity: This sits oddly with his earlier 'combust is slow, retrograde is dangerous'. The word 'वो का' is cut off and 'वो छोड़ देगा' could mean the subject is dropped or the planet gives up.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर मंगल नीच का है काटने वाला कि कट लगा दूंगा और है अस्त तो कट नहीं लगाएगा निशान डाल के छोड़ देगा
says: He says a debilitated Mars is the cutting type that threatens to slash, but if it is also combust it will not cut; it will only leave a mark and stop. Combustion takes the sharpness out of a harmful Mars.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Mars is in Cancer; combust means the Sun is also in Cancer. The house decides which body area gets the mark. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 1st, lagna Cancer. A scar or mark on the head or face rather than a deep cut.
Derived: combust debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. A mark on the chest or in the home, vehicle scratches rather than a crash.
Derived: combust debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 10th, lagna Libra. A mark on the knees; a work setback shows as a blemish, not as ruin.

ambiguity: 'नीच का' is read as Mars in Cancer, its debilitation sign. Whether combust and debilitated cancel exactly is his wording only.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say a combust planet gives no results at all, good or bad, rather than leaving a mark.

hindi: तो अस्त ग्रह अगर खराब है तो उसके उपाय नहीं कराते हम क्योंकि वो बैड कर नहीं पाता सूर्य करने नहीं देता
says: Remedy rule: if a combust planet is a bad one, he does not prescribe remedies for it, because it cannot do harm; the Sun does not let it.
ambiguity: It conflicts with his earlier line that a combust planet can be fixed by a stone or donation; here it is for the harmful planets only.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a combust malefic is held to lose its power to harm in classical texts.

hindi: इस तरह कई फैक्ट में घ में हनुमान जी का ध लगा हा धवज लगाते उपाय हनुमान जी को साउथ की र प्लेस करते हैं
says: Vastu remedy: in many places, such as factories and homes, a flag of Hanuman ji is put up, and Hanuman ji is placed facing the south.
ambiguity: The caption is badly broken ('ध लगा हा धवज'); 'flag' and 'south' are the readable parts, and 'फैक्ट' is probably 'फैक्ट्री'.
classical_check: Silent: a Hanuman flag is a vastu custom, not a classical Jyotish remedy.

gist: A broken run of words about something kept in the house being an indicator of Hanuman ji and belonging to vastu; the caption is too garbled to record a claim.

hindi: अनकस माइंड रीड कर लेता वास्तु के उपाय होते हैं
says: He says the unconscious mind reads the symbol, and that is how vastu remedies work.
ambiguity: 'अनकस' is the caption's garble of 'unconscious'.
classical_check: Silent: it is a modern psychological explanation, not a classical one.

gist: Mentions that the Chitragupta class was done earlier.

hindi: कोने से दिख जाता है जैसे आप मान के चलो कैसे एक्टिवेट करते हैं हम इसको
says: He adds that the symbol need not be looked at directly: it gets seen even from the corner of the eye, and the question is how this is activated.
ambiguity: 'कोने से' could mean the corner of the eye or a corner of the room.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह अनकॉन्शियस माइंड यह देवता जो है जो वरुण की कृपा कहते हैं कृपा कृपा कृपा पता नहीं क्या है
says: He links the unconscious mind to the deity Varuna, the Neptune of his scheme, and says what people call grace is this Varuna's grace; he adds that nobody really knows what it is.
ambiguity: 'यह देवता जो है जो वरुण' is broken; it may say the unconscious is a deity ruled by Varuna.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune and Varuna as the unconscious are not classical; Varuna is a Vedic water god.

gist: Illustration: you thought of rasgulla, barfi and halwa that were not there and your mouth watered; you walked to the sweet shop and bought carrot halwa, showing that one thought changed your whole system.

hindi: ऐसे ही हो सकता है ध्वज लगा देने से आपका जो अनकॉन्शियस माइंड है वो ऑन होता है और पुरानी यादों से हनुमान जी को उठा के लाता है
says: By the same logic, he says putting up the flag switches on the unconscious mind, which then brings Hanuman ji up from old memories.
ambiguity: 'गधा' in the caption is read as 'ध्वज' (flag).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सेल्फ कॉन्फिडेंस का देवता है
says: He names Hanuman as the deity of self-confidence, so the flag brings out the self-confidence of the person.
ambiguity: The sentence begins in the previous line and 'सेल्फ कॉन्फिडेंस का देवता है' is its end.
classical_check: Silent: Hanuman as the self-confidence god is a devotional idea, not a Jyotish karaka.

hindi: ये साउथ साउथ ईस्ट का देवता है साउथ ईस्ट का देवता है साउथ साउथ ईस्ट का प्रमुख है
says: Vastu link: he says Hanuman is the deity of the south and south-east, the head of the south-south-east direction, which is why the flag goes there.
ambiguity: 'साउथ साउथ ईस्ट' is read as south and south-east; the exact direction is unclear because he repeats the words.
classical_check: Silent: vastu texts give the south to Mars/Yama and the south-east to Agni, not to Hanuman.

hindi: साउथ ईस्ट का शुक्र है
says: He says the south-east belongs to Venus, so the direction has a Venus link; this ties Hanuman's direction to Venus.
ambiguity: 'शुक्र है' can also mean 'thank goodness'; it is read here as 'the Venus'. The sentence is very short.
classical_check: Agrees: vastu gives the south-east to Venus (Agni corner).

hindi: आपके ऑटोमेटिक लाइफ के अंदर माइंड से आपके अनकॉन्शियस माइंड की वजह से ऐसी रिकंस्ट्रक्शन होती है कि आप उस एरिया की वाइब्रेशंस को पकड़ लेते हो
says: He says that through the unconscious mind a kind of reconstruction happens in your automatic life, so you pick up the vibrations of that area of the house without noticing.
ambiguity: 'रिकंस्ट्रक्शन' is vague: it may mean the mind rebuilds its sense of the place.
classical_check: Silent: a modern psychological claim.

gist: Demonstrates with a pen: a hot zone and a cold zone are drawn, and the pen warms near one and cools near the other, to show automatic response to an area.

hindi: अब मान लो घर के अंदर य वेस्ट का एरिया है यह वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट है जैसे ही आपके इस घर के अंदर आप एक चीज ले जाते हैं या आपका कुछ जाता है तो ये कृपा लेने लग जाता है
says: Vastu example: in the house, the west or north-west area is such that as soon as you take something there, or something of yours goes there, that area starts drawing away your grace.
ambiguity: 'ये कृपा लेने लग जाता है' is unclear and may mean the area starts taking your grace, or taking something else. 'वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट' is read as west and north-west.
classical_check: Silent: vastu gives the west to Saturn and the north-west to the Moon but not this rule.

hindi: जैसे ही यहां यहां चला जाता है ऑटोमेटिक डिप्रेशन शुरू हो जाती है
says: He says that as soon as a person goes into that area, depression starts automatically. This is his vastu claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: He points at a place on a board; it is the west/north-west just named, but this is inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो वो एरियाज बंधे हुए हैं कोई पैसे का एरिया है कोई वेस्टेज का एरिया है कोई पेट का एरिया है कोई सिर का एरिया है
says: He says the areas of a house are bound to fixed topics: one is the money area, one the wastage area, one the stomach area and one the head area.
ambiguity: The sentence starts in this line and ends in the next; he does not map each area to a direction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: vastu zones have set associations, but the mapping to body parts is his own.

hindi: ऐसे ही कुंडली में भी खाने बने हुए हैं एक घुटना है आपका एक सिर है एक पैर है यह सारी कार्यक्रम कुंडली के अंदर अपने आप ही बने हुए हैं
says: He says the chart works the same way: its houses (khane) are fixed to body parts, one is the knee, one the head, one the foot, and all this is built into the chart by itself.
cells_derived_method: The house gives the body part (head 1st, knee 10th, feet 12th) and the sign in it adds its own body part, so one cell touches two parts. Derived from Kala Purusha, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 1st, lagna Aries. House and sign both point to the head, so the head is the sharp focus.
Derived: Capricorn in the 10th, lagna Aries. House and sign both point to the knees, so the knees are the sharp focus.
Derived: Pisces in the 12th, lagna Aries. House and sign both point to the feet.
Derived: Aries in the 10th, lagna Cancer. The house says knees and the sign says head, so a split focus between the two.

ambiguity: He names the parts but gives no house numbers.
classical_check: Agrees: Kala Purusha gives each bhava and sign a body part, in the same order.

hindi: ये चेहरे की और फेस की ले लेंगे ये घुटना है ये राइट घुटना है
says: Pointing at the chart, he says this house is the face, which they will take later, and another is the knee, specifically the right knee.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a diagram, so no house numbers are spoken; the right-versus-left split is his own addition. The first words are partly garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the knee is the 10th house in Kala Purusha; left and right sides are not in the classical scheme.

gist: A broken line about 'properly, if a reverse baby were born, left ... with your brain you have to know Jyotish'; the sense cannot be made out.

hindi: यह पेट का हिस्सा है
says: He points out another house in the chart and calls it the stomach part of the body.
ambiguity: No house number is spoken; it follows the body-part list and leads into the piles remark.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th and 6th houses cover the stomach and intestines in Kala Purusha.

hindi: आपको पाइल्स बाबा सीरा आठवे घर से सेट बैठेगी
says: He says piles (bawasir) will be read from the 8th house. This is his health claim recorded as said, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 8th and its lord shape the kind of piles. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio (Mars) in the 8th, lagna Aries. A Mars-ruled 8th reads as bleeding piles.
Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 8th, lagna Gemini. A Saturn-ruled 8th reads as chronic, dry constipation-type piles.
Derived: Virgo (Mercury) in the 8th, lagna Aquarius. A Mercury-ruled 8th reads as nervous digestive trouble leading to piles.

ambiguity: 'बाबा सीरा' is the caption's garble of 'बवासीर' (piles).
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 8th covers the excretory region, and Mars and Saturn are named for piles in classical medical astrology.

hindi: आप देखो कुंडली के अंदर यह दोष है बंदे को कंफर्म हो जाएगा कि हां यह है और होएगा
says: He says that when you check the chart and find the fault there, the person will have it confirmed that yes, this problem exists and will happen to him; the chart check is how such problems are verified.
ambiguity: 'होएगा' (will happen) states certainty; nothing says how likely the fault is once found.
classical_check: Silent: it is a general claim that the chart confirms conditions.

gist: Says how moles are counted and which planet is where will be taken later.
Audience asks the next question: Jupiter was discussed at the start of the class, so if Jupiter is right do all other things start going right.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति ठीक है तो वो रास्ते दिखाता रहेगा पूरी जिंदगी आप देखेंगे आपको मुसीबत आती है हमेशा निकल जाते हो
says: Answering, he says that if Jupiter is in good shape it keeps showing you the ways throughout life: trouble comes but you always get out of it.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Jupiter in a trouble house shows this most clearly. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 6th, lagna Libra. Own sign in the house of trouble, so problems arise and are resolved.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th, lagna Aries. Own sign in the fortune house, so help arrives through teachers and luck.
Derived: Jupiter in Cancer in the 11th, lagna Virgo. Exalted in the gain house, so help comes through friends and networks.

ambiguity: 'ठीक है' is not defined (dignity, house, aspects).
classical_check: Agrees: a strong Jupiter is the planet of protection and guidance.

hindi: जाते हो शनि भी यही करता है आपके पास मुसीबत आनी चाहिए पता नहीं कैसे कौन बचा लेता है
says: He adds that Saturn does the same: trouble ought to come to you, and somehow someone saves you without your knowing how.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Saturn in a house of struggle shows this most. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo. Own sign in the house of trouble, so crises are met with workarounds.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 11th, lagna Sagittarius. Exalted in the gain house, so rescue comes through structure and contacts.

ambiguity: The first words 'जाते हो' finish the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong Saturn in a dusthana helps one survive hardships, which is the harsh version of rescue.

hindi: ऐसे लोग अक्सर करते हैं हम तो हरने माता से मिलने जाते हैं हम तो हनुमान जी को सलाम करते हैं रोज उनके होते हैं जुपिटर के पॉजिटिविटी
says: He says that such rescued people often credit a goddess or Hanuman ji, saying they visit the Mata or salute Hanuman daily; in fact it is the positivity of their Jupiter that is working.
ambiguity: 'हरने माता' is garbled (perhaps Vaishno Mata). The last words 'उनके होते हैं' are cut and read as 'it is theirs'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter is the planet of devotion and divine protection.

hindi: बृहस्पति की और उनकी लाइफ में प्रॉब्लम आती है और पता नहीं कैसे निकल जाती है कोई दोस्त ही कुछ बता देता है अचानक ही उनको पता लगता है उनका टायर पंचर हुआ और पंचर वाले के सामने हुआ है
says: He gives examples of this rescue: a problem arises and clears up without them knowing how, a friend happens to tell them something, or the tyre punctures right in front of a puncture shop.
ambiguity: The examples are anecdotes; they are not claims about a particular placement.
classical_check: Silent: anecdotes of lucky escape are not classical rules.

hindi: जुगाड़ का ग्रह तो है शनि और बृहस्पति कृपा का है
says: He splits the two helpers: Saturn is the planet of jugaad, meaning workarounds and improvised fixes, while Jupiter is the planet of grace.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the grace karaka; Saturn as the jugaad planet is his own colourful label for its resourcefulness.

gist: Repeats that all the jugaad, as many as are needed, is done by Saturn.

hindi: आपको टेंशन नहीं अब आपको ना यह ढूंढना बंद होना कैसे होगा शनि भयंकर जुगाड़ कराएगा
says: He says you need not worry about how it will happen, since Saturn will arrange fierce workarounds for you; the native does not have to find the way himself.
ambiguity: The middle words ('ना यह ढूंढना बंद होना') are garbled; the sense 'stop searching for how' is a best guess.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Points out that Adani and Ambani carry debts of billions and the richest man bought X for 44 billion dollars; he stops mid-sentence, with no chart point made.

hindi: लोन लिया हनुमान जी से यह हनुमान की कृपा है यह मंगल ग्रह करता है
says: He says that the strength you 'borrow' from Hanuman ji is Hanuman's grace, and that in the chart it is the planet Mars that carries it out.
ambiguity: 'लोन लिया' (took a loan) is a figure of speech for drawing on Hanuman's help; it is not explained.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the planet of courage and Hanuman is worshipped for Mars-type strength, though the classics do not equate the two.

gist: Says all these matters will be taken up and seen later, that there is a lot of depth in them and it will be long.
Audience says the next question: they did something in the Hanuman Chalisa class and are getting nothing.

hindi: हनुमान जी से कृपा मांगो मिल जाता है साक्षात है करके देख लो हजार बार देख लो
says: Remedy: ask Hanuman ji for his grace and it is received; he is a living, present deity, so try it a thousand times and see.
ambiguity: He names no chart condition for who it suits; it is given as a general devotional remedy.
classical_check: Silent: Hanuman worship is a devotional practice and not a classical Jyotish remedy by rule.

gist: Audience asks how the purpose of one's life is seen in the chart.
Says you cannot see it yourself; meet him, do seva, and then the work proceeds and you will know, since if you could read it yourself the matter would be over.

hindi: और वैसे लाइफ के पर्पस ढूंढने के चक्कर में मत रहो आपके भाग्य में जो लिखा वो होके रहेगा परपस की ऐसी की तैसी
says: He says not to waste effort searching for your life purpose, because whatever is written in your fortune will happen anyway; he dismisses the idea of a purpose strongly.
ambiguity: It sits oddly with his later explanation that life does have a purpose (working off past karma).
classical_check: Partly agrees: destiny is fixed by prarabdha karma in classical thought, though texts do speak of a purpose (dharma).

gist: Story: only yesterday an old client of about thirty years, whose marriage he had arranged thirty years ago, came to him.
The client left offended, saying 'you are not helping me at all'; he had been asked for some particular information first.
Says that when a bad time comes people turn away from the guide, not the other way round, and that they come back on their own after being knocked about.
Says free seva is going on, but people try two or four other places when distressed and end up paying fees.

hindi: परपस यह है कि अपनी जिंदगी अपने हिसाब से चले नहीं
says: He says life's purpose is not that our life should run as we plan it.
ambiguity: The sentence is short and the 'नहीं' at the end reads as a negation of the first clause.
classical_check: Silent: it is a karma-doctrine view, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: हमारा परपस यह है कि पूर्व जन्म के अंदर किए हुए वो कर्म जिनका हमें कोई आभास नहीं जिसके कारण से हो रहा है सब वो हम भोग पाए काट पाए
says: He says our real purpose is to go through and clear the karmas of previous births, of which we have no awareness, which are the cause of everything that is happening now.
classical_check: Agrees: the chart is read as the map of past-life karma to be experienced (prarabdha).

hindi: और के बदले रिएक्शन ना दे नई पीढ़ियां नई कहानियां ना बनाए
says: He adds that while going through the old karma we should not react in return and so create new stories that would carry over into new generations.
ambiguity: 'और के बदले' is garbled; it reads as 'against others in exchange'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical doctrine warns that retaliation creates fresh karma (kriyamana).

hindi: और क्षमा सीखे और दफा करना सीखे और फाइट आउट करें यह परपस है हमारी लाइफ का
says: He finishes the list of life's purposes: learn forgiveness, learn to let things go, and fight the account out; that is the purpose of our life.
ambiguity: 'फाइट आउट' could mean to settle it by facing it, or to fight back, which would contradict the line on not reacting.
classical_check: Silent: it is a moral teaching, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: एक्चुअली लाइफ का तो ऑटोमेटिक पर्पस है जब
says: He says that actually life's purpose takes care of itself, running automatically; it is not something the native has to arrange.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and continues into the next line ('when it makes us be born...').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पैदा कराएगी करा दिया उसने हमें भी अपनी मर्जी से नहीं पैदा होने का मौका दिया अपनी मर्जी से ले जाएगी हमारे से पूछ के कोई नहीं मारने वाला
says: He says nature made us be born without asking us and will take us away by its own choice; nobody asks us before ending our life. Birth and the end of life are not in our hands.
ambiguity: The subject of 'पैदा कराएगी' (feminine) is unnamed: possibly nature or the cosmic mother.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: birth and death are fixed by karma in classical doctrine.

hindi: हम आप मौत के मुंह में हो आपकी मौत नहीं होगी आप भले चंगे हो लिखा है मर जाओगे मरही जाओगे कोई बीमारी भी नहीं होगी परपस फिक्स है
says: He says that if death is not written, you will not die even in the jaws of death, and if it is written you will die even when perfectly healthy and with no illness; the purpose is fixed. This is general fatalism, not a prediction for any chart and no date.
ambiguity: It is a general doctrine; he names no planet or house for death.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: ayus (lifespan) is held to be fixed by the chart and cannot be changed by effort alone.

gist: Says do not be troubled by searching for what your purpose is, so enjoy yourself and party.

hindi: आपका ब्रेन जितना शार्प और बढ़िया रहेगा उतना बढ़िया टैकल कर पा लाइफ को पार्टी करने वाले व्यक्ति का बुध मंगल स्ट्रांग रहता है बृहस्पति सेट रहता है
says: He says the sharper your brain, the better you handle life, and that a person who parties and enjoys life has a strong Mercury and Mars, with Jupiter settled.
cells_derived_method: Strength of Mercury and Mars would come from own or exalted signs. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 3rd, lagna Cancer. Mercury is exalted, so quick wit and social ease.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th, lagna Aries. Mars is exalted, so energy and stamina for an active, social life.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 7th, lagna Sagittarius. Own sign, so an easy, talkative circle of friends and partners.

ambiguity: 'सेट रहता है' (stays set) is vague for Jupiter; it could mean calm or well placed.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury and Mars give wit and energy; the 'party person' link is his own.

hindi: कंफ्यूज लोग होते हैं बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब हो जाए पढ़ाई में कंसंट्रेशन उड़ जाती है
says: He says confused people are those whose Jupiter is disturbed, and that when Jupiter is disturbed concentration in studies flies away.
cells_derived_method: A disturbed Jupiter means debilitated, in an enemy sign, or afflicted; the study houses (4th, 5th) feel it most. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Jupiter is debilitated in the study house, a confused and unfocused mind.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. An enemy sign in the study house, so scattered attention and many half-finished subjects.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. An enemy sign in the school house, so early learning is disturbed by indecision.

ambiguity: 'डिस्टर्ब' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter is the karaka of intellect, and an afflicted Jupiter is linked with a confused mind.

gist: Says he will cover everything about studies in a separate class, and then do it planet by planet.
Audience asks whether ancestors' grace is available to everyone, or whether it suits only some, like an ishta devata.

hindi: सब पा सकते हैं पित्र कृपा गया जाओ श्राद्ध करके आओ
says: Remedy: everyone can receive the ancestors' grace; go to Gaya and perform the shraddha rite there.
classical_check: Agrees: shraddha at Gaya is a long-standing tradition for pitru peace.

gist: Someone says the rite has been done here and there; he answers that it must be in Gaya, where there is a certain black stone.
Starts the Gaya story: a black stone lies there, the line is cut and continues into the next line.
Finishes the story: Vishnu pressed down the demon Gayasur, and the black stone lying there is that stone.
Audience recalls a class remark that water offered here becomes urine for the ancestors there and asks what that means; the question is cut off.
Says that is the Trishanku story, to leave it, that it is all drama; he does not remember it and will take it separately next week.

hindi: ऐसा होता है जी वो तरीके की बात होती है हृदय से फीलिंग के साथ पितरों को श्रद्धा से किया जाए कि पितरों हमें बुलाओ तो पितर बुला भी लेंगे
says: Remedy detail: ancestor rites work when done the right way, from the heart, with feeling and reverence; if you ask the ancestors to call you, they will.
ambiguity: 'हमें बुलाओ' (call us) is not explained: it could mean guidance or a sign.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: shraddha means faith; texts stress the sincerity of the rite.

hindi: कुछ भी मत करो कुछ भी मत करो अर्जुन ने कुछ नहीं किया उसे कोई पता नहीं सब कृष्ण करता है छोड़ दो पितरों पर छोड़ना सीखो पितरों पर विश्वास रखो
says: He says do nothing yourself: like Arjuna, who did nothing and knew nothing because Krishna did it all, learn to leave it to the ancestors and trust them.
ambiguity: 'Do nothing' is an image of surrender; he does not forbid the rites just given.
classical_check: Silent: surrender to the ancestors is a devotional idea, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Says people do not trust their guru and call him a cheat, as Duryodhana called Krishna a trickster, and that Krishna or the guru would only kick them away.
Says you can make a stone into God, the way Dhanna Jat found God in a stone; one name in the caption is garbled.

hindi: आपका बिलीफ सिस्टम कितना स्ट्रंग है सारा खेल बिलीफ सिस्टम का है
says: He says the result depends on how strong your belief system is; the whole game is the belief system, so a remedy or devotion works as far as your faith lets it.
ambiguity: It does not say whether a remedy works with no belief at all.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts say a remedy needs shraddha (faith) to work.

gist: Says some people do not show respect or honour; the sentence is cut short.
Audience says the last two questions are about ancestors, and asks what combinations show pitru dosha in a chart that one cannot identify.

hindi: पहली बार शादी की बात चली छूट गई जॉब की पहली बार बात हुई छूट गई साला एक बार तो अटकता ही है
says: He gives life signs of pitru dosha: the first marriage proposal falls through, the first job offer is lost, and everything gets stuck once.
ambiguity: These are behavioural signs read from life; no planet or house is named. 'पहला ब मिसक हो गया' just before it is garbled.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not list 'first attempt fails' as a pitru-dosha sign.

hindi: मेरा एक बार में तो काम ही नहीं होता जी घर से भी दो बार निकल के जाता हूं चाबी भूल जाता हूं
says: More signs of pitru dosha: no work gets done in one go, and the person leaves home twice because he forgot the keys.
ambiguity: These are daily-life symptoms and not tied to any chart factor.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिससे मिलने जाता हूं पता नहीं रास्ते में लेट हो जाता हूं मेरा कोई काम पहली बार में नहीं होता
says: The last of the signs: you get late on the way to meet someone for no reason, and no task is done on the first attempt.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous line.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह पित दोष है 100% होके रहेगा यह यूनिवर्सल है
says: His verdict: these signs mean it is pitru dosha, a hundred percent, and he calls it universal.
ambiguity: 'यूनिवर्सल' could mean the rule always holds, or that the dosha is present in everyone to some degree. '100%' is rhetorical, not measured.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts diagnose pitru dosha from the chart (9th, Sun, Rahu), not from life symptoms.

hindi: इसकी पोटेंसी बहुत बढ़ जाती है अगर ग्रह नीच का हो पांचवें घर में या नीच दृष्टि हो शत्रु हो तो कम है इस तरह से चलता है
says: He says the strength of this dosha goes up a great deal if a planet is debilitated in the 5th house, or if a debilitated planet aspects it; if the planet is only in an enemy sign the effect is lower.
cells_derived_method: The debilitation sign depends on the planet; the cell is the sign where a given planet is debilitated in the 5th. Enemy-sign cells give the milder case. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 5th, lagna Gemini. The Sun is debilitated, so the strong form of the dosha (the Sun is the pitru karaka).
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. The Moon is debilitated, so the strong form.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 5th, lagna Sagittarius. Saturn is debilitated, so the strong form.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 5th, lagna Capricorn. The Sun is in an enemy sign, so the milder form.

ambiguity: 'नीच दृष्टि' is read as an aspect from a debilitated planet; it could also mean a bad aspect.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts judge a planet in the 5th by dignity and aspects, and pitru dosha by the Sun, but this exact strength scale is his own.

gist: Audience asks the next question, also about ancestors: he had said ancestors' photos can be placed in a certain direction to get their grace; is that generic or specific to a chart.

hindi: डव पित्रों का स्थान है
says: Vastu link: he says one direction is the place of the ancestors; the first word looks like a garbled 'south'.
ambiguity: 'डव' is read as 'साउथ'; the direction is not certain from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees if south: vastu gives the south to Yama and the ancestors.

hindi: वास्तु जो है वो फिक्स है ज्योतिष में वेरिएबल बहुत ज्यादा है
says: He contrasts the two sciences: vastu is fixed, while Jyotish has very many variables.
classical_check: Agrees: vastu zones are fixed for all, while a chart varies per person.

hindi: वास्तव में तो मालिक एक ही है साउथ ईस्ट का शुक्र नॉर्थ ईस्ट का मालिक ही बृहस्पति है
says: He says that in vastu each direction has a single owner: the south-east is Venus's and the north-east belongs to Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'साउथ ईस्ट का शुक्र' is read as 'Venus of the south-east'.
classical_check: Agrees: vastu gives the south-east to Venus and the north-east to Jupiter.

hindi: ज्योतिष में हो सकता है आपकी पढ़ाई शनि के पास है कि मंगल के पास है बुध के पास है बृहस्पति सबके पास कुछ भी हो सकता है
says: By contrast, in Jyotish he says the owner of a topic changes from chart to chart: your studies may be with Saturn, Mars, Mercury or Jupiter, anything is possible.
cells_derived_method: The planet who owns the study house depends on the sign in the 5th, so each lagna gives a different owner of studies. Derived from sign lordship, matching his four examples.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Studies belong to Saturn.
Derived: Aries in the 5th, lagna Sagittarius. Studies belong to Mars.
Derived: Gemini in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. Studies belong to Mercury.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo. Studies belong to Jupiter.

ambiguity: He does not say which house holds studies in this sentence; the 5th is taken from earlier in the lecture.
classical_check: Agrees: the lord of the 5th house gives the planet through which education is read.

hindi: आपके माता से संबंध गाड़ी लेने का तरीका किसके पास है पता ही नहीं
says: He says the same unknown owner applies to your relationship with your mother and the way you buy a car: you cannot tell which planet holds them without the chart.
cells_derived_method: The planet holding the 4th (mother and vehicle) depends on the sign in the 4th. Derived from sign lordship.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. Mother and vehicle belong to the Moon.
Derived: Aries in the 4th, lagna Capricorn. Mother and vehicle belong to Mars.
Derived: Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. Mother and vehicle belong to Venus.
Derived: Capricorn in the 4th, lagna Libra. Mother and vehicle belong to Saturn.

ambiguity: The 4th is not named in this sentence; the next sentence does it by the car and the sign number 4.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th house is the mother and vehicle house, read through its lord.

hindi: वास्तु में तो गाड़ी बताएंगे यहां पर राशि बताएगी इस घर की
says: He says vastu would only give a general rule for the car, while in Jyotish the sign in this house will give the specific answer for this native.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 4th would decide the car's colour and style. Derived from planet colours, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus (Venus) in the 4th, lagna Aquarius. White or cream colours and comfort-focused cars suit.
Derived: Sagittarius (Jupiter) in the 4th, lagna Virgo. Yellow, gold or large family cars suit.

ambiguity: The house is the vehicle house (4th) by the following sentence; here he says only 'इस घर की'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 4th lord and its sign guide vehicle matters in classical texts; the colour-by-sign is his own.

hindi: लाल रंग की गाड़ी अगर चार नंबर राशि और मंगल की राशि है अगर लाल गाड़ी लोगे ना ठो केगी य स्पेसिफिक हो गया कहानी लाल गाड़ी ले नहीं सकते आप
says: A specific example: if the vehicle house has a Mars sign, a red car will get banged up if you buy it, so such a native cannot take a red car.
cells_derived_method: By the same logic, other sign lords in the 4th would have their own unlucky colour. Derived by planet colour, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra (Venus) in the 4th, lagna Cancer. Venus is a benefic lord, so the red-car ban does not carry over; by his logic the lord's own white or cream would be fine.
Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 4th, lagna Libra. Saturn is a harsh lord like Mars, so by the same logic the lord's own black or dark blue would be the unlucky car colour.
Derived: Cancer (Moon) in the 4th, lagna Aries. The Moon is a gentle lord, so no colour ban follows by his logic; white or silver would be fine. This is the weakest guess.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर राशि और मंगल की राशि' may mean the 4th house with a Mars sign (Aries or Scorpio), or sign number 4 (Cancer) which is not Mars's; the first fits better. 'ठो केगी' is a garbled 'ठुकेगी' (will get hit).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no vehicle-colour rule.

hindi: मां को लाल रंग की साड़ी लाल रंग का कपड़ा लाल चीज न देके दे गिफ्ट करके देखो मां को मां के चरणों में डालो मां से संबंध खत्म हो जाएगा
says: He says that for such a native, giving the mother a red sari, red cloth or any red thing, even laying it at her feet, will end the relationship with the mother.
cells_derived_method: The colour that clashes would change with the sign lord in the 4th. Derived, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn (Saturn) in the 4th, lagna Libra. By the same logic the lord's own black or dark gifts would be the risk, since Saturn separates much as Mars cuts.
Derived: Cancer (Moon) in the 4th, lagna Aries. The Moon is a gentle lord, so by his logic white or silver gifts to the mother are fine and no colour ban follows.

ambiguity: It is not clear whether this is for everyone or only for the Mars-sign 4th house just mentioned; the colour is taken as stated for that case. The wording is sarcastic.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no rule on gifts of a colour to the mother.

hindi: काट देता है मंगल ऑपरेशन कराता है यूं मान के चलो आग लगाता है
says: He explains why: Mars cuts, causes operations and sets things on fire, so the red-coloured Mars item brings that effect.
ambiguity: 'आग लगाता है' is figurative; it may mean fire or conflict.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of cuts, surgery, fire and conflict.

gist: Says this is a very big khichdi, before returning to the audience question.

hindi: क्योंकि आपके पितर आपके ही है वो आप लगाओ आराम से लगाओ तो उसमें अगर आपका फिफ्थ हाउस खराब है इंडिविजुअल कुंडली में होता रहे उससे कोई फर्क नहीं है
says: Answering the question: placing the ancestors' photo is a generic remedy, because the ancestors are your own; put it up comfortably, and it makes no difference if your 5th house is bad in your individual chart.
ambiguity: It conflicts with his earlier link of pitru dosha to the 5th: here the 5th does not change the remedy.
classical_check: Silent: ancestor photos are a household custom and not a Jyotish remedy by chart.

hindi: वो वास्तु फिक्स है वास्तु में तो फिक्स ही है आप रसोई में बेडरूम बना नहीं पाओगे टॉयलेट बना नहीं सकते
says: He says vastu is fixed: you cannot make a bedroom in the kitchen spot or build a toilet wherever you like; each room has its fixed place.
ambiguity: It is a vastu point, not a chart point.
classical_check: Agrees: vastu fixes the zone for each room.

hindi: आप कहीं भी कुछ भी खेल सकते हो तो इससे में कांट्रडिक्ट नहीं करते दोनों एक दूसरे को
says: He says that since Jyotish lets you play with anything anywhere while vastu stays fixed, the two do not contradict each other.
ambiguity: The first words ('याय आप कहीं भी कुछ भी खेल सकते हो') are broken; the meaning is inferred from the contrast with fixed vastu.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कभी इसी इसी का तो बेबी है वास्तु
says: He says vastu is the baby of Jyotish: it grew out of it and belongs to the same family.
ambiguity: 'कभी' is a garbled word and 'इसी' presumably points to Jyotish.
classical_check: Partly agrees: vastu is an allied branch of the Vedic sciences, not a child of Jyotish in the classics.

hindi: वास्तु फुल फ्लेड देख ही नहीं सकता कोई वास्तु स्पेशलिस्ट बिना जन्मपत्री के जो लोग ठीक करा देते हैं वास्तु में सिर्फ
says: He says no vastu specialist can do a full vastu analysis without the birth chart; those who fix a house by vastu alone are only working half the picture, and the sentence breaks off.
ambiguity: The last words ('वास्तु में सिर्फ') are cut off.
classical_check: Silent: classical vastu texts do not require a birth chart.

hindi: नक्शा दे के व मोटे तौर पर होता है और वह भी बहुतों को काम करता है 80 पर
says: Vastu advice given just from a floor plan is done at a broad, rough level, and even that rough level works for many clients, which he puts at about 80 percent.
ambiguity: The first words are the tail of a sentence from the previous batch, so the subject (Vastu advice from a map) is inferred. '80 पर' is read as 80 percent; the caption does not say 80 percent of what (clients, cases or problems).
classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives a success rate for plan-based Vastu advice; this is his own experience claim.

hindi: दवाइया तो केमिस्ट्री देता ठीक कर देता है स्पेशलिस्ट के लिए जाना पड़ता है बड़ी समस्या के लिए डॉक्टर के पास कंसल्टेंसी
says: Medicine analogy for levels of remedy: ordinary medicines from a chemist cure common ailments, but a big problem needs a specialist doctor and a proper consultation. He uses it to say generic Vastu fixes cover ordinary problems while serious ones need individually studied advice.
ambiguity: The link from the medicine picture to Vastu is my reading of where he is heading; he does not spell it out in this sentence. It is an analogy only, no health claim is made.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not grade remedies into generic and specialist tiers; this is a teaching device of his own.

hindi: मोटे र पर तो वास्तु में नर्मल मेडिसिन करो आप फिट कोई दिक्कत नहीं है नर्मल करेक्शन होती है
says: At the broad level Vastu works like normal medicine: apply the standard, routine corrections and the person is 'fit' with no difficulty. Ordinary Vastu correction is routine and does not need special study.
ambiguity: 'मोटे र पर' is a caption slip for 'मोटे तौर पर' (broadly). 'आप फिट' could mean the client is fine afterwards or the advice 'fits'.
classical_check: Silent: Vastu Shastra texts give zone rules, not a normal-versus-special correction scheme.

hindi: कलर कलर थेरेपी से ठीक हो जाते है 50 पर केस
